title: Sales Executive
description:
**Description**
---------------

Arjunaa Jewellers is seeking a motivated Sales Executive to join our Sales team in Bengaluru. This full-time, on-site position offers an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals to build a rewarding career in the luxury goods and jewellery industry.

As a Sales Executive, you will engage with customers to understand their preferences, present our exquisite collection of jewellery, and deliver a personalised shopping experience that builds lasting relationships. You will work closely with the sales team to achieve targets and contribute to the continued growth of our brand.

We offer a monthly salary range of INR 15,000 - 60,000, depending on experience and performance, along with opportunities for professional development and career advancement within a respected jewellery brand.

### **Responsibilities**

* Greet and engage with customers to understand their jewellery preferences and requirements
* Present and demonstrate a wide range of jewellery products with expertise and enthusiasm
* Deliver a personalised and exceptional customer experience in-store
* Achieve individual and team sales targets consistently
* Recommend complementary products and suggest suitable pieces for special occasions
* Handle customer queries, concerns, and feedback professionally
* Maintain accurate records of sales, customer details, and transactions
* Keep the showroom organised, presentable, and well-stocked
* Stay updated on new collections, pricing, and market trends in the jewellery industry
* Build and maintain long-term relationships with repeat and loyal customers

### **Requirements**

* Graduate or diploma holder in any discipline
* 0-2 years of experience in sales, retail, or customer service (freshers are welcome)
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills in English, Hindi and Kannada
* Confident, polished, and customer-focused approach
* Goal-oriented mindset with a passion for sales
* Basic understanding of jewellery or luxury goods is an advantage
* Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and festive periods
* Strong attention to detail and a professional demeanour

title: VP - Global Rewards and Benefits Operations
description:
**Job Description :**

**About the Function:**

Global Business Operations keeps our business moving, connecting markets, streamlining processes and keeping everything running smoothly at scale.

With teams across Bangalore, Budapest, Bogotá, Gurugram. GBO delivers the essential services that support our day-to-day performance, from finance to operations and beyond. It’s a truly global environment, where collaboration across time zones and cultures is part of everyday life.

You’ll gain exposure to different markets, build skills for the future and develop a broad understanding of how a business operates at scale. It’s a great place to learn, grow and see the bigger picture.

**About the Role**

**Job Title: Head of Global Rewards and Benefits Operations**

**Level 4A, Vice President**

**Location: Bangalore**

**Reporting to: Head of People Experience**

**Top Accountabilities**

* Build, lead and continuously develop a high-performing Global Reward & Performance Operations team, creating a culture of accountability, service excellence, coaching, engagement and continuous improvement.
* Own the end-to-end delivery of Global Reward & Performance Operations services, ensuring a standardized, scalable, well-controlled and customer-focused operating model.
* Accountable for service catalogue management, service performance, KPIs, SLAs, capacity planning, operational governance and employee experience across all Reward & Performance operational services.
* Lead the delivery of critical global reward and performance processes, including Annual Reward Cycle, Global Calibration, Long-Term Incentive processes, Sales Incentive administration, Benchmarking, Benefits Administration, Pay Equity, Salary Survey submissions and associated governance activities.
* Drive standardization, simplification and operational excellence across global processes, reducing unnecessary local variation and improving consistency, efficiency and service quality.
* Continuously lead the transition of repeatable, transactional and operational Reward activities into the Global Business Services organization, ensuring robust SOPs, knowledge transfer, readiness planning and successful hypercare support.
* Establish clear operating interfaces between Reward Operations, Reward Advisory, Centres of Excellence, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Global Mobility and other stakeholders to ensure seamless execution and accountability.
* Own operational controls, audit readiness, compliance, risk management and data governance across Reward & Performance processes, including oversight of critical Workday and Payroll integrations.
* Partner with the Rewards Global Process Lead and with the Rewards COE, the identification and implementation of automation, analytics, reporting and technology solutions that improve productivity, reduce manual effort and provide enhanced management insight.
* Develop and maintain effective partnerships with external vendors and service providers, ensuring high-quality delivery, service performance and continuous improvement.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives through measurement, process optimisation, customer feedback and operational performance reviews.
* Support the evolution of the Reward operating model, including assessment of opportunities to integrate Compensation and Benefits operations into a unified Total Rewards service model aligned with the Reward Hub strategy.

**Top Accountabilities**

* Help to build and lead a high performing and highly engaged Global Reward and performance Operations team in Bangalore
* Drive and oversee ARC project delivery, Global Calibration, E-deltip, SIP, Benchmarking, Pay Equity projects and Salary Survey Submission including exceptional stakeholder management, financial control, application of governance and brilliant execution
* Application of Project Management Principles, ensuring adherence to Project Management methodology and tools
* Ensure that all required actions are executed in Workday (and other systems) to enable the Annual Reward Cycle
* Enable processes to ensure there is accurate data, effectively supporting the processes (ARC etc.)
* Partner with and deliver appropriate interventions for first point, HR Business Partners, Reward Managers, Executive Reward, Shares, Global Mobility, Process Governance, Payroll teams and others to ensure stakeholders are clear on their responsibilities for executing the Annual Reward Cycle and other processes and are fully equipped to perform their role
* Partner with Reward COE teams to align and discuss on critical priorities and take decisions on operational executions
* Partner with Payroll team to align on ways of working to ensure the Annual Reward Cycle payments are executed appropriately and with accuracy.
* Partner closely with Power BI and automation team to simplify the processes and reporting’s for wider audiences including HR teams.
* Partner with External vendors on Benchmarking and Pay equity projects/processes to appropriately run operations and achieve continues improvements

**Candidate requirements and qualifications**

* At least 12 years of progressive experience in global Reward and Performance Operations, HR Operations or HR service delivery, with substantial responsibility for compensation and reward processes.
* Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end annual reward and performance cycles, including global calibration, benchmarking, pay equity, salary survey submissions and incentive processes.

* Strong operational knowledge of Workday and its use in reward and performance processes, with the ability to translate business requirements into accurate, scalable system execution.
* Proven success in building, leading and developing high-performing teams in complex, global and highly matrixed organisations, with a strong focus on coaching, engagement and delivery resilience.
* Experience managing complex, deadline-critical programmes using disciplined project management, governance, financial control and risk management.
* Strong understanding of data governance, regulatory requirements, internal controls and the interdependencies between reward processes, HR systems and payroll.
* High level of numerical and analytical capability, with a track record of using data to identify risk, improve decisions and strengthen operational performance.
* Demonstrated ability to simplify and standardise processes, use automation and reporting effectively, and embed a culture of continuous improvement.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the credibility to partner with CHROs, senior HR leaders, Global Centres of Expertise, HR Business Partners, Payroll and other cross-functional teams across geographies.
* Ability to connect Reward and Performance Operations with the broader people strategy, including talent, workforce planning and regulatory priorities, while maintaining a strong focus on employee experience.
* Experience managing external partners and vendors against clear service, quality and commercial expectations.
* A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience is required; a recognised Reward, HR or project management qualification would be advantageous.

**Working with us**  
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
**We're hiring for Procurement Manager in Bengaluru Location.**

**Job Title:** Procurement Manager  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka (Work from Office)  
**Department:** Operations / Supply Chain & Procurement  
**Experience:** 4–10 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience and industry standards  
**Language Requirements:** Hindi and English (Fluency in both is mandatory)

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven and result-oriented **Procurement Manager** to lead and strengthen our procurement function at our Bengaluru office.

**Fluency in Hindi is mandatory**, as the role involves regular negotiations and direct communication with suppliers across Hindi-speaking markets, particularly in North and Central India.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Sourcing & Vendor Development**

* Identify, evaluate, negotiate with, and onboard domestic and international suppliers.
* Develop and maintain a strong, diversified vendor network across relevant product categories.
* Identify and develop suppliers across North and Central India.
* Establish vendor evaluation and categorization frameworks, including approved, preferred, development, and blacklisted vendors.
* Explore new sourcing opportunities through market research, industry networks, and trade events.
* Develop alternative sourcing options to minimize supplier dependency and supply chain risks.

**2. Vendor Negotiation & Commercial Management**

* Lead commercial negotiations covering pricing, payment terms, credit periods, volume discounts, and service-level agreements.
* Conduct competitive bidding, quotation comparisons, and commercial evaluations to ensure optimal procurement decisions.
* Negotiate and establish long-term supplier agreements and framework contracts.
* Build strategic vendor partnerships to achieve competitive pricing, better payment terms, and reliable supply commitments.
* Conduct periodic vendor performance evaluations based on pricing, quality, delivery timelines, and responsiveness.

**3. Procurement Operations & Order Management**

* Manage the complete procurement cycle, including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, order tracking, Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), invoice verification, and payment coordination.
* Ensure timely and accurate PO processing in alignment with business and operational requirements.
* Monitor open purchase orders and proactively coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries.
* Resolve procurement-related issues, including delayed supplies, quality rejections, short deliveries, and commercial discrepancies.
* Coordinate with logistics and finance teams for inbound shipments, import clearances, freight, and customs documentation.

**4. Cost Optimization & Budget Management**

* Drive procurement cost efficiency and achieve defined cost-saving targets.
* Monitor market and commodity price trends to identify strategic buying opportunities.
* Identify cost-reduction opportunities through supplier negotiations, alternate sourcing, bulk purchasing, and process improvements.
* Analyze procurement expenditure and identify opportunities for improved cost control.
* Prepare and present monthly procurement reports, cost-saving trackers, and budget variance analyses to management.

**5. Compliance, Documentation & Process Governance**

* Ensure proper maintenance of procurement records, including purchase orders, vendor agreements, quotations, GRNs, and invoices.
* Ensure adherence to internal procurement policies, GST requirements, and applicable import/export regulations.
* Maintain an accurate and updated vendor master database, including commercial and compliance details.
* Ensure procurement processes are transparent, well-documented, and audit-ready.
* Support internal audits and vendor due diligence activities.

**6. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Lead, guide, and develop the procurement team, including executives and coordinators.
* Establish clear performance objectives, KPIs, and accountability standards.
* Coordinate with operations, sales, logistics, finance, and other departments to ensure procurement alignment with business requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact for procurement-related decisions and escalations at the Bengaluru office.
* Develop and implement procurement SOPs to improve efficiency, transparency, and process consistency.
* Participate in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) discussions, providing inputs on supply availability, vendor risks, and procurement costs.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 4–10 years of relevant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial, distribution, or trading organizations will be preferred.
* **Fluency in Hindi and English (spoken and written) is mandatory.**
* Proven experience in domestic and international vendor management and commercial negotiations.
* Strong understanding of procurement processes, supplier development, and cost optimization.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including data analysis, cost comparisons, and reporting.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Tally, or equivalent.
* Good understanding of procurement documentation, GST compliance, and vendor management processes.
* Knowledge of import/export documentation and customs procedures will be an added advantage.
* Kannada proficiency will be an advantage for local vendor coordination in Bengaluru.

**Interested and qualified candidates are welcome to contact us or refer someone who is actively seeking employment. WhatsApp your Resume or contact to HR : 9042051861**

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

description:
Job description:

**Job Description: Outbound Sales & Lead Generation Executive**

**Experience:** 4–5 Years  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Department:** Sales & Business Development  
**Industry:** Corporate Gifting / B2B Sales

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Business Development Executive with 4–5 years of experience in outbound sales, field sales, and B2B lead generation. The candidate will be responsible for independently identifying potential corporate clients, conducting client visits, building business relationships, and generating qualified leads for the inbound sales team to take forward.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable with fieldwork, cold outreach, client meetings, and independently developing new business opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Outbound Lead Generation:** Independently identify and generate new business leads through cold calling, field visits, networking, referrals, and direct client outreach.
* **Field Sales & Client Visits:** Visit corporate offices, businesses, and potential clients to identify gifting requirements and explore business opportunities.
* **Corporate Client Acquisition:** Identify and approach decision-makers such as HR managers, procurement teams, administration heads, marketing teams, and business owners.
* **Lead Qualification:** Understand client requirements, budgets, purchase timelines, and gifting needs to qualify leads before passing them to the inbound sales team.
* **Lead Handover:** Maintain accurate lead details and share qualified leads with the inbound sales team for follow-up, proposal discussions, and closure.
* **Market Research:** Identify target industries, corporate gifting opportunities, potential accounts, and new business segments.
* **Relationship Building:** Establish and maintain relationships with prospective clients to create opportunities for repeat business and referrals.
* **Sales Pipeline Management:** Maintain a database of prospects, track outreach activities, update lead status, and ensure timely follow-ups.
* **Target Achievement:** Meet assigned targets for qualified leads, client visits, prospecting activities, and business opportunities generated.
* **Market Feedback:** Gather insights on customer requirements, competitor offerings, pricing expectations, and market trends, and share them with the sales team.
* **Internal Coordination:** Coordinate with the inbound sales team to ensure a smooth handover of leads and provide relevant client information.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 4–5 years of experience in B2B sales, field sales, outbound sales, or business development.
* Proven experience in independently generating leads and acquiring new prospects through outbound activities.
* Experience in corporate sales, corporate gifting, promotional merchandise, FMCG, or related B2B industries would be an advantage.
* Strong communication, negotiation, networking, and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable conducting regular field visits and meeting prospective corporate clients.
* Ability to identify decision-makers and generate qualified business opportunities.
* Good organizational skills and the ability to maintain lead databases and sales reports.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and capable of working independently.
* Familiarity with CRM tools and lead management processes is preferred.

**Performance Expectations**

* Consistent generation of qualified outbound leads.
* Achievement of assigned field visit and prospecting targets.
* Quality and relevance of leads handed over to the inbound sales team.
* Development of a strong corporate prospect database.
* Effective follow-ups and accurate reporting of sales activities.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is someone who can independently go into the market, identify potential corporate customers, approach decision-makers, and generate genuine business opportunities without relying solely on inbound enquiries. The role is focused primarily on **outbound prospecting and field-based lead generation**, with qualified leads handed over to the inbound sales team for further conversion.

title: Associate Growth Account Manager, ANZ
description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

  

**How you'll make impact**
--------------------------

As an Associate Growth Account Manager, SME & Growth, you’ll own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of ambitious ANZ businesses, helping customers get more value from Airwallex by increasing product adoption, strengthening relationships and identifying sustainable growth opportunities.

You’ll combine account planning, customer engagement and end-to-end commercial ownership across Airwallex’s product suite, including business accounts, payments, spend management, treasury and API-enabled solutions. You’ll build trusted relationships with founders, finance leaders, operators and other senior decision-makers, while partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Solutions, Operations, Risk and Compliance to deliver strong customer outcomes.

You’ll identify, develop and close upsell, cross-sell and expansion opportunities; manage complex commercial negotiations; use customer, product and commercial data to prioritise your portfolio; and maintain disciplined pipeline management and accurate forecasting in Salesforce. This is a scaled, high-velocity role where you’ll manage a large book of business and create focused, repeatable ways to drive customer value and growth.

You’ll work from our Bangalore, India office five days a week.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

### **Essentials**

* 2+ years of experience in account management, relationship management or sales, ideally selling a technical product, SaaS platform, payments solution or other financial technology. Candidates with 5+ years of relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
* Experience managing a large book of business and driving growth across a high-volume portfolio (for example, 500–1,000+ accounts).
* A proven track record of meeting or exceeding commercial targets and delivering against revenue, gross profit or other relevant KPIs.
* Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to understand customer strategies and pain points, uncover opportunities and articulate compelling value propositions.
* Demonstrated experience managing sales cycles, including upsell, cross-sell, renewal or expansion opportunities from identification through close.
* Experience managing multi-product accounts and developing account strategies that drive retention, adoption and expansion.
* Strong analytical and commercial judgement, with the ability to use data to prioritise accounts, identify opportunities and plan effective customer engagement.
* Exceptional verbal and written English, with the ability to communicate confidently with technical, commercial and executive stakeholders.
* Strong negotiation, problem-solving, networking, relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
* Curiosity about customers and their businesses, with the ability to ask thoughtful questions, understand underlying needs and connect those needs to practical solutions.
* A resourceful, efficient approach to problem-solving, with resilience, a positive attitude and a strong bias towards action when navigating customer or internal blockers.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

### **Preferred**

* Experience working with customers in professional services, consulting, accounting, marketing, education, travel or healthcare.
* Experience in fintech, payments, SaaS or another fast-growing technology business.
* Familiarity with APIs, integrations or technical solution selling, and the aptitude to learn complex products and customer requirements.
* Experience managing or selling products such as payments, foreign exchange, business accounts, cards, expense management, bill pay or treasury.
* Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM.
* Experience leading commercial negotiations involving multiple products, senior stakeholders, procurement, legal or other review processes.
* Experience using customer or transactional data to diagnose opportunities and improve account performance.
* Comfort operating in a high-growth environment with evolving priorities, high standards and meaningful ownership.
* A curious, commercially minded approach and a willingness to continuously deepen your product and industry knowledge.

**You'll thrive here if**
-------------------------

* You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.
* You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.
* You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office five days a week.
* You own the outcome and don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.
* You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team.
* You stay curious about customers, take initiative to work through challenges and focus on making progress efficiently.

**Learn more about your team**
------------------------------

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

-------------------------------------------------------------

All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. title: Manager, Inbound Sales, SME & Growth, SG
description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

  

**Manager, Inbound Sales, SEA**
-------------------------------

### **How you’ll make impact**

Airwallex is scaling its inbound sales capability for Southeast Asia through its Bangalore hub. You’ll lead a team of ISRs who own the full funnel for SME clients sourced via Marketing and Partnerships. That runs from lead assignment to qualification, pitch, onboarding, and ramp-up to qualified volumes.

You’ll build a hungry, self-starting team that moves fast and works with discipline. You’ll set the standard for speed, urgency, and Salesforce hygiene, and you’ll turn high inbound volume into revenue in the shortest possible time.

* Build, hire, and develop a high-performing ISR team defined by hustle, speed, and ambition.
* Own team performance across lead response time, qualification, conversion, closed-won deals, ramp to qualified volumes, revenue contribution, and forecast quality.
* Drive daily operating discipline: lead-clearing SLAs, follow-up cadences, and structured workflows that maximise output and quality.
* Enforce Salesforce hygiene as the source of truth. Make sure every rep prioritises leads and manages their pipeline from accurate data and forecasting.
* Improve qualification frameworks, sales processes, and GTM execution to increase conversion and accelerate deals to activation.
* Coach reps through discovery, value-selling, negotiation, closing, onboarding, and ramp-up. Develop independent sellers who find the shortest path to an activated, transacting client without waiting for instructions.
* Own the feedback loop with Marketing and Partnerships to improve top-of-funnel lead quality and channel performance.
* Establish structured collaboration between the Bangalore team, Javen Tan, and regional SME & Growth sales teams supporting SEA.
* Partner with Revenue Operations, Revenue Enablement, Product, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Onboarding, and Account Management to improve customer experience, handover quality, and sales execution.
* Use call reviews, pipeline inspections, deal reviews, win-loss analysis, and feedback loops to raise individual and team performance.

This is an in-office role, and you’ll be in our Bangalore office five days a week.

### **What we’re looking for**

**Essentials**

* At least 5 years of hands-on experience as a sales rep in inbound, inside sales, ISR, SDR, or high-velocity B2B sales, plus at least 3 years managing and developing a team of sales reps.
* Experience leading a high-velocity inbound team, with a track record of hustle and operational excellence in a fast-paced, high-lead-volume environment.
* A proven track record of hiring, coaching, and developing sales talent, particularly self-starters and early-career sellers.
* Demonstrated success managing sales performance across lead conversion, revenue, ramped volumes, pipeline, and forecast targets.
* Deep understanding of full-cycle B2B sales: qualification, discovery, value-selling, negotiation, closing, onboarding, and activation.
* Strong command of Salesforce and sales engagement tools (such as Outreach), with the discipline to enforce CRM hygiene, pipeline reporting, and forecasting.
* Experience working with distributed teams and stakeholders across multiple countries or time zones.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience selling to SMEs, founders, finance leaders, or finance teams.
* Experience in payments, FX, cards, treasury, spend management, lending, or complex B2B SaaS.
* Experience supporting Singapore or broader Southeast Asian markets.
* Experience with marketing- or partnership-sourced funnels and GTM feedback loops.
* Experience implementing automation or AI-assisted sales workflows while maintaining quality and compliance controls.

### **You’ll thrive here if**

* You have a track record of hitting your numbers and you’re motivated by stretch goals.
* You’re hungry and ambitious, and you want to build a team that is too.
* You have a strong sense of urgency, you move fast, and you hold your team to the same standard.
* You’re a self-starter who owns the outcome and doesn’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.
* You believe discipline and structure create speed, and you can build the operating rhythm to prove it.
* You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally.
* You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office five days a week.
* You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you’re thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

### **Learn more about your team**

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You’re not selling a feature. You’re helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It’s a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*

**Equal opportunity**

Help the CEO manage time, information, communication, meetings, travel, priorities and follow-through.

### **Chief of Staff / Business Execution**

Help translate CEO priorities into action across the company, coordinate senior leaders, drive strategic initiatives and prepare the CEO for important decisions.

Because HBox primarily operates in the United States, this role will be based in Bengaluru but will operate substantially during overlapping U.S. business hours.

This is an important part of the position.

The person should expect to work with the CEO and U.S. leadership team **every working day**, rather than simply joining occasional evening calls.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Run the CEO Office**
-------------------------

Build and run a disciplined operating rhythm around the CEO so nothing important slips through the cracks. You’ll keep a clear, up-to-date view of:

* CEO priorities and key decisions
* Delegated items and follow-ups
* Upcoming meetings and important deadlines
* Customer and board commitments
* Strategic initiatives and recruiting priorities
* Key relationships

Rather than waiting for direction, you’ll anticipate what needs the CEO’s attention and bring it forward at the right time.

**2. Calendar & Priority Management**
-------------------------------------

Own the CEO’s calendar and make sure it reflects what matters most. You’ll:

* Actively manage scheduling and protect the CEO’s time for the highest-value work
* Coordinate meetings across U.S., India, and other international time zones
* Respond in real time to schedule changes, shifting priorities, and emerging issues

Because you’ll partner with the CEO daily, this role requires availability during U.S. business hours.

**3. Daily CEO Coordination**
-----------------------------

Maintain a highly effective daily operating cadence with the CEO.

The goal is to develop enough context that the individual increasingly anticipates what the CEO needs before being asked.

**4. Meeting Preparation**
--------------------------

Make sure the CEO walks into every important meeting fully prepared. You’ll build briefings and background materials for:

* Leadership meetings and strategic planning sessions
* Board meetings and investor discussions
* Customer and partnership discussions
* Candidate interviews

**5. Leadership Team Coordination**
-----------------------------------

Partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Operations, Clinical, Patient Engagement, Marketing, and HR to keep the leadership team aligned and moving forward. You’ll:

* Track decisions and commitments made in leadership meetings
* Follow up with owners to keep work on track and deadlines met
* Escalate issues when needed

You’re comfortable holding senior executives accountable while building strong, trusted working relationships.

**6. Strategic Projects**
-------------------------

Own and drive select CEO-led initiatives from first question to final recommendation. You’ll take on open-ended strategic questions, like *“Should HBox enter this market?”*, and bring structure and clarity to them by:

* Defining the key questions to answer
* Scoping and conducting the needed research
* Gathering and analyzing relevant data
* Developing strategic options
* Assessing financial implications and risks
* Delivering a clear, well-supported recommendation

**7. CEO Decision Support**
---------------------------

Turn complex information into clear, actionable recommendations so the CEO can make fast, well-informed decisions. Rather than passing along raw documents and email threads, you’ll synthesize the inputs, frame the options, lay out the trade-offs, and make a recommendation, such as: *“Here are three options and their trade-offs. I recommend Option B, and here’s why.”*

**8. Board & Investor Support**
-------------------------------

Help prepare the CEO and leadership team for board meetings and investor discussions. Responsibilities may include:

* Coordinating board materials and gathering updates from each function
* Reviewing presentations and preparing CEO talking points
* Tracking board requests and managing follow-ups
* Maintaining key board documentation

This role works with highly confidential company information and requires exceptional discretion and judgment

**9. Executive Communication**
------------------------------

Help the CEO communicate clearly and effectively with every audience. You’ll draft and refine:

* Internal emails and leadership communications
* Customer, board, and investor communications
* Candidate outreach
* Meeting summaries and presentations

Excellent written and spoken English is essential. You’re comfortable and credible engaging with senior U.S.-based executives, customers, physicians, investors, and partners.

**10. Travel & Logistics**
--------------------------

Plan and coordinate the CEO’s travel, including international trips, with a focus on making the most of the CEO’s time and productivity. Responsibilities may include:

* Booking flights, hotels, and ground transportation
* Building itineraries and coordinating schedules and meeting logistics
* Managing last-minute changes

Occasional travel within India or internationally may be required.

**Working Hours (Important Requirement****)**
=============================================

HBox is primarily a U.S.-focused business, and our Founder & CEO and senior leadership work U.S. business hours. This role is based in Bengaluru and is built around daily overlap with the U.S. workday, especially Central and Eastern time zones.

**Typical schedule:** about 3:00/4:00 PM to 12:00/1:00 AM IST. Exact hours may shift with daylight saving time, CEO travel, and business needs.

This gives you 5–6+ hours of real-time overlap each day so you can:

* Work directly with the CEO in real time
* Join leadership meetings and key customer discussions
* Coordinate directly with U.S. executives
* Respond to issues and finish follow-ups while U.S. teams are online

This isn’t an occasional late-night call. Daily U.S. overlap is a core, everyday part of the job. If you’re looking for a standard 9 AM–6 PM India schedule, this role isn’t the right fit.

We’re also committed to sustainable hours. You won’t be expected to routinely work both a full India workday and a full U.S. workday.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

* **Exceptional organization:** You juggle dozens of priorities at once without losing track of the details.
* **Strong business judgment:** You know what deserves the CEO’s attention and what doesn’t, and when to escalate, delegate, or handle it yourself.
* **Intellectual curiosity:** You quickly get up to speed on unfamiliar industries, technologies, financial concepts, and business problems.
* **High ownership:** Your instinct is “How do I get this done?” and not “Whose job is this?”
* **Bias for action:** You spot problems early and fix them before they become urgent.
* **Strong analytical skills:** You’re comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets, business metrics, and structured problem-solving.
* **Excellent communication:** You engage confidently with senior executives, physicians, customers, investors, board members, employees, and external partners.
* **Persistence:** You follow up as many times as it takes to get things done.
* **Low ego:** You’re as comfortable building a strategic analysis as you are fixing a calendar conflict or travel issue. No task is beneath you.
* **Discretion:** You’ll handle highly confidential business and personal information. Trust and integrity are non-negotiable.

**Ideal Background**

We’re flexible about your exact path. Strong candidates often come from:

* Chief of Staff, Founder’s Office, or CEO Office roles
* Senior Executive Assistant roles
* Strategy and operations, or business operations
* Management consulting or investment banking
* Startup operations
* Program management

**Qualifications**

* About 6–10 years of professional experience (we’ll consider exceptional candidates outside this range)
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA a plus but not required
* Experience working directly with U.S.-based executives or customers is highly preferred
* Background in healthcare, technology, SaaS, startups, or U.S.-focused businesses is a plus but not required

**AI & Technology Orientation**
===============================

HBox is becoming an increasingly AI-driven company, and the CEO Office should lead the way. You’re highly comfortable using AI and modern productivity tools for:

* Research, market analysis, and competitive analysis
* Meeting preparation and summaries
* Documents, presentations, and email drafting
* Data analysis and information organization
* Workflow automation

You’re always asking, “How can technology help us do this faster and better?”

**Location**
============

**Bengaluru, India.**

We strongly prefer someone who can work substantially in person with the CEO and India team when required.

The role can have some hybrid flexibility, but this is not intended to be a permanently remote administrative position.

title: Executive Assistant, Office of the Audit Operations
description:
### **bout Discover Dollar**

Discover Dollar is an AI-native company that helps large enterprises across the US and Canada find and recover money lost through overpayments, contract non-compliance and profit leakage in accounts payable. We turn transaction data into validated claims and recover that value from suppliers, across retail, manufacturing, CPG, healthcare and insurance.

### **About the Role**

The Head of Audit runs Discover Dollar’s audit organization, the company’s largest team. It has 60+ people across two offices, one in Bangalore and one in Mangalore serving Fortune Global 500 clients. The role covers audit development for new clients, support for delivery teams, operational insights for Sales and Marketing, and plans to scale the audit organization while keeping costs low.

You will be the Head of Audit’s high-trust partner. Your job: **turn ideas into plans, and drive plans to closure.** You will run the operating rhythm of the audit organization, keep key metrics current and in one place, and manage the Head of Audit’s time and communication so they can focus on clients, audit development and leadership decisions.

You will act with authority delegated by the Head of Audit on cadence and follow-through. You will raise slipping work directly with them.

This is not a recovery-audit execution role. You will not be auditing transactions. You will be making sure the organization that does it runs well.

### **What You Will Do**

**1. Operating rhythm and program management (~40%)**

* Turn discussions and ideas into action plans with owners, milestones and deadlines
* Build and maintain trackers for client initiatives and internal programs, including new-client audit setup
* Run weekly and monthly reviews: agenda, pre-reads, notes, action items and follow-ups
* Chase actions to closure, and flag risks and slippage early
* Coordinate with audit team leads, the data and analytics team, and other functions to unblock work

**2. Metrics and reporting (~20%)**

* Maintain a single, trusted view of key metrics: spend reviewed, claims pipeline, recoveries, delivery health and key risks. The source systems stay with their owners.
* Publish a weekly metrics pack at a fixed time
* Prepare documents and decks for internal reviews, client updates and leadership updates
* Package operational insights for Sales and Marketing, and support analysis for scale and cost planning

**3. Executive support (~30%)**

* Own the Head of Audit’s calendar: plan and sequence meetings, prevent conflicts and protect focus time
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including across US and Canadian time zones, with the right people, context and materials in place
* Manage inbox and communication:
  + Draft updates and summaries on the Head of Audit’s behalf
  + Send routine scheduling and internal follow-ups independently
  + Get sign-off before anything client-facing, anything involving numbers, or anything that makes a commitment
* Keep priorities, meeting notes, decision logs and follow-up threads organized
* Handle logistics when needed: travel, expense submissions, room bookings and client-meeting arrangements

**4. People and org programs (~10%)**

* Coordinate hiring
* Track performance-review timelines, training plans and team development programs

### **What Success Looks Like**

**By day 30**

* You understand the audit lifecycle end to end: data intake claim identification validation supplier submission recovery
* The initiative tracker covers every active program
* The weekly rhythm is running

**By day 60**

* Pre-reads go out at least 24 hours before every leadership review
* The weekly metrics pack goes out on time every week
* The Head of Audit’s metric questions get answered the same day

**By day 90**

* At least 85% of tracked action items close on time
* There are zero calendar conflicts, and 30% of the Head of Audit’s week is protected focus time
* The Head of Audit spends noticeably less time chasing updates

### **Who You Are**

**Must have**

* **Strong writing:** you turn messy notes into clear actions and crisp updates
* **Structured follow-through:** you plan, track and close without being reminded
* **Comfort with numbers:** you build trackers and basic reports, and you spot what doesn’t add up
* **Spreadsheet skills:** pivots, XLOOKUP and basic charts in Excel and Google Sheets, plus comfort with slides and docs
* **AI-native habits:** you use AI assistants every day to research, draft and analyze faster
* **Composure with senior leaders:** you can push for clarity and push back with tact
* **Discretion:** you will handle sensitive information, including hiring, performance reviews and client and supplier financial data
* **Adaptability:** you’re comfortable when priorities shift often, and you learn new tools quickly (Notion, Google Workspace, dashboards, audit platforms)

**Good to have**

  

* Exposure to audit, finance operations, procurement, AP or recovery audit
* Experience working with data or BI teams to build simple metrics
* Experience supporting a CXO or function head with calendar, meetings and communication

**Background:** any graduate or postgraduate degree. You might come from operations, consulting, program management, analytics, or an EA or business-support role where you managed a senior leader’s calendar and communication.

### **Working Hours**

* On-site in Bangalore, with daily direct work alongside the Head of Audit
* Because our clients are in the US and Canada, some evening overlap (IST) is expected

description:
This role will be based in the WRI Country Office in any of the offices in India. This is a hybrid position. You will need to be in office at least 8 days per month and living within reasonable commuting distance of the office. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.

**About us:**

WRI works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature, and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyze change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities.

Founded in 1982, our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations

**About the Program:**

The CRM Team sits within the WRI IT Department. The WRI IT Department is responsible for managing the procurement, use and maintenance of all electronic equipment by the Institute. It is responsible for providing the infrastructure and technology for automation and operational efficiencies across the enterprise. It implements the governance for the use of network and operating systems, and it assists the Business units by providing the required tools and functionality. It is a part of Global Operations Team which ensures efficiency of operations and consistency of practices throughout the WRI network.

The CRM Team is responsible for administering WRI's Salesforce instance and supporting WRI staff with its use for tracking of constituent engagement, fundraising, and similar activities.

**Job Highlight:**

Reporting to the CRM Associate Director, the Salesforce SME will serve as a senior business and technical analysis resource for the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Salesforce SME serves as the strategic owner and subject matter expert for WRI's Salesforce ecosystem, driving platform governance, business process optimization, data integrity, user adoption, and technology-enabled impact across global programs. This role partners with stakeholders across Development, Programs, Finance, Operations, Communications, and IT to ensure Salesforce effectively supports fundraising, donor management, grants management, program delivery, reporting, and organizational decision making.

**What will you do:**

This role combines business analysis, process improvement, Salesforce administration, reporting, data management, user support, and platform governance to ensure Salesforce effectively supports organizational objectives.

**Salesforce Solution Design & Process Development (60%)**

* Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solution approaches in partnership with the CRM team and technical resources.
* Evaluate solution options based on business requirements, Salesforce capabilities, usability, scalability, maintainability, and organizational best practices, prioritizing existing functionality before introducing new configuration or custom development.
* Analyze impacts and dependencies across Salesforce objects, fields, automation, security, reporting, integrations, and existing functionality.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Flows.
* Oversee Salesforce integrations with enterprise platforms including ERP, Finance, HR, Marketing, Collaboration, and Data Management systems.

* Partner with integration teams and vendors to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable data exchange.
* Manage integration, governance, monitoring, issue resolution, and system dependencies.
* Partner with CRM leadership to align NPSP capabilities and solutions with organizational strategy.

**Salesforce Strategy, Governance & Platform Ownership (20%)**

* Serve as the organization's primary Salesforce Subject Matter Expert and trusted advisor for CRM and related business systems.
* Establish and maintain platform governance, standards, security controls, data quality frameworks, and release management processes.
* Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and improved data-driven decision making.
* Ensure platform scalability, sustainability, compliance, and alignment with enterprise architecture principles.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to improve program delivery, constituent engagement, fundraising effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
* Support innovation initiatives that improve organizational effectiveness and user experience.
* Support and optimize nonprofit business processes including:
  + Donor and constituent management
  + Grant management and grant lifecycle tracking
  + Program and project monitoring
  + Impact measurement and reporting
* Leverage Salesforce Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP), Nonprofit Cloud, and related solutions, where applicable.

**Data Management, Reporting & Analytics (20%)**

* Establish data governance standards, data quality processes, and data practices.Drive improvements in reporting, dashboarding, KPI tracking, and executive analytics.
* Enable consistent reporting across fundraising, programmatic, operational, and financial activities.
* Support data migration, cleansing, deduplication, and ongoing system optimization initiatives.
* Ensure alignment between fundraising, program delivery, and reporting processes across the organization.
* Support data structures and workflows required for philanthropic reporting and donor stewardship.

**What will you need:**

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Technology, or related field.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Salesforce Advanced Administrator
* Salesforce Certified Agentforce Nonprofit Consultant
* Salesforce Platform App Builder, Salesforce Certified Platform Integration Architect, Salesforce Certified Platform Developer,

**Experience:**

* 8-12+ years of experience in Salesforce administration, business analysis, CRM strategy, or enterprise applications leadership.
* Proven experience serving as a Salesforce SME, product owner, platform owner, or CRM leader.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, LWC, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and integration patterns.
* Experience supporting nonprofit, NGO, foundation, international development, membership, or mission-driven organizations preferred.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP), Nonprofit Cloud, fundraising, donor management, grants management, and constituent engagement processes.
* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Reports & Dashboards, Flows, and platform automation.
* Strong understanding of CRM governance, data management, security models, reporting, and user adoption strategies.
* Experience managing enterprise integrations, vendors, implementation partners, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and strategic planning skills.
* Experience working in global, matrixed, and geographically distributed organizations.
* Familiarity with fundraising or nonprofit Development operations is helpful but not required.

**Languages:** You have verbal and written proficiency in English. Additional language proficiency relevant to WRI’s global work is an asset.

**Requirements:** Existing work authorization is required where this position is based. WRI is unable to authorize visa work authorization.

**Potential Salary and Benefits: INR 26,00,000 to 34,00,000 INR CTC Per Annum**

Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills and internal parity. WRI offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package.

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Sales Counsellor / Aesthetic Clinic Counsellor**

**Location:** Sarjapur Road, Bengaluru  
**Industry:** Dermatology, Skin, Hair & Aesthetic Treatments  
**Employment Type:** Full-time | 6 days a week

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, confident and target-driven **Sales Counsellor** to join our skin and aesthetic clinic.

This is a revenue-focused role. The counsellor will be responsible for converting enquiries and leads into consultations and treatments, counselling clients on suitable treatment plans, following up consistently, and ensuring that the clinic meets its daily, weekly and monthly revenue targets.

The ideal candidate should be an excellent communicator, comfortable discussing premium aesthetic treatments, persistent with follow-ups, highly organised and able to take ownership of numbers rather than wait for clients to walk in.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales & Revenue**

* Take ownership of the clinic's **daily, weekly and monthly revenue targets**.
* Follow up aggressively and consistently on new leads, enquiries, past consultations and existing clients.
* Convert incoming leads from calls, WhatsApp, digital campaigns, social media and other sources into clinic appointments.
* Counsel clients on relevant skin, hair, laser and aesthetic treatments based on their concerns and the doctor's recommendations.
* Explain treatment plans, packages, pricing, offers and payment options clearly and confidently.
* Identify opportunities for **cross-selling, upselling and treatment upgrades** without compromising the client's experience or clinical appropriateness.
* Follow up with clients who have consulted but not yet purchased or started treatment.
* Reactivate dormant clients and encourage repeat treatments, maintenance plans and package renewals.
* Track upcoming package expiries, incomplete treatment plans and potential repeat business.

**Lead Management & Follow-up**

* Respond promptly to all incoming leads and enquiries.
* Maintain a disciplined follow-up system so that no potential client is lost because of delayed or missed communication.
* Understand the client's concern, establish intent and guide them towards booking a consultation or treatment.
* Maintain detailed notes on every lead, including treatment interest, objections, follow-up dates and conversion status.
* Handle common objections around pricing, treatment concerns, downtime and decision-making confidently and professionally.

**Client Counselling**

* Build rapport quickly and make clients feel comfortable discussing aesthetic concerns.
* Explain treatments in simple, easy-to-understand language.
* Work closely with doctors, nurses and therapists to recommend the right treatment journey for each client.
* Ensure that counselling is persuasive and commercially effective while remaining ethical and aligned with medical recommendations.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to improve retention, referrals and repeat business.

**Reporting & Organisation**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, consultations, conversions and revenue.
* Prepare and update **daily, weekly and monthly sales reports**.
* Review the sales pipeline daily and prioritise high-potential leads.
* Maintain client information and follow-up schedules accurately in the clinic CRM/software or designated trackers.
* Provide regular updates to the Management on performance against targets.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Performance will be measured on:

* Monthly clinic revenue achievement
* Individual revenue contribution
* Lead-to-appointment conversion
* Consultation-to-sale conversion
* Follow-up effectiveness
* Repeat and renewal business
* Cross-sell and upsell revenue
* Reactivation of existing/dormant clients
* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting
* Client experience and feedback

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly sales-driven and target-oriented**
* Extremely proactive and persistent with follow-ups
* Confident speaking to clients over phone, WhatsApp and in person
* An excellent communicator with strong persuasion and negotiation skills
* Comfortable asking for the sale and closing conversations
* Well organised and disciplined about maintaining follow-up records
* Comfortable working with daily, weekly and monthly targets
* Able to analyse their own pipeline and identify what needs to be done to achieve the target
* Presentable, professional and client-focused
* Able to work independently and take ownership rather than wait for instructions
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced clinic environment

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Minimum **4-5 years of experience in sales, counselling or client conversion**.
* Previous experience in an **aesthetic clinic, dermatology clinic, cosmetic surgery centre, wellness clinic, premium salon or healthcare sales environment** is strongly preferred.
* Experience selling premium treatments, packages or high-value services will be an advantage.
* Strong spoken English is essential. Knowledge of Hindi and/or Kannada is an advantage.
* Basic proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, WhatsApp and CRM or clinic management software is required.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

A successful counsellor does not simply respond to enquiries. They actively manage the clinic's sales pipeline every day.

They know which leads need to be called, which clients are close to converting, which consultations need follow-up, which existing clients can be reactivated and where the revenue required to achieve the month's target will come from.

The role requires **ownership, urgency, organisation and strong closing ability**, along with the ability to build genuine trust with clients.

**Company Description** Kosmoderma Skin, Hair & Body Clinics is South India’s leading chain of dermatology clinics, founded in 2006 by internationally renowned cosmetic dermatologist Dr. Chytra V Anand. The clinics focus on both cosmetic and general dermatology, supported by international accreditations and advanced facilities. Kosmoderma offers scientifically proven treatments using US FDA-approved technology, with products tested through extensive research and trials in the USA, Europe, and India. The organization’s vision is to provide safe, effective, and affordable procedures with an exceptional client experience while maintaining gold standards. Kosmoderma promotes a culture of helping clients become the best version of themselves through professional, ethical care.

title: Distributor Account Manager
description:
**Distributor Account Manager – Digital Industries, India**

**Location:** Pune, Delhi, Bangalore (and other primary industrial hubs)

**Purpose:**

Define and drive the regional Distribution Channel Strategy for Siemens Digital Industries (DI). Achieve aggressive sales growth, expand market share, and hit regional revenue targets by cultivating high-performing, profitable, and strategic industrial distribution partnerships. As the primary commercial relationship owner, the Distributor Account Manager is responsible for driving both primary sales (Sell-in: Siemens to Distributor) and secondary sales (Sell-through / POS: Distributor to local machine builders/OEMs, panel builders, System Integrators, contractors, and industrial MRO accounts). The role orchestrates channel expansion into emerging industrial clusters, maintains strict commercial and inventory discipline (stock turns, DOH, buffer stock), mitigates channel conflicts, and leads distributor sales and technical enablement. By aligning partner competencies with Siemens' industry-leading automation, PLC, and drive technologies and digitalization solutions, the Distributor Account Manager strengthens local market reach, elevates brand shelf-space, and ensures consistent, scalable business growth across the assigned territory.

**Main Responsibilities:**

**1. Distribution Channel Strategy, Network Planning & Partner Governance**

* **Formulate & Execute Distribution Strategy:** Develop and implement comprehensive annual regional distribution business plans (ABP) tightly aligned with the Digital Industries portfolio

* **Distributor Network Mapping & White-Spot Expansion:** Continually assess regional industrial coverage; map industrial clusters to identify geographic and vertical white spots; recruit, onboard, and develop specialized automation and drive distributors to maximize local market penetration.

* **Commercial Governance & Agreement Structuring:** Establish and govern annual distributor commercial agreements, credit terms, tiered discount structures, Special Price Agreements (SPAs), and performance-linked quarterly/annual growth rebates to drive profitable volume growth.

* **Channel Mindshare & Shelf-Space Ownership:** Cultivate trusted executive relationships with distributor business owners and leadership teams, ensuring Siemens Digital industries command dominant shelf-space, priority stocking, and mindshare over competing brands.

* **Channel Conflict Management & Rules of Engagement:** Establish, uphold, and govern clear Rules of Engagement (RoE) between industrial distributors, System Integrators, and Direct Accounts, eliminating price cannibalization, protecting partner margins, and ensuring healthy channel co-existence.

* **Distributor Profiling & Tiering:** Evaluate and categorize distribution partners based on technical capability, financial health, sales force competency, and warehouse infrastructure, establishing tailored development roadmaps for each partner tier.

  

**2. Sales Realization, Inventory Management & Demand Fulfillment (Sell-in & Sell-through)**

* **Drive Primary (Sell-in) and Secondary (Sell-through) Sales:** Own the complete distribution revenue realization cycle—driving high-velocity flow/run-rate business and balancing distributor stock replenishment (Sell-in) with actual market consumption (Sell-through / POS) across Digital Industries portfolio

* **Optimize Inventory Health & Stock Profiling:** Guide distributors on optimal inventory profiling, core product stocking matrices, fast-moving catalogue items, Days of Inventory on Hand (DOH), and buffer stock levels; proactively monitor, manage, and liquidate aging and slow-moving stock.

* **Order Fulfillment & Supply Chain Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with internal customer service, logistics, and factory supply chain teams to track order backlogs, monitor component lead times, expedite critical customer dispatches, and ensure high on-time delivery (OTD) performance.

* **Special Price Agreements (SPA) & Project Pricing:** Rigorously evaluate, structure, and steer distributor SPA and project discount requests, balancing aggressive market win-rates against regional price realization, margin thresholds, and price stability.

* **Working Capital & Credit Risk Management:** Partner with commercial and finance teams to actively monitor distributor credit lines, receivables aging, payment discipline, and cash flow health, ensuring complete financial compliance and minimal credit risk.

* **Counter & Walk-in Sales Velocity:** Accelerate over-the-counter and catalogue sales velocity for standard automation and drive components by establishing rapid quotation and dispatch workflows within distributor branches.

**3. Market Penetration, Technical Enablement & Channel Demand Generation**

* **Distributor Technical Enablement & Competence Building:** Drive systematic technical training and certification programs for distributor sales engineers, application specialists, and counter staff on product sizing tools (including but not limited to TIA Selection Tool, DT Configurator), basic PLC engineering (TIA Portal), drive parameterization, and competitive conversions.

* **Counter Marketing & Point-of-Sale (POS) Branding:** Elevate distributor branch, counter, and showroom visibility through professional product demo boards, live interactive demonstration kits, promotional displays, and point-of-sale branding to capture walk-in and trade demand.

* **Distributor Counter Days & Customer Tech Clinics:** Co-host regular 'Distributor Counter Days', product clinics, and technical workshops to introduce new PLC, HMI, and Drive innovations to local contractors, machine builders, panel builders, and plant maintenance teams.

* **Joint Customer Engagement & Field Sales Support:** Lead joint field sales calls with distributor sales teams targeting local machine builders (OEMs), panel shops, and industrial MRO accounts to qualify opportunities, position technical value, and secure deal conversions.

* **Promotional Blitzes & Secondary Demand Campaigns:** Design and deploy focused regional promotional campaigns, trade incentives, product bundle packages (e.g., Micro-PLC + HMI + Drive starter kits), and digital outreach programs to stimulate secondary demand.

* **Competitive Intelligence & Voice of Market:** Continuously monitor and report competitor moves—including pricing trends, distributor discount levels, stock availability, and lead-time dynamics from competitors (Rockwell, Schneider Electric, ABB, Mitsubishi, Omron, Delta)—providing actionable feedback to regional leadership.

  

**4. POS Analytics, CRM/PRM & Channel Operations**

* **Point-of-Sale (POS) Data Management & Analytics:** Enforce disciplined, timely, and granular POS data reporting from all authorized distributors; analyze secondary sales data to uncover end-customer buying patterns, vertical demand trends, repeat orders, and untapped accounts.

* **Demand Forecasting & S&OP Alignment:** Translate POS consumption trends, channel inventory levels, open pipeline, and run-rate signals into high-accuracy rolling monthly and quarterly sales forecasts, directly feeding regional Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP).

* **PRM & CRM System Excellence:** Ensure comprehensive logging and tracking of distributor master data, SPA approvals, project registrations, pipeline opportunities, and performance metrics within PRM (Partner Relationship Management) and Salesforce CRM systems.

* **Distributor Performance Scorecards & Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR):** Conduct structured, data-driven Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) evaluating distributor performance against key KPIs—including sales targets, POS growth, stock turns, new customer acquisition, training certifications, and policy compliance.

* **Market Development Fund (MDF) Governance:** Oversee the allocation, execution, and ROI tracking of Market Development Funds (MDF) allocated for distributor marketing initiatives, trade shows, promotional literature, and customer engagement events.

**Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience:**

* **Education Qualifications:** B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / Mechatronics Engineering. A Post-Graduate Diploma along with experience in Distribution and Supply Chain Management is a strong advantage.

* **Professional Experience:** Minimum 10+ years of demonstrable experience in Channel Sales / Distribution Management, with a proven track record of handling authorized industrial distributors in the Industrial Automation, PLCs, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs / AC Drives).

* **Distribution Economics & Commercial Acumen:** Deep expertise in industrial distribution business models, including Sell-in vs. Sell-through dynamics, distributor working capital, inventory turn ratios (DOH), commercial rebate structures, discount cascading, and credit governance.

* **Automation & Drives Technical Depth:** Strong working knowledge of Digital industries portfolio - including but not limited to Factory Automation & Motion Control architectures: PLCs (micro, compact, and modular), HMIs, Variable Frequency Drives (standard and modular VFDs), Servo systems, Decentralized I/O, Industrial Ethernet (Profinet), and digital selection tools (TIA Selection Tool, Sizer/DT Configurator).

* **Channel Leadership & Conflict Resolution:** Demonstrated leadership in cultivating high-trust relationships with distributor business owners/principals, driving team motivation, and resolving multi-channel sales conflicts with diplomacy and commercial firmness.

* **Analytical & Operational Capabilities:** Strong competency in analyzing POS datasets, sales funnels, and inventory reports using CRM/PRM platforms (Salesforce) and MS Excel / PowerBI; exceptional communication, presentation, and collaborative negotiation skills.

title: Senior Analyst, Business Intelligence
description:
**Location**
------------

Bangalore, India

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Remote

**Department**
--------------

Global Ops

  

**LG Ad Solutions**
-------------------

LG Ad Solutions is a global leader in connected TV (CTV) and cross-screen advertising. We pride ourselves on delivering state-of-the-art advertising solutions that integrate seamlessly with today's ever-evolving digital media landscape.

**The Opportunity:**
--------------------

Our Business Intelligence team turns large-scale advertising, revenue, and viewership data into the insights that leaders, operations teams, and content partners use to run the business.

We are seeking a Senior Analyst – Business Intelligence to drive high-impact analytics that bridge enterprise BI with operational execution. As a senior individual contributor, you will be the go-to expert for business and operational insights, supporting the Sales, Product, Finance, and Operations teams. You will also play a key role in maintaining strong relationships with external teams and premium content providers globally, ensuring alignment on business intelligence, operational efficiency, and reporting standards.

This role is designed for someone who can operate independently, own critical BI initiatives end to end, and bring deep, hands-on expertise in building and managing enterprise-level Tableau environments. You will shape how intelligence is embedded across the company.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Tableau Platform Ownership**

* Manage content on Tableau Server/Cloud: projects, permissions, row-level security, and sharing with external partners.
* Own data sources, extracts, and refresh schedules, and tune workbook performance for large datasets.
* Reconcile dashboard figures against source systems and partner reports so every number can be trusted.
* Set and document best practices for dashboard design, naming, calculated fields, and version control.
* Mentor junior analysts and run Tableau knowledge-sharing sessions.

**Operational Intelligence & Analytics**

* Build enterprise dashboards, forecasts, and deep-dive analyses to support revenue, partner insights, and content monetization.
* Design and maintain reporting dashboards and anomaly detection for ad delivery and operational KPIs.
* Write efficient SQL and Python/PySpark on Databricks to prepare, join, and validate data at scale.
* Handle ad-hoc analysis requests and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Translate operational data into business rules, thresholds, and insights that Operations and Content teams can act on quickly.
* Collaborate with Product and Data Engineering on pipeline requirements, ensuring BI and operational use cases are met.

**Stakeholder & Partner Management**

* Act as the primary BI partner for Operations and global stakeholders, delivering insights that shape execution and monetization strategies.
* Support cross-functional partners (Sales, Product, Finance, Operations) and external Content Partners with tailored BI insights.
* Partner with external teams globally to ensure unified KPI definitions, consistent reporting, and alignment on data usage.
* Build strong working relationships with global external stakeholders and Content Partners so BI outputs earn trust and adoption.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 4+ years in BI, Analytics, or Data Strategy, ideally spanning both business insights and operational use cases in ad tech, digital media, or SaaS.
* 3+ years of hands-on Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server/Cloud experience, including publishing, permissions, row-level security, and scheduling.
* Expert Tableau skills: LOD expressions, table calculations, parameters, dashboard actions, and performance and extract optimization.
* Advanced SQL (complex joins, window functions, CTEs) on large datasets.
* Strong working knowledge of Databricks and Python/PySpark for data wrangling and automation.
* Strong executive communication and storytelling skills; able to present to global stakeholders.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders as an individual contributor and manage relationships with global teams and external partners.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with real-time or operational intelligence frameworks, particularly in advertising or content monetization.
* Familiarity with CTV/OTT and programmatic advertising concepts (SSP/DSP, impressions, fill rate, revenue share).
* Tableau certification (Desktop Specialist or Certified Data Analyst).
* Exposure to forecasting or time-series reporting.
