description:
Job description:

SALES OFFICER

Field Sales & Operations

THE ROLE

Own your territory. Build the pipeline. Grow your earnings.

* As a Sales Officer, you own the business pipeline for your assigned territory.
* Find businesses, convert them for on-site video data collection, and keep the recording pipeline running.
* Spend your days in the field meeting business owners face to face, closing them, and expanding into nearby towns and industrial clusters.
* Your effort directly impacts your conversion volume and incentive payout.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Build the business pipeline — your core job

* Convert new businesses every day for commercial video data collection and build your daily conversion count.
* Target factories, manufacturing units, workshops, service centers, commercial kitchens, warehouses, printing & packaging units and facility management operations.
* Multi-worker and 2-shift environments are especially valuable.
* Complete the conversion form fully and accurately for every business on the same day.
* A converted business means a real, reachable business that is scheduled and ready for recording.

2. Scout and expand your territory

* Map and open up nearby towns and industrial clusters assigned to your territory.
* Spot new commercial categories and corridors with high recording potential.
* Build corridor-level knowledge of streets, estates and clusters with a high concentration of qualifying businesses.

3. Own recording day

* Support field operations on recording days at businesses you converted.
* Resolve owner concerns, access issues and scheduling conflicts on the spot.
* Keep the internal coordinator updated on pipeline status, scheduled recordings and on-ground issues.
* Maintain the relationship through the full recording cycle.

INCENTIVE STRUCTURE — CALCULATED DAILY

* Below 5 conversions/day: No incentive.
* 5–7 conversions/day: ₹100 per lead (₹500–₹700/day).
* 8–10 conversions/day: ₹120 per lead (₹960–₹1,200/day).
* 11–14 conversions/day: ₹200 per lead (₹2,200–₹2,800/day).
* 15+ conversions/day: ₹250 per lead (₹3,750 onwards/day).
* Incentive Payment: Calculated daily and paid monthly.
* Maximum Incentive: Uncapped.
* Eligibility: Only verified and eligible business leads qualify.
* Additional Conversions: Every lead above 15 earns ₹250.

Below 5 conversions in a day, no incentive is payable for that day. Every additional conversion above 15 continues at ₹250 per lead — there is no ceiling on a big day.

HOW INCENTIVES ARE COUNTED

* Verified lead: A real, operating business at a physical address, with a named decision-maker whose mobile number is confirmed by call and physical visit, plus a geo-stamped photo of the premises taken in the app. All tasks must be verifiable.
* Every lead is verified: Accuracy matters. Any fabricated or fake detail voids the incentive for that week.
* Eligible categories only: Only businesses submitted on the form, from the categories listed in the goal sheet, count towards incentives.
* No duplicates: Leads are matched on phone number, bank details and location.
* Quality, not just volume: Every business submitted must allow recording at the location. Each denial carries a ₹2,000 deduction, so convert businesses that are genuinely ready.
* Chains & multi-outlet businesses: Each outlet counts separately only if it is a distinct physical location with its own decision-maker and contact number. Outlets sharing one number or address count once.
* Disputes: Raise a disagreement within 7 days; an independent reviewer will assess it.
* Calculation basis: Incentives are calculated on daily performance and paid monthly.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

**LOCALITE**: Native fluency in the local language of the zone, plus working English or Hindi (mandatory).

**EXPERIENCE:** Minimum 1 year as a Field Sales Executive, Business Development Executive or an equivalent field-facing role.

**NETWORK**: An existing network of business owners in the region — you should be able to name and reach real business owners in your territory. This comes up in the interview.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE IF YOU ARE

* A field sales or vendor acquisition professional who closes face to face.
* Energised by being on the road across your territory every day.
* A high-ownership operator who treats your territory like your own business.
* Someone who wants earnings tied to output, with no ceiling on a good month.

WORK DETAILS

Role type: Full-time contract role — 6-month contract

Work mode: 100% field-based

Travel: Extensive daily travel across your territory, including nearby mapped towns

Reporting: Zone Lead + internal coordinator (daily updates)

Benefits:

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Business Development Executive – Store Expansion & Market Mapping Department: Business Development Location: Goa Reporting To: Business Development Manager / Head – Expansion Role: Store Expansion, Site Acquisition, Market Mapping & Strategic Tie-ups 1. Job Purpose To identify and secure strategic locations for new store openings, conduct detailed geographical and market mapping, develop structured beat and route plans, and establish partnerships with residential societies and commercial establishments to maximise market penetration and business potential. 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities A. Site Identification & Store Acquisition - Identify, shortlist and evaluate potential locations for new store openings. - Conduct physical site visits and assess location suitability based on visibility, accessibility, population density and business potential. - Evaluate catchment areas, residential density, commercial activity and competitor presence. - Prepare comparative site evaluation reports with photographs, Google Maps locations and commercial details. - Recommend suitable sites for management approval and finalisation. B. Landlord Negotiation & Commercial Finalisation - Identify and establish contact with property owners and landlords. - Negotiate rental terms, security deposits, lock-in periods, escalation clauses and lease tenure. - Negotiate rent-free periods, fit-out periods and other commercial benefits. - Coordinate documentation and ensure commercial terms are aligned with company requirements. - Maintain a database of shortlisted properties, landlords and negotiation status. C. Market Mapping & Catchment Area Analysis - Conduct comprehensive market mapping of assigned geographical territories. - Identify and map all residential societies, apartments, gated communities, independent households and commercial establishments. - Capture details such as society name, address, approximate number of households, population density and contact details wherever available. - Identify high-potential catchment areas based on household density and accessibility. - Map competitors and other relevant businesses within the assigned territory. - Prepare detailed geographical maps using Google Maps and other mapping tools. D. Beat Planning & Route Development - Develop structured beat plans and daily route plans for assigned territories. - Divide geographical areas into clearly defined routes and micro-markets. - Ensure complete geographical coverage without duplication or overlapping routes. - Map all residential societies, individual households and commercial establishments along each route. - Establish route-wise coverage targets and maintain daily activity reports. - Continuously update route maps based on new developments and market changes. E. Society Tie-ups & Strategic Partnerships - Establish relationships and negotiate tie-ups with residential welfare associations, society management committees and apartment associations. - Secure permissions for promotional activities, branding, stalls and customer acquisition campaigns. - Explore partnerships with societies for exclusive offers and resident engagement programmes. - Develop relationships with commercial establishments, offices, institutions and other potential business partners. - Maintain a database of all society tie-ups, permissions and partnership agreements. F. End-to-End Geographical Mapping - Take ownership of complete geographical mapping of assigned territories. - Ensure every society, residential complex, household cluster and commercial pocket is mapped. - Create route-wise digital maps with clearly marked boundaries and locations. - Maintain an updated master database of mapped areas and business opportunities. - Identify uncovered locations and recommend expansion opportunities. - Submit territory-wise market potential and penetration reports to management. 3. Key Deliverables (KPIs) Parameter| Key Performance Indicator Site acquisition| Qualified sites shortlisted and finalised Rental negotiation| Commercially viable rental terms secured Market mapping| 100% mapping of assigned territories Society mapping| Complete database of societies and apartments Route planning| Clearly defined and mapped beats/routes Society tie-ups| Number of successful society partnerships Commercial mapping| Complete mapping of commercial establishments Geographic coverage| Zero major unmapped pockets in assigned territory Reporting| Daily, weekly and monthly progress reports 4. Required Skills & Competencies - Excellent communication and negotiation skills. - Strong local market knowledge and geographical understanding. - Proficiency in Google Maps, Google My Maps, Google Sheets and Excel. - Ability to conduct extensive fieldwork and market surveys. - Relationship-building and networking capabilities. - Good analytical and reporting skills. - Ability to independently manage assigned territories. - Willingness to travel extensively within assigned geographical areas. 5. Educational Qualification & Experience - Graduate in any discipline. - 1–3 years of experience in business development, retail expansion, real estate, site acquisition or field sales. - Experience in property negotiations and market mapping will be an added advantage. - Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. 6. Reporting & Accountability The Business Development Executive will be responsible for end-to-end execution of assigned territory development activities, from identifying potential store locations and negotiating with landlords to completing geographical mapping, route planning and establishing society partnerships. The position requires extensive field involvement, ownership of assigned territories and measurable delivery against expansion and market penetration targets.

title: VP, Internal Audit
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

**Job Description:**

Blackstone Internal Audit provides independent assurance to executive management and the Blackstone Audit Committee regarding the effectiveness of the Firm’s governance, risk management, and internal control processes. Additionally, BXIA facilitates Blackstone’s SOX Compliance Program by providing oversight, expertise, and support with management’s assessment of the effectiveness of its internal controls over financial reporting. We are seeking a highly motivated VP to lead the Bangalore-based internal audit, SOX and risk advisory activities, providing oversight of deliverables, talent development, stakeholder engagement, and transformation initiatives. The VP will play a critical role in strengthening the Firm’s control environment through a risk-based approach to assurance, while supporting broader Internal Audit objectives and enterprise-wide governance initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:** The BXIA VP will drive key activities undertaken by the Center of Excellence (COE) Internal Audit and SOX teams.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* BXIA COE Team Lead: Lead our COE team of captive and third-party resources in delivery of internal audit, SOX, risk advisory, and audit operations activities, demonstrating accountability and ownership of key deliverables of the team.
* Audit Execution Oversight: Support delivery and oversight of COE internal audit activities, including execution of risk-based audits of business, enterprise, and technology processes across Blackstone's global businesses.
* SOX Program Execution Oversight: Support delivery and oversight of COE SOX program execution activities across each phase of the program, including, planning, documentation, testing and reporting.
* Audit Operations Oversight: Oversee the delivery of audit operations support delivered by the COE, including analytics, dashboards, AI use case development, automation, and operational reporting.
* Quality Review of Deliverables: Oversee the quality and consistency of controls testing, documentation, and related assurance activities performed by the COE across Internal Audit, SOX, risk advisory, and special projects, ensuring adherence to methodology, quality standards, and continuous improvement objectives.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build relationships with key stakeholders; understand their operating and risk environments and serve as a trusted point of contact.
* Innovation & Strategic Initiatives: Drive operational improvements across the COE while supporting key departmental initiatives and overseeing COE resources contributing to strategic projects and special initiatives.
* Team & Talent Development: Drive a high-performance, values-based team culture by motivating, mentoring, coaching, skill-based training and developing team members in alignment with Blackstone principles.
* COE Operations, Resource & Project Management Oversight: Lead resource allocation, capacity planning, project prioritization and delivery monitoring across COE to ensure resources are deployed effectively, priorities are met, risks are escalated, and deliverables are completed timely and in accordance with established expectations.
* Global BXIA Team Partnership: Partner strategically with the Global Internal Audit team by defining the COE team’s objectives in alignment with BXIA’s broader strategy, vision, and operating model.

**Qualifications:** Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who are highly motivated, intelligently curious, and have demonstrated excellence in their prior endeavors. The ideal candidate will bring a passion for building and leading a top-tier Controls, Risk, and Assurance Center of Excellence, deep expertise in internal audit, SOX, risk management, and controls, a selfstarter mentality, and the ability to independently solve complex problems. Strong communication, project management, stakeholder management, and attention to detail are equally important as technical expertise. Successful candidates will have the following attributes:

  

* Educated: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field. CPA preferred; MBA, CIA, CFA, or CISA a plus.
* Experienced: 12+ years of external audit and/or internal audit experience within the Big Four, a similarly recognized global public accounting or consulting firm, or global financial services organization. Additional experience with SOX compliance is preferred.
* Technically Proficient: Demonstrated understanding and practical application of risk and control frameworks (e.g., IIA Standards, ICFR requirements, COSO framework, GAAP).
* Proven Leader: Experience leading teams and managing global or shared-service delivery models, with a strong focus on developing junior talent, fostering team cohesion, and operating effectively within a US-based global organization.
* Sound Judgement: Demonstrated ability to exercise sound risk-based judgment, prioritize competing risks and business needs, and effectively manage upward through timely communication and escalation of significant issues, risks, and decisions.
* Curious & Self-Directed: Ability to stay informed on industry best practices, technology, global markets, and internal audit and ICFR practices; operates with a high degree of autonomy and sound judgment. • Integrity-Driven: Committed to the highest personal and professional standards.
* Analytically Sound: Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills; transformation initiatives, data analytics experience, data visualization tools or audit testing and risk monitoring a plus.
* Project Management & Quality Focused: Strong project management skills with a proven ability to lead complex initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results with attention to detail.
* Interpersonally Skilled: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical topics clearly and influence and engage senior stakeholders across global teams.

title: Technical Implementation Lead
description:
**About Lifesight**
===================

**Lifesight** is a pioneering Unified **Marketing Measurement (UMM)** platform which helps marketers measure, plan and optimise their marketing spend. In a world of fragmented data, unreliable cookies, and outdated reporting, we empower modern businesses to achieve predictable, sustained growth by aligning marketing and finance on a single causal truth.

We are at the forefront of **Agentic Unified Marketing Measurement**. Moving beyond siloed tools and post facto dashboards, our AI-driven causal engine combines Causal MMM, Incrementality testing and Incrementality Adjusted Attribution to create a finance ready marketing decision system.

### **Why We Exist**

Our mission is to eliminate wasted ad spend and remove the guesswork from marketing. Operating as an independent, unbiased measurement layer, Lifesight enables CMOs, CFOs, and performance marketers to confidently answer the only question that matters: *What is the true incremental value of my marketing spend?*

**Join the Future of Decision Intelligence.** We are transforming marketing from a gamble into a science. By joining Lifesight, you will help build the intelligent, agent-ready infrastructure that powers data-driven, optimized decisions for hundreds of top global brands.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

As the Lead – Technical Implementation on our global Solutions team in Bangalore, you'll lead a team of Technical Implementation Specialists and own data onboarding for Lifesight's Unified Marketing Measurement solutions: **Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)**, **Incrementality Experiments**, and **Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)**.

You'll set the standard for how client data gets into Lifesight: scoped clearly, delivered on time, and accurate from day one. This role is for a hands-on leader who can coach a team, run multiple client onboardings in parallel, and speak with equal confidence to a client's data engineer and their CMO.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Lead the team**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of Technical Implementation Specialists; set priorities, review their work, and raise the bar on quality.
* Allocate client onboardings across the team based on complexity, capacity, and skills; step in hands-on when an engagement needs it.
* Build and maintain standard playbooks, checklists, and templates for data onboarding across MMM, Experiments, and MTA.
* Run regular 1:1s and team reviews; give clear feedback and support each specialist's growth.

### **Own data onboarding for MMM, Experiments, and MTA**

* Own end-to-end data onboarding for every client: scoping data requirements, validating pipelines, testing configurations, and signing off on measurement readiness.
* Define what "model-ready" data looks like for each solution: historical spend, KPI, and control variables for MMM; geo and audience-level data for Experiments; event, touchpoint, and conversion data for MTA.
* Oversee how the team combines, cleans, and transforms fragmented, multi-source data across Excel, SQL, and BigQuery.
* Catch data quality issues early (type mismatches, schema inconsistencies, integration gaps, anomalies, outliers) before they affect client outcomes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex implementation issues using internal tooling, APIs, and cross-functional collaboration.

### **Manage projects and timelines**

* Translate client requirements into structured implementation plans with clear milestones, owners, and dates.
* Run multiple onboardings in parallel; track progress, manage dependencies, and keep every project on schedule.
* Spot risks early, escalate with a proposed fix, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Report onboarding status, timelines, and blockers to leadership and client teams.

### **Be the client's trusted technical partner**

* Act as the senior technical point of contact and escalation point for clients during onboarding.
* Lead client calls and workshops; explain data requirements and measurement concepts in plain business language.
* Manage expectations, negotiate scope and timelines, and maintain trust through every engagement.
* Run account health checks and flag risks before they escalate.

### **Improve how we work**

* Use AI tools and prompt engineering to streamline workflows and automate repetitive onboarding tasks across the team.
* Feed structured client and team feedback into Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap and tooling.
* Partner with Data Science, Customer Success, and Sales for smooth handoffs from pre-sales through to model delivery.

**P.S.** – The above list need not put a ceiling on your aspirations at Lifesight.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in technical implementation, data onboarding, solutioning, or solutions consulting within B2B SaaS; ideally in data, martech, or adtech.
* 2+ years leading small teams (3–6 people) of implementation, solutions, or data specialists, including hiring, coaching, and performance feedback.
* Strong client-facing experience: you've owned onboardings end to end and been the go-to technical contact for enterprise clients.
* Excellent business communication: you write clearly, present with confidence, and adapt your message for engineers, marketers, and executives alike.
* Excellent project management: you run several projects at once, plan milestones, manage dependencies, and deliver on time. Experience with tools like Jira, Asana, or similar.
* Proven ability to scope complex client requirements and turn them into structured, actionable implementation plans.
* Hands-on experience combining, cleaning, and transforming fragmented, multi-format data using Excel, SQL, and BigQuery; Python or JavaScript is a plus.
* Sharp data hygiene instincts; you spot type errors, schema mismatches, and structural inconsistencies, and teach your team to do the same.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, Google Cloud (BigQuery), and SQL-based transformation workflows.
* Active user of AI tools and prompt engineering techniques (Few-Shot Prompting, Role/Persona Prompting, etc.), and keen to drive their adoption across the team.
* First principles thinking. You take ownership, challenge assumptions, and don't let blockers sit, for yourself or your team.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Direct experience onboarding data for Marketing Mix Models, Incrementality Experiments (geo or audience holdouts), or Multi-Touch Attribution.
* Familiarity with Tag Managers, JS Pixels / SDKs, server-side tracking, AdTech, DSPs, or marketing attribution tools.
* Familiarity with ad platforms and their data exports and APIs: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic, and similar ad networks.
* Experience building scalable onboarding processes or internal tooling for a growing implementation team.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar project management certification.

description:

JOB DESCRIPTION

**Innovate in Bengaluru**

This position is based at our on-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.

  

**About Lowe’s**

Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

**About Lowe’s India**

Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India

  

**About The Team**

The **Private Brands Team** is committed to delivering a cohesive and consistent brand experience through effective portfolio management and minimizing dependencies on third-party agencies. Our team operates through two distinct functions: Packaging Operations and After Sales Customer Support (ASCS).

The **Packaging Operations Team** is responsible for the execution of our Private Brand strategies. This includes managing packaging, print quality management, packaging innovation, and development. Provides in-house production capabilities for the Private Brands portfolio, through re-fresh and re-design of the SKUs for all Lowe’s brands. This team also ensures that the instruction manuals, legal and packaging copy for the Private Brands products adhere to the quality standards and brand guidelines as set by Lowe's.

  

**Job Summary**

The Senior Manager – Operational Excellence will lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability of Private Brands operations. This role will identify process improvement opportunities, eliminate waste and variability, establish performance measures, and deliver cross-functional projects that strengthen end-to-end operational outcomes.

The successful candidate is a strategic, data-driven operations leader with strong project management discipline. They will partner with business stakeholders to design practical solutions, implement sustainable process changes, and build a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational rigor.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**

* Lead the operational excellence agenda for Private Brands by identifying, prioritizing, and delivering process-improvement opportunities.
* Assess current-state workflows, identify bottlenecks, handoff gaps, rework, and inefficiencies, and develop future-state processes that improve speed, quality, cost, and stakeholder experience.
* Apply continuous-improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, root-cause analysis, value-stream mapping, and standard work to improve business performance.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, operating procedures, governance mechanisms, and controls to enable consistent execution.
* Drive adoption of simplified, standardized, and scalable ways of working across teams.
  

**Project & Program Management**

* Lead cross-functional projects from problem definition through planning, execution, change adoption, and benefits realization.
* Define project scope, milestones, workplans, dependencies, risks, resource requirements, and success measures.
* Establish clear governance, facilitate stakeholder reviews, manage issue resolution, and provide timely status updates to leadership.
* Balance multiple concurrent initiatives while ensuring delivery against agreed timelines, quality standards, and business outcomes.
* Support change-management activities to ensure new processes, tools, and operating models are effectively embedded.
  

**Performance Management & Analytics**

* Define, track, and improve operational KPIs related to productivity, cycle time, quality, cost, service levels, compliance, and capacity.
* Build reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into performance, improvement opportunities, and project outcomes.
* Use data and business insights to diagnose performance issues, make recommendations, and quantify the value delivered through improvement initiatives.
* Conduct regular operational reviews with stakeholders and translate findings into actionable improvement plans.
  

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Partner with Private Brands, LGS, PDMs, Category Managers, and other cross-functional teams to improve end-to-end business processes.
* Influence stakeholders at multiple levels through clear communication, structured problem-solving, and a strong focus on business outcomes.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members to build capability in operational excellence, project execution, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous learning.
  

**EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

  

* Graduate (in any discipline)

**Work Experience**

**Required**

  

* 13+ Experience in retail, merchandising, Private Brands, product development, packaging, print production, creative operations, or studio management.
* 5+ years of leadership experience
* Experience in retail, merchandising, Private Brands, product development, packaging, print production, creative operations, or studio management.
* Lean, Six Sigma, PMP, Agile, or other relevant process-improvement/project-management certification.
* Experience using operational metrics, dashboards, and data-analysis tools to improve performance.
* Experience working across global or matrixed organizations.
  

  

**Core Competencies:**

  
  

* Operational Excellence
* Continuous Improvement
* Process Design and Standardization
* Project and Program Management
* Strategic Execution
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Change Management
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* People Leadership
* Executive Communication
  

  

**Licenses and Certifications**

**Required (Any 1)**

* Lean Six Sigma, PMP, Agile, or other relevant process-improvement/project-management certification

You will lead creative strategy, storytelling, and content development for B2B brands, primarily targeting the US market. The ideal candidate combines exceptional creative judgment, strong business acumen, persuasive presentation skills, and the ability to translate complex business challenges into ideas that drive measurable results.

This is a hands-on leadership role that requires complete ownership of creative quality, team performance, client relationships, and contributions to business growth.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Creative Strategy & Direction**

* Lead creative strategy, copy direction, and storytelling across integrated B2B marketing campaigns, digital experiences, video, and sales enablement assets.
* Develop compelling campaign concepts, brand narratives, messaging frameworks, value propositions, and positioning strategies.
* Translate complex technology, products, and business challenges into clear, differentiated, and persuasive communication.
* Partner with design, UX/UI, video, and marketing teams to deliver cohesive, high-impact creative solutions.
* Guide creative development from concept through execution, ensuring originality, strategic relevance, and exceptional quality.
* Ensure all communication meets US English standards and resonates with North American business audiences.

#### **2. Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Partner closely with Sales and Business Development teams to develop creative strategies that help win new business.
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client accounts through proactive campaign ideas, content solutions, and creative recommendations.
* Develop compelling creative concepts, pitch narratives, and presentations that demonstrate business value and growth opportunities.
* Participate in client discovery meetings, strategic workshops, new business pitches, and executive-level presentations.
* Collaborate with Sales and Client Services teams to convert creative opportunities into clearly defined, commercially viable proposals.
* Understand client business objectives, competitive landscapes, and market trends to recommend new creative solutions.
* Contribute to revenue growth through stronger client engagement, account expansion, and new business wins.

#### **3. Client Leadership & Strategic Partnership**

* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders by bringing strategic thinking, creative expertise, and proactive recommendations.
* Lead creative discussions and confidently present concepts, messaging strategies, and campaign recommendations.
* Challenge briefs constructively, identify opportunities beyond the initial scope, and recommend solutions that deliver greater business impact.
* Partner with account and strategy teams to align creative recommendations with client objectives, audience insights, and marketing performance.
* Take ownership of creative direction, stakeholder alignment, and resolution of critical client feedback.

#### **4. Team Leadership & Creative Excellence**

* Lead, mentor, and develop copywriters, strengthening their conceptual thinking, storytelling, writing, and presentation skills.
* Establish high standards for creativity, editorial quality, accountability, and timely delivery.
* Review and guide content across campaigns, websites, video scripts, presentations, and marketing and sales enablement collateral.
* Ensure all deliverables are accurate, brand-aligned, strategically relevant, and client-ready.
* Foster a culture of creative ownership, continuous improvement, collaboration, and innovation.
* Work with project managers and cross-functional leaders to manage priorities, resources, and delivery quality.

#### **5. AI-Powered Creative Innovation**

* Champion the adoption of AI tools and workflows to accelerate creative ideation, content development, research, and production.
* Guide teams in using AI to generate stronger creative concepts, improve productivity, and deliver scalable content solutions.
* Identify and eliminate generic, repetitive, inaccurate, or low-quality AI-generated content.
* Combine human creativity, strategic thinking, and AI capabilities to develop distinctive brand communication.
* Explore AI-powered creative solutions that can be packaged and pitched as new services to existing and prospective clients.
* Maintain editorial quality, originality, brand consistency, and human accountability across all AI-assisted work.

#### **6. Creative Performance & Business Impact**

* Develop messaging strategies aligned with B2B buyer journeys, demand generation, account-based marketing, and sales enablement.
* Collaborate with performance marketing and strategy teams to improve campaign effectiveness and conversion.
* Use audience insights, competitive research, and campaign performance data to strengthen creative recommendations.
* Connect creative ideas to measurable business outcomes, including engagement, lead generation, conversion, and account growth.
* Contribute to pitches, proposals, and creative scoping while balancing quality, timelines, and commercial viability.

#### **Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in copywriting, creative strategy, or integrated marketing, preferably within a digital or creative agency.
* Minimum 3 years of experience leading copywriters or multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Proven experience developing creative strategies and campaigns for B2B brands, particularly for US and North American markets.
* **Exceptional command of US English**, with outstanding storytelling, conceptual writing, editing, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to contribute to new business pitches, client presentations, and account growth opportunities.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect creative solutions to client challenges and commercial objectives.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns, brand narratives, video scripts, digital experiences, and marketing and sales enablement content.
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing, demand generation, buyer journeys, and conversion-focused messaging.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior client stakeholders, sales leaders, and executive teams.
* Proven leadership skills with a strong focus on accountability, mentoring, creative quality, and delivery excellence.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools for creative development, content production, and workflow optimization.
* Strong portfolio showcasing creative thinking, campaign storytelling, strategic messaging, and business impact.

#### **Good to Have**

* Experience working with B2B technology, SaaS, AI, cybersecurity, healthcare, or enterprise brands.
* Experience partnering directly with Sales and Business Development teams to win new business.
* Demonstrated success in identifying and converting upsell or cross-sell opportunities.
* Experience leading high-value client pitches, strategic workshops, and executive presentations.
* Understanding of account-based marketing, demand generation, SEO, AEO, and content performance.
* Experience developing thought leadership, executive communications, product narratives, and video storytelling.
* Experience building AI-powered content workflows and scalable creative solutions.

#### **What We’re Looking For**

We are not looking for someone who only manages copywriters or reviews content.

We are looking for a **creative leader who thinks like a strategist, presents like a storyteller, and approaches opportunities with a business growth mindset.**

Someone who can walk into a client meeting, understand the business challenge, develop a compelling creative idea, and confidently pitch a solution that creates value for the client and growth opportunities for Position².

Above all, we want someone who takes complete ownership of their work, inspires the team to deliver exceptional creative, and plays an active role in winning and growing client business.

title: AI Outcome Customer Engineer, FDE, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.
* Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions.
* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
  
  
As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Solutions Engineer (EMEA Shift)
description:
**About Glean:**

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

**About the Role:**

The Solution Engineer role sits within the GTM organisation in India, making you a trusted technical advisor to the local sales team, our partners, and our customers. In this role, you will support the EMEA region, working closely with EMEA Account Executives, partners, and customers. You will work on exciting projects with some of the most forward-thinking organisations, helping guide the start of their Generative AI journeys. This role has a strong technical skill set and is not a classic SE profile. At Glean, our Solution Engineers work with our customers to help them connect Glean to their most important decision-making platforms. These platforms include Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Zendesk, and everything in between! As an SE, you will work closely with our Account Executives (AEs) and will be responsible for the technical success and delivery of our sales opportunities.

**You will:**

* Perform interactive demonstrations of the Glean platform to prospective customers.

* Educate and train our customers and partners on our product to ensure that they are set up for success.
* Present at company-sponsored events such as Google Cloud Next and AWS re:Invent.
* Liaise with Glean product managers and engineers to investigate issues, raise feature requests, and understand our future roadmap.

**About You:**
--------------

* You have a bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* You have at least 4+ years of experience in enterprise software pre-sales and have used value-based discovery frameworks.
* You possess excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to handle complex technical challenges.
* You are able to explain complex technical concepts in layman's terms to help educate and train our customers, prospects, and partners.
* You are comfortable presenting, both virtually and in person.
* You are familiar with cloud infrastructure (IaaS) platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure.
* You are familiar with identity services and Single Sign-On (SSO) providers such as Azure/Entra ID, Okta, and protocols such as SAML, SCIM, and OIDC.
* You are familiar with APIs, including sending and receiving data from API endpoints, and how to troubleshoot issues.
* You are familiar with security concepts and tools, e.g. Firewalls, VPNs, SSL/TLS, DLP, WAFs, and proxies.

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office).
* This role supports the EMEA region, with working hours of 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We are a diverse bunch of people, and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. title: Senior Territory Account Executive, Bengaluru
description:
### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

**Please note: This role will require you to be based in Bengaluru.**

  

About the Department Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.

Based in India (Bengaluru), you will drive sales into commercial and enterprise accounts across Karnataka and South India for Cloudflare's solutions. Your strategic selling activities will include "hunter" type activities to proactively penetrate target named accounts, detailed account planning, focused relationship building and leading effective sales campaigns to successful closure of high-value, multi-product architectural transformations.

The ideal candidate will possess both a major account sales background in technology solutions, primarily software and cloud-based, that enables them to drive engagement with senior level decision makers (CISOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering) within Cloudflare's target customers. Industry experience selling into Digital Natives, IT/ITES, SaaS scale-ups, and other Enterprise verticals is desired in this role. You must be capable of orchestrating complex six-figure ($100K+) expansions encompassing Zero Trust/SASE, Developer Platforms (Workers/R2), and Application Security.

As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a Sales strategy/plan for assigned vertical or accounts, as well as driving large account sales into India markets to achieve revenue targets. Therefore, you must have a strong network of contacts with decision makers in enterprise accounts across the region, and have experience selling complex solutions to these accounts. You will have an intuitive understanding and experience with the key business and technical needs of these large accounts and will create and deliver compelling value propositions to them for Cloudflare solutions, specifically targeting competitive displacements of Cybersecurity SaaS like Akamai, AWS, Azure, GCP, legacy appliances, Zscaler, or Cisco Umbrella.

Additional responsibilities will include

* Manage complex contract negotiations for high-AOV, multi-product enterprise deals
* Maintain a robust sales pipeline through proactive outbound targeting and whitespace mining within your installed base
* Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts to convert variable usage into committed enterprise contracts
* Collaborate closely with the regional partner ecosystem (e.g., Tech Data, Softcell) to accelerate deal velocity
* < 50% travel

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

* Bachelor's degree required
* Fluent in English
* Relevant direct experience, track record, and relationships within corporate enterprise accounts in the India market (specifically Karnataka and South India)
* Minimum 10 years of direct B2B selling experience, preferably managing internet, cloud, and security accounts
* Direct experience selling network security, Zero Trust/SASE (Cloudflare One), and/or CDN / Application Security solutions preferred
* Proven track record of executing competitive takeout campaigns against legacy hardware and cloud point solutions
* Prior experience being part of an early sales team helping drive traction in India market for a US-based SaaS company highly preferred
* Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles and cross-functional evaluations
* Basic understanding of computer networking, cloud architectures, and "how the internet works"
* Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)
* Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organisational skills
* Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit
* Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment

  

### **What Makes Cloudflare Special?**

We're not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We're a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

**Project Galileo**: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare's enterprise customers-at no cost.

**Athenian Project**: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

**1.1.1.1**: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here's the deal - we don't store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

-----------------

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Data Cloud Sales Specialist, you will help us grow our Data Cloud business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. In this role, you will work with customers to deliver true business value, demonstrate product functionality and provide a comprehensive overview of key business use cases. You will position Google Cloud's data suite (including BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, etc.) as the premium data intelligence platform for Agentic workflows. You will articulate the unique value of Lakehouse, governance, and semantic cataloging in delivering high-quality, hallucination-free AI Agents, enabling customers to leverage unified data foundations for real-time, AI-driven experiences. You will shape customers' cloud and Agentic Data Cloud strategy and enable digital transformation. You will lead with empathy, while identifying innovative ways to multiply your impact and the impact of the team as a whole to drive the overall value for Google Cloud. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

title: Executive - Sales
description:
**Executive - Sales**

**Location: Bangalore**

**About Us**

StayVista is **India’s largest villa hospitality brand** and has redefined group getaways. Our handpicked luxury villas are present in every famous holiday destination across the country. We curate unique experiences paired with top-notch hospitality, creating unforgettable stays. **Here, you will be a part of our passionate team, dedicated to crafting exceptional getaways and curating one-of-a-kind homes.** We are a close-knit tribe, united by a shared love for travel and on a mission to become the most loved hospitality brand in India.

**Why Work With Us?**

At StayVista, you're part of a community where your ideas and growth matter. We’re a fast-growing team that values continuous improvement. With our skill upgrade programs, you’ll keep learning and evolving, just like we do. And hey, when you’re ready for a break, our villa discounts make it easy to enjoy the luxury you help create.

**Your Role**

As a **Executive at StayVista**, you are a hospitality professional with a genuine passion for delivering outstanding guest experiences. You bring a comprehensive understanding of villa amenities and possess deep expertise across hotel functions, including Food & Beverage Service, Housekeeping, Front Office, and Food Production. With a strong customer-centric approach, you excel in creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere that anticipates and responds to guest needs seamlessly.

**About You**

* Establish and maintain a strong connection with guests through a warm welcome and efficient check-in process.
* Learn and anticipate guests’ needs by understanding their likes, dislikes, allergies, and preferences.
* Manage inventory for spirits, wines, and specialty foods, ensuring availability of high-quality items.
* Provide table dining service, ensuring meals and drinks are served to guests promptly and professionally.
* Coordinate with housekeeping to arrange room and public area cleanings at convenient times for guests.
* Stay updated on villa policies regarding safety, hygiene, and operational protocols.
* High school diploma (12th grade) with a Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management or a related certification in hospitality.
* This position includes tasks supporting Owner and Guest Management, as determined by organizational needs.

**Bonus Points - These are non-essential, but a bonus if you have them!**

* Familiarity with luxury villa operations and private estate management
* A two-wheeler is mandatory for travelling to properties and conducting regular property visits.

**Key Metrics: What you will drive and achieve**

* Food and beverage and event sales
* Vendor Coordination
* Payment collection
* Overall Feedback Collection

**Our Core Values:** Are you a ***CURATER?***

* **Curious**: Here, your curiosity fuels innovation.
* **User-Centric**: You’ll anticipate the needs of all our stakeholders and exceed expectations.
* **Resourceful**: You’ll creatively optimise our resources with solutions that elevate experiences in unexpected ways.
* **Aspire**: Keep learning, keep growing—because we’re all about continuous improvement.
* **Trust**: Trust is our foundation. You’ll work in a transparent, reliable, and fair environment.
* **Enjoy**: We believe in having fun while building something extraordinary.

**StayVista Spirit: Our Behavioral Competencies – How We Work Together**

* **Business Acumen:** You grasp the basics of our company, customers, and services, always thinking ahead in your work. You’re mindful of costs and benefits, making smart decisions while learning from risks and mistakes.
* **Change Management:** You’re open to change, adjusting quickly to new information or challenges. Always eager to learn, you find creative ways to improve your work and seek feedback for growth.
* **Leadership:** You set clear goals, guide your team with energy, and take full responsibility for the work, ensuring others respect your leadership through action.
* **Customer Centricity:** You understand both internal and external customer needs and take ownership in addressing any service issues. You maintain clear communication and handle customer interactions with patience and respect.
* **Teamwork:** You collaborate well with others, respecting diverse opinions and always contributing positively to the team. You keep lines of communication open and share your thoughts without judgment.
* **Result Orientation:** You take responsibility for completing tasks and proactively tackle challenges to exceed expectations. You’re quick to spot issues and address them efficiently, making decisive decisions with resourcefulness.
* **Planning and Organizing:** You handle multiple priorities well, staying organized and focused. You ensure your work is thorough, accurate, and aligned with set processes to meet goals effectively.
* **Communication:** You communicate your ideas clearly, encourage dialogue, and ensure timely responses to your team, clients, and manager. You assert your views confidently and use multiple channels to share information effectively.

StayVista is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decisions based on race, colour, religion, caste, creed, nationality, age, sex, including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable laws.

We are passionate about cultivating career advancements for our people and supporting them through mentorship, leadership, and career development programs. Our exceptional team is the cornerstone of MarketStar's accomplishments. We are proud of our award-winning workplace culture and for being named a top employer. These achievements are a testament to our six core values, embraced by our 3,000+ employees worldwide. From our headquarters in Utah, USA, to our global offices in India, Ireland, Bulgaria, Mexico, the Philippines, and Australia, we all work together to drive innovation and success.

  

We are excited to have you apply to join our MarketStar team and can’t wait to discuss how we can help you find growth!

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a professional with proven knowledge & experience of list-building methodologies and techniques. Conducting & Collecting Information on Primary/ Secondary/ Web research to find out the contact details of relevant business executives. Contact profiling through various search engines, websites & database tools.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct thorough research to identify potential leads and compile accurate and comprehensive contact lists.
* Utilize various online resources, databases, and tools to gather relevant information on prospects.
* Identify and target key decision-makers within identified companies to expand the sales pipeline.
* Generate high-quality leads that align with the company's target market and ideal customer profile (ICP).
* Maintain and update the lead database, ensuring all information is accurate, current, and organized.
* Regularly clean and verify the integrity of the data to avoid duplications and outdated entries.
* Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to understand their requirements and provide lists that meet their criteria.
* Support sales campaigns by providing targeted lists and segmenting data as needed.
* Monitor the performance of the generated lists, tracking key metrics such as lead quality and conversion rates.
* Provide regular reports and insights on list-building activities and their impact on sales and marketing efforts.
Stay updated on new tools and technologies that can enhance lead generation and data management efforts.  

**Key Skills:**

* 0-4 years of experience in a lead generation, data management, or research-focused role.
* Proven track record of building and maintaining high-quality lead databases.
* Proficiency in using CRM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with lead generation tools and software like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, etc.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides).
* Ability to utilize various tools and databases for data collection.
Strong attention to detail to ensure the accuracy and completeness of collected data.  

**What’s in it for you?**

Constant Learning and an entrepreneurial growth mindset. Employee-centric benefits plan including but not limited to Comprehensive Health Insurance, generous Leave Policy, Covid Support, Vaccination drives, Well-being sessions, real-time grievance redressal, and work flexibility.

We are a people-first organization with policies and processes that help you bring the best version of yourself into work including fast-track growth for high-potential folks. An opportunity to be associated with the world’s leading brands as clients. To be a part of an organization with more than 60% of homegrown Leaders. Customized training programs that are catered to personal and professional development. We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success.

**Note:** This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position and is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities, or working conditions associated with it. Responsibilities may change over time to accommodate business needs.

**If You're up for this position, hit the Apply Now Button!**

**Job Description – Operations Manager (Government Liaisoning)**

**Department:** Operations  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years  
**Industry:** Real Estate / PropTech / Property Consultancy  
**Location:** Bangalore  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager – Government Liaisoning to manage government coordination, property documentation, land-related approvals and operational activities. The candidate should have strong knowledge of Karnataka government departments, revenue procedures, land records and property registration processes.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently handling government applications, coordinating with relevant authorities, managing field operations and ensuring timely completion of property-related documentation and approvals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Government Liaisoning & Coordination**

* Coordinate with government departments such as Revenue Department, Taluk Office, BBMP, BDA, BMRDA, Sub-Registrar Office and Survey Department.
* Liaise with Tahsildars, Revenue Inspectors, Village Accountants and other government officials.
* Handle government office visits, application submissions and follow-ups.
* Maintain professional relationships with relevant government authorities.

**2. Land & Property Documentation**

* Handle and verify property-related documents such as RTC, Mutation, EC, Sale Deed, Gift Deed, Partition Deed, POA, Khata and Conversion Orders.
* Understand 11E sketches, Akarband, Tippani, Survey Sketch and other land records.
* Coordinate property document verification and identify discrepancies.
* Handle documentation related to rectification, cancellation and lease deeds.

**3. Government Approvals & Application Processing**

* Manage applications related to DC Conversion, land mutation, Khata transfer, land survey and property registration.
* Coordinate layout approvals, building plan approvals and other property-related permissions.
* Track application status and ensure timely submission and completion.
* Resolve application objections, documentation issues and procedural delays.

**4. Operations & Team Management**

* Manage daily operations and allocate responsibilities to team members.
* Supervise field executives and liaisoning coordinators.
* Monitor application progress and ensure timely completion within defined TAT.
* Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Legal, Technical and Customer Support.
* Handle escalations and improve operational efficiency.

**5. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain application tracking reports, pending case reports and follow-up trackers.
* Monitor application turnaround time and team performance.
* Maintain records of government applications, approvals and customer documentation.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly operational reports for management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience in Government Liaisoning, Real Estate Operations or Property Documentation.
* Strong knowledge of Karnataka government departments and land-related procedures.
* Practical experience coordinating with Revenue, Survey, Registration and Municipal departments.
* Good understanding of property documents and land records.
* Experience handling government applications and approval processes independently.
* Strong communication, coordination and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage teams, field operations and multiple applications simultaneously.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, MIS reporting and documentation management.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Real Estate Developers / Builders
* PropTech Companies
* Property Consultancy Firms
* Land Documentation and Legal Services
* Real Estate Advisory Companies

**Additional Advantage**

* Knowledge of Karnataka Land Revenue Act and Registration Act.
* Familiarity with Bhoomi, Kaveri and other Karnataka government portals.
* Law or Civil Engineering educational background.
* Experience handling land conversion, survey and mutation processes.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of government applications and approvals.
* Reduction in pending applications and processing delays.
* Accuracy of property documentation.
* Effective coordination with government departments.
* Team productivity and operational efficiency.
* Timely MIS reporting and case-status updates.
