title: [Evergreen] Technical Account Manager
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the cornerstone of technical customer success. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.

This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.  
  
***This is a hybrid position based in our Bengaluru office, requiring you to participate in an on-call rotation schedule to triage and manage high-severity issues and outages.***  
  
**You should apply if:**

  

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization:** Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.
* **Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience:** Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.
* **Execute Transformational Technical Account Management:** Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.
* **Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise:** Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.
* **Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning:** Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.
* **Communicate with Influence and Clarity:** Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.
* **Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.
* **Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier:** Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.
* **Embody Samsara's Values & Principles:** Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* **Experience:** 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success.
* **Education:** We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.
* **Bilingual:** English and Spanish is a must.
* **Customer Focus:** A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required.
* **Collaborative Spirit:** A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.
* Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.
* Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.
* Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions

#LI-hybrid

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

**Fraudulent Employment Offers**

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

**About G2 - The Company**

G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.

Now, we have joined forces with Capterra, SoftwareAdvice, and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.

And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.

Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!

**About G2 - Our People**

At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (*P*erformance + *E*ntrepreneurship + *A*uthenticity + *K*indness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.

You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.

**About The Role**
------------------

This is a leadership role where you will be leading a team of quota carrying SMB Account Executives (EMEA/APAC) who are responsible for new business acquisition in our Emerging Vendor segment. You will be responsible for achieving revenue goals of your region and segment while driving consistent growth and efficiency. The person in this role needs to be a natural problem solver and a mentor to their team which is working in one of our fastest growing segments selling G2 Marketing Solutions. You will need to own reporting, planning, deal operations and forecast for your team. Since this team will be managing Global customers out of India, this role will require you to work in shifts and collaborate closely with your global counterparts. **This role is a hybrid in-office role, with a three-day workweek.**

**In This Role, You Will:**
---------------------------

**Sales (40%)**

* Help your team drive urgency with prospects and help them see value in G2’s solutions.
* Lead and involve executive engagement and sponsorship on high growth accounts.
* Maintain a high acquisition rate and average selling price.
* Drive the culture of self-sourced pipeline development within your team and measure it consistently.
* Help you team in deal management and negotiations.

**Operations (20%)**

* Be an adviser to your team on their deals and provide guidance on both strategic and tactical aspects to win a customer.
* Adapt and implement MEDDPICC methodology for deal reviews and health (while it’s preferable for the candidate to be aware of MEDDPICC, this is not a deal breaker).
* Drive forecast discipline week-on-week with your team on deals and goals Focus on forecasting accuracy.
* Drive discipline in organisational training and compliance across your team.
* Report forecast and performance of your team to your leader week-on-week.
* Drive adherence to processes and cadence from your team.
* Drive executive engagement and sponsorship on high growth accounts.

**Team Management (30%)**

* Create a cadence to conduct frequent review of your team’s performance and their career growth.
* Success will be measured by the performance of your teams on input metrics, deal hygiene and output metrics.
* Identify, action and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience.
* Identify opportunity areas within your team and adapt mentorship based on the individuals you are managing.
* Drive a culture of camaraderie and competitiveness to build a healthy team.
* Drive discipline in organisational training and compliance across your team.
* Drive consistently in performance aligning to G2’s overall goals and roadmap.
* Focus on training and development for your team.

**Collaboration (10%)**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with your peers and leaders from cross-functional teams to align on goals and objectives.
* Forecast your business to your leadership team accurately and identify areas of improvement.
* Work with cross-functional teams on projects and initiatives to help your customers, company and team.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

* 10+ years in B2B SaaS Sales and preferably an experience selling into global markets.
* 2+ years sales leadership experience
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a true sales hunter approach.
* Extensive experience negotiating terms and closing contracts for business.
* Strategic thinker with strong storytelling skills and written communication.
* Proven ability to scale sales operations and achieve revenue goals.
* Strong leadership, communication, and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Educational qualification: Graduate degree or higher.

**Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity**

At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran, or physical or mental disability status.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced Solutions/Delivery Subject Matter Representative (SMR) to drive the growth and delivery excellence of our Financial Services Managed Services practice, with a primary focus on the Insurance sector and secondary coverage across Banking and Wealth & Asset Management.The role requires a unique combination of deep Managed Services delivery experience, AMS solutioning expertise, and Financial Services domain knowledge. The successful candidate will be responsible for shaping, estimating, costing, and designing Application Management Services (AMS) solutions while acting as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders and clients.The individual will play a critical role in supporting sales pursuits, responding to RFPs, conducting client workshops, participating in proposal defenses, and driving successful transition and delivery strategies for managed services engagements. The role will also serve as a competency leader, helping build service offerings, develop delivery talent, and scale Financial Services Managed Services capabilities.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

**Solutioning & Pre-Sales**

* Lead the design, estimation, costing, and staffing of Application Management Services (AMS) and Managed Services engagements across Financial Services clients.
* Build scalable support, maintenance, enhancement, and operate models aligned to client requirements and commercial constructs.
* Develop solution approaches across Fixed Price, Outcome-Based, Managed Capacity, Unit-Based, and Time & Material commercial models.
* Prepare winning proposals, RFP responses, Statements of Work (SOWs), solution presentations, and participate in client orals.
* Drive solution workshops with client stakeholders to define scope, service levels, operating models, governance structures, and transition strategies.
* Position EY assets, accelerators, automation solutions, and managed services frameworks to improve competitiveness and value realization.

**Managed Services Delivery Leadership**

* Bring practical AMS delivery experience by leveraging prior leadership of application support teams consisting of 30+ team members across multiple locations.
* Define target operating models, transition plans, governance frameworks, service management processes, and support structures.
* Ensure proposed solutions are operationally viable, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned with delivery best practices.
* Provide SME guidance on incident, problem, change, release, service request, and knowledge management processes aligned with ITIL principles.
* Support transition, stabilization, and continuous improvement activities for managed services engagements.
* Drive automation opportunities and industrialization initiatives to improve service quality, predictability, and operational efficiency.

**Financial Services Domain Leadership**

* Act as a competency SME for Insurance, Banking, and Wealth & Asset Management managed services opportunities.
* Apply industry knowledge to create differentiated managed services offerings tailored to Financial Services clients.
* Demonstrate understanding of key insurance processes including Policy Administration, Claims, Billing, Underwriting, Distribution, Customer Service, and Agency Management.
* Understand banking and wealth management technology landscapes and operating models to support cross-sector opportunities.
* Identify emerging market trends and develop service propositions aligned with client transformation priorities.

**Practice and Capability Development**

* Support the development and enhancement of Financial Services Managed Services offerings and go-to-market assets.
* Collaborate with delivery leaders, account teams, alliances, and competency leads to expand Managed Services opportunities.
* Mentor consultants and managers in solutioning, managed services delivery, and financial services domain capabilities.
* Contribute to competency building, knowledge management, and reusable solution frameworks.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, productivity, automation, and client satisfaction.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong expertise in designing and solutioning AMS and Managed Services engagements.
* Ability to combine deep delivery experience with commercial and operational solution design.
* Strong understanding of application support delivery models, service management frameworks, and operating structures.
* Experience managing stakeholder expectations across executive, business, technology, and delivery leadership teams.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and client-facing skills.
* Demonstrated capability to lead pursuit discussions, solution workshops, and executive presentations.
* Proven ability to work across geographically distributed teams in onsite-offshore delivery models.
* Strong commercial acumen including effort estimation, pricing, staffing models, productivity assumptions, and risk management.
* Ability to create executive-quality proposals, solution documents, and business cases.
* Strong people leadership and team development capabilities.
* Growth mindset with the ability to identify new opportunities and support account expansion initiatives.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 12+ years of overall experience in IT Services, Consulting, Managed Services, or Application Management Services.
* Minimum 7-8 years of hands-on AMS delivery and managed services leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading delivery teams of 25-30+ FTEs in global onsite-offshore delivery models.
* Minimum 5-7 years of experience designing, costing, estimating, and solutioning AMS engagements.
* Experience supporting multiple clients across Insurance, Banking, or Wealth & Asset Management sectors.
* Strong experience in pre-sales, proposal development, client presentations, and pursuit support.
* Experience developing operating models, transition plans, governance frameworks, and managed service delivery structures.

  

**Industry Expertise**

* Strong knowledge of Insurance business processes, platforms, and technology ecosystems.
* Understanding of P&C, Life, Health, Specialty, or Commercial Insurance operations preferred.
* Exposure to Banking and Wealth & Asset Management business functions and supporting technology landscapes.
* Ability to translate business objectives into scalable managed services solutions.

  

**Technical & Delivery Knowledge**

* Familiarity with cloud-based application support environments and digital operations.
* Understanding of DevOps, Agile delivery, Service Management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience supporting applications built on technologies such as Java, .NET, Microsoft stack, web applications, APIs, cloud platforms, packaged applications, and modern enterprise ecosystems.

* Experience with Insurance core platforms such as Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, or comparable FS ecosystems.

* Credible delivery leadership experience.

* A proven ability to win work, build teams, and deliver scalable managed services solutions.

description:
**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports & Cine Optics.

ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales & Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.

Further information at ZEISS India .

**Role Overview**
=================

The National Head – Customer Service & Logistics will lead the end-to-end customer service, order management, warehousing coordination, and logistics agenda across India. The role is accountable for delivering reliable order fulfilment, compliant operations, efficient logistics partnerships, and consistently strong customer experience across a network of 20 stock points.

The position manages 3 direct reports and more than 25 indirect reports, providing strategic direction, operational governance, capability building, and performance oversight to the pan-India customer service and logistics team.

**Key Stakeholders**
====================

**Internal:** Sales, Finance, Legal, Regulatory, and Administration teams.

**External:** Customers, third-party logistics service providers, transporters, and courier vendors.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Order Management and Customer Service**
--------------------------------------------

* Own the national order-to-delivery process and establish consistent service standards across all stock points.
* Ensure accurate and timely order processing, allocation, fulfilment, invoicing coordination, and delivery tracking.
* Monitor order backlogs, service exceptions, returns, claims, and customer escalations; drive timely resolution and root-cause correction.
* Partner with Sales and Finance to align order priorities, credit or commercial dependencies, inventory availability, and customer commitments.
* Define and track customer service metrics, operating dashboards, review mechanisms, and escalation protocols.

**2. Logistics and 3PL Management**
-----------------------------------

* Lead logistics operations across the national distribution network, balancing service, speed, cost, capacity, and compliance.
* Manage relationships and performance of 3PL partners, transporters, and courier vendors through defined service levels and regular business reviews.
* Own contract coordination, commercial evaluations, renewals, and onboarding of logistics service providers in collaboration with Legal, Finance, and Procurement or Administration stakeholders, as applicable.
* Assess new logistics requirements, network capacity, route needs, and service models to support business growth.
* Prepare and manage logistics budgets, monitor actual expenditure, identify variances, and deliver sustainable cost improvements.

**3. Audit and Operational Governance**
---------------------------------------

* Ensure readiness for statutory and internal audits across customer service and logistics operations.
* Maintain appropriate records, standard operating procedures, control evidence, licenses, vendor documents, and corrective-action trackers.
* Coordinate audit responses, close observations within agreed timelines, and strengthen controls to prevent recurrence.
* Establish governance routines across stock points to ensure process consistency, accountability, and transparent reporting.

**4. Regulatory and Legal Compliance**
--------------------------------------

* Liaise with Regulatory, Legal, Finance, and local operating teams to support ongoing compliance at all stock points.
* Coordinate the availability, renewal, and documentation of applicable drug licenses, GST registrations, trade licenses, and other required approvals.
* Monitor compliance requirements affecting warehousing, distribution, transportation, invoicing, and customer service processes.
* Escalate compliance risks promptly and ensure agreed remediation actions are implemented and documented.

**5. Team Leadership**
----------------------

* Lead, supervise, and develop the pan-India customer service and logistics organization comprising 3 direct reports and more than 25 indirect reports.
* Set clear goals, role accountabilities, performance standards, and review cadences for national and stock-point teams.
* Build team capability through coaching, process training, knowledge sharing, succession planning, and cross-functional exposure.
* Promote a culture of customer focus, ownership, collaboration, compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure adequate workforce planning, workload allocation, and backup coverage for business continuity.

**6. Special Projects and Continuous Improvement**
--------------------------------------------------

* Lead projects focused on logistics cost optimization, distribution-network optimization, customer delight, and faster order fulfilment.
* Use operational data to identify bottlenecks, prioritize improvement opportunities, and measure the impact of interventions.
* Drive process standardization, automation opportunities, and scalable ways of working across stock points.

**Candidate Profile**
=====================

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Graduate degree in supply chain management, logistics, operations, business administration, commerce, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
* Substantial experience in customer service, order management, logistics, distribution, or supply-chain operations, including leadership responsibility across multiple locations.

title: Senior Executive - Accounts
description:
Halma is a global group of life-saving technologies companies, driven by a clear purpose. We are an FTSE 100 company with headquarters in the UK and operations in 23 countries, including regional hubs in India, China, Brazil, and the US.

Our diverse group of nearly 50 global companies specialise in market leading technologies that push the boundaries of science and technology.

Halma India fulfils the potential of the region by harnessing the diverse talents, expertise, infrastructure, and operational resources. At Halma India, We have a team of over 280 professionals representing commercial, digital, business support group and support functions across our seven offices in India, two in Bengaluru and one each in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Thanjavur, Vadodara, and Ahmedabad.

**Position Objective**
----------------------

The Senior Accounts Executive will ensure the financial records of Halma, specially on AR and Inventory, are maintained accurately in conformance to the accounting policies, internal controls and the statutory requirements and thereby minimizing financial risk the organization is exposed to. He / She will also be responsible to prepare and provide various reports and analysis.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Invoicing & Accounts Receivable**

* Ensure timely and accurate posting of customer receipts, invoices and credit notes in the ERP system.
* Manage and monitor customer credit limits in ERP in accordance with the credit policy.
* Maintain customer credit assessment reports and related trackers.
* Ensure export invoices are generated accurately and all applicable documents, including e-Invoices and e-Way Bills are prepared and issued on time.
* Ensure accurate preparation of recharge calculations and timely submission of OPCO invoices.
* Prepare and review Accounts Receivable ageing reports, proactively monitor overdue receivables and ensure timely closure of outstanding reconciling items.
* Coordinate with customers, Sales teams, and OPCO representatives to ensure timely collections and resolution of payment disputes.

### **Inventory Accounting and Records Maintenance**

* Coordinate periodic physical inventory verification and reconcile inventory variances with ERP records.
* Process inventory adjustment and write-off entries after obtaining necessary approvals.
* Perform periodic reconciliation of Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and purchase accounts to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Calculate and account for inventory obsolescence provisions and debtors provisions in accordance with company policies and accounting standards.

### **Product Pricing & SVB Compliances**

* Support business teams with product pricing calculations and ensure product pricing is accurately maintained and updated in ERP.
* Coordinate Special Valuation Branch (SVB) documentation, submissions, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain proper documentation and trackers for customs and SVB-related matters.

### **Audits & Book Closures**

* Prepare monthly Accounts Receivable schedules, reconciliations, and management reports and update the balances in Tagetik.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close activities within defined timelines.
* Provide required schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents for statutory, internal, tax, and group audits.

### **Other Activities**

* Ensure EDPMS & GR Waivers are timely closed with bank as per RBI guidelines.
* Prepare various ad-hoc reports and maintain updated trackers.
* Ensure timely and accurate posting of necessary journal entries in the ERP system.
* Act as a backup for other activities related to other finance functions as and when required.

### **Process Improvement Initiatives**

* Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation within the Accounts Receivable function.
* Develop and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and process documentation.
* Support ERP enhancements, testing, and system improvement initiatives.
* Guide junior team members and contribute to knowledge sharing and process standardization.

**Critical Success Factors**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of accounting principles, accounting standards and indirect taxes.
* Good understanding of Accounts Receivable, inventory accounting, customs regulations, and import/export compliance.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems.
* Consistently delivers high-quality work within defined timelines.
* Communicating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Proactive, flexible, and collaborative approach to achieving team and organizational objectives.

**Academic Qualification**
--------------------------

* CA Inter / CMA Inter with 1–2 years of experience in Finance & Accounts (post articleship).
* B.Com / M.Com with very good knowledge of accounting concepts and 5–6 years of experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Experience from Manufacturing or Trading companies, preferable.

**Experience**
--------------

* 3–4 years of experience in corporate accounting and taxation.
* Experience in ERP Accounting software and Automation Tools.

**Competencies**
----------------

* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and demonstrate ownership.
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Collaborative and adaptable approach with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Adheres to ethical standards and company policies.

Halma India is a Great Place to Work® certified organisation. Here’s why working with us is fulfilling:

  

**We offer a safe and respectful workplace**, where everyone can be who they ‘REALLY’ are, feel free to bring their whole selves to work and use their unique talents, knowledge, expertise, experiences, & backgrounds to create meaningful outcomes.

Parenting comes with questions, chaos, joy, and more than a few sleepless nights — and through it all, what every parent needs is a support system that just gets it.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented Tendering & Costing Executive with experience in commercial interior projects. The candidate will be responsible for preparing project cost estimates, analysing BOQs, reviewing tender documents, preparing quotations, and submitting competitive commercial proposals. The role requires coordination with the sales, project, procurement, and operations teams to ensure accurate costing and timely tender submissions.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Tender Management**

* Review and analyse tender documents, drawings, specifications, and BOQs.
* Prepare and submit tender documents within specified deadlines.
* Understand project requirements, scope of work, technical specifications, and commercial terms.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals.
* Track tender opportunities and maintain a tender submission database.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, architects, and project teams for tender-related clarifications.

**2. Costing & Estimation**

* Prepare detailed project cost estimates for commercial interior projects.
* Analyse BOQs, quantities, drawings, and technical specifications.
* Calculate material, labour, transportation, installation, and other project-related costs.
* Obtain and compare vendor and supplier quotations.
* Prepare rate analysis and detailed cost breakups.
* Ensure accurate costing and maintain appropriate project margins.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.

**3. BOQ & Quantity Analysis**

* Prepare and review Bill of Quantities (BOQ).
* Perform quantity take-offs from architectural and interior drawings.
* Analyse flooring, ceiling, and other interior product requirements.
* Identify discrepancies in drawings, specifications, and BOQs.
* Coordinate with technical teams for material specifications and product suitability.

**4. Quotation & Commercial Documentation**

* Prepare quotations, cost sheets, pricing schedules, and commercial proposals.
* Review vendor quotations and negotiate pricing where required.
* Prepare comparative statements and cost analysis reports.
* Ensure all commercial submissions are accurate and properly documented.
* Follow up on submitted quotations and tender results.

**5. Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with sales, procurement, logistics, and project execution teams.
* Obtain material prices and technical details from suppliers.
* Support the sales team with project costing and pricing strategies.
* Maintain records of submitted tenders, quotations, revisions, and project estimates.
* Provide regular updates to management on tender status and costing activities.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in tendering, estimation, and costing.
* Experience in commercial interior projects, flooring, ceiling systems, or building materials is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of BOQ preparation, quantity surveying, and rate analysis.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and technical specifications.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and AutoCAD.
* Experience with tender portals and ERP systems will be an advantage.

Required Skills

* Tender preparation and submission
* BOQ preparation and analysis
* Quantity take-off and measurement
* Project costing and estimation
* Rate analysis and pricing
* Vendor quotation comparison
* Technical and commercial documentation
* MS Excel and AutoCAD
* Attention to detail and deadline management

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in preparing estimates and tender submissions for commercial interior projects. They should be capable of independently analysing drawings, preparing BOQs, calculating project costs, obtaining vendor quotations, and submitting accurate and competitive commercial proposals.

title: Capability Lead Planning & Inventory Management
description:
**About us:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.

**Overview about TII**  
  
At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

**About the Role**

The Capability Lead – Planning & Inventory Management plays a critical role in shaping how Target plans demand, positions inventory, and executes flow across the enterprise. This role is accountable for building and evolving enterprise planning and inventory capabilities by tightly integrating demand intelligence, inventory strategy, and operational execution.

Operating as a senior individual contributor (Level 6, Senior Manager equivalent), this role drives synchronization across Merch Planning, Inventory Management, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure demand and inventory strategies collectively support sales growth, inventory health, speed to market, and guest experience.

This role influences enterprise decision‑making through Integrated Business Planning (IBP), builds scalable planning and inventory frameworks, and leads complex, cross‑functional initiatives across discretionary, fast‑fashion, and frequency businesses.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Owns enterprise level inventory management & demand forecasting capabilities, not just functional execution
* Operates independently with broad decision authority and high judgment
* Influences outcomes across PIM, Supply Chain, Finance, and Merch without direct people leadership
* Shapes standards, frameworks, and operating models that scale across multiple businesses
* Drives clarity and alignment in executive and IBP forums through fact based narratives
* Balances near term execution realities with long term capability and system health

**Enterprise Demand Forecasting & Planning Strategy**

* Shape the strategic direction of short‑ and long‑term demand forecasts by synthesizing algorithmic model outputs, historical performance, trend indicators, and business context.
* Partner closely with Data Science to refine forecasting models, validate assumptions, and improve accuracy across stable, seasonal, promotional, transition, and fast‑cycle categories.
* Ensure demand strategies translate into executable receipt, flow, and inventory plans aligned to financial targets and network realities.
* Influence forecasting standards, inputs, and operating rhythms that improve enterprise‑level consistency and decision quality.

**Guest, Trend & Market Signal Integration**

* Integrate guest behavior, digital and store signals, competitive dynamics, fashion and trend insights, macroeconomic inputs, weather impacts, and price/promo effects into demand and inventory plans.
* Translate complex signals into clear, actionable guidance for Merch Planning, Inventory Management, and Merchant partners.
* Anticipate demand inflections, lifecycle shifts, and trend acceleration/slowdown to proactively reposition inventory and adjust flow strategies.

**Inventory Management Strategy & Flow Enablement**

* Lead enterprise inventory management capability across receipt planning, flow phasing, weeks of supply (WOS), and inventory health metrics.
* Guide inventory strategies that balance availability, freshness, speed to market, and risk mitigation across discretionary, fast‑fashion, and frequency businesses.
* Partner with Inventory Operations and Supply Chain to align planning intent with execution constraints, including lead times, capacity, network flow paths, and vendor performance.
* Drive standardized inventory frameworks, tools, and best practices that improve responsiveness, scalability, and inventory productivity.

**Planning & Inventory Synchronization**

* Act as the integrator between demand forecasting, Merch Planning, and Inventory Management to ensure a single, aligned enterprise view of demand, receipts, flow, and inventory investment.
* Resolve systemic disconnects between planning and inventory execution by improving handoffs, decision forums, and operating cadences.
* Strengthen linkages between forecast changes and downstream impacts on receipts, flow timing, inventory health, capacity, and financial outcomes.

**Enterprise Alignment & Demand / Inventory Consensus**

* Influence cross‑functional partners—including Merch Planning, Inventory Management, Supply Chain, Finance, and Analytics—around a unified demand and inventory outlook.
* Shape compelling strategic narratives that reconcile algorithmic forecasts, merchant intent, inventory constraints, and operational tradeoffs.
* Serve as a trusted advisor in resolving demand vs. inventory tensions and prioritizing outcomes that are right for the guest and the enterprise.

**Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Leadership**

* Represent planning and inventory strategy in IBP forums by clearly framing demand and inventory risks, opportunities, and scenarios.
* Connect forecast and trend shifts to implications on receipts, flow sequencing, inventory investment, and capacity requirements.
* Guide senior leaders toward informed, trade‑off‑based decisions that balance growth, margin, inventory productivity, and service.

**Advanced Demand Sensing & Inventory Analytics Partnership**

* Partner with Data Science and Analytics teams to evolve demand sensing and inventory optimization capabilities.
* Incorporate early performance signals, short‑lifecycle indicators, trend shifts, weather, and promotional response into planning and inventory decisions.
* Influence enhancements to planning and inventory decision‑support tools, inputs, and analytical frameworks.

**Forecast, Inventory Performance & Capability Leadership**

* Lead forecast accuracy, inventory health, and flow performance reviews across Promo, Seasonal, New Item, Transition, and Frequency categories.
* Diagnose root causes, identify systemic gaps, and drive improvement plans in partnership with Planning and Inventory teams.
* Establish enterprise benchmarks, metrics, and operating norms that elevate performance.
* Build durable planning and inventory capability through frameworks, playbooks, documentation, and hands‑on coaching.

**Qualifications Required:**

* Minimum 10+ years of overall experience, including 8+ years in Demand Planning, Assortment Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, Merchandise Planning, or related Planning functions, with deep expertise in retail planning processes and business operations.
* Experience working with enterprise planning platforms such as o9 Solutions, Blue Yonder (JDA), SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Kinaxis, Oracle Demand Planning, or similar planning solutions.
* Proven experience in fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Deep expertise in enterprise planning methodologies, demand forecasting, assortment planning, inventory optimization, planning governance, and performance enablement.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives through strong project management, stakeholder engagement, communication, and influencing skills to deliver strategic business outcomes.
* Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to lead through ambiguity, drive organizational change, and accelerate the adoption of planning capabilities and new ways of working.

**Impact**

This role plays a pivotal part in advancing how Target plans and executes—ensuring demand signals, inventory strategies, and operational execution move in sync. By strengthening planning and inventory capabilities and improving enterprise alignment, this role directly enables better guest outcomes, healthier inventory, and more agile execution across the enterprise.

description:
**Account Manager - Vertical Sales, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG)**

**Location:** Bengaluru | Individual Contributor | Customer-facing sales role

**Role purpose**

Own and grow strategic CPG accounts across Bengaluru / South India, with assigned national CPG accounts. Act as the customer relationship owner, shaping near-term order intake while building multi-year transformation partnerships across automation, drives, industrial software, services and digitalization. The role requires high customer mobility, strong plant and corporate engagement, and the ability to connect immediate brownfield opportunities with strategic modernization and digital-transformation programmes.

**Key responsibilities**

* Build account strategies, stakeholder maps and 1-3 year growth roadmaps for assigned customers, covering corporate, plant, procurement, engineering, operations and digital leadership.
* Deliver short-term sales goals through disciplined opportunity creation, qualification, forecasting, negotiation and closure, while protecting margin and customer value.
* Create long-term engagement through executive relationships, installed-base modernization plans, greenfield influence, digital roadmaps, sustainability themes and multi-site replication.
* Identify customer pain points and translate them into measurable business value, ROI and differentiated Siemens propositions rather than stand-alone product quotations.
* Develop a healthy, evidence-based pipeline; maintain accurate CRM data; run weekly opportunity reviews and monthly account-plan reviews with clear milestones and next actions.
* Orchestrate technical sales, business units, services, software teams, partners, OEMs, EPCs and consultants while retaining clear end-to-end account ownership.
* Track competition, buying centres, specifications, project signals and share of wallet; convert market intelligence into early customer actions and account-specific battle plans.
* Capture win/loss learning, create references from successful use cases and replicate proven solutions across customer plants and adjacent CPG accounts.

**Strategic acumen and dynamism required**

* Think strategically, but move with urgency: switch comfortably between today’s forecast blocker, this quarter’s target and a multi-year customer transformation agenda.
* Operate with high energy, curiosity and resilience in an ambiguous environment; proactively open doors, challenge assumptions and create opportunities before formal RFQs.
* Balance hunting and farming: acquire new business, expand existing accounts, revive inactive relationships and displace entrenched competition through value and risk-managed migration.
* Communicate credibly from shopfloor to CXO level, combining industry understanding, commercial judgment and concise executive storytelling.
* Show strong ownership, collaboration and learning agility; mobilize the wider Siemens ecosystem without waiting for perfect information or losing speed.

**Experience and capability profile**

* Approximately 8-12 years of B2B sales, strategic account management or business development experience in industrial automation, electrical/drive systems, industrial software, digitalization or related technology solutions.
* Demonstrated success in owning complex accounts, developing pipeline, negotiating commercial outcomes and converting consultative opportunities into orders.
* Exposure to CPG, food and beverage, brewery, dairy, FMCG, process industries or high-speed manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Working understanding of plant automation and digital architectures, including PLC/DCS/SCADA, drives, MES/MOM, industrial edge, data/AI use cases, lifecycle services and OT cybersecurity.
* Strong stakeholder management, forecasting discipline, presentation and negotiation skills; willingness to travel extensively to customer and project locations.
* Engineering or technology degree preferred; MBA or equivalent commercial qualification is an advantage.

**Success measures**

* Order intake, revenue, gross margin and forecast accuracy against agreed targets.
* Qualified pipeline coverage, new-application creation and share-of-wallet growth.
* CXO access, early project influence, account-plan milestone completion and customer engagement cadence.
* Conversion of pilots/references into multi-site rollouts, modernization programmes or recurring business.
* CRM quality, cross-functional orchestration and customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate combines strategic depth with frontline intensity: a thoughtful account architect who is equally comfortable closing the next order and shaping the next three years of customer growth.

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About Klipit.ai**

Klipit.ai is building technology solutions that help businesses streamline their HR, finance, accounting, and document management processes. Our enterprise product portfolio includes:

* **BizHR:** HRMS, employee management, attendance, payroll, and related HR operations.
* **Bizpro:** Invoice management, expense reimbursement, accounting automation, and integrations with accounting platforms such as Tally.
* **Bizvault:** Secure cloud storage and document management for businesses.

We are looking for a results-driven **Outbound Calling Manager** to lead our telecalling and lead qualification team, generate qualified sales meetings, and build a predictable pipeline of opportunities for our sales team.

**Role Overview**

The candidate will be responsible for managing a team of outbound callers who connect with prospective businesses, understand their requirements, qualify leads, and schedule high-quality product demonstrations and sales meetings.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong team management, outbound sales process expertise, performance monitoring, and the ability to deliver measurable results through disciplined execution.

The primary objective is not just to generate calls, but to convert prospecting efforts into qualified meetings and revenue opportunities for the sales team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Management & Leadership**

* Recruit, train, manage, and motivate a team of outbound callers and lead qualification executives.
* Set daily, weekly, and monthly targets for calls, qualified leads, meetings booked, and meetings attended.
* Conduct daily team huddles, performance reviews, call coaching, and periodic training sessions.
* Monitor individual productivity and take corrective action to improve performance.
* Build a target-oriented culture focused on meeting quality rather than call volumes alone.

**2. Outbound Calling & Lead Qualification**

* Develop and execute outbound calling strategies targeting SMEs, startups, distributors, manufacturers, and other relevant businesses.
* Ensure callers effectively communicate the value propositions of BizHR, Bizpro, and Bizvault.
* Qualify prospects based on company size, employee strength, business requirements, existing software, decision-maker access, and purchase intent.
* Identify the appropriate decision-makers, including business owners, CFOs, finance heads, HR managers, and operations heads.
* Schedule qualified product demos and sales meetings for the enterprise sales team.
* Ensure accurate lead information, qualification notes, meeting confirmations, and follow-up records are maintained in the CRM.

**3. Sales Pipeline & Meeting Management**

* Work closely with the sales team to understand the ideal customer profile and improve meeting quality.
* Ensure scheduled meetings meet agreed qualification criteria and are relevant to the assigned salesperson.
* Track meetings booked, meetings attended, cancellations, no-shows, and conversions into opportunities.
* Coordinate with sales executives to collect feedback on lead quality and continuously improve qualification standards.
* Implement follow-up processes to minimise meeting drop-offs and maximise attendance.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified meetings to support monthly customer acquisition targets.

**4. Data Management & Performance Reporting**

* Monitor daily calling activity, connect rates, conversations, lead qualification rates, and meeting conversion rates.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports for management.
* Analyse campaign performance, lead sources, calling scripts, and team productivity.
* Work with the marketing team to improve lead quality and optimise campaign outcomes.
* Maintain clean, accurate, and updated CRM records and ensure disciplined follow-up.

**5. Process Improvement**

* Develop effective calling scripts, objection-handling frameworks, and qualification checklists.
* Design separate calling approaches for HR, finance, accounting automation, and document management prospects.
* Introduce structured training and quality monitoring processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity through better data, segmentation, automation, and calling practices.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4 years of experience in outbound telecalling, inside sales, lead generation, or sales development.
* At least 2 years of experience managing and achieving targets through a team of callers or lead qualification executives.
* Proven track record of generating qualified B2B meetings for field sales, inside sales, or enterprise sales teams.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, HRMS, accounting software, fintech, ERP, or other business technology solutions is preferred.
* Strong people management, coaching, communication, and objection-handling skills.
* Ability to analyse performance metrics and take data-driven decisions.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, Excel/Google Sheets, and telecalling tools.
* Strong organisational skills and a target-driven mindset.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be measured against business outcomes, including:

* Number of qualified meetings scheduled per month.
* Percentage of scheduled meetings successfully attended.
* Percentage of meetings accepted by the sales team as qualified.
* Lead-to-meeting conversion rate.
* Meeting-to-opportunity and meeting-to-customer conversion rates.
* Team productivity and achievement of monthly targets.
* Accuracy of CRM data and follow-up discipline.

title: Founding Business Director
description:
**Founding Business Director – Finance & AI**

**Nebula Finance AI | Bangalore, India**

**Employment type:** Full-time, following a six-month probationary period  
**Location:** Kannur, Kerala, India  
**Expected office launch:** January 2027  
**Reporting to:** Founder  
**Travel:** Regular domestic travel, with potential international travel  
**Future mobility:** Willingness to relocate to other metros and international location as the business matures.

**About Nebula Finance AI**

Nebula Finance AI is an emerging financial technology company building an AI-powered finance workflow and intelligence platform for corporate clients in India.

Developed by AI engineers from Great Britain, our platform is designed to transform how corporate finance and treasury teams manage financial workflows, access insights, evaluate financial decisions, and automate repetitive processes.

Our solutions focus on practical applications across corporate treasury and finance, including cash and liquidity management, foreign exchange exposure and hedging, debt management, investments, receivables analysis, and AI-assisted financial decision-making.

By connecting financial data, business systems, banking workflows, and AI-powered intelligence, Nebula aims to help organisations improve efficiency, visibility, risk management, and the quality of financial decisions.

We have completed pilot testing with two major corporate organisations in India and are preparing to commence commercial operations. We are now establishing our first Indian office in Kannur, Kerala, with a planned launch in January 2027.

This is an opportunity to join Nebula at its earliest stage and help shape its commercial journey from the ground up.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly versatile, commercially minded and technology-oriented **Founding Business Director** to work directly with the Founder based in the UK.

The successful candidate will bring in **16-20 years of enterprise sales experience, closing large value enterprise solutions.** The person will have experience dealing with SAP, Oracle solutions and will be a well-known name in the market place.

The person will play a central role in developing client relationships, identifying business opportunities, demonstrating our technology, understanding customer requirements, and supporting the implementation and commercial growth of the Nebula platform.

As our first employee in India, you will have significant exposure to the Founder, senior corporate decision-makers, and the development of a growing AI-finance business.

The ideal candidate will combine a sound understanding of corporate finance and treasury with excellent communication skills, commercial awareness, technological curiosity, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Corporate Client Acquisition and Relationship Management**

* Identify and develop business opportunities with large Indian corporates, including organisations with complex finance and treasury operations.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with Chief Financial Officers (CFOs), Chief Executive Officers (CEOs), Treasurers, Finance Directors, and other senior decision-makers.
* Research target organisations, understand their business models, and identify opportunities where Nebula's solutions can create measurable value.
* Arrange client meetings, introduce the platform, follow up on opportunities, and support the conversion of prospects into paying customers.
* Maintain a structured pipeline of prospects, meetings, demonstrations, proposals, and commercial opportunities.

**2. Platform Demonstrations and Solution Development**

* Develop a thorough understanding of the Nebula Finance AI platform, its modules, and its business applications.
* Conduct product demonstrations for prospective clients, including senior finance executives and corporate treasury teams.
* Understand customer requirements and translate business problems into practical technology use cases.
* Work with the Founder and technical team to communicate client feedback, refine demonstrations, and support the development of new features.
* Assist in preparing presentations, proposals, business cases, product documentation, and client-specific solution designs.

**3. Corporate Finance and Treasury**

* Develop a detailed understanding of corporate finance and treasury workflows, including cash management, liquidity forecasting, FX exposure, hedging, investments, debt management, and receivables.
* Understand how corporate finance teams interact with banks, ERP systems, financial data, and internal approval processes.
* Help identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and improve financial visibility through AI.
* Participate in discussions with client finance teams to understand existing processes and demonstrate how Nebula can improve them.

**4. Technology and AI Applications**

* Develop a working understanding of the technical architecture and capabilities of the Nebula platform.
* Demonstrate technological curiosity and an ability to understand how software applications, APIs, databases, AI models, and ERP integrations work.
* Work with the technical team to translate client requirements into clear functional specifications.
* Support platform testing, troubleshooting, user onboarding, and the preparation of user guides.
* Contribute to the development of practical AI-powered workflows for corporate finance.

**A strong interest in coding and software development is essential.** Candidates who can read or write basic code, understand APIs, work with data, or build simple technical demonstrations will have an advantage.

**5. Commercial Operations and Business Development**

* Support the Founder in preparing commercial proposals, pricing discussions, presentations, and client engagement strategies.
* Conduct market research to identify prospective customers, competitors, industry trends, and emerging opportunities in corporate finance technology.
* Maintain accurate records of client interactions, sales opportunities, and follow-up actions using a CRM or other business tools.
* Assist with client onboarding, implementation coordination, training, and ongoing relationship management.
* Help establish the processes, standards, and operating practices required to build Nebula's first Indian office.

**6. Founder’s Office and Strategic Projects**

* Work directly with the Founder on business development, strategic initiatives, operational planning, and market expansion.
* Take ownership of projects from initial research through execution and follow-up.
* Prepare concise reports, market assessments, meeting notes, and management updates.
* Represent Nebula professionally in client meetings, industry events, and business discussions.
* Be prepared to take on responsibilities beyond a conventional job description as the company evolves.

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

* **16- 20 years of enterprise sales solution experience with a demonstrated history of the being a top-performer in the industry**.
* A well-known name in the market place and a thorough understanding of the gap in SAP and Oracle ERP Solutions with **a portfolio of client which could be moved**.
* Ability to onboard a few clients during the probationary period and proving his ability to catapult Nebula to greater heights in Indian and GCC markets.
* **Apart from a senior ERP sales consultant, senior banker, corporate advisor, retired CFO, ex-auditor etc will act as a strong candidate for the role.**
* A bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* An MBA in Finance, Business Management, or a related field is preferred.
* A strong understanding of corporate finance, treasury, financial markets, or business financial operations.
* Excellent spoken and written English. This is a non-negotiable requirement, given the role's direct interaction with senior corporate executives.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, communication, and client-management skills.
* A good understanding of coding and software development concepts, with the ability to engage confidently with technical teams.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand complex business problems.
* A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently.
* Willingness to travel regularly to major Indian cities based on client and business requirements.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

The following would be advantageous:

* Experience in corporate treasury, banking, financial services, fintech, enterprise software, or B2B technology sales.
* Exposure to FX markets, derivatives, hedging, liquidity management, investments, or debt financing.
* Experience engaging with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Directors, or other senior corporate stakeholders.
* Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP, financial software, APIs, databases, or business intelligence tools.
* Basic programming experience in Python, JavaScript, SQL, or similar languages.
* Familiarity with AI tools, large language models (LLMs), automation, or workflow software.
* Experience preparing business presentations, conducting product demonstrations, and developing commercial proposals.

Candidates with a strong combination of finance knowledge, technical aptitude, communication skills, and commercial potential will be considered even if they do not meet every preferred criterion.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who:

* Thinks like a business owner rather than someone who simply completes assigned tasks.
* Is comfortable speaking with senior executives and presenting complex concepts clearly.
* Can understand both the financial problem and the technological solution.
* Learns quickly, asks intelligent questions, and takes initiative.
* Is comfortable working in an early-stage startup where responsibilities evolve.
* Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining professionalism and attention to detail.
* Values confidentiality, integrity, accountability, and long-term client relationships.
* Is ambitious about building a career at the intersection of finance, AI, and enterprise technology.

**Employment Structure**

The role will begin with a **six-month probationary period**. Subject to satisfactory performance and the agreed employment terms, the position will continue as a full-time role.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Founder during the company's initial commercial expansion. As Nebula grows, there will be opportunities to assume greater responsibility across business development, client solutions, commercial operations, and regional expansion.

Compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and suitability for the role. Any performance-linked incentives or other benefits will be communicated during the recruitment process.

**Why Join Nebula Finance AI?**

* **Founding-team opportunity:** Become the first employee in our Indian operations and contribute directly to building the business.
* **Direct exposure to leadership:** Work closely with the Founder and participate in strategic and commercial decisions.
* **Enterprise technology exposure:** Gain practical experience in AI-powered financial workflows, enterprise software, and corporate treasury.
* **Senior client engagement:** Work with CFOs, CEOs, Treasurers, and other senior decision-makers.
* **Ownership and responsibility:** Take the lead on meaningful projects rather than being restricted to a narrow job function.
* **Career growth:** Develop towards leadership responsibilities as the business expands in India and internationally.
* **Geographic mobility:** Potential opportunities to work from other Indian cities or Dubai as the business develops.

**Application Process**

Interested candidates should submit the following:

* An updated CV/resume.
* A recent passport-size photograph.
* A brief cover note explaining their interest in Nebula Finance AI and why they are suited to a founding-team role.
* Details of relevant finance, technology, coding, client-facing, or business development experience.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a written English communication assessment, a finance or treasury case study, a basic technical aptitude assessment, and a product demonstration or business presentation exercise.

**To apply:** Submit your application through the recruitment channel specified in the job advertisement.

**Nebula Finance AI**  
*Building the future of corporate finance through artificial intelligence.*

Pay: ₹75,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per month

title: Business Development Executive - Corporate Sales & B2B Gifting
description:
**ABOUT ATHLOUN**

**A considered brand, built in Bengaluru**

Athloun is a premium menswear brand built on one idea: nature already knew how to breathe, cool and move. We advanced it. We engineer polos, tees and layers from nature-derived fibres and innovative finishes, and we make them to a standard we would be proud to hand to anyone.

Since 2025 we have moved quickly and quietly. Today, corporate teams are some of our most loyal customers, and building that business is the next chapter of our story.

**WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS NOW**

Corporate orders are already our fastest-growing business, and the opportunity is far larger than what we have captured. Every company runs onboarding batches, offsites, events and festive gifting, and most still settle for merchandise that ends up forgotten in a drawer. More companies today think carefully about what they buy and what it says about them. We want Athloun to be their first choice: team wear people are proud to wear, from a brand that takes nature seriously.

Over the next year we will take our corporate offer from Bengaluru to India’s key business cities, earn a place on the vendor lists of leading startups, tech companies, global capability centres and enterprises, and build a network of gifting partners and distributors. You will be the person who makes that happen.

**THE ROLE**

**What you will own**

· Win corporate orders for team wear, uniforms, onboarding kits, event merchandise and festive gifting.

· Build lasting relationships with HR, admin, procurement and event teams, and with corporate gifting distributors and agencies.

· Run the full cycle yourself: first conversation, logo mock-up, sample, quote, delivery and the repeat order.

· Open doors to vendor lists at startups, tech companies, global capability centres and large enterprises.

· Own a sales target, and bring back what buyers want so we keep sharpening the range.

**YOU**

**Who will thrive here**

This role is for people who love a challenge, light up when meeting new people, and do not wait to be told what to do next. If you see a closed door as the start of a conversation, you will feel at home.

· 1–4 years in B2B sales, corporate gifting, merchandise, events or a related field.

· An existing network in procurement, HR, admin or event teams, or among corporate gifting distributors.

· A self-starter’s drive: you follow up without being asked, and you enjoy closing.

· Comfortable working independently in a hybrid setup, and motivated by owning a number.

· Confident communication in English; one or more regional languages is a strong plus.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

**Why join us**

· **Rewarding pay.** A fixed monthly salary plus commission on every order you bring in.

· **Flexibility.** A hybrid role based in Bengaluru.

· **Real ownership.** Join early, work directly with the founder, and see your impact on the business every week.

· **Room to grow.** As the corporate business grows, so does your role, with a clear path into a leadership position.

· **A brand worth selling.** A premium, made-in-India product you will be proud to put in a client’s hands. Patented EcoEMO™ fabric finish, lab-tested UPF 50+, and made in a supply chain certified to GOTS, OEKO-TEX and bluesign.

**THE DETAILS**

**At a glance**

**Designation**: Business Development Executive — Corporate Sales & B2B Gifting

**Location**: Bengaluru, Karnataka (hybrid)

**Employment type**: Full-time

**Experience**: 1–4 years

**Compensation**: Fixed salary + commission

**Reports to**: Founder

**Openings**: 1

**Start date**: Immediate

**Probation**: 6 months

**Travel**: Client visits as required

**Applications close**: 14th November 2026

**HOW TO APPLY**

**Tell us which doors you can open**

Email your CV to support@athloun.com with a short note naming the companies and networks you could open for Athloun. Be specific. That note tells us more than a CV can. Please attach a passport-size photograph with your CV.

We read every application personally. Applications close on 14th November 2026.

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹41,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

description:

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. At Rippling, data is at the heart of our business and the Revenue Operations team leverages this data to provide the insights that have made Rippling one of the fastest-growing companies in the world. In this role, you’ll act as a primary, trusted business partner to senior sales and executive leadership to build, scale, and operationalize a go-to-market strategy for your dedicated part of the sales organization. This role will be focused on our rapidly growing sales team, providing a high level of exposure to senior leadership, complex problem-solving opportunities, and the autonomy to drive major strategic initiatives.

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer.
