description:
**Job Title / Designation:** PPC Manager
  
**Experience:** 15+ Years
  
**Qualification:** BE/Diploma/BTech in Electronics & Communication, Mechanical, Industrial, or Production Engineering.
  
**Job Location:** Bengaluru
  
  
**Role Description**  
  
We are seeking a highly driven Production Planning & Control (PPC) Manager specialist with 15+ years of core experience in EMS or Electronics Manufacturing or Defense or Aerospace, or High-Reliability Electronics Manufacturing. In this role, you will lead end-to-end operational planning, from Material Requirement Planning (MRP) and Master Production Scheduling (MPS) down to shop-floor execution. You will act as the operational center, managing cross-functional workflows across component sourcing, PCBA manufacturing, box-build integration, and Environmental Stress Screening (ESS). Furthermore, you will serve as a key liaison aligning top management strategies, sales targets, and customer delivery commitments with real-time manufacturing capacity.
  
  
**Desired Experience**   
  

* 15+ years of hands-on PPC manager experience in EMS or Electronics Manufacturing or Aerospace or Defense or Automotive, or EMS (Electronic Manufacturing Services) operating under AS9100D, IATF 16949, or ISO 9001 quality frameworks.
* Proven track record in managing high-mix, low-to-medium volume manufacturing, Mechanical assembly, wiring harness, System-level mechanical integration & Supply chain.
* Direct exposure to testing workflows, acceptances, and Environmental Stress Screening (ESS) environments (thermal cycling, ESS, vibration, and functional testing).
* Advanced proficiency in ERP systems, advanced Excel macros/data analytics, BOM management, clear-to-build (CTB) tracking, and capacity planning.

  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  

* **Master Scheduling & Shop-Floor Planning**: Develop, maintain, and execute Master Production Schedules (MPS) and Material Requirement Plans (MRP) for SMT/PCBA assembly, mechanical integration, and final testing to ensure 100% On-Time Delivery (OTD).
* **Manufacturing & Assembly**: Coordinate with production team and engineering teams to optimize line balancing, eliminate shop-floor bottlenecks, and track daily output against target routings.
* **Supply Chain & Materials Management**: Partner with SCM, stores, and procurement to monitor component lead times, track critical active/passive electronic components, verify CTB readiness, and optimize store kitting processes.
* **Testing & ESS Integration**: Plan and route assemblies through functional testing, screening, and ESS labs to prevent testing backlogs and maintain steady WIP throughput.
* **Top Management Engagement**: Prepare daily/weekly progress dashboards, WIP reports, capacity utilization matrices, and delay analysis reports for executive reviews.
* **Sales & Customer Touchpoints**: Serve as the primary operational contact for the sales team and clients to provide accurate Lead Time estimates (ATP/CTP), order tracking, and delivery timelines.
* **Process & Inventory Control**: Control Work-in-Progress (WIP) levels, reduce inventory carrying costs, enforce strict engineering change order (ECO) controls, and drive continuous improvement through Lean and 5S initiatives on the shop floor.

title: Director, Global Supply Management
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

**Position Summary**

The Director, Global Supply Management is a senior functional leader responsible for setting direction, establishing governance and delivering reliable in-season supply outcomes for assigned global portfolios. You will convert changing commercial requirements into possible supply commitments and lead enterprise-level trade-off decisions across demand, production capacity, materials, delivery, and responsiveness.

Beyond managing daily supply performance, the Director shapes the GSM operating model, builds decision mechanisms, sponsors planning and technology transformation, and develops organisational capability. You will operate in a global matrix, partnering with senior leaders across MPIM, Supply Planning, Merchandising, Sales, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Materials, Logistics, Finance and Technology.

Success requires deep supply-chain expertise, independent executive judgment, a proven record of transformation, the ability to influence without direct authority and a disciplined approach to leading a high-performing Bengaluru-based team.

**1. Global In-Season Supply Strategy and Demand-Supply Governance**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

  

* Set the in-season GSM strategy, operating priorities and performance agenda for the assigned global portfolios, aligned with our goals.

* Lead global demand-supply reconciliation and establish a disciplined governance process for possible vendor-level, time-phased supply commitments.
* Anticipate supply constraints and commercial changes; direct scenario planning and recommend explicit service, speed, capacity and cost trade-offs.
* Establish decision rights, escalation thresholds and executive review mechanisms for supply choices.
* Represent GSM in S&OP interfaces and senior business forums, providing concise decision recommendations and clear accountability.

**2. Supplier Capacity, Materials Readiness and Network Agility**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

  

* Provide senior oversight of supplier capacity agreement, RCCP, production feasibility, and material readiness in partnership with Product Development, Sourcing, Manufacturing, and Fabric teams.
* Shape cross-vendor capacity allocation and supply flexibility recommendations to respond to shifting our priorities.
* Sponsor plans to reduce lead times, improve material and production responsiveness, and strengthen the assigned supply network.
* Resolve material or capacity constraints requiring prioritisation or senior-leadership intervention.
* Ensure transparent assumptions, risks, milestones for critical supply commitments.

**3. In-Season Execution and Business Continuity**
--------------------------------------------------

  

* Lead the governance of in-season supply performance, supply confirmations, production readiness and delivery-risk resolution for assigned portfolios.
* Establish proactive risk identification, exception management and structured recovery processes across sourcing and execution partners.
* Lead resolution of the most consequential supply disruptions and direct escalation of issues affecting business-critical deliveries.
* Improve commitments, supply reliability, response speed and execution discipline.
* Ensure continuity through well-defined handoffs, process documentation and organisational resilience.

**4. Global GSM Operating Model, Transformation and Analytics**
---------------------------------------------------------------

  

* Define and guide a multiyear roadmap for GSM process, operating-model scalability and digital planning capability.
* Sponsor transformation plans to simplify planning cycles, standardise governance.
* Partner with Technology, Analytics and Planning on enterprise solutions, including o9, Boardwalk where applicable.
* Promote scenario-based management, data quality, exception-led workflows and decision-support dashboards.
* Establish benefit realisation, adoption measures and accountable owners for transformation plans; reduce reliance on individual expertise.

**5. Executive Partnership and Enterprise Influence**
-----------------------------------------------------

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization

* Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
* Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
* Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
* Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
* Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
* Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
* Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP

* Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
* Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
* Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
* Maintain a rolling 12–18 month supply and capacity outlook.
* Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
* Design and implement the site's S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
* Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
* Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control

* Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
* Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
* Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
* Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
* Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
* Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
* Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP

Existing responsibilities plus:

* Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
* Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
* Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
  + Lead times
  + Lot sizes
  + Safety stocks
  + Reorder levels
  + MOQ
  + Supplier lead times
  + Planning horizons
* Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
* Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
* Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management

* Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
* Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
* Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
* Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
* Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
* Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
* Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
* Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
* Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
* Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management

* Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
* Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
* Drive reduction of:
  + Excess inventory
  + Obsolete inventory
  + Slow-moving inventory
  + Uncontrolled WIP
* Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
* Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.

6. Warehouse & Logistics

Existing responsibilities plus:

* Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
* Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.
* Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable.
* Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials.
* Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability.
* Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments
* Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes.
* Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site.
* Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch.

Support implementation of traceability systems.

* + Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements.
  + Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions.
  + Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions.
  + Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions.

7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain

Existing responsibilities plus:

* Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems.
* Establish robust governance for:
  + BOM
  + Material master
  + Routings
  + Lead times
  + Planning parameters
  + Purchase orders
  + Production orders
  + Inventory records
* Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring.
* Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation.
* Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment.
* Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements.
* Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live.
* Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities.
* Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch.

8. Risk Management & Business Continuity

* Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity.
* Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions.
* Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics.
* Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks.

9. Continuous Improvement

* Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving.
* Improve:
  + Planning accuracy
  + Inventory turns
  + Supplier OTD
  + Material availability
  + Production plan adherence
  + Lead time
  + OTIF
  + Supply Chain cost
* Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization.

title: Sales force architect
description:
**Job Description: Salesforce Architect – Admin, FSC & Agentforce**

**Job Title:** Salesforce Architect  
**Management Level:** Manager  
**Location:** Bangalore  
**Experience:** 8–11 Years  
**Primary Skills:** Salesforce Administration, Financial Services Cloud (FSC), Agentforce

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect with strong expertise in Salesforce Administration, Financial Services Cloud (FSC), and Agentforce to design, implement, and optimize enterprise Salesforce solutions.

The candidate will be responsible for defining solution architecture, configuring Salesforce applications, implementing AI-powered agents, and ensuring platform security, scalability, and performance. The role requires a strong combination of hands-on technical expertise, architectural design capabilities, and the ability to lead development teams and collaborate with client stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Salesforce Architecture & Administration**

* Design scalable and secure Salesforce solutions aligned with business and enterprise architecture requirements.
* Configure and manage Salesforce objects, fields, record types, page layouts, Lightning Record Pages, and business processes.
* Define profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, role hierarchies, sharing rules, and organization-wide defaults.
* Design and implement Flows, validation rules, approval processes, and other declarative automation.
* Manage Salesforce environments, deployments, release management, and platform configuration.
* Monitor platform performance, data quality, security, and system limitations.
* Establish Salesforce configuration standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.

**2. Financial Services Cloud (FSC)**

* Design and implement Salesforce Financial Services Cloud solutions for banking, wealth management, insurance, and other financial services use cases.
* Configure FSC data models and capabilities supporting customer relationship management, financial accounts, households, and customer 360-degree views.
* Develop solutions for customer onboarding, relationship management, account servicing, and financial services workflows.
* Customize FSC functionality to meet business requirements while maintaining alignment with standard Salesforce capabilities.
* Integrate FSC with core banking systems, financial applications, and third-party platforms.
* Ensure appropriate security, data privacy, and governance controls for financial services implementations.

**3. Agentforce & AI Solutions**

* Design, configure, and deploy Agentforce agents for business process automation and customer or employee support.
* Configure agent Topics, Instructions, Actions, and routing based on business requirements.
* Develop and optimize prompt templates using Einstein Prompt Builder.
* Create Agentforce actions using Salesforce Flows, Apex, and external API integrations.
* Implement AI guardrails, data protection measures, and appropriate Einstein Trust Layer capabilities.
* Integrate Agentforce with Salesforce CRM and relevant FSC data to deliver contextual and accurate responses.
* Test, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize agent behaviour using Agent Builder and runtime logs.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI-driven automation to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.

**4. Technical Development & Integrations**

* Provide architectural guidance on Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, and reusable Salesforce components.
* Design integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and other suitable integration patterns.
* Implement secure authentication, data synchronization, error handling, and monitoring mechanisms.
* Review technical designs and code to ensure scalability, maintainability, and adherence to Salesforce best practices.
* Support data migration, application enhancements, deployment activities, and production issue resolution.

**5. Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead technical design discussions and translate business requirements into effective Salesforce solutions.
* Prepare architecture diagrams, solution design documents, and technical specifications.
* Mentor developers and administrators and provide guidance on complex technical challenges.
* Collaborate with business analysts, functional consultants, project managers, and client stakeholders.
* Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical reviews, testing, deployment, and release governance.
* Ensure high-quality delivery while managing technical risks, dependencies, and project timelines.

**Mandatory Skills & Experience**

* 8–11 years of overall IT experience with substantial Salesforce platform experience.
* Strong expertise in Salesforce Administration, configuration, security, and declarative automation.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC).
* Practical experience implementing Salesforce Agentforce, including agent configuration, actions, prompt templates, and automation.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data modelling, security, and sharing mechanisms.
* Experience with Salesforce Flows, Apex, LWC, and enterprise integrations.
* Knowledge of Salesforce deployment processes, release management, and platform governance.
* Ability to lead technical teams, engage with stakeholders, and make architecture-level decisions.

**Good to Have**

* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect certifications.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Agentforce Specialist, or relevant FSC certifications.
* Experience with Einstein Prompt Builder, Salesforce Data Cloud, and AI-driven business automation.
* Experience in banking, insurance, wealth management, or other financial services domains.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools, source control, automated testing, and Salesforce DevOps practices.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

A hands-on Salesforce Architect who combines strong platform administration and security expertise with FSC implementation experience and Agentforce capabilities. The candidate should be comfortable designing enterprise solutions, guiding technical teams, and delivering secure, scalable, AI-enabled Salesforce applications.

title: M4 Senior Director - Sales
description:
About the Team
  
  
Join PayU's specialized Government Institutional Businesses (GIB) team, where fintech innovation meets public sector transformation in India's rapidly evolving digital governance landscape. Our GIB team is a dedicated, high-performing unit focused on partnering with government entities, public sector undertakings, and institutional clients to drive digital payment adoption and financial inclusion across India. You'll be part of a mission-driven organization that values strategic thinking, regulatory compliance, and collaborative partnerships with government stakeholders. Our team operates at the intersection of cutting-edge payment technology and public sector requirements, working closely with cross-functional partners including Product, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Success to deliver secure, scalable solutions for government and institutional clients. As a senior leader within this team, you'll have the opportunity to shape India's digital payments infrastructure, lead specialized sales teams, and drive significant impact in the public sector while working alongside industry experts in government technology solutions.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
As Senior Director - Sales for Government Institutional Businesses, you will lead strategic business development initiatives with government entities, PSUs, and institutional clients while driving substantial revenue growth through large-scale public sector partnerships. This senior leadership role requires an accomplished sales leader with deep government sector expertise who can navigate complex procurement processes while building and scaling specialized sales organizations. You'll be responsible for overseeing government sales strategies, leading specialized teams, and closing marquee opportunities with central/state governments, PSUs, and institutional clients, focusing on PayU's comprehensive suite of payment solutions tailored for public sector requirements. This role offers significant strategic influence in India's digital governance transformation and reports directly to the Chief Growth Officer. The position can be based in Gurgaon, Bangalore, or Mumbai with substantial opportunities for career advancement within PayU's global organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies for government and institutional business segments across central, state, and local government entities
  
Lead, mentor, and scale specialized government sales teams with expertise in public sector procurement and compliance requirements
  
Oversee complex government tender processes, RFP responses, and multi-stakeholder negotiations involving government decision-makers
  
Identify and penetrate new government verticals, PSUs, and institutional segments to expand PayU's public sector footprint
  
Conduct strategic analysis of government digital initiatives, policy changes, and emerging opportunities in the public sector
  
Establish and nurture strategic partnerships with government technology partners, system integrators, and consulting firms
  
Build and maintain senior-level relationships with government officials, PSU leadership, and institutional decision-makers
  
Serve as executive sponsor for strategic government accounts, ensuring compliance and successful implementation of payment solutions
  
Collaborate with Product, Legal, and Compliance teams to develop government-compliant solutions meeting regulatory and security requirements
  
Drive sales excellence through coaching and development of government sales specialists and account managers
  
Establish government-specific sales methodologies, tender processes, and compliance frameworks
  
Represent PayU at government forums, policy discussions, and public sector technology events
  
Own accurate forecasting for government sales cycles, pipeline management, and strategic account planning
  
Provide executive-level reporting on government sales performance, policy impacts, and competitive positioning to senior leadership
  
Drive continuous improvement in government sales processes, compliance procedures, and stakeholder engagement strategies
  
  
**Requirements:**  
15+ years of progressive B2B sales experience with minimum 8-10 years specifically in government/public sector sales leadership
  
Exceptional track record of winning large government tenders and consistently exceeding sales targets in public sector technology
  
Proven experience leading government sales teams and managing complex stakeholder relationships across multiple government levels
  
Demonstrated success with government procurement processes, tender management, and contract negotiations with deal sizes of ₹5Cr+ annually
  
Extensive background in new business acquisition within central government, state governments, PSUs, and institutional clients
  
Deep expertise in government technology, digital payments, fintech, or banking sectors with strong regulatory knowledge
  
Experience selling to government entities across sectors such as taxation, treasury, social welfare, e-governance, or public enterprises
  
Comprehensive understanding of government payment systems, regulatory compliance, and public sector digital transformation initiatives
  
Expert knowledge of Indian government procurement policies, tender processes, and compliance requirements (GEM, CVC guidelines)
  
Outstanding communication and presentation skills with proven ability to influence senior government officials and institutional leaders
  
Strong analytical and strategic planning capabilities with experience in government policy analysis and stakeholder mapping
  
Proven ability to build, lead, and scale specialized government sales organizations with compliance expertise
  
Extensive experience in cross-functional collaboration with legal, compliance, and product teams for government solutions
  
Deep understanding of government decision-making processes, budget cycles, and approval hierarchies
  
Results-oriented leadership with strong accountability and ability to navigate complex government bureaucracy
  
Cultural alignment with public service values and PayU's commitment to financial inclusion and digital transformation
  
Demonstrated experience managing long government sales cycles (18-36 months) and multiple stakeholder approvals
  
MBA from premier business school or equivalent, with additional certifications in government procurement preferred
  
Strong network and relationships within government technology ecosystem preferred
  
Based in Gurgaon, Bangalore, or Mumbai, or willing to relocate
  
Willingness to travel extensively across India for government meetings, tender presentations, and stakeholder engagement
  
  
What we offer?
  
  
A positive, get-things-done workplace
  
A dynamic, constantly evolving space (change is par for the course – important you are comfortable with this).
  
An inclusive environment that ensures we listen to a diverse range of voices when making decisions.
  
Ability to learn cutting edge concepts and innovation in an agile start-up environment with a global scale.
  
Access to 5000+ training courses accessible anytime/anywhere to support your growth and development (Corporate with top learning partners like Harvard, Coursera, Udacity).
  
  
**About us:**  
At PayU, we are a global fintech investor and our vision is to build a world without financial borders where everyone can prosper. We give people in high growth markets the financial services and products they need to thrive. Our expertise in 18+ high-growth markets enables us to extend the reach of financial services. This drives everything we do, from investing in technology entrepreneurs to offering credit to underserved individuals, to helping merchants buy, sell, and operate online. Being part of Prosus, one of the largest technology investors in the world, gives us the presence and expertise to make a real impact. Find out more at www.payu.in
  
  
Our Commitment to Building A Diverse and Inclusive Workforce
  
  
As a global and multi-cultural organization with varied ethnicities thriving across locations, we realize that our responsibility towards fulfilling the D&I commitment is huge. Therefore, we continuously strive to create a diverse, inclusive, and safe environment, for all our people, communities, and customers. Our leaders are committed to create an inclusive work culture which enables transparency, flexibility, and unbiased attention to every PayUneer so they can succeed, irrespective of gender, color, or personal faith. An environment where every person feels they belong, that they are listened to, and where they are empowered to speak up. At PayU we have zero tolerance towards any form of prejudice whether a specific race, ethnicity, or of persons with disabilities, or the LGBTQ communities.

We are expanding our presence across East Bengaluru and are looking for a proactive freelance professional to help us establish relationships with gated communities, Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), apartment management committees, and community representatives.

Role Overview

As a Freelance Community Outreach & Partnerships Executive, you will represent Maa Nest and help introduce our services to residential communities across Whitefield, Hoodi, Varthur, and the Panathur area.

Your primary responsibility is to identify suitable gated communities, contact their management teams, arrange meetings, present Maa Nest's services, and establish potential community partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and build a database of 30–55 relevant gated communities across the assigned areas.
* Research contact details for RWA representatives, association presidents, secretaries, and facility managers.
* Contact community representatives through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and in-person visits.
* Arrange meetings with RWAs, Management Committees (MCs), and apartment association representatives.
* Represent Maa Nest in outreach meetings and introduce our childcare, elder care, and physiotherapy services.
* Explain how residents can discover and book care professionals through the Maa Nest app.
* Explore approved promotional opportunities through resident groups, notice boards, community events, and announcements.
* Maintain a tracker of communities contacted, meeting dates, outcomes, and follow-ups.
* Follow up with interested associations and help develop community partnerships.

Initial outreach will focus on:

* Prestige Shantiniketan
* Prestige Lakeside Habitat
* Brigade Cosmopolis
* Sobha Dream Acres
* Folium by Sumadhura
* Sumadhura Capitol Residences
* Brigade Cornerstone Utopia
* Salarpuria Sattva Greenage and nearby East Bengaluru communities
* Other large Prestige communities in Whitefield
* Large Sobha, Sumadhura, and Brigade communities around Hoodi–Whitefield

Additional communities across Varthur and the Panathur area will be included. Access and meetings are subject to community approval.

Four-Week Performance Targets

* **Week 1:** Identify and contact 30 communities and build a verified contact database.

The overall target is to build an outreach pipeline covering 30 or more communities and work towards approximately 20–30 RWA/MC meetings over four weeks, depending on community availability.

* English and Kannada proficiency preferred; Hindi is an advantage.

* Direct interaction with the Maa Nest founding team.
* An opportunity to contribute to the growth of a home-care startup.

The Area SE Senior Director is a strategic leader partnering with the Area VP, Geo SE Leader, and SE Directors to shape strategy and ensure execution. This role builds a future-ready SE organisation, advocates for customer and market needs, and balances local and GEO priorities.
  
As a senior leader, the Director shares accountability with the Area VP for business outcomes. Operating across multiple countries, they translate WW and GEO strategy into local priorities and provide evidence-based insights to GEO leadership.
  
**1. Own Technical Execution and Business Impact**
  
Prioritise key customer, partner, and business outcomes; enhance architecture quality; improve opportunity management; and showcase SE contributions through technical wins, operational excellence, pipeline influence, competitive success, and market growth. Drive adoption of NetApp's AI and Intelligent Data Infrastructure by partnering on strategic transformations.

Develop technical talent and leadership through coaching, feedback, and targeted growth. Strengthen succession, close capability gaps, and foster an inclusive, high-performing culture with clear expectations and accountability. Build capabilities supporting NetApp's AI, cloud, and technology goals.

Shape Area strategy, priorities, and execution collaboratively. Provide credible technical perspectives, use market evidence to inform decisions, and partner with sales leadership on strategic planning and go-to-market efforts. Serve as a trusted advisor on technology transformation and AI adoption.
  
**4. Connect Field Reality to Portfolio and Go-to-Market**
  
Gather Area insights for Product Leaders. Translate customer, partner, competitive, and market data, including AI use cases and adoption challenges, into clear recommendations guiding portfolio, product, enablement, and go-to-market decisions. Participate in feedback loops and communicate outcomes to the field.
  
**5. Represent and Advocate for the Area**
  
Present customer, partner, market, and resource needs; synthesize evidence into recommendations; build support cases; and collaborate with GEO and WW leaders to remove execution barriers. Represent NetApp in executive engagements, partner ecosystems, and industry forums to strengthen its AI leadership.
  
**6. Lead Organisational Transformation**
  
Challenge current practices, remove execution barriers, and lead experimentation to evolve SE capabilities, culture, and operating models. Align the organisation with NetApp's growth ambitions by building technical capability and execution discipline to accelerate AI and cloud growth and position the NetApp Platform as the AI era’s intelligent data infrastructure. Enable teams to convert customer use cases and partnerships into adoption, pipeline, and growth.
  
**7. Operate as a GEO Leadership Team**
  
Collaborate with the GEO SE Leader and SE Directors to set standards, share capabilities, address systemic issues, and ensure consistent execution. Prioritise enterprise success over local optimisation and execute agreed decisions collectively.

title: Assistant Sales Manager – West
description:
Overview:

**About Bruker**

Bruker builds high-performance scientific instruments and analytical solutions that help researchers study life and materials at the molecular, cellular and microscopic level. Our customers work in life science research, pharma, materials science, semiconductors, industrial labs and clinical research.

We have more than 11,000 employees at over 90 locations worldwide. Our instruments are used in laboratories everywhere, and we keep investing in new technology to solve the analytical problems our customers face today.

**About the Role**

Bruker India Scientific Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an Assistant Sales Manager to grow our X-ray business in western India. You will sell our X-ray diffraction (XRD), X-ray fluorescence (XRF) and single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SCD) systems to universities, research institutes and industry.

These are capital-equipment sales with long buying cycles and several decision-makers. You will own each opportunity from the first conversation to the purchase order, working closely with our application scientists, product specialists and service team. Your customers will include IITs, NITs, IISc, IISERs and CSIR labs, as well as companies in pharmaceuticals,cement, glass, metals, , energy storage, semiconductors and geology.

**Location:** Mumbai (covering Maharashtra, Gujarat and parts of Madhya Pradesh)

**Reports to:** Director – Sales & Service, AXS Division, India

**Employment type:** Full-time, permanent

Responsibilities:

**What You Will Do**

* Build and run a sales plan for your territory, and meet or exceed your sales target for XRD, XRF, SCD, XRM and XMA products.
* Manage the full sales cycle: finding and qualifying leads, understanding customer needs, proposing the right solution, running demos, negotiating and closing.
* Grow business with existing customers and win new accounts across academia, government labs and industry.
* Work with application scientists and product specialists to turn customer requirements into the right Bruker solution.
* Arrange and take part in customer demos at our application lab in Bangalore and at our facilities in Karlsruhe and Berlin, Germany.
* Prepare presentations, quotations, proposals and tender documents, and show customers clearly why Bruker is the better choice.
* Keep Salesforce up to date with opportunities, forecasts and order bookings, and maintain a pipeline of at least 3× your quarterly target.
* Give management accurate monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts.
* Keep track of competitors, market trends and new applications in the region, and share what you learn with the team.
* Represent Bruker at conferences, trade shows, technical meetings and customer events.

Qualifications:

**What We Are Looking For**

* A degree in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, Geology or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience selling scientific instruments or capital equipment, ideally XRD, XRF or similar analytical techniques.
* A good track record of closing complex deals with academic, government and industrial customers, including public tenders.
* Experience working with a CRM system. Salesforce experience is a strong plus.
* Fluent English and Hindi. Marathi, Gujarati or another regional language is an advantage.
* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Well organised and self-motivated, able to handle many opportunities, tenders and stakeholders at the same time.
* A team player who works well with colleagues in applications, service, marketing and back office.

**Travel**

This is a field-based role. Expect to travel 60–70% of the time within your territory, with occasional trips outside it for customer demos, conferences, training and internal meetings, including in Germany.

**What We Offer**

* The chance to sell instruments that are leaders in their field, in a growing Indian market.
* Product training with our application teams in Karlsruhe and Berlin, Germany, as part of a structured onboarding.
* Close support from a global team of scientists and engineers when you are in front of customers.
* Competitive salary, performance-based incentives and a full benefits package.
* A friendly, collaborative team where initiative is noticed and there is real room to grow your career.

*Bruker is an equal-opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.*

title: Sr. Executive Supply - EMD
description:
**Job Description :**

**About us**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

**About the Function:** Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.

With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.

It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

**About the role:**

The **Senior Executive - Export [Logistics Planner]** is responsible for planning and executing end-to-end export logistics operations for alcoholic beverages. The role ensures seamless coordination across manufacturing units, transporters, freight forwarders, and Customs House Agents (CHA) while maintaining strict adherence to excise and statutory regulations. The position focuses on timely gate-in, cost optimization, vendor management and productivity improvements aligned with production and shipment plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Export Logistics & Execution**

* Manage end-to-end export logistics including factory dispatch, port movement and shipment handover.
* Ensure **timely vehicle placement** in line with production and shipment schedules.
* Monitor **gate-in timelines** at ports/ICDs to adhere vessel cut-offs and avoid detention costs.
* Coordinate production plans in alignment with **vessel availability and export demand**.

**Documentation & Customs Coordination**

* Oversee preparation and accuracy of export documentation including invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, and excise documents.
* Coordinate with **freight forwarders, transporters and CHAs** to ensure smooth customs clearance and shipment execution.
* Ensure compliance with applicable **DGFT regulations, Foreign Trade Policy, Customs requirements** and other relevant export regulatory requirements, including coordination with concerned authorities for approvals, licences, registrations and statutory documentation.
* Ensure compliance with **self-sealing certification** requirements and related documentation.
* Ensure proper tracking of procurement of material under **Advance Authorisation** and subsequently shipping bill filing while maintaining records of invoice numbers wrt products.

**Stakeholder & Multi-Unit Coordination**

* Act as a single point of contact between multiple manufacturing units, export sales, production and external logistics partners.
* Align dispatch plans across units to optimize load consolidation and shipment efficiency.
* Ensure proactive communication to mitigate operational delays.

**Vendor & Cost Management**

* Manage transporter, CHA and freight forwarder performance against service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Ensure timely **vendor invoice verification, processing and payment coordination** with finance teams.
* Drive **productivity improvements and logistics cost savings** through route optimization, rate negotiations and process improvements.

**Planning & Vehicle Management**

* Prepare and execute **advance transport plans** and share vehicle placement forecasts with transporters.
* Ensure availability of vehicles to support production schedules and avoid dispatch bottlenecks.
* Monitor turnaround time (TAT) for vehicles and optimize utilization.

**Statutory & Excise Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to **Excise regulations and export statutory requirements** at plant and shipment levels.
* Coordinate with excise authorities for approvals, documentation and inspections as required.
* Maintain audit-ready records for regulatory and internal compliance reviews.

**Process Improvement & Reporting**

* Track key logistics KPIs such as on-time dispatch, gate-in adherence, cost per case and vendor performance.
* Identify process gaps and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and compliance.
* Support audits, internal reviews and management reporting.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of **export logistics, documentation and excise compliance** in alco-bev industry
* Hands-on experience with **freight forwarders, transporters and CHAs**
* Expertise in **production-linked dispatch planning and vehicle management**
* Cost optimization, negotiation and vendor management skills
* High attention to detail, problem-solving ability and operational ownership
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management capabilities

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in export logistics within **alco-bev, FMCG or regulated manufacturing industries**
* Graduate/Postgraduate in Logistics, Supply Chain, International Trade or related field
* Experience in excise-controlled manufacturing environments preferred

**Working with us**

title: Mgr. Supply Chain Planning & Logistics
description:
* Bengaluru, INDIA, India
* Not Remote
* Manufacturing & Operations
* JOB215583

  

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of the Position**

We are seeking a supply chain professional to own end-to-end **demand forecasting, supply planning, inventory control, and logistics execution** for a portfolio of medical devices — **capital equipment, instruments, accessories, and spare parts**.

The role drives a disciplined **S&OP** process across a regulated, lot-traceable, and often import-dependent supply chain — balancing patient-facing service levels, working capital, regulatory compliance, and cost-to-serve.

The incumbent will be the bridge between **Commercial (tender + commercial channel), Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Manufacturing / Imports, Finance, and Service** — ensuring on-shelf availability of life-critical products and uninterrupted service support to the installed base.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand Planning & Forecast Management**

* Own **statistical and consensus demand forecasts** at SKU / region / channel level, segmented by capital equipment, instruments, accessories, consumables, and spares, on a **rolling 18-month horizon**.
* Support **New Product Introduction (NPI) launches** — build phase-in plans aligned to regulatory milestones, sales-force readiness, and channel fill.
* Manage **EOL and product-transition planning** with care — clinical preferences and regulatory constraints make abrupt phase-outs risky.
* Run **spare-parts and accessory planning** driven by installed-base data, attach rates, and service-event history.
* Track forecast accuracy — **MAPE, WMAPE, bias, FVA** — at category level; isolate tender forecast error from commercial baseline.

**Supply Planning & Inventory Control**

* Convert the demand plan into a constrained **supply plan** across in-house.
* Work closely with global Supply planner.
* Own **inventory planning and control** — safety stock, cycle stock, and strategic stock — segmented by criticality (lifesaving / Class C-D items held at higher service levels, slow-moving accessories at lower tier).
* Manage **expiry, FEFO discipline, and inventory ageing** to keep write-offs within target.
* Plan around **import lead times, CDSCO license validity, and customs clearance** dependencies for imported SKUs.
* **Coordinate with global stakeholders** — regional supply hubs, principal manufacturers, and global category / planning teams — for **supply allocation, expedites, and execution tracking** across time zones.

**Logistics & Service Levels**

* Oversee **inbound (imports + domestic), inter-DC, and outbound logistics** to distributors, hospitals (direct), and field service engineers.
* Manage 3PL/4PL partners under **ISO 13485-aligned** vendor audits and **Good Distribution Practices (GDP)**.
* Track and improve **OTIF, lane-level cold-chain excursion %, expiry write-off %, freight cost per unit, OTIF-to-hospital direct, and tender-fulfilment %**.

**S&OP & Stakeholder Integration**

* Run a disciplined **monthly S&OP** — Demand Review Supply Review Pre-S&OP Executive S&OP — with a separate **tender pipeline review** layered in.
* Act as the **single integrator** across Commercial, Tender, Service, Regulatory, Quality, Manufacturing, Imports, and Finance; quantify trade-offs (service to a hospital vs. expiry risk vs. cash).
* Drive **scenario plans** for tender wins/losses, NPI go-live shifts, supplier disruptions, and import delays.

**Analytics, Systems & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive deployment and adoption of planning systems — **o9, SAP** — alongside **QMS-integrated traceability** in ERP.
* Build dashboards for **forecast accuracy, inventory ageing / expiry runway, service level by hospital, tender OTIF, and import lead-time variance**.
* Champion **Lean / Six Sigma** initiatives and **GDP-aligned SOPs**; institutionalize a **logistics control tower** for critical SKUs.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manage cross functional stakeholders across commercial, Service, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Planning , Imports and Finance.
* Build and sustain Strong working relationship with global counterparts ,3PL/4PL Partners.
* Represent the function in senior business reviews and external audits (CDSCO, ISO 13485 surveillance).

### **Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **7–10 years** of professional experience in a similar position, **ideally within a medical device company**.
* Demonstrated ownership of **demand planning, supply planning, and logistics** in a regulated, multi-channel environment.
* **Strong analytical skills** with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong **communication skills**, both verbal and written.
* Effective **time management** and ability to drive multiple parallel workstreams.
* Ability to build and sustain **long-term professional relationships** across cross-functional and external stakeholders.

**Required Education and Training**

* **Bachelor's degree** (Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or related discipline).

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* **MBA / PGDM** in Operations or Supply Chain Management.
* Familiarity with an integrated **ERP, preferably SAP** (MM / SD / PP modules).
* Hands-on exposure to advanced planning systems — **o9,SAP**
* Strong knowledge of the **MS Office** product suite, particularly Excel (advanced functions, Power Query).
* Working knowledge of **CDSCO Medical Devices Rules 2017, GDP, and ISO 13485** as applied to distribution and storage.
* **APICS CPIM / CSCP / CLTD** or **Lean Six Sigma** certification.
* Exposure to **Power BI / Tableau** for analytics and dashboard

### **Additional Information**

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

As an Aera Techno-Functional Manager, you will lead the design and delivery of Decision Intelligence solutions, own stakeholder alignment, and guide cross-functional teams from business problem definition through deployment and value realization. The role requires strong solution leadership, data fluency, and hands-on understanding of Aera delivery.

* Proven stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, solution governance, risk management, and executive communication skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

title: Fashion Sales Leads

Fashion Sales & E-Commerce Growth Lead

**Fashion | Lifestyle | Digital Commerce | Marketplace | Business Development**

**Company:** Modus Enterprise Transformation & Associated Ventures  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India | Hybrid / Field-Based  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Contract / Entrepreneurial Partnership  
**Experience:** 2–5+ Years  
**Compensation:** Performance-Linked / Commission / Revenue Share / Fixed + Incentives (Based on Experience)

About the Opportunity

We are building and scaling exciting ventures across Fashion, Beauty, Lifestyle, Retail, and Digital Commerce.

We are looking for ambitious, commercially driven **Fashion Sales & E-Commerce Growth Leads** who can take ownership of sales initiatives, develop business relationships, onboard fashion brands and vendors, and build profitable revenue channels.

Our initiatives include fashion and lifestyle brands, local commerce marketplaces, online retail platforms, B2B fashion distribution, and digital-first sales models.

This is an opportunity for individuals who want to move beyond traditional sales roles and become part of building and scaling new businesses.

Key Responsibilities1. Fashion Sales & Business Development

* Develop and execute sales strategies for fashion, apparel, accessories, beauty, and lifestyle products.
* Identify and engage retailers, boutiques, fashion stores, distributors, wholesalers, and institutional buyers.
* Build relationships with manufacturers, designers, fashion brands, and suppliers.
* Drive B2B, B2C, and direct-to-consumer sales opportunities.
* Generate leads, negotiate commercial agreements, and close sales.
* Develop regional sales networks and strategic partnerships.

2. E-Commerce & Marketplace Growth

* Drive sales through online marketplaces, brand websites, and digital commerce platforms.
* Support product launches and growth on platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, and other relevant channels.
* Onboard fashion sellers, brands, manufacturers, and local retailers onto emerging commerce platforms.
* Work with teams on product listings, pricing, promotions, campaigns, and conversion optimisation.
* Develop social commerce and WhatsApp-based selling opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for omnichannel retail and local fashion delivery.

3. Brand & Vendor Partnerships

* Identify emerging and established fashion and lifestyle brands for commercial collaboration.
* Build partnerships with manufacturers and sourcing hubs, including Bengaluru, Tiruppur, and other fashion markets.
* Negotiate supplier pricing, commissions, margins, and partnership terms.
* Develop vendor onboarding pipelines and maintain strong commercial relationships.
* Support private-label and exclusive product opportunities.

4. Sales Campaigns & Customer Acquisition

* Plan and execute digital and offline sales campaigns.
* Collaborate with marketing teams on influencer partnerships, social media campaigns, and customer acquisition.
* Identify opportunities for pop-up stores, exhibitions, fashion events, and promotional sales.
* Drive repeat purchases, customer retention, and loyalty initiatives.
* Monitor customer feedback, buying patterns, and emerging fashion trends.

5. Revenue Ownership & Commercial Performance

* Own agreed sales targets, customer acquisition goals, and revenue milestones.
* Maintain an active sales pipeline and conversion forecasts.
* Track sales, margins, customer acquisition costs, and channel profitability.
* Identify new growth opportunities and recommend commercial improvements.
* Work independently with a strong focus on measurable business outcomes.

Candidate Profile

We welcome applications from fashion sales professionals, e-commerce specialists, retail business developers, brand partnership managers, and entrepreneurial individuals.

**Essential Skills**

* Experience in fashion, apparel, retail, lifestyle, e-commerce, or marketplace sales.
* Strong business development, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities.
* Understanding of fashion retail, pricing, distribution, and customer behaviour.
* Ability to generate leads and convert opportunities into revenue.
* Confidence working with vendors, brands, retailers, and business owners.
* Strong commercial awareness and an entrepreneurial mindset.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, Shopify, or similar platforms.
* Existing network of fashion brands, suppliers, retailers, or distributors.
* Knowledge of D2C brand growth and digital marketing.
* Experience with apparel sourcing, private labels, or fashion merchandising.
* Understanding of CRM tools, sales analytics, and AI-enabled commerce.
* Experience launching new products or developing new markets.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?

This is not simply a conventional sales position.

You will have the opportunity to work across multiple emerging ventures and help build businesses from the ground up.

Successful individuals may progress into:

* Senior Fashion Sales & Growth Lead
* E-Commerce Business Head
* Fashion Marketplace Director
* Brand & Commercial Partnerships Director
* Venture Business Partner / Founding Team Member

We particularly welcome professionals who are interested in long-term entrepreneurial opportunities and performance-linked growth.

Commercial & Partnership Model

We offer flexible engagement structures depending on the candidate's experience, commercial network, and ability to generate revenue.

Options may include:

* Fixed compensation with performance incentives.
* Sales commission and revenue-linked earnings.
* Project-based commercial partnerships.
* Entrepreneurial revenue-sharing arrangements.
* Long-term business leadership opportunities for high performers.

Specific commercial terms and performance milestones will be mutually agreed upon before engagement.

First 90 Days – Expected Outcomes

**Month 1 – Market Development**

* Understand the fashion and e-commerce initiatives.
* Build a target list of brands, retailers, and vendors.
* Establish an active sales and partnership pipeline.
* Identify immediate revenue opportunities.

**Month 2 – Commercial Activation**

* Begin onboarding vendors and commercial partners.
* Execute initial sales campaigns.
* Develop marketplace and distribution opportunities.
* Secure initial commercial transactions.

**Month 3 – Revenue Growth**

* Demonstrate measurable sales traction.
* Build repeatable customer and vendor acquisition processes.
* Expand active partnerships and sales channels.
* Present a practical six-month revenue growth plan.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in individuals who:

* Have a passion for fashion, lifestyle, and commerce.
* Enjoy selling, networking, and developing business relationships.
* Can work independently and take responsibility for outcomes.
* Want to participate in building new brands and platforms.
* Are motivated by business growth, achievement, and long-term earning potential.

**If you have the network, sales capability, commercial drive, and ambition to help build the next generation of fashion and lifestyle commerce businesses, we would like to hear from you.**

Sell the AI research platform that makes every old-school survey tool look slow. Join the founding team in Bengaluru.

**The gig**

We’re building the research platform teams everywhere switch to, starting right here in Bengaluru. You’ll win B2B accounts away from the tools they use today.

**The pitch you’ll carry**

Weeks become hours. Five tools become one.

* 5x faster research, from question to insight
* 10x faster reporting: one prompt, a full report
* 50–70% lower research cost

**What you’ll do**

* Hunt online: LinkedIn, email and referrals to the people who own survey spend (insights, marketing, CX, product), then live demos that do the talking
* Hunt offline: walk into offices, stores, campuses, cafés, hotels, clinics and events, meet the decision-maker, pitch on the spot
* Win switches: show teams stuck on legacy survey tools why one platform beats five
* Close and report back: sign the deal, set up their first survey with them, tell the founders what the market is saying

**Your playgrounds**

* Research and CATI/panel agencies, startups and D2C brands
* Hypermarkets and retail: QR codes at billing counters and shelves
* Restaurants, cafés, hotels: QR on tables and at check-in
* Colleges: campus polls, student research, collaboration tie-ups
* Clinics, salons, gyms: a QR at the counter turns every visit into feedback
* Events and fests: live crowd feedback, results the same evening

**You are**

* A fresher or up to 2 years into sales or BD (B2B is a plus)

* A go-getter who wants a founding-team seat and trusts the upside

* Day 30: know the product cold, run your first demos, build your target list
* Day 60: active pipeline, QR or campus pilots running, first customers closed

Skynetic Ventures builds AI solutions that solve real-world business and industrial problems. Our focus areas include Computer Vision, Industrial AI, Enterprise AI, video analytics, and intelligent automation.

We work with businesses to identify operational challenges and implement AI-powered solutions that improve efficiency, visibility, safety, quality, and decision-making.

We are looking for a motivated and result-oriented B2B Sales Executive / Sales Intern to drive lead generation, prospect outreach, client engagement, and business development.

The candidate will work closely with the leadership and technical teams to identify potential customers, understand their business challenges, introduce relevant AI solutions, coordinate product demonstrations, and support the conversion of leads into paying customers.

This role is ideal for someone interested in technology sales, enterprise business development, and building customer relationships in a growing AI company.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Lead Generation and Prospecting

* Track opportunities from initial contact through negotiations and closure.

4. CRM and Sales Reporting

* Maintain an organised database of leads, contacts, meetings, follow-ups, and sales opportunities.

* Prepare periodic reports on lead generation, outreach, meetings, pipeline progress, and conversions.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and minimise opportunities lost due to poor coordination.

5. Market Research and Business Development

* Research industries, customer segments, competitors, and emerging opportunities for AI adoption.
* Identify potential channel partners, system integrators, consultants, and industry associations.

* Help prepare sales collateral, case studies, pitch decks, and client-facing presentations.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence in approaching new people and initiating business conversations.
* Good research, analytical, and organisational skills.
* Strong follow-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Basic proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint or Google Slides.
* Willingness to learn about AI, Computer Vision, and enterprise technology solutions.
* A proactive attitude, persistence, and a target-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA in Marketing, Sales, or Business Development is an advantage.
* Prior experience in B2B sales, lead generation, telecalling, business development, or customer acquisition is beneficial but not mandatory.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

description:

**About Us**
------------

CloudifyOps is a company with **DevOps** and **Cloud** in our DNA. CloudifyOps enables businesses to become more agile and innovative through a comprehensive portfolio of services that addresses hybrid IT transformation, Cloud transformation, and end-to-end DevOps Workflows.

We are a proud Advance Partner of Amazon Web Services and have deep expertise in Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform solutions.

We are passionate about what we do. The novelty and the excitement of helping our customers accomplish their goals drives us to become excellent at what we do.

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Culture at CloudifyOps :**  
Working at CloudifyOps is a rewarding experience! Great people, a work environment that thrives on creativity, and the opportunity to take on roles beyond a defined job description are just some of the reasons you should work with us.

**About the role :**  
As Senior Pre-Sales Engineer, you own the technical side of our pursuits, from first discovery call to signed SoW and handoff to delivery. You will be the Senior Engineer in the pre-sales team, shape CloudifyOps' cloud, DevOps and AI transformation offerings, and act as the trusted advisor to enterprise and startup clients. You sit between Sales, Delivery and Technology, and you are expected to turn customer problems into differentiated, AI-enabled solutions that can be delivered and priced with confidence.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will be in front of customers and in the architecture, while also building the assets, benchmarks and standard plays that let the whole team win more consistently.

**What will you do :**

**Solutioning and architecture**

* Design cloud infrastructure, DevOps and platform engineering solutions across AWS, Azure and GCP, and recommend the best-fit approach with clear trade-offs.
* Own end-to-end solutioning for RFIs and RFPs, including architecture, SoWs, effort estimates and cost models.
* Ensure solutions in every SoW follow best practice, match client requirements and are deliverable by our teams.

**AI transformation**

* Shape and position our AI transformation offerings: agentic AI for cloud migration and modernization, AIOps and autonomous operations, AI-assisted DevOps/DevSecOps, and AgentOps governance.
* Run AI readiness and use-case discovery workshops with client CTO, CIO and engineering leaders, and translate them into prioritized roadmaps and PoCs.
* Define where AI delivers measurable value (planning, estimation, IaC generation, code refactoring, incident response) and where it does not, with clear guardrails for data security, governance and cost.
* Work with the CTO office and engineering teams to feed customer needs back into our AI platforms and accelerators.

**Customer engagement and PoCs**

* Plan, build and deliver compelling PoCs and demos that show business value, including AI-powered migration, assessment and operations scenarios.
* Act as subject matter expert for end-to-end DevOps: configuration management, CI/CD, release engineering, provisioning and Day-2 automation.
* Build trust with customers through technical depth, strategic thinking and execution.

* Partner with Sales, Marketing and Alliances to build winning proposals, standard plays, upsell and cross-sell motions, and new service offerings that build pipeline.
* Build and maintain a repository of reusable pre-sales assets, pricing and effort benchmarks, and standard tools and processes.
* Work with Delivery for a smooth handoff and technical oversight after the deal closes.
* Identify trends, risks and issues that need escalation, and operate within defined SOPs.

**Requirements :**

* 8–12 years of overall experience, with at least 5 years in pre-sales, solution architecture or technical consulting for cloud and DevOps. Prior experience leading or mentoring a team.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, Azure and GCP, including designing application and infrastructure architectures and hybrid/multi-cloud strategies.
* Proven experience migrating and modernizing workloads to cloud, including assessment, wave planning, containerization and Kubernetes.
* Strong DevOps background: CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), GitOps, observability and DevSecOps.
* Experience with cloud cost calculators and building accurate cost, effort and TCO estimates.
* Working knowledge of AI and agentic AI applied to engineering and operations (LLMs, agent frameworks, AIOps), and the ability to explain it credibly to executives and engineers.
* Track record of owning RFIs/RFPs, SoWs and PoCs, and of working closely with Sales on winning deals.
* Excellent presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills, from CXO briefings to technical deep dives.

**Good to Have**

* Certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, CKA/CKAD or Terraform Associate.
* Hands-on exposure to LangChain, LangGraph or similar agent frameworks, and to LLM observability and prompt management.
* Experience with FinOps, platform engineering and managed services (SRE, 24×7 operations) pre-sales.
* Experience building service offerings, partner plays or productized accelerators.

description:
**Terralogic Software Solutions** is seeking a visionary **SOC Lead** with **7+ years of experience** to spearhead our Security Operations Center in **Bangalore**.

This unique role bridges the gap between deep technical defense and strategic business growth. We are looking for an executive-minded defender who can command day-to-day tactical incident response, mentor an elite team of analysts, and step into the boardroom to architect custom security solutions for global enterprise clients. If you thrive on the front lines of cyber defense and enjoy driving pre-sales strategy, this leadership position is your next career milestone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**SOC Operations & Technical Leadership**

* **Command the Center:** Direct the daily operations of our multi-tiered (L1/L2/L3) SOC team, managing incident validation, prioritization, and response execution.
* **Optimize the Stack:** Architect, fine-tune, and advance our SIEM/SOAR platforms, threat intelligence integration, and hunting workflows.
* **Establish Excellence:** Author standard operating procedures, high-fidelity use cases, and automated playbooks while ensuring strict SLA compliance and exhaustive Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* **Advance Threat Hunting:** Guide the engineering and analyst teams through proactive threat hunting initiatives, complex forensics, and sophisticated malware analysis.

**Strategic Pre-Sales & Solution Architecture**

* **Engine Business Growth:** Partner with executive sales and account teams to capture new market opportunities, lead technical client presentations, and deliver compelling platform demonstrations.
* **Architect Enterprise Solutions:** Translate complex client security requirements into high-level architectures, robust pricing structures, and tailored Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) models.
* **Own the Proposal Lifecycle:** Serve as the technical authority on RFPs and RFIs, drafting rigorous technical proposal documents and accurate effort estimations.

**Collaboration & Team Upskilling**

* **Align Stakeholders:** Interface smoothly with internal sales, delivery, and marketing functions to align SOC engineering capabilities with client business objectives.
* **Foster Cyber Talent:** Act as the primary mentor for junior and mid-level analysts, continuously upskilling the workforce on emerging adversary tactics and modern defensive tooling.
* **Deliver Executive Reporting:** Design and present transparent, impact-driven security dashboards and technical briefings for both internal leadership and client executives.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **Proven Leadership:** 8+ years of dedicated experience in cybersecurity, with a verifiable track record of leading end-to-end security operations centers.
* **SIEM/XDR Mastery:** Deep, hands-on familiarity with enterprise security suites such as **Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, or CrowdStrike**.
* **Framework Fluency:** Advanced comprehension of incident response frameworks, threat modeling, and industry standards, including **MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and ISO 27001**.
* **Elite Communication:** Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and articulation skills tailored for technical engineers and C-level stakeholders alike.
* **Pre-Sales Acumen:** Direct experience designing technical proposals, calculating resource estimations, and building competitive service pricing structures.

**Preferred Qualifications (But not mandatory)**

* Active industry-recognized certifications such as **CISSP, CISM, CEH**, or equivalent technical badges.
* Prior experience delivering pre-sales support within a premier **MSSP** or global cybersecurity consulting firm.

**Why Terralogic?**

At Terralogic, your expertise will directly shape our defensive architecture and drive commercial success. We provide an empowering, highly technical ecosystem where strategic innovation is prioritized, leadership is autonomous, and global career progression is realized.

Advance your leadership trajectory today. **Apply now to command the next generation of digital defense.**

This isn’t just a Mid-Market sales role.

You’ll own a territory of Indian organisations with **1,000–5,000 employees**, managing complex HR technology sales opportunities, engaging executive stakeholders and helping customers move from manual, fragmented or legacy processes to modern, connected and data-driven workforce solutions.

You’ll be trusted to own your territory while being supported by experienced leaders, Solution Consultants, Marketing and Business Development teams that help you succeed.

If your goal is Enterprise Sales in the future, this is exactly the type of experience that gets you there.

Selling HR technology in India requires more than product knowledge. It requires the ability to understand how organisations are scaling, where HR processes are becoming complex, and how leaders think about compliance, productivity, employee experience and ROI.

You’ll work with fast-growing and established businesses—including promoter-led companies, GCCs and organisations with distributed or frontline workforces—helping them improve payroll accuracy, workforce visibility, manager effectiveness and employee experience.

* Consistently exceed your sales targets.

You’ll probably have:

* 5+ years of success in SaaS sales or running your own successful business.

* Strong outbound prospecting skills.
