* Experience running full sales cycles.
* Confidence presenting to senior decision-makers.
* A consultative approach to selling.
* Comfort navigating price-sensitive, ROI-driven buying environments with multiple business and technology stakeholders.

* Exposure to industries with large, distributed or frontline workforces—such as manufacturing, retail, healthcare, hospitality, logistics, BFSI, IT/ITES or GCCs—would be an advantage.
* Experience selling HR technology, payroll, Workforce Management, HCM, ERP, employee experience platforms or other enterprise SaaS solutions will be highly valued.

You don’t need Enterprise Sales experience.

You do need the ambition to get there.

title: Demand Generation Executive
description:
**Job Description: Demand Generation Executive (1-4 years)**

**Company:** Factori.ai

**Department:** Marketing

**Location:** Bangalore, HSR Layout

**Work Mode:** 5 Days Work From Office

**About Factori**

Factori is the real-world data layer for enterprise AI. Our real-world intelligence platform connects business decisions and AI systems to aggregated physical-world signals through the Real World Graph. We help enterprise teams bring external context into decisions about locations, markets and customers. Our marketing team is building awareness and qualified demand among multi-location retailers and QSR businesses, starting with the US market.

**The role**

Turn Factori's retail stories and evidence into campaigns that reach the right accounts and create qualified sales conversations. Working closely with our Growth Lead, you will execute focused acquisition and nurture programs, connect campaign activity to CRM outcomes and improve what happens after someone raises their hand.

**What you will own**

* Build account and buying-group segments around multi-location retail, with expansion, real estate, strategy, analytics and marketing stakeholders. Research relevant business triggers and verify account fit with sales.
* Execute coordinated campaigns across LinkedIn, email, webinars and selected Google Search campaigns. Start with a focused channel mix agreed with the Growth Lead and expand where evidence supports it.
* Turn approved retail insights, demonstrations and customer stories into account-based marketing programs. Adapt messages to the buying situation and stakeholder while preserving the supporting evidence.
* Build campaign briefs, audience lists, ad and email variations, nurture sequences and landing-page requirements. Partner with the Webmaster on implementation and conversion testing.
* Run webinar and event promotion, registration, reminders and follow-up. Coordinate with sales so interested attendees receive relevant next steps.
* Maintain campaign tagging, CRM campaign records, segmentation and lead-routing rules. Test capture, deduplication, ownership and follow-up with the relevant teams.
* Report on account engagement, qualified meetings, sales acceptance and opportunity progression. Investigate campaign-to-CRM discrepancies and recommend changes based on lead quality and downstream results.

**Required AI knowledge and skills**

Practical knowledge of using AI to design, run and improve demand generation workflows is required for this role.

* Proficiency with AI tools for account research, segmentation, message adaptation and campaign analysis, including verification of company information and buying triggers.
* Understanding of how to connect AI with campaign data, spreadsheets and automation tools to support repeatable research, reporting and follow-up workflows.
* Ability to evaluate AI-generated recommendations against platform and CRM data. Knowledge of human review checkpoints, error handling, attribution limits and responsible handling of prospect data.

**What you bring**

  

* Hands-on B2B demand generation, campaign operations or performance marketing experience, with clear examples of your personal contribution.
* Practical experience running campaigns in at least two of these areas: paid media, email/lifecycle, account-based marketing or webinars.
* Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation workflows. Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce or comparable systems is useful.
* Confidence with spreadsheets and funnel analysis, including conversion rates, cost per qualified outcome and the difference between a lead and a sales opportunity.
* Strong execution, copy judgment and collaboration with sales. You can show an AI workflow you have used and explain how you validated it.

Experience selling into enterprise retail, working with longer sales cycles or supporting US-market campaigns is useful. Account research and automation skills can come from different toolsets.

**What success looks like**

In your first 90 days, establish a reliable campaign-to-CRM baseline, deliver a focused retail campaign and follow-up journey, and complete documented optimization cycles. We will assess target-account engagement, held qualified meetings, sales acceptance, opportunity contribution and cost per qualified outcome. Paid investment grows only when conversion and follow-up work. Pipeline targets will reflect budget, sales capacity and observed conversion.

**Why join**

You will help build Factori's direct enterprise demand engine and see how campaigns affect real sales conversations. You will work with experienced leads and have room to turn effective experiments into repeatable programs.

company: JEE TOURS AND TRAVELS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
**What You’ll Be Doing**

You’ll be one of the first people our travellers speak to — and your job is to make that conversation count.

You will:

* Speak with prospective travellers and understand what they are really looking for
* Ask thoughtful questions about their interests, preferences, travel style and expectations
* Help them discover Nordic experiences they may not have considered
* Work with our travel planning team to shape recommendations around the traveller
* Present itineraries and explain why particular experiences have been chosen for them
* Guide travellers through questions, concerns and decisions
* Follow up through calls, WhatsApp and email in a warm and professional way
* Build trust and convert conversations into confirmed bookings
* Stay updated on Nordic destinations, stays, experiences and travel possibilities

**You’ll Probably Love This Role if**

* You genuinely enjoy speaking with new people
* You are naturally curious and like understanding what people really want
* Travel excites you
* You enjoy recommending experiences and helping people make decisions
* You communicate warmly, confidently and clearly
* You are comfortable following up and staying connected with prospects
* You enjoy the challenge of turning a great conversation into a booking
* You notice details and understand that small things can make a big difference
* You like learning constantly
* You take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do next

**This Role Is Not About Selling Standard Packages**

You will not simply send an itinerary and wait for a response.

The role is about understanding the traveller well enough to make the conversation, recommendation and follow-up feel personal.

We want people to feel:

**“They understood what I was looking for.”**

That is what makes the sale happen.

**What We’re Looking For**

Experience in travel, hospitality, luxury, customer service, relationship sales or another people-facing role is useful — but the right mindset matters just as much.

You should have:

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Good listening and questioning skills
* A genuine interest in travel
* Confidence speaking with customers on calls
* Comfort using WhatsApp and email professionally
* Strong follow-up discipline
* The ability to guide and influence decisions without being pushy
* Comfort working towards sales and conversion targets
* Attention to detail
* A willingness to learn the Nordic region deeply
* A strong sense of ownership

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role is not just about how many calls you make.

It means:

* Travellers enjoy speaking with you
* You understand what matters to them
* Your recommendations feel relevant and personal
* Your follow-ups feel helpful, not transactional
* Travellers trust you
* More conversations turn into confirmed journeys

And most importantly:

**Travellers choose JeeTravels because they feel their holiday is being built around them.Why You May Enjoy Working Here**

If you love travel, this role gives you the opportunity to be immersed in it every day.

You’ll learn about incredible Nordic destinations, discover beautiful stays and unique experiences, speak with different kinds of travellers and build strong consultative sales skills along the way.

* Every conversation is different.
* Every traveller is different.
* And every booking starts with understanding the person behind the trip.

**Think This Sounds Like You?**

Don’t just send us your CV.

Tell us:

**Someone says, “I want to travel to the Nordics, but I don’t know what kind of trip I want.” What would you want to know about them before suggesting anything?**

Your answer may tell us more about whether you’re right for this role than your CV will.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

As the Lead for RCS for Business Partnerships, you will be the strategic architect for the next generation of mobile conversational commerce. Google is transforming consumer-to-business interaction through Rich Communication Services (RCS) across both Android and iOS devices. You will be responsible for defining the growth trajectory, commercial frameworks, and ecosystem strategy to make RCS the leading business-to-consumer messaging channel.  
  
In this role, you will navigate a consolidated communications and conversational AI ecosystem. You will lead engagements with the executive leadership spanning AI-native botbuilders and CSPs, Martechs, Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS) providers, messaging aggregators, and enterprise brands. You will architect the commercial and policy environments required to scale the business ecosystem sustainably. You will act as a critical bridge between local market realities and global product and business leadership.

The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product-enabling partnerships, go-to-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own business health, revenue enablement strategy, and adoption metrics for RCS for Business. Formulate and execute the multi-year partner roadmap.
* Drive alignment across competing market players to build a frictionless RCS ecosystem. Accelerate enterprise brand adoption by partnering with companies to launch flagship, industry-first conversational commerce experiences with leading brands.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to global Product and Engineering leadership, translating local market regulatory nuances, technical hurdles, and partner dynamics into high-priority product requirements.
* Represent Google as the preeminent thought leader for RCS and business messaging at major European industry events, regulatory discussions, and executive roundtables.
* Mentor and strategically guide local and regional partner managers. Establish best practices, repeatable commercial frameworks, and negotiation playbooks for the broader India partnerships team.

Bengaluru, India

This role leads the delivery and success of Technical Account Management (TAM) and Support Account Management (SAM) services for NetApp customers. The manager is accountable for team performance, service quality, customer outcomes, adoption, operational health, capacity, and execution against business priorities.

* Strong operational discipline to define, inspect, and improve service health and delivery metrics through recurring reviews and data-driven actions.

title: Sales Manager-Power Electronics
description:
The Role

INSYS Digital Systems is a Bengaluru-based deeptech company with over a decade of experience designing and manufacturing safety-critical power electronics and embedded systems for Indian Railways — including SMPS-based Integrated Power Supply (IPS) systems and Digital Axle Counters. We are now entering the telecom power, data centre power, and solar energy markets, leveraging our proven expertise in high-efficiency power conversion, battery management, surge protection, ruggedised enclosures, and remote monitoring — all directly applicable to solar inverters, BESS, and balance-of-system power electronics. We are looking for a seasoned Sales Manager to own all three verticals end-to-end: build the pipeline from scratch, establish relationships with telecom operators, tower companies, data centre builders, colocation providers, and solar EPC/C&I buyers, and drive our first commercial wins across these verticals.

Key Responsibilities

* **Market Development:** Identify, map, and penetrate the Indian telecom power and data centre power infrastructure markets —tower companies (Indus Towers, ATC India, Summit Digitel), system integrators, fibre network providers, hyperscale data centre builders (NTT, STT, Yotta, CtrlS), colocation providers, edge/enterprise DC operators, solar EPC companies, C&I rooftop buyers, and DISCOM/SECI channel partners.
* **Sales Pipeline:** Build and manage a structured sales pipeline from lead generation through vendor empanelment, RFQ response, technical presentation, field trial, and purchase order closure across both verticals.
* **Key Account Management:** Develop and own relationships with procurement, engineering, and energy/infrastructure teams at target accounts. Become the go-to contact for INSYS in the power infrastructure ecosystem.
* **Channel & Partnerships:** Identify and onboard channel partners, telecom EPC contractors, DC MEP contractors, solar EPC firms, and OEM/white-label opportunities to extend market reach beyond direct sales.
* **Techno-Commercial Proposals:** Work closely with the INSYS engineering team to prepare technical proposals, compliance matrices, and competitive pricing for -48V DC rectifier systems, modular UPS/power shelves, outdoor power cabinets, battery backup solutions, small cell power units, solar inverters, and battery energy storage systems (BESS).
* **Vendor Empanelment:** Drive INSYS through the vendor qualification and empanelment process at major operators, tower companies, and DC operators, including TEC certification coordination.
* **Market Intelligence:** Track competitor activity , pricing trends, technology shifts (lithium-ion adoption, solar-hybrid, 5G power demands, 48V DC distribution, ALMM-listed modules, net metering policies), and feed insights into product roadmap decisions.
* **Revenue Targets:** Own quarterly and annual revenue targets for telecom, data centre, and solar verticals. Report on pipeline health, conversion rates, and forecast accuracy.
* **Field Trials & Pilot Deployments:** Coordinate pilot installations at customer sites, manage trial documentation, and convert successful pilots into commercial rollouts.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work with R&D on product-market fit, with operations on delivery timelines, and with management on pricing strategy and investment decisions for all three verticals.

Candidate ProfileRequired

* 8–12 years of sales/business development experience in telecom power, data centre power infrastructure, solar energy, or power electronics
* Existing relationships with procurement or energy/infrastructure teams at Indian telecom operators, tower companies, DC builders/operators, solar EPC companies, or telecom/DC/solar EPC firms

* Qualify leads by understanding their business requirements and matching them with our security solutions and services.
* Schedule meetings and product demos for the sales team with qualified prospects.
* Collaborate with the sales team to develop and implement targeted sales strategies for specific industries, regions, or clients.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of prospects, leads, and customer interactions in the CRM system.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging security technologies to better position our solutions to prospects.
* Attend sales training sessions and participate in team meetings to continuously improve sales skills and product knowledge.
* Provide feedback to marketing and product teams based on prospect and customer interactions to help refine messaging and improve product offerings.

**What we're looking for:**

* **Based in Bangalore or Mumbai**
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in sales, lead generation, or business development, within the cloud native, cybersecurity or devops industry.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and relationships with prospects and clients.
* Proficiency in using CRM systems, preferably HubSpot CRM or Salesforce, and other sales enablement tools.
* Excellent research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets and KPIs.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts, products, and services is a strong plus.

### **About Us**

We live and breathe our company values:

A few of the benefits we offer:

* + **Flexible Time Off:** Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
* **18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave:** We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

title: Outbound SDR - India
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

This is an outbound Sales Development role based in our Bangalore office. You’ll build a pipeline for our Account Executives by researching target accounts, reaching decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn, and booking qualified meetings.

The role is fully focused on top-of-funnel prospecting. It suits someone who enjoys high activity, quick feedback, clear daily goals, and a team where results are visible and celebrated. You won’t be handling inbound leads or closing deals.

Along the way you’ll learn Rippling’s full platform and the operational problems our customers deal with every day. Strong SDRs here build real skill in prospecting, discovery, objection handling, and territory management, which sets them up for the next step in their sales career.

**Note:**

* You’ll work Indian business hours i.e. 9am to 5pm IST.
* Hybrid: in the Bangalore office 3 days a week (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday).

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Research target companies, personas, and business triggers to find strong prospecting opportunities
* Run a high-volume outbound motion: daily call blocks, multi-touch sequences, email follow-ups, and account research
* Hit clear activity goals, typically 80 to 100 calls and 40 to 50 emails a day depending on territory priorities
* Qualify prospects against defined criteria and book quality meetings for Account Executives
* Work closely with your AEs and manager on territory strategy, account prioritization, and messaging
* Join weekly enablement sessions, call reviews, and 1:1 coaching, and put the feedback to use quickly
* Keep Salesforce accurate and up to date
* Use Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and our dialer to work efficiently

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 1 to 2 years as an outbound SDR at a SaaS company, prospecting into India
* Hands-on experience in tools like Salesforce, Outreach, or ZoomInfo
* Strong communication, especially on the phone and in short, sharp written outreach
* A results-driven mindset: you move with urgency, go after quota, and are persistent in finding new business
* Comfort in a fast-paced environment and with learning a complex, evolving product
* Coachability: you take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative: you ask good questions and find ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high-activity, competitive team where performance is visible

**What success looks like**

* Month 1: onboarding on our product, customers, sales methodology, tools, and messaging
* Month 2: live prospecting begins, with a focus on activity consistency and a partial quota
* Month 3: full ramp, managing your own daily outbound activity and booking qualified meetings consistently
* Beyond: building the skills and track record to grow at Rippling, whether that’s toward an Account Executive role, SDR leadership, or another go-to-market path

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Inbound SDR - India
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Inbound SDR role at Rippling provides a unique opportunity - we're looking for a talented and ambitious Inbound SDR who can manage high velocity top-of-funnel sales qualification, while also navigating a very strategic sales process.

Our Inbound SDRs are responsible for prospecting and qualifying new customers and channel partners for Rippling. We’re building a team that will require a “winning” attitude, a high sense of urgency, and a passion for sales. As an Inbound SDR at Rippling, you will have the opportunity to help shape processes and build pipelines to support your Account Executive counterparts immediately. We believe in promotion from within and transparency on career paths that allow you to grow in your sales profession.

**Note:**

1. This will be an IST shift role, i.e. 9am to 6pm IST.

2. Hybrid: in the Bangalore office 3 days a week (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday).

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Become a product expert across our full platform and understand the competitive landscape
* Respond to inbound leads from paid, social, organic, and demand generation channels, and qualify them against defined criteria
* Run discovery calls with strategic, thoughtful messaging
* Book quality meetings for Account Executives
* Multithread into accounts that have come in through inbound to reach more decision-makers
* Hit set daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs
* Join weekly enablement sessions, call reviews, and 1:1 coaching, and put the feedback to use quickly
* Keep Salesforce accurate and up to date
* Use Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and our dialer to work efficiently

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Strong communication, especially on the phone and in short, sharp written outreach
* Own every lead assigned to you from first touch to a clear outcome, with fast response times and consistent follow-up
* Comfort in a fast-paced environment and with learning a complex, evolving product
* Coachability: you take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative: you ask good questions and find ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Ability to collaborate with others and work cross functionally among different teams at Rippling
* Desire to join a competitive team based environment

**What success looks like**

* Month 1: onboarding on our product, customers, sales methodology, tools, and messaging
* Month 2: working live leads, with a focus on speed to lead, qualification quality, and a partial quota
* Month 3: full ramp and booking qualified meetings consistently

description:

* Use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enhance work products and share practices with teammates.
* Manage competing priorities, develop actionable recommendations, and collaborate with India, global, and regional alliance stakeholders.
  

  

**The team**

The Ecosystems & Alliances team is part of the global firm. We are looking for a passionate, high energy, and self-motivated individual who is accustomed to working independently and collaboratively on small and large projects in a close-knit team. We are seeking a person with at least 5 years of strategy experience, of which a minimum of 3 years should be post-MBA, in the internal or external consulting space with strong research, analytical and writing skills, combined with excellent command of the English language.

The team will work with global and regional alliances leaders at the intersection of businesses, industries, and strategic growth offerings, to shape strategies for Deloitte’s Ecosystems and Alliances practice to solve the most complex challenges in more cohesive, consistent, and exponentially powerful ways.

The team’s goals are:

* Enable leaders to make decisions about strategic investments that deliver transformational growth and incremental earnings for Deloitte’s E&A practice
* Use cutting edge qualitative and quantitative research, storyboarding, and analytical skills to build in-depth go-to-market (GTM) strategies

**Location: Bengaluru**

**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Master’s degree or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
* 5+ years of strategy experience, including 3+ years of post-MBA experience.
* Experience conducting qualitative market research and quantitative analysis of sales and pipeline data.
* Experience developing PowerPoint presentations and using Microsoft Excel for data analysis.
* Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) tools for research, analysis, or presentation development.

* Experience collaborating across global teams, time zones, or workstreams.

**Designation:** Business Development Manager – Aerospace & Defence  
**Department:** Business Development / Sales  
**Experience:** 10+ Years  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. About Venttup

Venttup Ventures Pvt. Ltd. operates in engineering and manufacturing-related areas, including localisation, new product development (NPD), reverse engineering, prototyping and contract manufacturing. We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to expand our presence in the Aerospace and Defence sectors and build strategic relationships with OEMs, Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers, defence organisations and manufacturing partners.

2. Role Summary

The Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing strategic customer relationships, generating qualified enquiries and converting them into profitable business. The candidate must have **10+ years of relevant experience, with mandatory prior experience in the Aerospace or Defence industry** and a proven track record in B2B business development, technical sales or key account management.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Business Development & Revenue Growth

* Develop and execute business development strategies for the Aerospace and Defence sectors.
* Identify new customers, projects, RFQs, tenders and long-term manufacturing opportunities.
* Generate qualified leads and convert enquiries into orders and repeat business.
* Develop annual business plans, revenue forecasts and customer acquisition strategies.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline and achieve agreed revenue targets.

B. Aerospace & Defence Customer Development

* Build relationships with aerospace and defence OEMs, Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers, system integrators, PSUs and private-sector manufacturers.
* Identify relevant opportunities with organisations such as HAL, BEL, BEML, DRDO-linked programmes, ISRO-linked programmes and other eligible aerospace and defence customers, where relevant to Venttup's capabilities.
* Develop relationships with procurement, sourcing, engineering, programme management and senior decision-makers.
* Track upcoming programmes, customer requirements, supplier-development opportunities and localisation initiatives.
* Identify vendor registration, approved supplier onboarding and customer qualification opportunities.

C. Technical & Manufacturing Business Development

* Promote Venttup's capabilities in localisation, reverse engineering, NPD, prototyping, precision engineering and contract manufacturing, as applicable.
* Identify opportunities involving machined components, castings, forgings, sheet metal, fabricated parts, assemblies and other engineering products.
* Understand customer drawings, technical specifications, BOMs and manufacturing requirements sufficiently to coordinate with internal technical teams.
* Work with Engineering, Quality, Sourcing, Production and Finance teams to assess feasibility, costing, pricing and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate RFQs, technical-commercial proposals, quotations, negotiations and order closure.

D. Tendering & Commercial Management

* Identify and evaluate relevant government, PSU and private-sector tenders and procurement opportunities.
* Coordinate bid preparation, documentation, compliance requirements and submission timelines.
* Understand applicable defence procurement procedures and customer-specific vendor registration requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, contracts and commercial conditions while protecting company margins.
* Monitor order status, customer commitments, receivables and account growth.

E. Key Account Management

* Develop long-term relationships with strategic customers and maintain regular engagement.
* Manage customer enquiries, follow-ups, forecasts, order pipeline and business reviews.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure customer requirements are communicated and commitments are met.
* Handle commercial escalations and support resolution of customer concerns.
* Identify cross-selling, repeat-order and new-programme opportunities within existing accounts.

F. Market Intelligence & Reporting

* Monitor aerospace and defence industry trends, competitor activities and emerging manufacturing opportunities.
* Participate in relevant industry exhibitions, supplier-development programmes, conferences and customer meetings.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity trackers, sales reports and revenue forecasts.
* Present periodic business development updates, pipeline status and performance reports to management.

4. Mandatory Experience & Qualifications

* **10+ years of overall professional experience**, with substantial relevant experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, Technical Sales or Key Account Management.
* **Mandatory: Previous work experience in the Aerospace or Defence industry.** Candidates without relevant Aerospace/Defence industry exposure should not be shortlisted.
* Demonstrated experience in acquiring customers, managing strategic accounts, generating RFQs and converting opportunities into orders.
* Experience dealing with OEMs, Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers, defence manufacturers, PSUs or government-linked customers is highly desirable.
* Understanding of engineering/manufacturing processes, technical-commercial proposals, costing and customer qualification.
* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial, Electrical, Electronics Engineering or a related discipline. An MBA in Marketing/Business Management is an advantage.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Willingness to travel for customer visits, supplier meetings, exhibitions and business development activities.

5. Preferred Industry Exposure

* Aerospace manufacturing and supply chain
* Defence equipment and systems manufacturing
* Precision engineering and machining
* Localisation and import substitution
* New Product Development (NPD)
* Reverse engineering and prototyping
* Contract manufacturing and engineering components
* Aerospace/defence OEMs and Tier-1/Tier-2 supplier ecosystems

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* New customer acquisition and approved vendor registrations.
* Qualified RFQs and opportunities generated.
* Order conversion rate and new business revenue.
* Value and quality of the active sales pipeline.
* Profitability and commercial margins on secured business.
* Growth in strategic accounts and repeat business.
* Timely submission of proposals, quotations and bids.
* Accuracy of CRM records, sales forecasts and management reports.

7. Preferred Candidate Location

Candidates based in **Karnataka, particularly Bengaluru and nearby industrial hubs**, are preferred. Candidates from other locations may be considered if they have strong Aerospace/Defence business development experience and are willing to work from Bengaluru.

8. Application Requirements

Candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting:

* Total years of experience and years specifically in Aerospace/Defence.
* Previous employers and relevant industry segments.
* Aerospace/Defence customers and accounts handled.
* New business acquired and revenue/order-book achievements.
* Experience with RFQs, tenders, vendor registrations and commercial negotiations.
* Current location, current CTC, expected CTC and notice period.

**Important screening criterion:** Prior Aerospace or Defence industry experience is mandatory. Preference will be given to candidates who can demonstrate actual customer acquisition and order-conversion achievements rather than experience limited to lead generation or sales coordination.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in a technical environment, including 5 years in a customer-facing technical pre-sales or solutions architecture role
* 8 years of experience with modern SOC stack (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, NDR, EDR, UEBA and Threat Intelligence).
* Experience in gathering business requirements, facilitating whiteboarding sessions, and delivering technical presentations to stakeholders.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a technical field.
* Certificated in the Cloud or Security industry (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience working with, evaluating, or securing AI agents, Generative AI models, or LLM-driven applications in an enterprise context.
* Experience implementing complex enterprise security solutions (e.g., advanced threat hunting, Zero Trust architectures, Identity and Access Management systems).
* Demonstrated proficiency in coding or scripting (e.g., Python, Go) and experience with log parsing, data normalization, and automation logic.
* A knack for troubleshooting complex, multi-layered cybersecurity environments and a rigorous approach to technical roadblocks.

**About the job**
-----------------

When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As a Customer Engineer (CE) for Google Cloud Security, you serve as the technical bridge between our most innovative security technologies and our customers' most complex business challenges. You are not just a technical advisor; you are a strategic partner to the Sales team, responsible for articulating the unique value proposition of Google Cloud’s security ecosystem.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Act as the primary technical advisor, partnering with Sales to build and execute account strategies that win trust and drive adoption of Google Cloud Security solutions.
* Design creative, scalable, and resilient security architectures that map directly to our customers’ specific business goals and operational challenges.
* Lead technical validations, including Proofs of Concept (PoC) and technical deep-dives, proactively identify and remove roadblocks to ensure project success.
* Serve as an expert storyteller who can translate complex cybersecurity concepts into compelling, practical business outcomes for both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Partner with product development stakeholders to refine product capabilities, contributing technical insights that optimize performance and market relevance.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Entrepreneur in Residence (Sales & Business Ownership)
description:
**Entrepreneur in Residence (Sales & Business Ownership)**

**The role:**

  

We're hiring an Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) to own a business line end to end — from finding

the first customer to running it as a P&L. This is a sales-first role for someone who wants to

build, not just close.

Reward360 is a BFSI-focused loyalty and customer engagement platform, working with India's largest

banks. Our platform, Engage OS, powers rewards marketplaces, campaigns, travel, card management and

payments. Alongside the core business, the Founder's Office incubates new bets — and each one needs

an owner.

Title: Entrepreneur in Residence (Sales & Business Ownership) Reports to: Executive Chairman & Co-founder, via the Founder's Office Location: Bangalore (HSR Layout), in office

Experience: 2–3 years

**What you'll own:**

  

You run the business as if it were your own company: revenue, pipeline, partners, and the numbers

behind them.

**1. Go-to-market**

Define the ideal customer, pitch and pricing for your business line

Build and test outbound motions: cold outreach, referrals, events, partnerships

**2. Sales, start to close**

Prospect, pitch and run discovery with CXOs and business heads at banks, NBFCs, fintechs and brands

Own proposals, commercials and negotiation through to signed contract

**3. Delivery and account growth**

Hand off cleanly to product and ops, and stay accountable for go-live Grow accounts through

renewals, upsell and new use cases

**4. P&L and reporting**

Own revenue targets, unit economics and the weekly pipeline review

Report directly to founders with a clear view of what's working and what isn't

**5. Building the business**

Feed customer insight back into product and roadmap

Hire and lead a small team as the business scales

**Who you are**

You've carried a number, you like owning outcomes, and you'd rather build something than manage a

territory.

**Must-haves**

* 2–3 years in B2B sales, business development or a founder's office role, with a revenue target you owned
* A track record of closing deals yourself, not only supporting them
* Strong written and spoken communication; comfortable in front of senior stakeholders Numerate: you can build a simple business model, pricing sheet and pipeline forecast High ownership and speed — you act without waiting for perfect information

**Good to have**

* Experience selling to banks, NBFCs, fintechs or consumer brands Exposure to loyalty, rewards, payments or marketing tech Startup experience, or having started something of your own
* An MBA or equivalent — helpful, not required

**What success looks like**

By 12 months, your business line is generating repeatable revenue that runs without founder involvement in every deal.

Timeline - Outcome

First 30 days - Know the product, market and competitors; ICPand pitch signed off by founders

First 90 days - Qualified pipeline built; first paid customer orsigned LOI closed

6 months - Repeatable sales motion; monthly revenue targetmet

12 months - Business line runs as its own P&L; case made forscaling the team

**What you get:**

  

* Real ownership early in your career, with direct access to the founders.
* A business line that's yours to build, with founder-level visibility
* Direct mentorship from the founders and Founder's Office
* Access to R360's bank and brand relationships from day one
* A clear path to Business Head as your line scales

**How to apply:**

send your CV and a short note on the biggest deal you've closed — what you sold, to whom, and how

**Sales Development Representative (SDR) – India Market**  
**Location**: Bangalore (hybrid) | **Reports to**: Founder | **Experience**: 2–5 years

**About Stackgenie**

Stackgenie is a founder-led managed DevOps consultancy serving enterprise, government, telco and financial services clients across the UK, US, UAE and India, backed by a 24/7 delivery center in Kerala. We sell high-trust technical services: managed DevOps engagements, cloud and platform engineering and SLA-backed support contracts for business-critical infrastructure. Deals are won on credibility and speed, not volume, and the person in this role works directly with the founder, not three layers below a VP of Sales.

**The Role**

You will own the top of the funnel for the Indian market. That means two things, in order of importance:

1. **Inbound conversion :** Qualified enterprise leads come in through our website and service pages. Your job is to respond fast, qualify sharply, and get meetings booked while the lead is still warm. At our size, a well-handled inbound enquiry is worth more than a hundred cold emails, and we treat it that way.

2. **Outbound prospecting :** Build and work a target list of Indian enterprises, GCC's, BFSI and telco accounts, and high-growth companies with real cloud and DevOps spend. LinkedIn, email and calls with messaging you help shape rather than a script you recite.

**What You Will Do**

* Respond to and qualify inbound leads within hours, not days and book meetings for the founder and delivery leads.
* Identify, research, and prioritize target accounts across cloud, DevOps, and AI/ML buying centers in India.
* Run structured outbound sequences and iterate on messaging based on what actually gets replies.
* Engage CTO's, VPs of Engineering and Heads of Infrastructure in credible first conversations about their delivery and reliability challenges.
* Keep the CRM accurate and the pipeline honest: every stage, every next step, every reason a deal is stuck.
* Hand off qualified opportunities cleanly with context and stay involved through the first meeting.
* Occasionally travel within India for client meetings and industry events.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 2–5 years in SDR, inside sales, or business development for IT services, SaaS, or cloud(services experience preferred over product).
* Enough technical fluency to hold a first conversation about cloud, CI/CD, Kubernetes or DevOps without bluffing; you do not need to be an engineer, but you need to be unafraid of engineers.
* Sharp written English and a confident phone presence with senior stakeholders.
* Disciplined CRM habits and a genuine respect for pipeline hygiene.
* Self-driven and comfortable being measured on meetings booked and pipeline created, not activity volume.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Bangalore; hybrid working

**Compensation**

* Fixed base plus uncapped commission tied to qualified meetings and closed revenue.
* Clear promotion path : SDR's who consistently source closed revenue move into a full-cycle business development role

**Why This Role**

* Direct line to the founder: your feedback shapes positioning, pricing and ICP, not just your quota.
* You sell real enterprise engagements with named logos, not seat licenses.
* Small team, international clients, zero bureaucracy and full visibility into how deals actually close.

description:
**Business Development Lead – Strategic Partnerships (Venues, Communities and Corporates)**

Blithe is hiring a Business Development Lead in Bengaluru to turn leads into signed venues, apartment communities and corporates, and to build the sales team that repeats it.

**Role at a Glance**

* **Role:** Business Development Lead – Strategic Partnerships
* **Location:** Bengaluru: HSR office and on-ground field visits (in person)
* **Type:** Full time
* **Experience:** 2 to 4 years in B2B or field sales, partnerships or business development
* **Reports to:** The founder
* **Team:** Starts with a sales executive and a Growth + Sales intern; you build the team from there
* **Travel:** Up to 75% on the field across Bengaluru
* **Languages:** English and Hindi; Kannada or Telugu is a plus
* **Compensation:** Base plus performance incentive (see below)

**The Opportunity**

Blithe (SocialMagic Consulting Pvt Ltd) is a Bengaluru platform where creators, venues and communities host experiences and people discover and book them. We earn when events fill, so a partner counts only once it hosts events and sells tickets.

You will own the conversion side of growth. Lead generators, our founders and inbound enquiries bring in venues (cafes, pubs, breweries, art studios, activity hubs), apartment communities, corporates and colleges. You turn those leads into signed partners who run events on Blithe, and you hand each one to community operations with a first event date.

You start as a player-coach: you close the first deals yourself, in person, across Bengaluru. Within about six months you build and lead the sales team that repeats it. This is a strategic role for someone who wants to build a sales function from zero, working next to the founders.

**Key ResponsibilitiesConvert and Close**

* Take leads from our lead generators, founders and inbound enquiries and move them to signed partners: venues, apartment communities and their resident committees (RWAs), corporates and colleges.
* Run face-to-face pitches with owners, floor managers, RWA committees and HR or admin heads; show how hosting Blithe events lifts footfall and revenue.
* Structure and negotiate hosting terms. Blithe sells all tickets at partner venues, with no platform fee on venue events.
* Take every signing to a dated first event; a signed partner with no event does not count.

**Build the Team**

* Hire, train and coach sales executives and interns; write their scorecards and 30-60-90 day plans with the founders.
* Run the weekly rhythm: pipeline review, field days, win and loss notes.
* Work with the founders on the incentive plan, and track the sales that drive it.

**Pipeline and Reporting**

* Keep every lead, stage, next step and date in the CRM.
* Report weekly: pipeline value against target, win rate and sales cycle; forecast monthly sales and flag risks early.

**Partner Handover**

* Hand each partner to community operations with terms, contacts and a first event plan, and stay accountable until the second event.
* Match organizers and creators to venue slots so partner venues fill.

**Market and Pitch**

* Turn field feedback into better decks, scripts and offers every fortnight, and run localized outreach campaigns with the marketing team.
* Track competing platforms and the objections venues and corporates raise.

**What You BringMust Have**

* 2 to 4 years in B2B sales, field sales, partnerships or business development, with partnership deals you sourced or converted.
* A record of beating a target, which you can describe with numbers.
* Comfort pitching owners and decision-makers in person, including walk-ins.
* Strong negotiation and communication in English and Hindi.
* A self-starter's habits: you build from near zero with little supervision and keep every lead in a CRM.
* Willingness to be on the field up to 75% of the time across Bengaluru.

**Good to Have**

* Hospitality, events, community or two-sided marketplace experience.
* Experience leading or mentoring at least one person.
* Kannada or Telugu speaking skills.
* Existing relationships with Bengaluru venues, RWAs or corporate HR teams.

**How We Measure the Role**

* **Pipeline coverage:** At least 3 times next quarter's sales target.
* **Win rate:** 15% by Dec 2026, 20% by Mar 2027.
* **Sales cycle, first call to deal:** 60 days, then 50 days.
* **Monthly sales:** At least ₹1 lakh, rising with the plan toward about ₹8.9 lakh by Mar 2027.
* **Time from signing to first event:** 14 days or less.
* **Team:** Each new hire productive within 60 days.

*"Sales" means events at partner venues once their first event is held, plus college, corporate and apartment community events. Tickets sold through creators on the online marketplace do not count.*

**Compensation Structure**

* **Total Annual Compensation (CTC):** ₹4.80 Lakhs – ₹6.00 Lakhs per annum (Base + Monthly Performance Incentives)
* **Fixed Base Pay:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month (₹3.0L – ₹3.6L per annum)
* **Performance Incentive:** Up to ₹20,000 per month based on sales targets, paid out monthly starting from ₹1 Lakh in sales revenue achieved.
* **Monthly Earning Potential:** Up to ₹50,000 per month (Base + Variable).
* **Equity & Ownership (ESOPs):** Attractive ESOP allocation for top performers after initial 6 months, giving you real equity ownership in Blithe as we scale.

**Perks & Field Allowances**

* **Field & Travel Allowance:** 100% reimbursement for official field movement and travel across Bengaluru.
* **Mobile & Data:** Monthly cell phone and data plan reimbursement.
* **Work Culture:** Flexible schedule, paid time off (PTO), paid sick leave, and direct founder mentorship working out of startup hubs in HSR Layout and Koramangala.

**What You Gain**

* **Founder access:** You work side by side with the founders and shape the sales strategy as well as run it.
* **Ownership:** You own the partnerships vertical and build the team behind it, from the first hire.
* **Network:** You build relationships across Bengaluru's hospitality, venue, community and corporate circles.
* **Growth:** A path to a head-of-sales role as the team scales.
* **Environment:** A small ambitious team working from startup hubs in HSR and Koramangala.

**How We Hire**

* Apply with your CV and a short note (about 150 words): one partnership you closed, the steps you took and the numbers.
* Screening call (30 minutes) with a founder.
* Scenario round (60 minutes) with the founders: a venue conversion case and a corporate case, worked step by step.
* Field day: pitch a venue with a founder, or a mock pitch, followed by feedback.
* References and offer, usually within two weeks of the first call.

Pay: Up to ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Solutions Engineer (Customer Experience)
description:
**Role:** Solutions Engineer (Customer Experience)
  
  
**Location:** Bangalore, India
  
  
MEET THE TEAM
  
We are looking for a deep technical authority based in India to join us as aCustomer Experience Solutions Engineer. This isn't just about knowing a product; it’s about being the master of the CCaaS domain. You will be the definitive authority who our customers and internal teams turn to for solving the most sophisticated challenges in the India market. If you are a technologist who thrives on deep technical challenges and wants to be the recognized authority in your field, we want to talk to you!
  
  
WHY CISCO?
  
At Cisco, you aren't just selling software; you are architecting the future of customer engagement. Unlike single-point solutions, Cisco offers a unique ecosystem advantage, integrating best-in-class networking, security, and collaboration tools into a unified CX platform. You will become a trusted advisor, delivering measurable business outcomes for India’s most influential organizations.
  
  
YOUR IMPACT
  
As a Customer Experience Solutions Engineer at Cisco in India, you will be the technical authority for our CX architecture. You will act as the driving force behind our most impactful sales, demonstrating undeniable expertise and winning the trust of India's largest enterprises through your deep knowledge of CCaaS, AI, WFM and QM. Your mastery will be the key that unlocks our customers' success and delivers tangible business outcomes. You will have a profound strategic impact, serving as the technical architect of digital transformation for India’s most influential organizations, directly shaping how they engage with their customers at scale.
  
  
**IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:**  

* Drive Technical Leadership: Champion our technical vision within the CCaaS market by partnering with clients to solve complex challenges. You will lead technical discovery and architect sophisticated proof of values that demonstrate the tangible business value and unique competitive advantage of Cisco’s solutions.
* Master and Promote: Serve as the go-to authority for the Cisco Contact Center ecosystem. You will articulate its vision, strategy, and technical details—from omnichannel routing to AI-driven agent assistance—to audiences ranging from engineers to C-suite executives.
* Focus on Customer Outcomes: Partner with customers to understand their unique business goals, designing and validating solutions that deliver measurable success and operational excellence.
* Win as a Team: Partner with Account Managers to provide the critical domain expertise needed to win strategic opportunities. You are the authoritative voice on the account team.
* Mentor and Scale Expertise: Act as a force multiplier, mentoring and enabling the broader SE community in India on CCaaS, AI,WFM and QM technologies.
* Influence Product Direction: Serve as a critical feedback loop to Cisco's global engineering and business units. Your real-world insights from the India market will directly influence the roadmap and future of our products.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in a pre-sales engineering or a similar deep technical role
* 5+ years of broad and deep technical knowledge in CCaaS architectures, omnichannel routing, and contact center operational workflows (including on-premises and cloud deployments).
* Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing solutions that leverage AI for customer engagement (e.g., virtual agents, sentiment analysis, automated self-service optimization).
* Demonstrable experience building and maintaining positive relationships with customers and partners in the India market.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Experience with CRM, WFM and QM solutions is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of automation, APIs, and programmability (JavaScript, Python, REST APIs) within the CCaaS domain.
* Recognized as a subject matter expert (SME) with a reputation for technical excellence; experience in public speaking and writing technical content.
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCIE Collaboration, Cloud Architecture certifications from AWS/Azure/GCP).

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Catering Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**

**The Hoxton, Bangalore**

We are looking for a **Catering Sales Executive** to join our dynamic team for The Hoxton Bengaluru City.

The Hoxton is opening its very first neighbourhood hotel in Asia, coming to India’s Bengaluru city centre in 2026. This is a major milestone for the brand as it ventures into a new continent entirely and we are now looking for a brilliant leadership team to help bring this lifestyle brand to the market.

Located in the heart of the city centre, The Hoxton, Bengaluru City will bring its undeniable brand DNA and guest experience to India’s “Silicon Valley”, a high-tech city filled with parks and gardens and known for its vibrant cafe and pub culture - very apt for a brand that was founded in London!

The hotel will feature 149 bedrooms in a variety of The Hoxton’s well-loved room categories and the lobby will have a vibrant all-day dining restaurant & bar. Topping off the hotel we will have a rooftop pool and bar, large-scale function rooms and The Apartment - The Hoxton’s unique meeting & events concept

**More about us…**

The Hoxton is a series of open-house hotels, each in a neighbourhood that we love. Ever since we opened our first hotel in Shoreditch, we’ve never just been about offering a bed for the night. We want to be more than that: proving style doesn’t need to be sacrificed for good value and providing a place where guests can hang out alongside the locals and submerse themselves in the neighbourhood with vibrant, welcoming public spaces.

**What's in it for you...**

* The opportunity to work with an exciting new hospitality concept in Bangalore and have a real impact on its success.
* Join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
* The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
* Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences.
* Great discounts across the entire Ennismore family (which you get to keep even if you decide to leave us!).
* A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.

  
**Job Description**

**What you’ll do…**

  

* Managing the meetings and events enquiry process from start to finish, answering calls and emails, sending proposals, converting enquiries and taking the event through the planning and logistical stage to handover to operations.
* Negotiating meeting & events rates with clients, in line with the selling guidelines, to assist in achieving the hotel’s revenue targets.
* Following up with clients post event to get feedback and secure repeat business where possible.
* Cross-selling all global Hoxton and Ennismore properties, where applicable, to maximise revenue opportunities across corporate segments.
* Ensuring Opera Sales is up to date by putting inputting new enquiries into the system.
* Manage the preparation and distribution of function sheets on a weekly basis and present function sheets in the weekly operations meeting.
* Conducting show rounds on property.
* Building good relationships with clients for repeat business, contacting and probing repeat clients when appropriate and track year on year trends and events to support repeat business.
* Effectively co-ordinating activities related to booked meeting & event business with other departments, ensuring client’s expectations are met by maintaining team communication.
* Maintaining excellent Hoxton product and brand knowledge and upselling wherever possible.
* And yes, there’s a little admin … ensuring that daily, weekly and monthly administration is completed accurately and that all groups have necessary documentation on file. But let’s face it, we know you love that!
* Supporting the sales team in attending and assisting with in-house marketing activities, familiarisation trips, client hospitality evenings, presentations, show rounds and promotional activities as required.

  
**Qualifications**

**What we’re looking for…**

* Individuals. You’re looking for a place where you can be you; no clones in suits here.
* Passion for hospitality – whether that’s a drink, a meal, an event or a bed for the night.
* You’re all about having a positive impact on the people you interact with, leaving them with a memorable experience.
* You’re not precious. We leave our egos at the door and help get things done.
* You’re up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once.
* If we got stuck in a lift together, we’d have a good time and share a few laughs.
* You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other, and has fun along the way.
* You’re passionate about hotels and specialise in groups & events at an executive level.
* You are scarily organised, have the ability to multi-task and spin a million plates in the air at one time, prioritise and re-prioritise as things come in.
* A people person, great at building strong and lasting relationships.

title: Digital Sales Representative
description:
* Bengaluru, KA, India
* Not Remote
* Sales
* REF25177Q

  

### **Company Description**

At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
  
  
As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
  
  
Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
  
  
Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
  
  
Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position**

The Digital Solutions Representative (DSR) is responsible for driving the successful deployment, adoption and value realization of Intuitive Digital Solutions across assigned customers. The role will own the customer lifecycle by partnering with clinical, administrative, IT and executive stakeholders to integrate digital solutions into customer workflows, build sustained utilization and demonstrate meaningful customer value.

The DSR will develop strong customer relationships and act as a key partner in advancing customers' digital journey with Intuitive. As the digital portfolio evolves, the role will also contribute to the growth, expansion, commercialization and renewal of Intuitive Digital Solutions across assigned customers.

**Essential Job Duties**

Own the complete customer lifecycle for Intuitive Digital Solutions across assigned accounts, from activation and onboarding through adoption, value realization, expansion and renewal.

* Drive activation and implementation of digital solutions across new installations and eligible existing customer sites, coordinating with relevant internal teams and hospital stakeholders.
* Manage site readiness and activation requirements, proactively identifying dependencies, barriers and risks and coordinating their resolution or escalation.
* Drive adoption and sustained utilization of digital solutions by engaging surgeons, clinical teams and other customer stakeholders and integrating digital solutions into routine workflows.
* Develop and execute account-level adoption, engagement plans and enabling the workflow and behavioral changes required to improve utilization.
* Monitor customer engagement and utilization, identify adoption gaps and implement targeted actions to improve usage and value realization.
* Develop strong relationships across the customer organization, including hospital executive leadership, IT, clinical leadership, surgeons and administrators, and serve as a key point of contact for the digital solutions portfolio.
* Conduct regular business reviews with customers and hospital leadership, demonstrating utilization, outcomes and the value delivered by Intuitive Digital Solutions while aligning on priorities and opportunities for further value creation.
* Understand customer objectives and effectively demonstrate how Intuitive Digital Solutions deliver relevant clinical, operational, training and business value.
* Identify and develop digital champions and KOLs who can advocate for digital solutions, share best practices and support broader adoption.
* Capture and validate customer outcomes, use cases and success stories to support case studies, reference sites, value validation and broader market development.
* Identify and develop opportunities to expand digital solutions across sites and hospital networks, partnering with relevant internal teams to progress opportunities.
* Support commercialization of the digital portfolio by articulating customer value, developing opportunities and contributing to revenue growth, customer retention and renewals as digital offerings evolve.
* Capture structured customer and market insights, including product feedback, adoption barriers and emerging customer needs, and communicate these to relevant internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate visibility of activation, adoption, utilization, customer engagement, opportunities and overall account progress through appropriate systems and reporting.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in medical devices, healthcare technology, software/SaaS, business development, customer success or a related customer-facing role preferred.
* Experience working with hospitals, healthcare providers, strategic accounts and/or corporate hospital networks is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong customer relationships and influence stakeholders across clinical, technical, administrative and executive functions.
* Strong customer engagement, presentation, training and consultative communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive technology adoption, customer utilization and behavior or workflow change.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, priorities and customer initiatives.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret utilization, customer engagement and business insights and translate them into action.
* Highly organized and able to prioritize and manage time in a fast-paced, field-based environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.

Working Conditions

* Comfortable working a flexible, dynamic schedule.
* Able to travel up to 75%, including some short-notice travel.
* Able to enter surgical and other patient care areas.
* Able to lift up to 60 lbs, as required.

### **Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, marketing, healthcare, information technology or a related field required.

### **Additional Information**

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
  
business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
  
Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
  
candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

Lowe’s India actively supports the communities it serves through programs focused on skill-building, sustainability and safe homes. For more information, visit, www.lowes.co.in.

  
  

**Job Profile Summary**

The Principal Enterprise Architect leads the development and communication of target-state architectures, roadmaps, and solutions for technologies across one or more product portfolios and/or multiple complex architecture domains. This includes building high-quality architecture solutions, providing expertise and guidance on the design and establishment of architecture standards that align with current and future business needs. The Principal Enterprise Architect works with little or no oversight and provides coaching and direction to lead architects on the team.

  
  

**Job Description**

* Defines and documents the organization's enterprise architecture standards, target state architectures, and best practices that guide and influence architecture decisions across a product portfolio and/or across architecture domains.
* Provides oversight to ensure current state enterprise architectures are well defined and domain specific architectures are in alignment with enterprise level strategy and direction; proposes new architecture where appropriate.
* Participates in the process of evaluating and approving architecture deliverables; maintains and promotes the value and functional application of architectural governance, standards, guidelines, and patterns.
* Educates and helps the business and senior leadership to incorporate enterprise architecture standards, policies, and best practices to ensure consistency across the organization.
* Creates, maintains, and communicates current and target state data architecture for data domains within subject areas.
* Creates architecture roadmaps at the product portfolio level, collaborating with executives to translate business strategy and technology objectives into an enterprise architectural approach.
* Works to evolve technologies at the product portfolio level from legacy environments to industry best practices, using understanding of legacy systems to determine the correct migration path of enterprise architectures to the future state.
* Oversees proof of concept activities and drafts whitepapers to inform key technology decisions and strategy; provides input and assistance to lead architects on the team where necessary.
* Leads the selection of new application, data, and infrastructure technologies; validates that the selection aligns to target architecture and overall technology direction.
* Leads the development of architecture metrics and reporting to evaluate and communicate the achievement and impact of the enterprise architecture function; presents enterprise architecture content to internal and external audiences, including cross-functional executive leadership.
* Research technology industry trends to establish best practices that guide the design of technology solutions.

  
  

**Required Qualifications:**
  

* 10 years of IT experience
* 7 years of experience in IT system design or architecture
* 4 years of experience leading technical teams with or without direct reports
* 3 years of architecture experience at an enterprise level
* Experience defining cross-domain IT target state architectures and roadmaps
* Experience working in a large matrixed organization, interacting with senior leadership
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, computer science, computer information systems (CIS), engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree)

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
  

* Master's degree in business administration, computer science, CIS, engineering, or related field

The Sales Head – APAC will own the complete sales strategy, execution and revenue performance across the APAC region for the Sarder portfolio, including AI CERTs, AI Labs, Adoptify AI, N+ and other current or future ventures.

The role owns both Direct and Channel Sales and carries an annual revenue target of $10M. This is a hands-on leadership role with complete ownership of revenue outcomes and execution.

Team Leadership, Coaching & Sales Enablement

title: Senior Director,Consulting

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients.
