About JLL
  
We’re JLL. We’re a professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We help organizations around the world achieve their ambitions by owning, occupying and investing in real estate.
  
If you’re looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. **Key responsibilities include:**  
Lead the provision of strategic consulting services in India in areas of portfolio strategy and planning, workplace strategy, business location advisory, change management and other management consulting disciplines using best in class tools and practices.
  
Develop and manage the regional Consulting business plan. Develop objectives/desired results and work with the Consulting team and other regional business leaders to achieve completion.
  
Oversee the design and implementation of the regional Consulting delivery model that will meet client needs and ensure resources are utilized to provide cost-effective products.
  
Support the commercialization and roll-outs of new, innovative ideas and best practices from the innovation center.
  
Engage client leadership and real estate leads to maximize the value of their portfolios.
  
Unlock opportunities for new business and account growth and work with the account team and/or Sales organization to convert these opportunities.
  
Work on new proposals and pitches to achieve sales targets. Provide strategic guidance as well as support for bids, presentations and other similar support activities.
  
Leverage external networks to further sales and business development efforts.
  
Develop a thorough understanding of JLL’s broad capabilities to meet client needs, recognizing opportunities to expand the client footprint by partnering with business and service line leaders.
  
Ability to lead diverse teams, through influence. Align regional teams and key stakeholders across Work Dynamics.
  
Create a solution oriented environment whereby the team is consistently seeking to identify leading edge practices focused on delivering value to the client while working within the process requirements of the account and JLL.
  
Create relationships within the JLL environment to leverage cross account capability to enhance account profitability.
  
Provide guidance for consistent delivery of Consulting services across the region, including reporting requirements, policies and procedures.
  
Ensure high level of execution and client satisfaction for all services performed by the local team.
  
Develop a culture focused on clients, people and teamwork, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation.

Identify opportunities to demonstrate expertise and leadership within industry organizations to further advance the recognition of JLL as a leader.
  
  
Every day is different, and in all these activities, we’d encourage you to show your ingenuity.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply you need to be / have:**

Ten years of industry, management consulting or corporate real estate experience within large corporates.

Diverse industry and functional backgrounds gained through consulting or elsewhere.

Exceptional track record delivering success managing business’ in multiple geographies
  
Ability to solve problems and deliver differentiated value, through the implementation of new services or products.
  
Ability to navigate culture and politics across multiple functions to generate win-win solutions
  
Desire for continuous improvement; creative thinking, problem solving and the ability to innovate
  
Collaborative, goal oriented and able to solve problems/ meet goals in creative ways with limited resources
  
Exhibits flexibility, open-mindedness and adaptability to a rapidly changing environment
  
Demonstrates a sense of urgency and accountability
  
Behavioural CompetenciesThink Big – thinks strategically, simplifies the complex, solves complex problems, sees the big picture
  
Customer Service – dedicated to exceeding clients expectations, ensuring excellent in delivery are achieved through the right solution.
  
Drive Change – thrives on change, learning agility, intellectually curious, appetite for risks, digital drive
  
Helps others – builds relationships, actively collaborates, helps others succeed.
  
Influential – persuasive yet instills confidence among stakeholders, gravitas to drive change and obtain results.
  
Connector – can bring together various constituents across the organization to help drive client solutions.
  
Thrives in Ambiguity – can navigate through a complex, multi-faceted organization with multiple stakeholders
  
  
What you can expect from us
  
You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.
  
Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, wellbeing, benefits and pay. Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sights and imagine where JLL can take you ...
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1751141

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**The opportunity**

  

The product owner will be responsible for the technology analysis, end user research, future product planning, and cradle-to-grave life-cycle management of the product that is developed. You will build products from existing ideas, and help to develop new ideas based on your industry experience and your contact with customers and prospects. You must possess a unique blend of business and technical savvy; a big-picture vision, create a vision of the product from an end user perspective, and the drive to make that vision a reality. You must enjoy spending time in the market to understand their problems, and find innovative solutions for the broader market. You must be able to communicate with all areas of the company. You will work with a technology counterpart to define product release requirements. You will work closely with various stakeholders to make business decisions and create product strategies that ensure the long-term sustainability of the products or tools. You will also serve as the internal and external evangelist for your product offering, occasionally working with the sales channel and key customers.

**Your key responsibilities**

  

* Identifying, evaluating, and planning new software products using lean/agile principles.
* Creating use-cases and related requirements materials for use by our development/technology teams
* Defining minimum viable product features (MVP) and/or pivoting existing products.
* Propose product strategy changes because of competitive changes in the marketplace.
* Working cross-functionally, define and drive alignment and implementation of the software roadmap including products, services, and solutions.
* Closely collaborate with cross-functional teams across business, technical and implementation teams to define product requirements to build and own the product roadmap.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog together with product management.
* Report to Global leadership on product status, management of budget etc.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of customers’ challenges and needs to clearly define product requirements
* Manage the product life cycle
* Assist in the build / buy strategy including recommendations for current solutions
* Communicate and drive organizational alignment on software deployment with key stakeholders including end users
* Works with the technology and client services teams to build and enhance products from existing ideas, and help develop new concepts based on industry research and the needs of end user

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* Experience with HR / Payroll technology solutions and a good understanding of global HRIS / HR / Payroll technology landscape
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done
* Ability to effectively work as a leader in a cross functional team environment including business and product development, supply chain and procurement processes and execution dependencies
* Strong track record of influencing successful product/solution vision/roadmap and executing to a plan
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and expertise in communicating with teams across geographies
* Excellent knowledge of Design Thinking and User Experience methodologies.
* Strategic thinker who is comfortable in a fast-paced, always-on, ambiguous start-up environment

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in engineering (Computer Science/ Technology
* 12 - 15 years of experience in IT/software industry with at least 6 years in capacity of product manager.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* Knowledge and experience in dealing with cross platform mobile applications.
* Demonstrated success in delivering high quality technology products/services in a very high growth environment where priorities shift rapidly.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management

  

**What we offer**

  

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

  

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Luxury Sales Advisor
description:
LAMP CRAFTS

LUXURY SALES ADVISOR

Bengaluru | Full-Time | Showroom-Based | 6 Days a Week

⸻

THE OPPORTUNITY

What if your next job became the foundation of your career?

Lamp Crafts is building something ambitious — and we are looking for a few exceptional people to build it with us.

As a Luxury Sales Advisor, you will be part of the core customer-facing team at Lamp Crafts. You will work with discerning clients, architects, interior designers, lighting professionals and some of the finest lighting products and manufacturers from around the world.

You will be taught.

You will learn.

You will be given responsibility.

You will be expected to grow.

And if you have the hunger and ability to make the most of the opportunity, there is significant room to grow with the company.

It will not be easy. That is precisely why it is an opportunity.

⸻

ABOUT LAMP CRAFTS

Lamp Crafts was established in 1980.

For almost five decades, we have been part of India’s lighting industry.

Today, we are entering our next chapter — building a new-generation luxury and architectural lighting experience centre in Bengaluru.

Our approach is simple:

We do not sell everything that is available.

We sell what we approve.

Our world is built around design, architecture, lighting, craftsmanship, technology, performance, hospitality and experience.

We are not trying to become the best.

We are building Lamp Crafts to be the best.

⸻

THE ROLE

LUXURY SALES ADVISOR

The Sale Advisor is one of the most important client-facing positions at Lamp Crafts.

This is not a conventional showroom sales role.

You will be entrusted with clients, projects, relationships and the Lamp Crafts experience.

You will work with and support the Sales Executive team, while reporting to the Manager and working within the larger leadership structure of the GM and MDs.

The designation carries responsibility, trust and accountability.

We want people who can represent Lamp Crafts with the polish, confidence, knowledge and ownership expected from someone who treats the business as their own.

⸻

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Client Experience & Discovery

\* Welcome and engage clients professionally.

\* Understand the person and the project before recommending products.

\* Listen carefully and ask intelligent questions.

\* Understand architecture, interiors, lifestyle, design intent, requirements and timelines.

\* Guide clients through the Lamp Crafts experience.

Consultative Sales

\* Develop enquiries into opportunities.

\* Build relationships with homeowners, architects, interior designers, consultants and project professionals.

\* Recommend appropriate lighting solutions.

\* Present and demonstrate products.

\* Prepare and present quotations.

\* Handle objections and commercial discussions.

\* Follow up consistently.

\* Close projects and develop repeat business.

Product & Lighting Advisory

You will progressively develop strong knowledge of:

\* Architectural lighting

\* Decorative lighting

\* Indoor and outdoor lighting

\* Lighting technology

\* Materials

\* Optics

\* Performance

\* Beam control

\* Colour quality

\* Dimming

\* Applications

You will learn not merely what a product is, but why it deserves to be recommended.

Project Coordination

You will work with:

\* Architects

\* Interior designers

\* Lighting designers

\* Consultants

\* Contractors

\* Electrical teams

\* Vendors

\* Installation teams

You will progressively be involved from enquiry and selection through quotation, ordering, delivery, installation and after-sales.

Team & Showroom Responsibility

You will work closely with the Sales team, supporting their development and maintaining the standards expected at Lamp Crafts.

You will also contribute to maintaining the showroom — its presentation, order, cleanliness, product displays and overall customer experience.

⸻

YOU WILL BE TAUGHT

You do not need to know everything about lighting when you join.

You do need to be willing to learn.

Lamp Crafts will provide training in:

Lighting | Products | Sales | Hospitality | Customer Experience | Project Coordination

You will learn from people with decades of industry experience and gain exposure to products, manufacturers, projects and professionals across the lighting industry.

The people who listen, learn and apply what they are taught will progress.

⸻

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for polished, dynamic individuals who want to achieve something.

You should be:

\* Reliable

\* Well mannered

\* Well spoken and articulate

\* Humble

\* Sophisticated

\* Committed

\* A strong team player

\* Curious and hungry to learn

\* Hungry to grow

\* Comfortable taking responsibility

\* Confident without arrogance

\* Street-smart while maintaining integrity

\* Resilient

\* Comfortable dealing with successful and discerning clients

\* Energetic, proactive and alert

We want people who can carry themselves as though they are owners of Lamp Crafts — taking responsibility for the outcome rather than simply completing an assigned task.

⸻

QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE

Minimum qualification: Graduate in any discipline.

Candidates with backgrounds in:

Architecture | Interior Design | Engineering | Construction | Hospitality | Aviation | Business | Sales & Marketing

may be particularly suitable.

3+ years of relevant experience preferred, especially in luxury or premium retail, lighting, architecture, interiors, construction, hospitality, business development or client servicing.

What you have achieved in your previous role matters more to us than the designation you previously held.

⸻

LOCATION & COMMITMENT

Location: Bengaluru

This is a showroom-based position.

Candidates should either be located within a practical commuting distance of the Lamp Crafts showroom or be willing to relocate to Bengaluru.

6 days a week | Approximately 9–10 hours per day

This is not a work-from-home, hybrid or part-time position.

The initial years of building Lamp Crafts will require a high level of commitment from the core team.

Requires Site Visits.

⸻

WHAT YOU CAN BUILD

Lamp Crafts is at an exciting stage of its journey.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to build expertise in an industry combining:

Architecture

Interior Design

Lighting

Technology

Luxury

Sales

Hospitality

Projects

Business Development

Your knowledge can grow.

Your responsibilities can grow.

Your career can grow.

And as Lamp Crafts grows, there will be opportunities for people who have demonstrated the ability, commitment and character to grow with it.

⸻

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

\* Fixed salary based on experience and capability

\* Monthly individual and team performance incentives

\* Annual performance incentives

\* Travel allowance for approved business travel

\* Accommodation and food may be provided after successful completion of probation, subject to company policy and availability

\* Health insurance after 6 months, subject to company policy

\* Annual performance bonus eligibility from the 3rd year onwards, after completion of 2 full years with Lamp Crafts

The annual bonus is performance-based and is not fixed or guaranteed.

⸻

IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

If you are looking for an easy job, this probably isn’t it.

If you are looking for a place where you can learn, work hard, become exceptionally good at what you do and build something meaningful, we would like to hear from you.

Lamp Crafts is looking for people who want to make it big — and are prepared to earn it.

Apply with:

\* Updated resume

\* Current location

\* Current / last salary

\* Expected salary

\* Notice period

\* Relevant experience

\* A brief note on why you want to build a career in luxury and architectural lighting

* Paid sick time

description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 17, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1751744

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Associate Director, Strategy & Execution, Consumer Products and Retail, EY-Parthenon GDS India**

At EY, we develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We empower you in a flexible environment and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

We work together across our full spectrum of services and skills, powered by technology and AI, so that business, people and the planet can thrive together.

We’re all in, are you?

Join EY and shape your future with confidence.

  

**The opportunity**

The Strategy & Execution team in EY-Parthenon recognizes that CEOs and business leaders are tasked with achieving maximum value for their organizations’ stakeholders in a transformative business environment. We challenge assumptions to design and deliver strategies that improve profitability, strengthen competitiveness and create long-term value.

We are looking for an experienced strategy consulting professional to join EY-Parthenon GDS India as an Associate Director within the Consumer Products and Retail sector.

You will be based in EY GDS India and work as an integrated member of the Singapore Strategy & Execution team, primarily supporting client engagements across Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.

This is a client-facing consulting and leadership role. You will work closely with EY-Parthenon teams and clients across ASEAN to develop and deliver strategic opportunities, drawing on market, competitor and customer insights and incorporating commercial, operational, financial and implementation perspectives.

The role provides the opportunity to work on complex, cross-border engagements, develop relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to building EY-Parthenon’s Consumer Products and Retail capabilities across Singapore, ASEAN and GDS India.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Client engagement and delivery**

* Lead client engagements, major workstreams or independent modules across strategy, commercial transformation and operational transformation assignments.
* Structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses and define robust approaches to address clients’ strategic and operational priorities.
* Lead the collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative information, translate findings into insights and formulate practical recommendations.
* Take ownership of the quality, timeliness and commercial relevance of project deliverables.
* Work directly with client stakeholders to understand their priorities, align on project objectives and communicate emerging findings and recommendations.
* Lead or contribute to client discussions, working sessions, presentations and senior stakeholder meetings.
* Develop clear, compelling and evidence-based presentations and reports for senior client audiences.
* Work effectively with geographically dispersed engagement teams, coordinating closely with colleagues in Singapore, GDS India and other ASEAN markets.

**Strategy and transformation**

You will work across a range of strategy and transformation engagements, which may include:

* Market entry and growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy
* Revenue growth management
* Commercial transformation
* Digital and AI-led transformation
* Commercial due diligence
* Post-merger integration
* Divestment strategy and execution
* Cost and organization transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial and operational transformation
* Turnaround strategy and rapid value creation

**Team leadership and capability development**

* Lead, coach and develop teams working across GDS India, Singapore and the wider EY-Parthenon network.
* Provide clear direction, constructive feedback and day-to-day support to team members.
* Contribute to building a strong Consumer Products and Retail capability within EY-Parthenon GDS India.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, learning and broader capability-development initiatives.
* Help strengthen collaboration and knowledge sharing between the Singapore and GDS India teams.
* Promote an inclusive, high-performing team environment focused on development, quality and client impact.

**Business and practice development**

* Support the development of ASEAN-focused proposals, credentials and other business-development materials.
* Contribute sector insights and subject-matter expertise to pursuit teams and client discussions.
* Help identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and support the development of new relationships.
* Contribute to the continued growth of the Strategy & Execution practice and its Consumer Products and Retail portfolio across ASEAN.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

To succeed in this role, you should be able to:

* Lead complex strategy and transformation workstreams with limited supervision.
* Combine rigorous analysis with sound commercial judgment and practical recommendations.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly and confidently to senior internal and client stakeholders.
* Build trusted working relationships across different organizations, markets and cultures.
* Manage multiple priorities and maintain high standards in a fast-paced, project-based environment.
* Lead, motivate and develop diverse teams operating across locations.
* Collaborate effectively with Singapore-based and wider ASEAN engagement teams.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the strategic, commercial and operational issues affecting Consumer Products and Retail businesses.
* Adapt your working approach to different client, cultural and market contexts.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution. A master’s degree or MBA is preferred.
* At least six years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in a strategy consulting firm or a closely related consulting environment.
* Demonstrated experience in the Consumer Products and Retail sector.
* Experience leading substantial workstreams, project modules or client engagements.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical and financial analysis skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing and presenting materials for senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing and developing consulting teams.
* The ability to work effectively with colleagues and clients across locations, functions and cultures.
* A willingness and ability to travel internationally in line with client and engagement requirements.

  

**Relevant Consumer Products and Retail experience**

Relevant experience should include one or more of the following areas:

* Corporate, portfolio, market entry or growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy and commercial transformation
* Revenue growth management
* Digital and AI-led business transformation
* Cost reduction and operating-model transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial or operational transformation
* Commercial due diligence, post-merger integration or value creation

  

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Previous experience working with clients or consulting teams in Singapore, ASEAN or other international markets.
* Experience operating as part of a cross-border or globally integrated consulting team.
* Familiarity with the business environment, consumer trends and market dynamics of Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.
* Experience supporting consulting proposals, business development and client pursuits.
* Experience building sector capabilities, coaching teams or contributing to recruitment and learning initiatives.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with senior client stakeholders.

  

**Regional exposure and ways of working**

* The role requires close collaboration with colleagues and clients across ASEAN, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate regional engagement requirements.
* Periodic travel to Singapore and other ASEAN markets will be required, depending on client and engagement needs. This may include short-duration on-site assignments at different stages of an engagement.
* The successful candidate should be comfortable working in an integrated regional team, building relationships remotely and in person, and adapting to the requirements of cross-border client engagements.
* Strong performers may be considered for future international mobility opportunities, subject to business requirements, performance, immigration requirements and applicable firm policies.

  

**What we offer you**

We will fuel your ambition and potential with future-focused skills development that equips you with state-of-the-art methodologies and technology-enabled solutions. With more than 25,000 people in 150 countries, you will join an inclusive and empowering culture that values your uniqueness, prioritizes your wellbeing, and immerses you in the diverse thinking and cross-cultural experiences necessary to help deliver impact to clients across the globe and help build a better working world.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Refund, Loan & Dispute Operations Executive - Customer Support
description:
**Role Overview:** We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and ownership-driven Refund, Loan & Dispute Operations Executive to manage refund calculations, loan/EMI-related cases, non-starter loan cases, financial disputes, transaction reconciliation, and customer resolutions. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with Customer Support, Sales, Finance, Escalation teams, and external loan/financial partners to ensure that every assigned case is accurately analyzed, properly coordinated, and taken to end-to-end closure.

This is a numbers, data, and ownership-driven role. The candidate should be comfortable working with financial data, Excel/Google Sheets, transaction records, and customers.

**Position Details**

* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Department:** Customer Support
* **Experience:** 1–3 years
* **Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com / BBA / Finance-related qualification preferred
* **Location:** Kolkata

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Refund Calculation & Processing:**
* Calculate refund amounts accurately as per the refund policy, payment mode, programme access, and applicable deductions.
* Validate refund eligibility by checking payment records, enrolment details, and supporting documents.
* Verify payment proofs, transaction IDs, and invoices before any refund is initiated.
* Manage the complete refund lifecycle from request → verification → approval → payout → closure.
* Ensure refunds are processed only after obtaining the required approvals.
* Follow up on failed, delayed, or reversed refunds until the amount is credited to the customer.
* **Loan & EMI Case Management:**
* Handle loan/EMI-related cases for customers who have purchased programmes through loan or financing partners.
* Verify and provide accurate information on EMI amount, EMI deduction history, EMI commencement date, tenure, outstanding amount, and payment/loan status.
* Manage loan cancellations, incorrect deductions, and loan closure/foreclosure-related requests in coordination with the loan partner.
* Analyse and manage non-starter loan cases, and coordinate with the loan partner to resolve them as per the agreed process.
* Proactively connect with learners/customers in non-starter loan cases to understand the reason for non-start, provide clarity on loan/EMI status and next steps, and ensure the learner understands the resolution.
* **Financial Dispute Resolution:**
* Handle payment disputes, chargebacks, double debits, and failed transactions where the amount was debited.
* Investigate each case using transaction records, payment gateway data, bank references, and customer communication.
* Prepare the required documents and evidence to respond to disputes raised through payment gateways, banks, or partners within timelines.
* Own the dispute end-to-end after raising it with the concerned POC, including regular follow-ups, TAT monitoring, escalation of delays, validation of the resolution, and formal closure of the case.
* Escalate complex, high-value, or suspicious cases for appropriate review.
* **Transaction Reconciliation:**
* Reconcile transactions across payment gateway reports, bank statements, sales/CRM records, and loan partner reports.
* Identify mismatches, duplicate payments, unmapped payments, and pending settlements.
* Coordinate with the Finance team to resolve discrepancies and close open items.
* **Customer Resolution & Case Closure:**
* Communicate with customers on refund, loan, and dispute cases in a clear, professional, and empathetic manner.
* Explain refund calculations, loan status, and expected timelines to customers in simple terms.
* Prioritize cases based on financial impact, customer impact, ageing, defined TAT, and escalation severity, ensuring that high-value and critical cases receive timely attention.
* Resolve escalated customer cases within the defined TAT.
* Reconnect with the learner/customer after internal resolution wherever required and provide clear closure, including the action taken, final outcome, and any further steps expected from them.
* **Stakeholder & Partner Coordination:**
* Coordinate with Customer Support, Sales, Finance, Escalation teams, and external loan/financial partners.
* Follow up on pending approvals, partner responses, payouts, and documentation.
* Identify recurring issues and process gaps, and recommend improvements for better control, speed, and transparency.
* **Reporting & Record Management:**
* Maintain tracking sheets of refunds, loan cases, and disputes using Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Prepare regular MIS reports on case volumes, refund value, pending cases, and closure rates for management review.
* Ensure all records and supporting documents are properly organized and readily available for review.
* **Confidentiality & Financial Control:**
* Maintain strict confidentiality of customer and company financial information.
* Handle bank details, loan information, and transaction data responsibly.
* Support controls that minimize errors, duplicate refunds, misuse, and unauthorized payouts.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA / Finance-related qualification preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in refund operations, loan/EMI operations, payment disputes, reconciliation, finance operations, or a similar role.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF/COUNTIF, filters).
* Good understanding of payment flows, EMIs/loans, refunds, chargebacks, and transaction records.
* Experience handling loan/EMI queries (EMI deductions, tenure, outstanding amount, foreclosure) will be a strong advantage.
* Ability to perform accurate financial calculations and analyze transaction data.
* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for customer and partner interactions.

**Key Personal Attributes**

* Good organizational, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Comfortable coordinating with customers, internal teams, and external partners.
* High integrity and strong ethical standards.
* Analytical and detail-oriented.
* Strong ownership and accountability till case closure.
* Calm and patient while handling escalated customers.
* Process-driven with good judgment.
* Comfortable handling sensitive financial information.
* Ability to work independently and maintain accurate records.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work closely with the Customer Support, Finance & Operations teams.
* Hands-on exposure to refund operations, loan/EMI processes, payment disputes, and reconciliation.
* Opportunity to build and improve refund and dispute resolution processes.
* Growth opportunity within a fast-paced organization.

**About be10X**

At be10X (Goenka Kachave LLP), we don't just teach AI – we turn it into a career weapon. We're an AI upskilling platform built to help working professionals unlock faster promotions, bigger salary hikes, sharper productivity, and career breakthroughs they didn't think were possible yet. Founded by IIT Kharagpur alumni Aditya Goenka and Aditya Kachave, we've rewritten the career trajectories of over 5 million learners through cutting-edge programs spanning AI, Finance, Data, Product, and Business.

And we're not just growing – we're scaling fast. A profitable, fully bootstrapped organization with INR 500+ crore in annual recurring revenue, a 2,500+ member team, and 15 offices across Pune, Bengaluru & Kolkata, we're one of India's – and the globe's – fastest-growing EdTech organizations.

We're looking for a fashion-obsessed communicator to help build our brands from the ground up. You'll work directly under our Creative Director, who conceives and approves every campaign. Black Linus Clothing Company Private Limited is the home of Ewig Chic (luxury makeup and makeover studio), Blouse Bazaar (women's blouse wear) and Gaja Seere (curated sarees).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Campaigns & Content

- Support the Creative Director in developing campaign ideas, shoot concepts and mood boards, and bring your own fashion-forward, bold, glamorous ideas to the table

- Coordinate brand shoots end to end: models, makeup, styling, locations, schedules and deliverables

- Keep our brand content current with global fashion trends

Online Presence

Brand Experiences & Events

- Handle logistics, guest coordination and on-the-day execution

- Guest lists are built from our existing network. You'll maintain and grow them with new, relevant names and follow up with attendees after events

Customer Engagement

- Engage with prospective customers in person, converting interest into enquiries and sales

WHO YOU ARE

- Passionate about fashion, style and glamour, with a sharp eye for what looks premium

- Energetic, organised and comfortable coordinating many people and moving parts

- A fast learner who takes direction well and then runs with it

description:

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next-generation, life-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Sales Operations – Senior Executive is responsible for enabling efficient commercial execution across the West region through end-to-end order management, SFDC administration, service invoicing, sales enablement support, data governance, reporting, and cross-functional coordination. The role ensures accurate and timely transaction processing, maintains reliable commercial data, and supports stakeholders with actionable business information.

This position reports to the Commercial Operations Manager and is part of the Customer Support team. The role is based in *Bengaluru* and will be an on-site position supporting the West *&* South region of India.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Manage end-to-end order processing, fulfilment coordination, and execution for the West region, ensuring accuracy and timely closure.
* Channel Partner & Customer Engagement: Manage partner and customer coordination, inventory availability, order tracking, and timely resolution of queries to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Administer SFDC, maintain customer and commercial data, and provide user support to improve system adoption and data quality.
* Manage service invoicing and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely, accurate billing and resolution of discrepancies.
* Support sales enablement initiatives, including documentation, process coordination, and operational follow-through.
* Perform data hygiene, analysis, and reporting activities to maintain data accuracy and provide reliable business insights.
* Coordinate with sales, commercial operations, logistics, finance, service, and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless and timely execution.

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, commerce, finance, supply chain, life sciences, or a related discipline.

* Working proficiency in SFDC or a comparable CRM platform, along with data management, reporting, and Microsoft Excel skills.

* Five or more years of experience in a similar sales operations, commercial operations, order management, or customer support role.
* Understanding of biotechnology, life sciences, diagnostics, or a related field.
* Experience working in a regulated healthcare or medical technology environment and coordinating across multiple business functions.

5C Network is India's largest and fastest-growing radiology network, transforming radiology services nationwide

— and soon globally — through advanced technology and clinical excellence. We partner with leading hospitals

and diagnostic centres to deliver unmatched quality, speed, and accuracy in radiology reporting. Our hybrid

delivery model combines physical reporting hubs with an expansive remote network to set new industry

benchmarks. 5C is the only AI-in-Medical-Imaging company with scaled products spanning reactive, preventive,

and proactive imaging, deployed both nationally and internationally.

expanding its customer base, with a preference for candidates experienced in or oriented toward the B2B domain.

You will be responsible for identifying potential customers, engaging with prospects, and guiding them through

the sales process. Your goal will be to build strong relationships with healthcare providers and organizations,

understand their needs, and demonstrate how our AI teleradiology solutions can address their challenges.

* Lead Generation: Proactively identify and qualify potential customers through research, cold calling,

email campaigns, and social media.

updates in the CRM system. Track and report on key metrics and progress toward sales targets.

staying up to date with industry trends and advancements. Communicate product features, benefits, and

competitive advantages effectively.

share insights, and ensure a seamless customer experience. Provide feedback to help refine marketing

materials and sales approaches.

and closing. Handle objections and overcome challenges to secure new business opportunities.

* Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients. Ensure

high levels of customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare, or a related field; MBA freshers with strong

motivation and a genuine interest in pursuing a career in sales are encouraged to apply.

* Prior experience in inside sales is preferred, particularly within the healthcare, technology, or B2B

domain; however, highly motivated freshers with the requisite skills and enthusiasm will also be

considered.

* Strong understanding of the healthcare market, particularly teleradiology and AI applications, is an added

advantage.

* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and

trust with prospects and clients.

* Results-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets.

effectively.

* Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team

environment.

title: Deal Manager
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 16, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1751026

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Discipline**

Pursuits & Commercial Excellence

  

**Role Type**

Deal Manager - Assistant Director

  

**The opportunity**

The Deal Manager - Assistant Director partners with Engagement Teams to support regional strategic, high-value pursuits. They engage early and at multiple stages during the pursuit process and are responsible for developing a tailored communications strategy to articulate a compelling ‘Why EY’ proposition in all pursuit collateral. The Deal Manager - Assistant Director is responsible for the tactical management of all pursuit work-streams including the facilitation of pursuit readiness sessions, touchpoint campaign, draft value proposition, proposal development and orals preparation. The Deal Manager - Assistant Director provides support, advice and expertise to in all the stages of Bid Management Process, involving in pre-RFP, RFP response and post-RFP phase

  

Deal Manager - Assistant Directors are expected to

* Manage execution of pursuit process, including critical path, timeline, and interdependencies
* Assess competitive situation and help develop differentiated win strategy focused on client priorities while protecting EY’s interests
* Develop power map and tactics to navigate client buying process
* Provide ‘glue’ to focus and guide extended pursuit team through structured sales approach and proposal development
* Collaborate with extended pursuit team define, package and articulate compelling client offer across scope, solution, price, and terms
* Plan storyline/key messages and prepare extended team for orals.

  

Additionally, the Deal Manager - Assistant Director is required to identify, develop and implement innovative approaches to pursuit management and drive adoption of these across the Region.

  

Your key responsibilities

**Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management**

* Partner with Engagement Teams to provide a full-service pursuit management model for Regional strategic, high-end opportunities
* Leads by example and advocates for gold standard pursuit practices
* In collaboration with other pursuit team members (e.g., Deal Leader, Engagement Partner, Client Partner), develops client-centric win themes that underpin the entire deal strategy. Ensures the win themes are reflected consistently throughout all client communications and deliverables.
* Suggests creative ideas that enhance our win strategy or ability to differentiate
* Manage and leads the development of opportunity value propositions
* Develop strategic messaging and lead conceptualization of all client-facing pursuit collateral
* Ensures all pursuit deliverables (e.g., meeting documents, proposals, presentations) are developed on schedule submitted on time and with the highest quality
* Ultimately responsible for quality control of all client-facing materials during the pursuit
* Ensures deal infrastructure is established & maintained, including TEAMS site, calendar, action tracker, team roster, notebook, etc. with support from the Deal Coordinator as needed.
* Develops and maintains the pursuit plan/action tracker and calendar, making certain that all pursuit activities are assigned ownership, tracked and executed according to schedule.
* Plan storyline/key messages and prepare extended team for orals
* Supports team strategic and/or operational initiatives to develop new or enhance existing best practices, tools, or enablers.
* Act as the central point of contact in managing the end-to-end process: evaluating requirements, organizing meetings, preparing meeting notes, finalizing timelines and accountabilities as per deadlines
* Serve as a facilitator/key contributor in pursuit strategy sessions, manages output and drives actions
* Shares lessons learned, best practices and innovation from pursuits and other experiences with teammates, the broader BD community, and the global firm as appropriate.
* Act as the knowledge steward for the pursuit
* Builds collaborative relationships with pursuit teams & senior client stakeholders,
* Lead post pursuit analysis and review; makes recommendations for process improvement
* Maintain relationships with other Deal Activation teams and key interdependency groups across the organization Participate in relevant internal and external networks
* Facilitate internal deal governance process

  

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* Champion CoE best-practice pursuit management tools and processes
* Solution-oriented and makes sound decisions quickly, given tight timeframes
* Demonstrate versatility in a constantly evolving environment with a wide variety of social styles
* Influence / challenge the account team to optimize the chances of winning

  

**Supervision Responsibilities:**

* Work with considerable autonomy while often managing the work of others
* Provide coaching and mentoring to others; may serve as a Counsellor to other Deal Coordinators in P&CE.
* Support the onboarding and training of new hires in P&CE.
* Develop and coach Deal Coordinators, Client Executives and Client Servers, through teaming on pursuits and facilitated training
* Oversee the work of the pursuit support team, including third-party resources (e.g. Deal Coordinator, external translation services, etc.)

  

Skills and attributes for success

* Critical thinking, organized, detail – oriented with strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines
* Good understanding of Business Development and Pursuit Management
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines which are essential for a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and listening)
* Strong inter-personal skills
* Ability to analyze data and derive conclusions
* Excellent critical and strategic thinking
* Excellent project management and negotiation skills
* Self-motivated, resourceful & ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ability to influence without authority, lead and coach others
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree (advanced degree preferred)
* MBA (Marketing/International Business)

  

**Experience:**

* 12-15 years in Business Development of which minimum 5 years should be in Bid Management/Pre-Sales/Pursuit Management in professional services organizations
* Minimum 5 years’ experience working with large Global organization preferably in a professional services firm
* Must have communications and proposal writing experience
* Experience in managing end to end managed services deals
* Experience working in a cross-border, multi-cultural environment

  

**Certification Requirements:**

* Expected to remain current on EY training and curriculum (e.g. Account Management Framework (AMF), Badges, etc.)
* APMP and or PMP Certification would be added advantage

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* As the job involves responding to clients' needs and varying time zones, long/flexible hours are regularly required
* Moderate travel - including occasional international travel - will be required

  

**Technologies and Tools**

Excellent MS office skills, specifically PowerPoint are required

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Description: ServiceNow Solution Architect / Engineering Manager (AI-Focused)**
=====================================================================================

**Grade / Level:** Manager
  
**Experience:** 8–14 years
  
**Team:** EY GDS – TTT ServiceNow & CT Teams
  
**Location:** Bengaluru / India GDS

**Role Summary**
----------------

The ServiceNow Solution Architect – Manager is a senior consulting and technology leadership role within EY GDS. This role leads the architecture, design, and delivery of AI-enabled, enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions for global clients. The position combines deep ServiceNow platform expertise, Now Assist and GenAI Controller–led architecture, consulting leadership, and people management. The individual acts as a trusted advisor to client and internal stakeholders, driving platform transformation aligned to EY consulting methodologies, risk frameworks, and business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Architect end-to-end ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, and custom applications
* Define secure, scalable, and resilient ServiceNow architectures aligned with EY GDS and client enterprise standards
* Lead complex integrations using REST, SOAP, MID Server, and third-party enterprise platforms
* Establish best practices for data models, workflows, automation, and performance analytics
* Review and govern technical designs, AI feature usage, and code quality across engagements

### **ServiceNow AI, NowAssist & GenAI Architecture Leadership**

* Define and lead NowAssist and GenAI Controller–based solution architectures aligned to ServiceNow best practices
* Design AI-augmented use cases including Agent Assist, Virtual Agent, AI Search, case summarization, and resolution intelligence
* Architect context-aware GenAI workflows while ensuring data privacy, security, and responsible AI controls
* Partner with CT/CTP and TTT stakeholders to align AI adoption with platform roadmaps and value realization goals
* Evaluate ServiceNow AI features across releases and drive enterprise-scale adoption strategies

### **Program & Delivery Leadership**

* Lead large-scale ServiceNow and AI-enabled transformation programs across multiple workstreams
* Collaborate with engagement and program leaders to manage scope, risks, quality, and timelines
* Proactively manage architecture risks, platform constraints, and delivery escalations
* Ensure compliance with EY GDS delivery governance, security, and quality standards

### **Consulting Manager Responsibilities**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to client executives and senior IT leaders
* Translate business problems into ServiceNow and AI-led solution roadmaps
* Lead executive workshops, architecture reviews, and value-based discussions
* Support pre-sales, estimations, solutioning, and RFP responses
* Drive measurable outcomes through adoption, change, and value realization strategies

### **People & Practice Leadership**

* Manage, coach, and develop ServiceNow architects and engineers aligned to EY career frameworks
* Conduct performance reviews, goal setting, and capability development
* Build AI and ServiceNow competencies through certifications, training, and innovation initiatives
* Support hiring, onboarding, and capacity planning for GDS TTT and CT teams

### **Governance, Risk & Innovation**

* Define platform governance, AI usage standards, and reusable architectural assets
* Ensure responsible AI usage aligned with EY risk, compliance, and data governance principles
* Promote innovation leveraging AI, automation, and emerging ServiceNow capabilities

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* 8–14 years of overall IT experience with 6+ years of hands-on ServiceNow platform experience
* Strong expertise in ServiceNow architecture, data model, scripting (JavaScript, Glide API)
* Deep understanding of ServiceNow AI architecture including Now Assist, GenAI Controller, AI Search, and Predictive Intelligence
* Hands-on experience enabling GenAI-driven workflows, Agent Assist, and Virtual Agent capabilities
* Experience leading enterprise-scale ServiceNow or AI-enabled transformations
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and CIS certifications (mandatory)
* ServiceNow Certified Architect or advanced AI-focused certifications (preferred)
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and leadership skills

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience working in EY GDS, Big 4, or large global consulting organizations
* Exposure to AI governance, risk, compliance, and data privacy controls in enterprise environments
* Multi-industry experience including Technology, BFSI, Healthcare, or Manufacturing
* Strong executive communication and storytelling skills

title: Sales Enablement Director
description:
**About Keka**

Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. More than 12,500 companies trust Keka, from fast-growing small businesses to large enterprises and global companies with teams across borders.

We build software the way HR actually works. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East, our revenue team is growing fast to keep up. That is where this role comes in.

**Location: Hyderabad [or] Bangalore, Onsite**

**The role**

You will make every Keka seller faster to ramp, sharper in front of customers and more consistent in how they win.

Our sales team is growing quickly across SMB, mid-market and enterprise. Growth like this breaks things that worked at a smaller size: onboarding gets uneven, messaging drifts, and top-performer habits stay locked in a few heads. You will own the enablement engine that fixes this, from a new hire's first week to how a tenured AE runs a complex deal.

You will make every Keka seller faster to ramp, sharper in front of customers and more consistent in how they win.

Our sales team is growing quickly across SMB, mid-market and enterprise. Growth like this breaks things that worked at a smaller size: onboarding gets uneven, messaging drifts, and top-performer habits stay locked in a few heads. You will own the enablement engine that fixes this, from a new hire's first week to how a tenured AE runs a complex deal.

Enablement sits at the centre of our FY27 revenue plan. The plan is a conversion problem more than a volume problem, and every conversion target assumes a seller who can hold a credible conversation in the buyer's own industry. We are moving the field from feature-based selling to problem-based selling, and the enablement engine you build is how that shift reaches every rep. It will be prescriptive and data-driven: shaped by rep-level data, not by a training calendar.

You join while two programs are already in motion. The Demo Excellence Center builds one message map, content package and demo experience for each industry. The Packaging and Pricing work turns that story into packages customers buy. You will own the enablement that puts both in the field.

You will work closely with Sales leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing and Customer Success, and you will be judged on revenue outcomes, not training hours.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and ownership**

* Build and own the sales enablement strategy and roadmap, tied directly to revenue targets.
* Partner with the CRO and sales leaders to find the biggest gaps in rep performance and close them.
* Set the enablement charter, priorities and budget, and report impact to leadership every quarter.

**Onboarding and ramp**

* Design role-based onboarding for SDRs, AEs, Account Managers and frontline managers.
* Cut time-to-first-deal and time-to-full-quota, with clear certification milestones.
* Run onboarding at scale as hiring grows, without dropping quality.

**Skills and coaching**

* Build continuous learning programs: discovery, demo, objection handling, negotiation, multi-threading.
* Tailor plays for each segment: SMB (high velocity, short cycles), mid-market (multi-stakeholder deals) and enterprise (complex, long-cycle, committee-led buying).
* Equip frontline managers to coach well, using call reviews, deal reviews and clear scorecards.

**Sales methodology and process**

* Roll out and embed a common sales methodology (for example MEDDICC, Challenger or SPIN) across teams.
* Work with RevOps to bake the methodology into CRM stages, exit criteria and forecasting.

**Content and tools**

* Partner with Product Marketing on pitch decks, battlecards, ROI tools, case studies and competitive intel.
* Own the sales content hub and make sure reps can find the right asset in seconds.
* Choose and drive adoption of enablement tech (LMS, conversation intelligence, content management).

**Launches and new markets**

* Get the field ready for product launches, pricing changes and new segments or geographies.

**Measurement**

* Track enablement impact through ramp time, win rate, deal size, cycle length and quota attainment.
* Use data to decide what to scale, fix or stop.

**Team leadership**

* Hire, lead and grow a high-performing enablement team.

**Must-haves**

* **B2B SaaS background.** Your enablement or sales leadership career is rooted in B2B SaaS.
* **Has managed scale-up.** You have built or rebuilt enablement while a sales team grew fast (for example doubling headcount or moving into new segments), and kept quality high through it.
* **Proven track record.** You can show numbers you moved: ramp time, win rate, quota attainment, deal size or cycle length.
* **Experience across SMB, mid-market and enterprise.** You have enabled teams selling to SMB, mid-market and enterprise buyers, and you know how a high-velocity motion differs from a consultative, long-cycle one.
* **12 to 15 years of experience,** with at least 4 to 5 years leading enablement, sales training or sales readiness, and a team of your own.
* **Based in Bengaluru or Hyderabad,** or ready to move before joining.

**Nice-to-haves**

* HR Tech, payroll, fintech or other horizontal SaaS sold to business owners and HR or finance buyers.
* Has taken enablement into a new geography (for example the Middle East or Southeast Asia).
* Hands-on with tools like Gong or Avoma, Highspot or Seismic, an LMS, and Salesforce or HubSpot CRM.
* Was a quota-carrying seller or sales manager earlier in their career.
* Certified in a sales methodology (MEDDICC, Challenger, Sandler or similar).

description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Director, AI & Information Security

**Role Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Senior Staff Cyber Security Architect to design, implement, and govern security architecture across enterprise networks, endpoints, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and AI ecosystems. This role is critical to establishing security standards, driving secure-by-design initiatives, and ensuring our technology landscape remains resilient against evolving cyber threats. You will serve as a trusted technical leader, bridging business and technology to enable innovation through secure, scalable architecture.

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As a Senior Staff Architect, you will define and maintain the enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs. You will lead security reviews for infrastructure, cloud, SaaS, and emerging AI initiatives while enforcing Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust principles. Success in your first 6–12 months includes developing a cohesive security roadmap, establishing robust AI and cloud security guardrails, and partnering cross-functionally across Engineering, IT, and Product teams to reduce critical risks while elevating our overall security maturity.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Define and maintain** enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs across network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, and AI domains.
* **Architect and govern** secure cloud landing zones, security guardrails, and DevSecOps shift-left practices across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* **Establish and enforce** Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust Architecture principles, ensuring secure connectivity, micro-segmentation, and least-privilege access.
* **Lead the development** of our enterprise AI security strategy, establishing controls for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), model poisoning detection, and responsible AI governance.
* **Design** enterprise network and endpoint security architecture, overseeing standards for NGFW, ZTNA, EDR, MDM, and secure SD-WAN.
* **Oversee** SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) and establish comprehensive controls for enterprise platforms (e.g., M365, Salesforce, Workday).
* **Develop** robust Identity & Access Management (IAM) strategies, including SSO, MFA, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and passwordless authentication.
* **Conduct** comprehensive architecture reviews, threat modeling, and security assessments to identify risks and recommend strategic remediation to executive leadership.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with Engineering, Product, IT, and Legal teams to integrate security throughout the development lifecycle and align with regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
* **Provide architectural guidance** during major cyber incidents, partnering with SOC and Incident Response teams to evaluate events and strengthen future security controls.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of comprehensive cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years in a Security Architect or Lead Security Engineering role supporting enterprise-scale global environments.
* Deep technical expertise across network, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, and emerging AI security domains.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing Zero Trust Architectures and managing enterprise risk.
* Experience developing secure cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the courage and ability to influence cross-functional leadership on security best practices.
* **Education Requirements:** B.Tech/B.E. in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or GIAC.
* Cloud-specific security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience or certifications related to AI/LLM Security (e.g., CAISP) and data privacy (CIPP).
* Master's degree in a relevant technical or engineering field.

Gurgaon/Bangalore, India — Hybrid / Remote

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology and your hard work!

**Overview**

This is a position based in Delhi(preferred), Bangalore is an option, ideal for a senior sales professional with experience navigating complex, consultative sales cycles within large organizations.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and securing new enterprise accounts, expanding relationships within existing customers, and positioning Solace as a critical enabler of both traditional event-driven architecture (EDA) and next-generation AI-driven initiatives.

As organizations accelerate their adoption of artificial intelligence, real-time data movement has become a foundational requirement. Solace plays a key role in helping enterprises modernize their integration strategy to support AI workloads by ensuring that data is delivered securely, efficiently, and in real time across distributed systems.

You will work closely with technical stakeholders and executive decision-makers to demonstrate how Solace’s platform can serve as the backbone for modern AI-ready infrastructure.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Be responsible for establishing, cultivating, and improving Solace’s relationship with clients.
* Identify new business opportunities to grow with both new clients, and within existing clients – and they lead the sales process from start to finish.
* Develop and execute territory and account plans that address short-term and strategic goals which include pipeline building, revenue attainment, profit margin, client wallet share, and customer satisfaction.
* Be a “hunter” and must be a self-starter who is able to work independently. At the same time, be a strong team player — capable of collaborating widely and building a deep relationship with their pre-sales engineer(s) and others.
* Ultimately, accountable to win new business, and in the process will build strong client relationships (at both the working and executive level), negotiate complex deals, and establish long-lasting client relationships.

  

**What You’ll Bring to the Role**

* Consultative selling
* Ability to build strong executive relationships
* Proven ability to close large, complex, SAAS deals
* Track record in selling middleware products, solutions, and services
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with a proven ability to connect with clients
* Ability to pull together a team and lead complex negotiations
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* 8+ years of experience managing client relationships in the Enterprise IT space
* Proven track record of sales success in other IT companies
* Familiarity with MEDIC / MEDDPICC sales process
* Willingness to travel as much as 30% of their time (2-3 days a week)
* Ability to work without sponsorship required

  

**Why You’ll Love Working at Solace**

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

* **Work with brilliance** – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.
* **Balance matters** – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.
* **Hybrid-first** – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.
* **Values-driven** – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.
* **Growth mindset** – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.
* **Customer Obsessed** – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).
* **Keep it fun** – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.
* **Creative culture** – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

  

**At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.**  
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

**Let’s Talk**

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!
