title: Associate Director — Commercial Insights & Analytic
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**OBJECTIVES / PURPOSE**

We are seeking an Associate Director to lead the GCC Commercial Insights & Analytics (I&A) teams supporting a US business unit (USBU) within Takeda. This is a hands-on people-leadership role accountable for the quality, consistency, and business impact of all analytics delivered. Both Managers and Analysts report into this role. The Associate Director coaches and guides the team through their day-to-day work, ensures accountabilities for all deliverables, owns the analytics relationship with US I&A leadership, and remains willing and able to be hands-on in the analysis when the situation requires.

* Own end-to-end analytics delivery, ensuring high-quality, on-time delivery of brand and portfolio analytics while holding the team accountable for every deliverable.
* Lead a team of both Managers and Analysts — coaching and guiding them through their work, reviewing outputs, unblocking issues, and stepping in hands-on on complex or high-visibility analyses when required.
* Serve as the senior GCC analytics partner to US I&A leadership, owning demand intake, prioritization, delivery governance, and executive communication.
* Govern the operating model and ways of working, ensuring consistency, rigor, and predictable delivery across teams.

**ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**BU Delivery Oversight & Quality Governance**

* Own the quality, timeliness, and commercial relevance of all analytics delivered — performance reporting, HCP targeting and segmentation, patient opportunity assessments, launch readiness analytics, and complex ad hoc deep dives across the BUs' brands.
* Set and enforce analytical standards and review frameworks, ensuring consistent methodological rigor, data accuracy, narrative quality, and stakeholder readiness before US review; be hands-on to arbitrate or execute the most complex analyses when needed.
* Balance capacity and prioritization, resolving contention and reallocating effort to protect the highest-value, highest-urgency deliverables.

**Stakeholder Management & Operating-Model Governance**

* Act as the senior point of contact for US I&A leadership, managing demand intake, setting and meeting delivery commitments, and proactively communicating status, risks, and trade-offs.
* Represent GCC analytics in the BUs' US I&A planning sessions, quarterly business reviews, and cross-functional analytics forums, ensuring GCC contributions are visible, trusted, and commercially relevant.
* Establish and continuously improve the operating model between the GCC teams and their US I&A counterparts — intake, prioritization, SLAs, escalation paths, and communication norms — and drive adoption.

**People Leadership, Coaching & Accountability**

* Lead a team of 4-6 direct reports spanning Managers and Analysts, with indirect oversight of the broader analyst population; set clear goals, conduct regular one-on-ones, provide substantive feedback, and build individualized development plans.
* Coach and guide the team through their work — shaping analytical approach, reviewing deliverables, and developing problem-solving and stakeholder skills — while holding every team member accountable for the quality and timeliness of their output.
* Develop Managers into stronger people leaders, coaching them on delivery governance, stakeholder management, and team development, and building leadership bench strength.
* Own workforce planning, hiring, and talent development for analytics teams, including interview-panel leadership, onboarding, performance management, and retention of critical talent.

**Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Champion automation and efficiency across recurring reporting workflows, sponsoring SQL- and Python-based pipelines and dashboard automation that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
* Rationalize the reporting portfolio on a regular basis, consolidating, automating, or retiring deliverables in alignment with evolving brand-team priorities.
* Lead Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), insourcing, and transition initiatives for the BU, standing up and stabilizing new analytics workstreams within the GCC while sustaining delivery quality.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's Degree required in Statistics, Data Science, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree (Master's or MBA) in Analytics, Data Science, Business, or a related field strongly preferred.

**Experience:**

* 12-15 years of progressive experience in US pharmaceutical commercial analytics, including substantial people-leadership experience managing both managers and analysts across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated track record of owning end-to-end analytics delivery for multiple business units, driving accountability across teams, and remaining hands-on in the analysis when required.
* Deep knowledge of US pharma commercial datasets: patient-level claims (IQVIA, Komodo Health, Symphony Health), specialty pharmacy (867), EMR, sales data, and access/payer data is required.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in coding techniques such as SQL, SAS, R, or Python for data manipulation and workflow automation; advanced Excel required.
* Strong experience with Tableau or Power BI for performance, launch, and brand analytics dashboard development; experience with Databricks or cloud-based analytics environments is preferred.
* Proven experience leading Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), insourcing, or transition initiatives in a GCC, captive, or offshore delivery model supporting US/Global stakeholders is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to lead multiple high-priority workstreams simultaneously in a fast-paced, cross-cultural, matrixed environment.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* **People Leadership & Coaching —** Leads a team of Managers and Analysts; coaches and guides through the work and holds everyone accountable for quality and timeliness.
* **Multi-BU Delivery Ownership —** Owns end-to-end delivery and quality for US business units — demand, prioritization, quality standards, and delivery health.
* **Hands-On Analytical Depth —** Willing and able to step into complex or high-visibility analyses directly; sets the technical bar by example.
* **Operating-Model Governance —** Governs intake, prioritization, quality standards, and ways of working consistently across teams.
* **Advanced US Pharma Analytics —** Deep proficiency in US commercial data and statistical methods; critically reviews complex analyses with sound methodological judgment.
* **Senior Stakeholder Partnership —** Builds trusted relationships with US I&A leadership; communicates proactively and manages expectations credibly.
* **Data Storytelling —** Distils complex multi-source findings into compelling, decision-oriented narratives with clear business implications.
* **Cross-Cultural Communication —** Fluent communicator across India-US time zones and organizational levels; adapts style for technical and commercial audiences.

**Intangible Skills:**

* Curiosity · Confidence · Reflective · High risk tolerance · Organized · High command of written and spoken English fluency.

**TAKEDA LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS**

In alignment with Takeda's Values-Based Culture, this role requires demonstration of the following leadership behaviours:

* **Act with Integrity —** Deliver accurate, transparent work and take full responsibility for quality.
* **Collaborate Cross-Functionally —** Contribute positively to GCC-US team workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
* **Drive Accountability —** Take ownership of all assigned tasks and deliver on commitments.
* **Embrace Learning —** Continuously build analytical and domain capabilities through feedback and self-driven development.

**About the job**
-----------------

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.
  
  
As an Account Executive, you will work with your respective set of advertisers to shape their business growth and strengthen long-term relationships. You will set the goal and strategy for how their advertising can reach users, drive growth for the book of business, and win a share of wallets for Google. You will be front-line sales leads with a focused portfolio of clients, working alongside an Account Manager. You will design transformative strategies for business growth based on customer objectives.Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow. Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

title: Associate Manager, Market Development
description:
Overview:

Reporting to the Head of Sales, South Asia, the Associate Manager, Market Development, will be a key member of the Global Sales organization responsible for driving market growth, demand generation, and revenue execution across the South Asia region.

The role will focus on expanding Shure's presence within the Collaboration and Conferencing ecosystem by developing strategic relationships with end users, consultants, system integrators, distribution partners, and alliance partners. Leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and customer engagement, this individual will help build pipeline, accelerate specifications, and drive adoption of Shure's collaboration, conferencing, networked audio, and enterprise solutions portfolio.  
This position can be based in Bangalore or Hyderabad.

Responsibilities:

**Revenue Growth & Pipeline Development**  

* Drive business development, pipeline creation, and revenue growth within the Collaboration and Conferencing market to support regional sales objectives and long-term business growth.
* Identify, prioritize, and develop strategic opportunities, key accounts, and emerging market segments to expand Shure's customer base and specification influence.
* Work closely with sales leadership, distribution partners, and system integrators to accelerate opportunity conversion and improve win rates.

**End-User & Ecosystem Engagement**  

* Develop strong relationships with end users, consultants, technology influencers, and channel partners to position Shure as the preferred audio and collaboration solutions provider.
* Promote Shure's complete ecosystem, including conferencing, collaboration, networked audio, wireless, and software offerings, to drive cross-portfolio adoption and attachment opportunities.
* Influence project specifications and technology recommendations through proactive customer engagement and solution-based selling.

**Partner Enablement & Capability Development**  

* Plan and deliver training, workshops, demonstrations, and enablement programs for distribution partners, consultants, and integration partners.
* Strengthen partner capabilities around Shure solutions, value proposition, competitive positioning, and sales motions.
* Measure the effectiveness of enablement activities and recommend actions to improve partner engagement and conversion.

**Market Activation & Demand Generation**  

* Collaborate with Marketing and Market Activation teams to execute customer events, roadshows, industry conferences, webinars, and thought leadership initiatives.
* Support local demand-generation campaigns that increase market awareness, create qualified opportunities, and strengthen customer engagement.
* Represent Shure at key industry events and customer-facing activities throughout the region.

**Business Intelligence & Strategic Planning**

* Provide market insights, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and regional trends to support sales strategy, portfolio planning, and go-to-market decisions.
* Support forecasting, pipeline reviews, account planning, and business reviews through data-driven insights and opportunity analysis.
* Monitor competitive developments and recommend actions to strengthen Shure's market position and accelerate growth.

**Travel**  

* Ability to travel minimum 50% of the time, including occasional weekends, as business needs require.

  
Qualifications:

* Proven success driving business development, revenue growth, and strategic account expansion within the Integrated Systems, Unified Communications, or professional AV industry.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with 8-10 years of relevant experience in professional audio, collaboration technologies, or audiovisual solutions.
* Strong understanding of Integrated Systems markets, including Audio Visual Integration, Unified Communications, Collaboration Solutions, Networked Audio, Video Conferencing, and Multi-Language Discussion Systems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence complex buying decisions and build relationships across end users, consultants, integrators, distributors, and alliance partners.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze market trends, identify growth opportunities, and develop actionable sales strategies.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and customer engagement skills, with the ability to articulate business value to both technical and executive audiences.
* Experience with audio system design, DSP platforms, conferencing technologies, and enterprise collaboration solutions is highly desirable.
* Self-motivated, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, CRM platforms, and pipeline management processes.
* Native language fluency appropriate for the region with excellent spoken and written English.

**WHO WE ARE**

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

Join Shure and **Amplify Your Impact.** Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.

**THE MIX MATTERS**

Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

**About the Team**

The **Customer Insights** team uses data and analytics capabilities to provide strategic insights around customer and competitive landscape to help drive effective market strategy for Lowe’s. The team works closely with various key functions across the business to provide insights and recommendations across different business areas. The team is responsible to track, report and analyze various customer and market related metrics and generate actionable insights on key customer segments, customer experience vis-à-vis Lowe’s and our market position along with opportunities to help inform an effective Go To Market Strategy and win market share across key markets, customer segments and product categories.

  

**Job Summary:**

  

Executing direction from leadership, delivering results that align with strategic objectives, communicating critical information to other teams, managing vendor relationships, developing processes that align to organizational goals, specific technical skills required for managing a process.

  
  

**The primary responsibility** is to report, analyze and provide insights on Customer Experience at Lowe’s across selling channels, customer segments and product categories. The individual will apply analytical methods to combine internal and external data and analyze trends in Customer Experience Metrics and the factors that play a key role driving improvement in those metrics.

This position is responsible for following best practices in turning business questions into data analysis, analyzing results and identifying insights for decision making; determine additional research/analytics that may be needed to enhance the solution; and coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure project continuity and strategic alignment.

  
  

The individual will also have to proactively take up initiatives to apply modern tools and techniques to improve efficiency, accuracy and overall quality of insights offered to stakeholders.

  
  

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Analyze Customer feedback, LTR, NPS data to understand in-market trends and where to focus to improve Customer experience using Medallia platform / create reports / dashboards using Medallia capabilities.
* Work with our US (Mooresville) team to assist them in defining various reporting / analysis needs and building appropriate methodologies to provide actionable insights on Experience Metrics.
* Identifying the appropriate univariate and multivariate analysis to identify key customer trends and insights – Segmentation, Bayesian Networks, Factor analysis etc.
* Synthesize disparate sources of data—primary and secondary to develop cohesive stories, trends and insights that will drive strategic decision making across the enterprise.
* Leverage available information across workstreams to help connect dots and provide holistic insights on Customer Experience trends and Strategy.
* Work with the data operation teams to enhance data capabilities and develop tools to improve ease of access to data and BI for the broader organization
  

**Years of Experience:**

  

* 1-3 Years’ Hands on experience with Customer Experience Analytics / Customer Analytics / Customer Insights
  

  

**Required Minimum Qualifications:**

  

* Master’s degree in economics / Statistics / Analytics or MBA in Marketing
  

**Skill Set Required**

  

**Primary Skills (must have)**

* Hands on experience in Medallia Platform, SQL , Teradata, Hadoop, Python

* Hands-on Analytics Experience of building Statistical / Mathematical models and multivariate analysis like Segmentation, Logistic Regression, Bayesian Networks, Factor analysis, Conjoint analysis, etc.
* Familiarity with experience platforms like Medallia or Qualtrics with understanding of data and functionalities
* Ability to apply Analytical tools and techniques to extract insights from Structured and Unstructured data

* Consulting Skills - Ability to impact business decisions through analytics and research.
* Hands on experience in creating Executive level audience ready presentations to tell impactful stories.

* Excellent communication skill to connect with people from diverse background and experience
  

  

**Secondary Skills (desired)**

* Experience on working with text data would be an advantage.
* Experience in working with Customer Experience or Voice of Customer Metrics will be a good to have.
* Familiarity with retail industry and key concepts.

transformation priorities, shape differentiated consulting and managed security solutions, and lead complex pursuits from

* Develop account-specific cyber growth plans, value propositions, and executive engagement strategies that increase wallet

share.

risk exposure, investment roadmaps, and sourcing strategies.

investment cases.

data and AI security, OT security, resilience, and managed security services.

* Conduct executive workshops, security maturity discussions, innovation sessions, and value-led solution showcases to

create demand.

Build Trusted Client Relationships

* Establish trusted-advisor relationships with GCC leaders, Global and India CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Risk Officers, and

business executives.

* Connect India GCC stakeholders with global account and security leadership to align priorities, budgets, sponsorship, and

decision pathways.

* Represent Accenture Security at GCC forums, cyber security events, client roundtables, and executive briefings.

* Lead large cyber security pursuits from qualification and win strategy through solution shaping, proposal, negotiations, and

contract closure.

* Mobilize cyber solution architects, industry specialists, delivery teams, ecosystem partners, commercial, finance, legal, and

leadership teams to create differentiated and executable solutions.

* Drive competitive strategy, value articulation, pricing, deal economics, risk management, commercial constructs, and

executive-level proposals.

* Maintain strong pursuit governance, including qualification, stakeholder mapping, competitor analysis, decision criteria,

closure plans, and pipeline hygiene.

Collaborate Across the Accenture and Cyber Ecosystem

* Partner with Client Groups, Market Units, global account teams, Accenture Security practices, Technology, Operations,

Industry X, Cloud, Data & AI, and ecosystem partners to maximize GCC cyber opportunities.

* Work with account leadership to integrate cyber security into broader cloud, data, AI, SAP, digital-core, and operations

transformation agendas.

* Leverage strategic technology alliances to create differentiated offerings, joint campaigns, and co-sell opportunities.
* Share threat, regulatory, market, competitor, and investment insights to shape Accenture’s GCC cyber growth strategy.

* Strong knowledge of the cyber security market, threat landscape, regulatory environment, buying centers, leading

technology platforms, and managed security operating models.

* Demonstrated success selling cyber security consulting, transformation, implementation, and managed services to large

enterprises and GCCs.

* Ability to engage security and business executives, articulate cyber risk in business terms, and develop compelling outcomeled

value propositions.

* Strong capture management, account planning, qualification, negotiation, commercial, storytelling, and executive

presentation skills.

* Ability to orchestrate global, cross-functional teams and convert complex technical capabilities into integrated client

solutions.

* Strong analytical discipline, market awareness, sales forecasting, pipeline governance, and focus on measurable growth

outcomes.

description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Future Begins Here**
==========================

At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.

Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicentre of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

**At Takeda’s ICC we Unite in Diversity**

Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team.

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a Director of Data Execution & Operations to lead enterprise data execution and operational delivery across all Takeda U.S. Business Unit (USBU) and Oncology Business Unit (OBU) markets. The Director will be accountable for reliable day-to-day operations, disciplined execution, service performance, issue resolution, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.

The Director will lead the India Capability Center (ICC) team for the above markets, with ICC team members reporting directly into this role. The Director will work closely with the U.S. Director of Data Execution & Operations on day-to-day operational activities, execution priorities, and enhancements. This leader will establish a scalable operating model, strengthen operational governance, introduce automation, and provide leadership with clear visibility into operational performance, pipeline, demand, risks, and priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead the Data Execution & Operations program across all Takeda USBU and OBU markets, ensuring consistent delivery, operational stability, and business continuity.
* Partner closely with the U.S. Director of Data Execution & Operations to manage day-to-day operational activities, execution priorities, enhancements, and cross-market dependencies.
* Own end-to-end operational execution, including data processing, production support, incident management, release readiness, operational handoffs, and issue escalation.
* Establish and continuously improve the operating model, including roles, responsibilities, governance forums, decision rights, escalation paths, and communication rhythms.
* Define, track, and report service-level agreements (SLAs), operational KPIs, delivery metrics, recurring issues, and improvement actions.
* Prepare and present regular operational reporting covering SLA performance, KPIs, delivery status, incidents, risks, backlog, demand, and continuous improvement actions.
* Maintain an integrated backlog and demand tracker with clear ownership, prioritization, status, dependencies, target timelines, and escalation needs.
* Provide leadership with transparent visibility into the delivery pipeline, upcoming demand, resource capacity, operational risks, and decisions required.
* Work closely with the team to identify operational inefficiencies and implement automation that reduces manual effort, improves quality, and accelerates issue resolution.
* Drive structured root cause analysis and sustainable remediation for production issues, data delays, recurring defects, and cross-platform dependencies.
* Bring forward new ideas, tools, and delivery practices that improve reliability, transparency, scalability, cost efficiency, and user experience over time.
* Ensure clear documentation, runbooks, standard operating procedures, knowledge transfer, and support readiness across all programs.
* Provide timely and transparent updates to senior stakeholders on operational health, risks, dependencies, decisions, and corrective actions.
* Lead timely escalations for critical incidents, delivery risks, unresolved dependencies, capacity constraints, and items requiring leadership intervention.

**ICC Team Leadership and Talent Management**
=============================================

* Lead the ICC Data Execution & Operations organization, with ICC team members reporting directly to the Director.
* Build a high-performing team with clear accountability, strong ownership, defined goals, and measurable outcomes.
* Coach and develop team members, strengthen technical and operational capabilities, and create development and succession plans.
* Ensure the right skills, capacity, and leadership coverage are aligned to USBU and OBU priorities.
* Promote a culture of responsiveness, collaboration, transparency, continuous learning, and proactive problem-solving.
* Coordinate effectively with onsite teams and delivery partners across locations and time zones.

**Operational Governance and Continuous Improvement**
=====================================================

* Create a standardized operating model that can be applied consistently while supporting market- and franchise-specific data, business rules, and operational needs.
* Implement governance routines for service reviews, SLA performance, incident trends, risk management, prioritization, and continuous improvement.
* Establish dashboards and reporting that provide clear visibility into operational performance, backlog, recurring issues, team capacity, and improvement progress.
* Develop an automation roadmap focused on monitoring, alerting, reconciliation, workflow orchestration, issue triage, and recurring operational activities.
* Use service data, trend analysis, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to identify and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Ensure operational processes are scalable, documented, auditable, compliant, and ready to support product launches and changing business priorities.

**Stakeholder and Partner Management**
======================================

* Partner with USBU and OBU business leaders, data teams, analytics, architecture, governance, source-system teams, platform teams, and operations stakeholders.
* Translate business priorities into clear execution plans, operational commitments, and measurable service outcomes.
* Lead operational reviews and communicate issues, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Oversee vendor and delivery partner performance, including staffing, service levels, quality, timelines, financials, and corrective actions.
* Ensure shared resources, responsibilities, and dependencies are transparent across programs.

**Pharma and Life Sciences Responsibilities**
=============================================

* Apply strong knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial and oncology data to operational planning, execution, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
* Provide operational leadership across customer, patient, product, sales, claims, specialty pharmacy, market access, field activity, and syndicated data, as applicable.
* Ensure sensitive and regulated data is handled with appropriate privacy, security, access, retention, lineage, quality, and audit controls.
* Partner with market and franchise stakeholders to understand business rules, data frequencies, critical processes, and service expectations.
* Anticipate operational readiness needs for product launches, new data sources, platform changes, and evolving business models.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**
======================================

* 12+ years of progressive experience in data operations, data engineering, data delivery, production support, or related technology disciplines, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Proven experience leading large, distributed teams and managing direct reports in an enterprise or capability-center environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading operations across multiple business units, markets, franchises, platforms, or programs.
* Strong experience establishing operating models, governance routines, SLAs, KPIs, incident management, escalation processes, and continuous improvement programs.
* Experience using automation, monitoring, reconciliation, and observability to improve operational performance and reduce manual effort.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms, Databricks, cloud technologies, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and production support practices.
* Experience managing portfolios, vendors, capacity, budgets, operational risks, service levels, and executive communications.

**About Immidart Technologies**

**Immidart** is an enterprise SaaS platform supporting global mobility, immigration workflows and workforce compliance. Its capabilities include case and document management, workflow automation, compliance monitoring, reporting and AI-enabled assistance. The platform helps organizations improve process visibility, operational efficiency and employee experience.

**Role Purpose**

Own US territory sales execution and new-business development for Immidart. Build a qualified enterprise pipeline, lead consultative sales conversations, coordinate solution demonstrations, navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes and close subscription opportunities. The role is expected to operate with a high degree of independence and provide reliable pipeline and revenue forecasts.

**Territory and Customer Focus**

* US-headquartered and US-operating enterprises with international employees, immigration workflows or global mobility programs.
* Relevant buyers and influencers across Global Mobility, HR, Immigration, Legal, Compliance, Talent, Operations and Procurement.
* Immigration law firms, mobility service providers and referral or technology partners where strategically relevant.
* Prioritize named accounts and segments agreed with leadership; avoid assuming all enterprise accounts are equally qualified.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Territory Strategy and Pipeline Ownership**

* Build and execute a territory plan with target segments, named accounts, buying personas, outreach priorities and quarterly pipeline goals.
* Create pipeline through account-based prospecting, outbound campaigns, referrals, events and relevant partner channels.
* Own the sales process from first contact and qualification through negotiation, signed agreement and handover.
* Prioritize opportunities by business need, solution fit, commercial potential, buying process and close probability.

**2. Consultative Enterprise Selling**

* Lead discovery with senior HR, Global Mobility, Immigration, Legal, Compliance and Operations stakeholders.
* Connect customer challenges to relevant Immidart use cases, including case/workflow management, document processes, compliance visibility, reporting and AI-enabled support.
* Build a clear business case and value narrative; avoid unsupported claims about legal outcomes, compliance guarantees or financial returns.
* Manage complex stakeholder groups, objections, procurement steps, competition and mutual action plans.

**3. Demonstrations, Proposals and Commercial Closure**

* Lead introductory product conversations and coordinate tailored demonstrations with product/domain specialists.
* Translate customer requirements into a clear scope, proposal and commercial recommendation.
* Lead commercial discussions within approved pricing and discount guardrails; coordinate contract reviews with authorized legal and finance stakeholders.
* Maintain deal momentum through clear next steps, executive alignment and disciplined follow-up.

**4. Partnerships and Market Intelligence**

* Develop relationships with relevant immigration law firms, mobility service providers and referral partners.
* Identify partner-sourced opportunities and coordinate joint account activity where agreed.
* Report customer feedback, competitor positioning, pricing signals and product gaps to management.

**5. Forecasting and Operating Discipline**

* Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity stages, close dates, deal values, risks and next actions.
* Provide weekly pipeline updates and a realistic forecast; escalate deal risks early.
* Contribute to sales playbooks, messaging and repeatable processes as the territory develops.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 5–8+ years of B2B SaaS, enterprise software or consultative technology sales experience, with evidence of personally owned opportunities and closed-won business.
* Demonstrated ability to create pipeline independently rather than relying exclusively on inbound leads or inherited relationships.
* Experience navigating multi-stakeholder sales, proposals, commercial negotiation and procurement.
* Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation, objection handling, forecasting and CRM skills.
* Able to communicate technology value in clear business terms and work cross-functionally with product, legal, finance and customer success.
* Professional written and spoken English; able to represent Immidart credibly with senior buyers.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience selling SaaS subscriptions or enterprise platforms to HR, Legal, Compliance, Operations or technology buyers.
* Global Mobility, immigration technology, HRTech, legal/compliance technology or workflow automation experience.
* Experience with account-based selling, channel/referral partners and annual or multi-year contracts.
* Experience launching or building a territory with limited existing pipeline.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Final targets should be agreed by management based on territory potential, average contract value, sales-cycle length, lead sources and ramp-up period.

* New business bookings/revenue against agreed quota.
* Qualified pipeline generated and pipeline coverage against target.
* Opportunity conversion, win rate and average deal value.
* Sales-cycle duration, deal slippage and forecast accuracy.
* CRM completeness and consistency of next steps.
* Partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue, where assigned.

title: Personal Assistant – Job Description (India)
description:
**THE ROLE**

Job title: Personal Assistant to the Managing Director, UK Location: India (remote /

Bangalore city) — supporting the UK Managing Director Hours: Full time, working UK hours:

09:00–17:00 GMT (14:30–22:30 IST), with flexibility when needed Reports to: Tom Wheat,

Managing Director, PJR UK

We're looking for a sharp, energetic Personal Assistant who wants to grow with PJR, an

international ISO certification body. You'll be the Managing Director's right hand: keeping

the diary, inbox and client work moving, and taking things off their plate before they're

asked.

This isn't a "wait to be told" job. If you're organised, curious and love making things

happen, you'll learn the ISO world quickly and take on more responsibility as you go.

**About us:**

PJR (Perry Johnson Registrars) is an international certification body, founded in 1994. We

audit and certify organisations against ISO standards such as ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO

14001 (Environmental), ISO 45001 (Health & Safety) and ISO 27001 (Information Security).

*PJR UK is the United Kingdom operation of the internationally established Perry Johnson Registrars organization. As a UKAS and ANAB accredited certification body, PJR UK provides management system certification services across a broad range of sectors, including quality, environmental health & safety, cybersecurity, aerospace, medical, and food safety. Backed by PJR's international presence and certification experience, PJR UK serves organizations seeking accredited certification services in the United Kingdom.*

**What you'll do:**

**Supporting the Managing Director**

Manage the MD's diary across UK and India time zones, booking client meetings, audits

and calls

Triage the inbox, draft replies and chase actions so nothing slips

Prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on action points

Arrange travel, accommodation and visit schedules when needed

**Supporting clients and certificatio**n

Be a friendly, professional first point of contact for clients by email and phone

Track client certification cycles: audit dates, surveillance visits, recertifications and

renewals

Help process audit reports and certificates, checking they are complete and accurate

Help prepare proposals, quotes, presentations and client reports

Coordinate audit schedules between clients and auditors, including travel and logistics

**Keeping the business running**

Maintain the CRM, client records and shared folders so everything is easy to find

Raise invoices, chase payments and track expenses

Research prospects, standards updates and industry news when asked

Spot processes that could be done better, and suggest how

**Sales and marketing**

Provide sales admin: log enquiries, prepare quotes, update the sales pipeline and chase

follow-ups

Support marketing: social media posts (especially LinkedIn), email campaigns,

newsletters, website updates and event support

Keep marketing materials, case studies and client testimonials organised and up to

date

**AI, GRC tools and data**

Run and administer ourAI-powered GRC (governance, risk and compliance) tools,

including setting up clients, inputting data and producing outputs

Gather, clean and organise data from clients, internal systems and public sources

Build simple reports and spreadsheets on sales, audits and client activity for the MD

Stay curious about newAI tools that could make the team more efficient

**Who you are:**

Attitude matters more to us than a perfect CV. You'll fit right in if you are:

A go-getter — you take ownership, chase things down and don't need reminding

Eager to learn — you want to understand ISO standards and how audits work, and you

ask good questions

Proactive — you see what's coming next week and get ahead of it

Highly organised — you juggle priorities calmly and keep track of every detail

A great communicator — warm, confident and clear in written and spoken English

Trustworthy and discreet — you'll handle confidential client and business information

Positive and personable — clients and colleagues enjoy working with you

Adaptable — you can commit to 09:00–17:00 GMT working hours and are flexible when

priorities change

**Skills and experience:**

**Essential**

Bachelor's degree in any discipline

1–3 years' experience as a PA, executive assistant, coordinator or in a similar admin role

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) or Google

Workspace

Comfortable with video calls (Teams, Zoom) and working remotely

Reliable home internet connection and a quiet place to work

**Nice to have:**

Experience at a certification body, or in quality management or compliance

Awareness of standards such as ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 or 27001

Experience supporting UK, European or international clients

Familiarity with a CRM or project management tool (e.g. HubSpot, Zoho, Trello, Asana)

Experience in sales support or marketing, including LinkedIn and email campaigns

Confident using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) and GRC or compliance

software

Good with data: Excel formulas, pivot tables, cleaning and organising data

No ISO background? Don't worry — we'll train you. Curiosity and drive count for more.

**What we offer:**

Competitive salary, depending on experience

Fully remote working : Bangalore, Karnataka

Training in ISO standards and auditing, with a clear path to grow into a certification

coordinator or auditor role

Direct, day-to-day exposure to running an international certification body

Paid leave and Indian public holidays

A friendly, supportive team where your ideas are heard

**How to apply:**

Send your CV and a short note (no more than 200 words) to **sjoy@pjr.com** telling us:

1. Why this role appeals to you

2. An example of a time you took the initiative without being asked

Please use the subject line "PA Application – [Your Name]". Applications close on [date].

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short video interview and a practical task.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial procedures.

Preferred Candidate

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

* **Cultivate a high-performing team:** Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

  

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:

* Minimum 8+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.

* Proven experience presenting strategic plans to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
* Strong background in cross-functional collaboration within matrixed environments.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze financial data to inform strategic and tactical decisions.
* Track record of identifying and evaluating new business opportunities.
* Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel industry operations.
* Cross-disciplinary exposure to Marketing, E-commerce, and Finance functions.

  

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

**Location:** Bengaluru

**Work Mode:** Work From Office

**Experience:** 1 to 3 years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Company Description**

Madgeek is a technology company that helps businesses build better digital products and automate complex business processes. We work across custom software development, AI-powered solutions, SaaS platforms, eCommerce, CRM and business automation.

We work with businesses across different industries and help them solve problems that cannot always be addressed with off-the-shelf software.

**Role Description**

As a Business Development Executive, you will be responsible for generating and qualifying new business opportunities for Madgeek.

This is an outbound-focused role. You will research potential companies, reach out to decision-makers through calls, email and LinkedIn, understand their business challenges and identify opportunities where Madgeek can help.

You do not need to be a developer or have deep technical knowledge. What matters is your ability to understand a business problem, communicate clearly and have meaningful conversations with potential clients.

You will work closely with the leadership and technical team when an opportunity requires deeper technical discussions.

**What You Will Do**

* Research companies and identify potential clients for Madgeek's services.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective clients.
* Make outbound calls to business owners, founders, CXOs and other decision-makers.
* Reach out to prospects through email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.
* Understand the prospect's business, current challenges and technology requirements.
* Qualify leads based on business need, budget, decision-making authority and timeline.
* Schedule discovery calls and meetings with qualified prospects.
* Follow up with prospects consistently throughout the sales process.
* Maintain accurate lead and opportunity information in the CRM.
* Work with the leadership and technical team to move qualified opportunities forward.
* Keep track of outreach, responses, meetings and conversion rates.
* Research industries and identify new markets and opportunities for Madgeek.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in B2B sales or business development.
* Experience selling IT services, software, SaaS, digital solutions or technology services is preferred.
* Comfortable making cold calls and speaking with business decision-makers.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to understand a business problem and communicate how a technology solution could help.
* Good research and prospecting skills.
* Comfortable with outbound sales and following up with prospects.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently.
* Comfortable working with CRM and sales tools.
* Strong sense of ownership and a results-oriented approach.

**What You Can Expect**

You will work directly with the team at Madgeek and get exposure to the complete B2B technology sales process, from identifying a prospect to understanding their business problem and taking a qualified opportunity toward a solution.

This is a good opportunity for someone who wants to grow beyond basic lead generation and develop strong skills in consultative B2B technology sales.

title: Quality Analyst - Sales
description:
Company Overview:

NetCom Learning, part of Sarder Inc., is a global provider of IT, AI and business skills training. We partner with leading technology vendors to deliver authorized training and certification programs to enterprises, public sector organizations and individual learners worldwide.

Our Vendor Sales team builds and grows revenue through these technology partnerships. Every conversation the team has with a prospect or partner shapes our pipeline, and this role makes sure those conversations are consistently high quality.

Role Overview:

We are hiring a detail-oriented Quality Analyst to own call quality and lead quality for our Vendor Sales team in Bangalore. You will audit sales calls, validate that leads are correctly qualified using the BANT framework, and turn your findings into clear feedback that helps reps improve and helps leadership trust the pipeline.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, quality and data. It suits someone who understands B2B sales conversations, listens critically, and is comfortable giving direct, constructive feedback. As our sales team supports US markets, this role works the US shift (5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST).

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Call auditing**

* Audit a defined weekly sample of inbound and outbound sales calls against the Vendor Sales quality scorecard.
* Evaluate calls on opening, discovery, product and vendor knowledge, objection handling, compliance, call control and next steps.
* Identify critical errors such as misinformation, missed disclosures or unprofessional conduct, and escalate them promptly.
* Maintain accurate audit records and score sheets in the CRM or QA tool.

### **Lead qualification**

* Review leads passed from SDRs and sales reps to confirm they meet qualification criteria before handover to account executives.
* Validate lead data in the CRM: contact details, company, role, vendor or technology interest, and lead source.
* Flag disqualified, duplicate or incomplete leads and work with reps to correct them.
* Track lead acceptance and rejection reasons to spot recurring gaps.

### **BANT qualification**

* Verify that each qualified lead has clear evidence of Budget, Authority, Need and Timeline on the call and in CRM notes.
* Listen for whether reps ask the right BANT questions and probe beyond surface answers.
* Score BANT completeness and accuracy, and highlight leads advanced without sufficient qualification.
* Recommend improvements to BANT question frameworks and call scripts.

### **Feedback and coaching**

* Share structured, timely feedback with reps and team leads after each audit cycle.
* Run calibration sessions with sales managers to keep scoring consistent across auditors and teams.
* Partner with Sales Training to identify skill gaps and contribute to coaching plans and refresher sessions.

### **Reporting and process improvement**

* Publish weekly and monthly quality reports on call scores, BANT compliance, lead acceptance rates and top improvement areas.
* Analyse trends by rep, team, vendor and campaign, and present insights to Vendor Sales leadership.
* Help maintain the QA scorecard, audit guidelines and qualification criteria as the business evolves.

How Success is measured:

  

* Number of calls audited per week against the agreed sample target.
* Audit accuracy and turnaround time from call to feedback.
* Improvement in average call quality scores across the team.
* BANT compliance rate on leads handed over to account executives.
* Lead acceptance rate by account executives and reduction in rejected leads.
* Consistency of scoring in calibration sessions.

What we are looking for:

  

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline,
* 2–5 years of experience in sales quality assurance, call auditing, or inside sales / lead generation, preferably in B2B, IT, SaaS or EdTech,
* Hands-on understanding of lead qualification and the BANT framework.
* Experience auditing calls against a scorecard and giving structured feedback.
* Excellent spoken and written English, with a sharp ear for tone, accuracy and compliance.
* Working knowledge of a CRM such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for tracking audits and building reports.
* High attention to detail, objectivity and comfort giving candid feedback to sales reps.
* Willingness to work the US shift (5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST) from our Bangalore office.

Good to have:

  

* Experience with call recording or conversation intelligence tools such as Ring Central, Gong, Chorus or Aircall.
* Familiarity with other qualification frameworks such as MEDDIC or CHAMP.
* Knowledge of Six Sigma or similar quality management methodologies.
* Exposure to the IT training and certification market or technology vendor ecosystems (Microsoft, AWS, Cisco and others).
* Experience running calibration sessions or contributing to sales training programs.
* Experience supporting sales teams working with US or global markets.

Why Join us:

  

* Direct impact on pipeline quality and revenue for a global training business.
* Close exposure to Vendor Sales leadership and the chance to shape how quality is measured.
* Learning opportunities across AI, cloud and IT certification programs.
* A collaborative team culture with room to grow into QA lead or sales enablement roles.

title: Field Executive – KYC & Loan Onboarding
description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Operations – KYC & Onboarding  
**Designation:** Field Executive – KYC & Loan Onboarding  
**Locations:** Gurugram, Noida and Bengaluru  
**Work Mode:** Primarily field-based  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Reporting to:** Head of Operations

1. About the Role

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is looking for field-oriented, detail-focused executives to support customer acquisition handovers, KYC collection and loan application onboarding across its lending products.

The selected candidates will work directly with customers, employees, institutional partners, platform partners and small businesses to facilitate timely submission of KYC information and completion of application formalities. The role involves regular field visits, document collection, customer guidance and coordination with the internal Operations team.

The objective is to ensure that loan applications are complete, accurate and ready for the next stage of processing, while providing customers with a smooth and professional onboarding experience.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Field-Based Customer Onboarding

* Visit customers, partner locations, institutions, business establishments and other assigned locations to facilitate loan onboarding.
* Explain the application process, required documentation and next steps to prospective and existing customers.
* Assist customers in completing application forms and submitting required information through approved digital or physical channels.
* Coordinate field visits according to daily routes, customer appointments and operational priorities.
* Maintain records of visits, customer interactions, application status and pending actions.

B. KYC Collection & Application Completeness

* Collect and check required KYC documents and information using the company's approved checklist.
* Facilitate the submission of identity, address, bank-account and other required information, as applicable to the product and customer category.
* Check that submitted documents are legible, complete and consistent with the information provided in the application.
* Identify missing information, mismatches and incomplete applications, and help customers correct them.
* Upload or submit documents through the designated system in accordance with company procedures.
* Escalate suspected discrepancies, potential fraud indicators or unresolved KYC issues to the appropriate internal team.

The Field Executive is responsible for collecting and checking application information against the prescribed checklist. Final verification and acceptance must follow Loan2grow's approved KYC procedures and applicable requirements.

C. Product-Specific Onboarding Support

The executive may be assigned to one or more of the following lending products:

* **Education-fee Finance:** Coordinate with educational institutions, parents or students, as applicable, and support application and KYC completion during seasonal enrolment and fee-payment cycles.
* **Platform-worker Finance:** Work with platform partners and workers seeking bike, two-wheeler or work-kit financing to complete application formalities.
* **SME & Trade Finance:** Visit small businesses and borrowers to collect prescribed business, proprietor/entity and related application documents.
* Other Products as released over time.

For products where a Lending Service Provider (LSP) or partner performs onboarding activities, the executive will work within the responsibilities specifically assigned to Loan2grow.

D. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with the Business Development team for assigned customer and partner leads.
* Work with the Customer Operations Executive to communicate customer-dependent next steps and follow-up requirements.
* Submit complete applications and required supporting documents to the Operations team within agreed timelines.
* Respond promptly to requests for clarification or correction of information.
* Coordinate with operations team when documentation is flagged as missing, incomplete or inconsistent during the system verification process.
* Keep Head of operations or his appointee informed about field progress, unresolved cases and operational bottlenecks.

E. Field Reporting & Data Management

* Maintain daily field visit plans and records of completed and pending visits.
* Update application status, documents collected, customer availability and next actions in the designated system.
* Submit daily activity reports and periodic summaries of onboarding progress.
* Track the number of visits, applications supported, complete applications submitted and unresolved documentation issues.
* Ensure that physical documents, if collected, are handled and transferred securely under company procedures.

3. Qualifications & Experience

* Graduate in any discipline; candidates with relevant field operations experience may also be considered.
* Approximately 1–3 years of experience in field operations, KYC collection, customer onboarding, banking, NBFCs, fintech, microfinance, lending or sales-support roles.
* Fresh graduates with strong communication skills, mobility and a willingness to undertake fieldwork may be considered.
* Basic smartphone proficiency and the ability to use mobile applications, digital forms and document-upload systems.
* Experience with KYC documentation, loan applications, field verification or customer acquisition is an advantage.
* Availability of Vehicle/bike for mobility

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Comfortable with regular local travel and customer-facing fieldwork.
* Clear communication and the ability to explain processes in a simple, patient manner.
* Attention to detail when checking application information and documents.
* Good time management, route planning and follow-up discipline.
* Ability to use smartphones and digital applications confidently.
* Professional conduct, honesty and respect for customer privacy.
* Ability to work independently in the field while maintaining regular communication with the Operations team.
* Willingness to meet daily and weekly activity targets without compromising documentation quality or customer protection.

5. Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed against agreed targets, including:

* Number of planned and completed field visits.
* Number of applications supported and submitted.
* Percentage of applications complete at first submission.
* Reduction in incomplete applications and documentation rework.
* Timeliness of document submission and system updates.
* Accuracy of field visit records and customer information.
* Timely resolution or escalation of field-level issues.
* Compliance with customer privacy, document-handling and company operating procedures.

Targets will be set according to the assigned city, product mix, customer volumes and field coverage requirements.

6. Working Conditions

* Primarily field-based role with regular travel within the assigned city and surrounding service area.
* Candidates will be hired for **Gurugram, Noida or Bengaluru** and will generally operate within their assigned location.
* Regular coordination with the central Operations team and assigned institutional, platform or business partners.
* Travel reimbursement, local conveyance arrangements and any applicable field allowances will be governed by company policy.

7. Application Process

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV along with their current location, relevant field experience, current compensation, expected compensation, notice period and earliest joining date.

**Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited** seeks candidates who are reliable, customer-oriented and comfortable working in a field-based lending operations environment.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have access to a bike or two-wheeler for regular field visits?
* Are you comfortable with a primarily field-based role involving daily local travel to customers, institutions, platform partners and businesses?
* How much relevant experience do you have in field operations, KYC collection, customer onboarding, banking, NBFC, fintech or microfinance?
* Have you collected or checked KYC documents and helped customers complete loan or financial-service applications?
* Are you comfortable using a smartphone to capture or upload documents, complete digital forms and update application status?
* Can you plan daily field visits, maintain visit records and submit daily activity reports?
* What is your current monthly salary, expected monthly salary and notice period?
* When can you join?

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Field Sales Manager – Bangalore**
-----------------------------------

**Company:** Steel on Call Services India Private Limited

**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka

**Department:** Sales & Business Development

**Designation:** Field Sales Manager

**Experience:** 4+ Years

**Industry:** Steel / Iron & Steel – Mandatory

**Reporting To:** General Manager / Senior Management

**Contact Person Name : Lakshmi Devi Bandari**

**Contact Person Number : 8639443382**

### **1. Job Purpose**

The Field Sales Manager will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new business opportunities, acquiring customers, and expanding the company's presence across Bangalore and surrounding markets. The role requires strong experience in the steel industry, field sales, customer relationship management, and steel market development.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in the steel and iron & steel industry.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Generate leads through field visits, referrals, market research, and networking.
* Develop and implement sales strategies to increase revenue and market share.
* Identify new customer segments and expand business across Bangalore and nearby markets.

**B. Customer Acquisition & Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Visit steel dealers, distributors, retailers, fabricators, contractors, builders, infrastructure companies, and industrial customers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable steel products.
* Follow up on enquiries, quotations, negotiations, orders, and repeat business.
* Resolve customer concerns and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.

**C. Steel Market Development**

* Maintain a strong understanding of steel products, grades, specifications, pricing, and market demand.
* Monitor competitor activities, market prices, customer preferences, and emerging business opportunities.
* Develop a customer database and maintain accurate records of market intelligence.
* Identify opportunities in construction, infrastructure, manufacturing, fabrication, and related sectors.
* Establish and strengthen the company's network within the Bangalore steel market.

**D. Order Management & Sales Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal teams for quotations, pricing approvals, order processing, and product availability.
* Follow up on order execution, dispatches, and deliveries with the relevant teams.
* Monitor outstanding payments and coordinate with customers for timely collections.
* Ensure accurate sales reporting, customer records, and pipeline updates.
* Work closely with management to achieve business objectives and improve sales performance.

**E. Reporting & Performance Management**

* Prepare daily field visit reports and submit regular sales updates.
* Track leads, customer meetings, conversions, sales volumes, and revenue.
* Prepare sales forecasts and market development plans.
* Review sales performance against assigned targets and take corrective action where required.

### **3. Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related discipline.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Sales and Marketing will be an added advantage.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in field sales, preferably in the steel or iron & steel industry.
* Strong understanding of steel products, pricing, market dynamics, and customer requirements.

### **4. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong field sales and business development skills.
* Proven ability to generate leads and acquire new customers.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Good customer relationship management and networking abilities.
* Knowledge of Bangalore's steel market and customer base will be preferred.
* Ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, email, and sales reporting tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively within Bangalore and nearby markets.
* Fluency in Kannada and English is preferred; knowledge of Hindi will be an advantage.

### **5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
* New customer acquisition and conversion rate.
* Sales revenue and sales volume growth.
* Number of productive customer visits and qualified leads generated.
* Repeat business and customer retention.
* Timely payment collection and reduction of overdue receivables.
* Development of new market segments and business opportunities.
* Accuracy and timeliness of sales reports and forecasts.

### **6. Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in steel industry field sales, an established understanding of the Bangalore market, and the ability to build lasting customer relationships. The candidate must be proactive, commercially aware, target-oriented, and capable of independently managing field sales activities while contributing to the company's overall business growth.

**Interested candidates** with relevant steel industry experience and a proven track record in field sales and business development are encouraged to apply.
