title: Regional Manager - Sales
description:
**Job Title: Area Sales Manager (ASM) - DSA Channel (Home Loans)**

**Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Mumbai/Pune/Gurgaon**

**Reports To: Regional Sales Manager**

**Job Overview:**

The **Area Sales Manager (ASM)** for the **DSA (Direct Sales Agent)** Channel will be responsible for driving home loan sales through a network of direct sales agents. This role involves recruiting, training, and managing DSA partners, generating business leads, ensuring smooth loan processing, and achieving sales targets. The ASM will work closely with both the internal sales team and external DSA partners to grow the business and meet organizational goals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Sales Target Achievement:**
* Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual home loan sales targets by effectively managing the DSA channel.
* Ensure that DSAs meet their targets by providing them with necessary support and resources.
* **DSA Recruitment & Onboarding:**
* Recruit and onboard new DSA partners to expand the sales network.
* Conduct training sessions to onboard and continuously educate DSA agents about home loan products, processes, and compliance standards.
* **DSA Relationship Management:**
* Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with DSA agents to encourage consistent business.
* Regularly engage with DSAs to understand their challenges, provide solutions, and ensure smooth processing of home loan applications.
* **Lead Generation & Conversion:**
* Collaborate with DSAs to generate leads and drive conversions of prospects into home loan customers.
* Monitor the DSA agents' lead generation efforts, ensure quality control, and help close high-value deals.
* **Market Analysis & Strategy:**
* Analyze the performance of DSAs in the region and provide guidance to improve sales outcomes.
* Implement strategies to boost market penetration for home loans and identify opportunities for growth.
* **Sales Performance Monitoring:**
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance of DSA agents.
* Provide regular performance feedback and set action plans to address performance gaps.
* **Compliance & Risk Management:**
* Ensure that all home loan applications processed by DSAs are compliant with company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to DSA activities, loan documentation, and customer interactions.
* **Collaboration with Internal Teams:**
* Work closely with internal teams (Credit, Operations) to ensure smooth processing of loan applications from DSA leads.
* **Reporting & Documentation:**
* Provide regular updates to the senior management on DSA performance, sales achievements, challenges, and market trends.
* Ensure accurate reporting of all sales activities and pipeline data.

**Key Skills and Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 5 years of experience in sales in home loans or financial services. Prior experience with managing team and working with DSA agents is required.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
* **Sales Expertise:** Strong sales skills and a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets, especially in financial products like home loans.
* **DSA Management:** Experience in managing and motivating DSA agents or channel partners.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills to build relationships with DSA agents and customers.
* **Product Knowledge:** Deep understanding of home loan products, processes, documentation, and industry regulations.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Business Development Manager – Pharma & Healthcare Sales (New Accounts)**

**Company:** CLIRNET

**Locations (3 openings):** Delhi/NCR | Mumbai | Bengaluru/Hyderabad

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Experience:** 5–8 years

**About CLIRNET**

CLIRNET is a digital platform for verified healthcare professionals. Doctors use CLIRNET for CME programmes, medical content through MedWiki, and professional learning. Pharmaceutical and healthcare brands partner with us to reach and engage doctors in a credible, compliant and measurable way.

**The Role**

We are building a new sales team focused on winning new clients. This is a hunter role: your job is to find, pursue and close new accounts in your region.

Leads will come from two sources: your own industry network and our presales team. In both cases, closures are the key measure of success.

**Who You Will Sell To**

* Pharmaceutical companies, both international MNCs and Indian brands
* Nutraceuticals and dietary supplements
* Adult nutrition and food supplements
* Baby food and infant nutrition
* Dermatology and cosmeceutical brands
* Any healthcare brand that needs to reach and influence doctors

You will typically work with brand managers, product managers, marketing heads, medical affairs teams and digital marketing teams.

**What You Will Sell**

Doctor engagement solutions including CME programmes, medical content, digital campaigns and brand visibility across a verified doctor network.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Generate new leads through your own relationships in pharma and allied healthcare companies.
* Take up leads shared by the presales team and follow up promptly.
* Qualify leads quickly and focus time on those most likely to convert.
* Understand each client's brand goals and propose suitable CLIRNET solutions.
* Lead proposals, pricing discussions and negotiations through to signed business.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual targets for closures and revenue.
* Share feedback with the presales team on lead quality.
* Hand over new clients to internal teams for smooth campaign delivery.
* Track market trends and competitor activity in your region.
* Maintain accurate pipeline and closure reports.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5–8 years of experience in pharma sales, healthcare marketing, digital media sales, medical communications or agency business development.
* Existing working relationships with brand or marketing teams in one or more of the target segments. This is essential.
* A proven track record of closing new business, with clear numbers to show for it.
* Comfortable working both self-generated leads and leads from a presales team.
* Strong follow-up discipline and the ability to take a deal from first meeting to closure.
* Good communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Understanding of how pharma and healthcare brands engage doctors.
* Graduate required; MBA or life sciences background preferred.
* Willingness to travel within the region for client meetings.

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* A strong regional pipeline built within the first 90 days.
* Consistent closures from both own-network and presales leads.
* New account and revenue targets met as agreed with the Sales Head.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive fixed salary with performance-linked incentives
* Support from a dedicated presales team, so you spend more time closing
* A credible product with a verified doctor network behind it
* An early role in a new team, with room to grow as the team expands

title: Sales Support Engineer
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**  
We are seeking an energetic and result-oriented sales professional with proven experience in direct diesel generator (DG) set sales. The candidate should have hands-on experience managing individual sales targets, developing new business opportunities, and driving market awareness in the power generation industry. Exposure to Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and digital marketing initiatives will be an added advantage.  
**Key Responsibilities**  

* Drive sales and business development of DG sets in the 250 kVA to 1 MW segment, with preference for experience in the MHP (Medium Horsepower) and HHP (High Horsepower) range.
* Own and deliver individual sales targets, revenue, and profitability objectives.
* Develop new customers and expand relationships with OEMs, EPC contractors, industrial customers, rental companies, infrastructure developers, data centers, and government accounts.
* Understand customer applications, load requirements, and recommend suitable genset solutions.
* Create market awareness and increase product visibility through customer engagement programs, exhibitions, industry events, trade shows, and technical seminars.
* Identify and participate in relevant industry forums and associations to promote the product portfolio.
* Work closely with product management, engineering, and application teams to support customer requirements.
* Track market intelligence, customer trends, and emerging technologies.
* Utilize CRM tools and sales analytics to drive business decisions and improve sales effectiveness.
* Develop and deliver professional customer presentations, business reviews, and market reports.

**Desired Candidate Profile**  
**Experience**  

* 3-4 years of proven experience in direct genset sales.
* Must have independently handled sales numbers and revenue targets.
* Strong experience in 250 kVA to 1 MW DG set sales.
* Exposure to industrial, infrastructure, construction, rental, mining, railways, data center, or power generation markets preferred.

**Preferred Industry Background**  
  
**Skills & Competencies**  

* Strong understanding of DG set applications, specifications, and commercial aspects.
* Ability to identify customer needs and position the right solution.
* Knowledge of market development and brand visibility initiatives.
* Experience using social media platforms such as LinkedIn, YouTube, and digital marketing tools for lead generation will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), hybrid power solutions, microgrids, or renewable integration will be highly preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, CRM systems, Power BI, and presentation tools.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Self-driven, entrepreneurial mindset with a strong customer focus.

**Educational Qualification**  

* Bachelor of Engineering (Mechanical / Electrical / Industrial Engineering preferred)
* MBA in Marketing or Business Management will be an added advantage.

**Ideal Candidate**  
A young, aggressive sales professional from a leading genset OEM or distributor network who has successfully sold DG sets in the 250 kVA to 1 MW range, enjoys customer engagement, understands market-building activities, and is keen to expand into emerging technologies such as BESS and hybrid power solutions. Based in Bengaluru and willing to travel extensively to drive business growth.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

**Who we are and what we believe in**  
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

**Volvo Penta**, a world-leading supplier of engines and complete drive systems for marine and industrial applications, you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who works with passion, trust each other and embraces change to stay ahead. We make our customers win.

title: Pre-Sales Engineer
description:
**Job Description: Pre - Sales Engineer**

**Company:** Techzo

**Experience Level:** 1 - 3 Years

**Location:** JP Nagar 2nd phase, Bangalore

**Job Type:** Full-time

**About Techzo**

Techzo is a growing technology solutions provider specializing in cutting-edge cloud infrastructure, cyber security, and data security services. We help businesses secure their digital assets and build reliable IT frameworks. We are looking for a skilled pre-sales professional who can understand corporate needs and connect them with our expert tech solutions.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a tech-savvy and customer-focused **Pre-Sales Engineer** with **1\*-**3 years of relevant experience\* to join our technical sales team. In this role, you will act as the bridge between our client-facing sales team and core technical operations. You will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, conducting engaging product demonstrations, leading technical discussions, and proposing customized solutions across cloud, cybersecurity, networking, and backup/disaster recovery domains.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Discovery & Consultation:** Lead initial technical discussions with clients to analyze their IT environment, identify pain points, and define requirements.
* **Product Demonstrations:** Conduct articulate, tailored product and solution demonstrations for prospect key stakeholders and decision-makers.
* **Solution Architecture & Proposals:** Work with technical teams to draft technical proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), and responses to RFPs/RFIs.
* **Sales Collaboration:** Partner with sales Executives throughout the sales lifecycle to position Techzo’s offerings effectively and address technical objections.
* **Proof of Concept (PoC):** Assist in scoping and executing Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to validate proposed technical solutions for prospective clients.
* **Market & Tech Readiness:** Stay updated on industry trends across cloud architectures, cyber threat landscapes, and data storage technology to position solutions competitively.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **Experience:** Minimum **1-** **3years** of experience in a Pre-Sales, Technical Solution Consulting, or technical client-facing role.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Foundational understanding across core infrastructure topics:
* **Networking:** Routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, and fundamental network topology.
* **Cybersecurity:** Threat mitigation, network/endpoint security, and security best practices.
* **Cloud & Servers:** Basic concepts of public/private/hybrid cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and virtual/physical server environments.
* **Backup & Recovery:** Concepts around data backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional oral and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical jargon into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders.
* **Sales Acumen:** Familiarity with sales cycles, deal qualification, and value-proposition building.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment

Ability to commute/relocate:

* JP Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Experience:

* Pre-sales: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Sales Compensation Operations and Controls analyst
description:
At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold **“what if.”**

**What if** your ideas could ignite global innovation?

**What if** your curiosity could redefine the future?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of **your** career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect **70% of the Fortune 500** , and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.

How we empower our people is extraordinary: we’re recognized as a **Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024** — clear evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? **Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.”**

In a world where you can be anything, **Be Infoblox.**

**Sales Compensation Operations and Controls analyst**

We have an opportunity for a Sales Compensation Operations and Controls analyst to join our Finance team in Bangalore, India, reporting to Supervisor, sales compensation - Finance. In this pivotal role, you will support accurate, timely, compliant, and audit-ready administration of Infoblox’s global sales incentive programs. You will manage commission operations, accruals, reconciliations, controls, audit activities, and related accounting processes across Xactly Incent, Salesforce, enterprise financial systems, payroll, and reporting tools.

Collaborating closely with Sales Compensation, Sales Finance, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Accounting, Human Resources, Payroll, Information Technology, and external auditors, you will independently manage audit requests and queries from preparation through resolution. You will strengthen documentation, data quality, process governance, and automation while using approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to identify anomalies, improve productivity, and help move recurring processes toward zero touch.

**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Administer recurring global sales compensation activities in Xactly Incent, including employee setup, organizational data, quotas, bookings uploads, sales hierarchies, advances, draws, crediting, and plan maintenance
* Validate and reconcile bookings, sales crediting, quotas, attainment, commissions, payouts, and employee data across Salesforce, Xactly Incent, ERP, HCM, payroll, and reporting systems
* Review and process employee lifecycle changes, including new hires, transfers, promotions, leaves of absence, terminations, territory changes, and other events affecting eligibility, quota, crediting, or payout treatment
* Prepare and review monthly and quarterly commission calculations, accruals, payout files, contractor payments, payroll submissions, and management reporting
* Perform accounting support activities for commission expense, accruals, related payroll taxes, adjustments, journal-entry support, and period-end close
* Establish, execute, and maintain operating controls over commission calculations, plan changes, access, approvals, exceptions, evidence retention, and segregation of duties
* Maintain control narratives, process documentation, standard operating procedures, operating calendars, review checklists, issue logs, and audit evidence throughout the year
* Manage external and internal audits end to end, including preparing requests, coordinating evidence, responding to audit queries, tracking open items, supporting walkthroughs and testing, and driving timely resolution of findings
* Investigate commission inquiries, missing credits, opportunity splits, negative orders, payout variances, accrual differences, and other exceptions; document root causes, approvals, corrective actions, and closure
* Support plan configuration changes and user acceptance testing in Xactly Sandbox by preparing test scenarios, validating results, documenting defects, and retaining approval evidence before production migration

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in sales compensation, finance operations, accounting, FP&A, audit, sales operations, revenue operations, payroll, or a related analytical function
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline; CPA, CA, CMA, or other relevant professional qualification is a plus
* Experience supporting sales compensation operations, including quotas, crediting, attainment, commissions, accruals, payouts, adjustments, and exception management
* Demonstrated experience with accounting processes, reconciliations, accruals, journal-entry support, close activities, and audit evidence
* Experience managing audit requests or queries independently from initiation through response and resolution; public-company or SOX environment experience is preferred
* Experience with Xactly Incent, Callidus, Varicent, CaptivateIQ, or another incentive compensation platform is preferred
* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas, data validation, Power Query, and reconciliation techniques; exposure to Power BI or Tableau is an advantage
* Familiarity with Salesforce, ERP, HCM, payroll, reporting, and data-integration environments, with the ability to reconcile information across multiple systems
* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, judgment, confidentiality, control discipline, and ability to manage competing priorities and recurring deadlines
* Practical experience using AI-enabled productivity, analytics, automation, or content-generation tools responsibly, including the ability to validate outputs, recognize limitations, and maintain human accountability

**Be Successful — Your Path**

First 90 Days: Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short- and long-term goals.

**Six Months:**

* Independently complete assigned monthly and quarterly commission operations, accruals, reconciliations, controls, and audit deliverables with accurate, timely, and well-documented results
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of Infoblox’s compensation plans, accounting processes, control requirements, approval workflows, systems, and audit calendar
* Manage routine audit requests and queries through evidence collection, response preparation, follow-up, and closure with appropriate escalation
* Complete variance investigations across source systems and resolve recurring issues through root-cause analysis and documented corrective actions
* Deliver at least one approved automation, AI-enabled productivity improvement, or process redesign that reduces manual effort or strengthens quality and control coverage

**One Year:**

* Own an assigned portfolio of global sales compensation operations, accounting support, controls, and audit activities from data readiness through payout, accrual submission, reporting, and issue closure
* Serve as a dependable subject-matter resource for Xactly, commission calculations, accruals, reconciliations, controls, audit evidence, and query management
* Support annual audits independently, including walkthroughs, selections, evidence coordination, query responses, finding remediation, and stakeholder communications
* Implement measurable improvements that increase accuracy, audit readiness, transparency, scalability, or cycle-time performance
* Help move recurring sales compensation and accounting processes toward exception-based and zero-touch execution through workflow automation, analytics, and responsible AI use

**Belong — Your Community**

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

**Be Rewarded — Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match
* We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications

**Ready to Be the Difference?**

*Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis*

title: Senior Manager - Pre sales
description:
**Senior Manager – Pre-Sales** (Dezy | Bengaluru | Full-time)

About the Role

Dezy is hiring a Senior Manager – Pre-Sales to own the patient funnel from first enquiry to clinic walk-in across Dezy’s network. This role is for a sales professional with 5-8 years of experience who has managed inside sales or tele-sales teams and wants to own outcomes, not just activity. A clinical background is not required.

You will lead the tele-sales, lead management, and appointment teams, and be accountable for how every lead is handled, qualified, booked, and brought into a Dezy clinic. You’ll own the conversion numbers, tighten the processes, and drive daily performance across the team.

**About Dezy**

Dezy is India’s fastest growing dental-care technology company, on a mission to transform how dental care is accessed and experienced. Founded in 2019 by IIM graduates and senior dentists, Dezy currently operates 25+ clinics across India, with 20+ clinics in Bangalore, and plans to expand to 100+ clinics across India in the next 12-18 months. We’re backed by top venture capital funds like Chiratae, Alpha Wave and Peak XV. Dezy has also been recognised by the World Economic Forum as one of the “Top 100 Technology Pioneers in the World” for revolutionising dental care.

**Requirements**

* 6 days a week. Work from HSR Office
* 5-8 years of experience in sales, with at least 4-6 years managing inside sales, tele-sales, or contact center teams
* Experience in healthcare, aesthetics, education, or other high-consideration consumer categories is strongly preferred
* Track record of owning funnel metrics (lead-to-appointment, show-up, conversion), not just call volumes
* Experience managing teams of 15-40 people, including hiring, training, and performance management
* Hands-on comfort with CRMs, dialers, and funnel reporting; strong in Excel or Google Sheets
* Comfortable with targets, data, and direct performance conversations
* Strong communicator in English; Kannada and/or Hindi preferred
* Structured, process-driven, and able to execute hands-on while improving systems Key Responsibilities
* Own the pre-sales funnel across channels and clinics: speed-to-lead, lead qualification, appointment booking, and show-up rates
* Manage and coach the tele-sales and appointment teams to daily, weekly, and monthly targets
* Work with Marketing on lead quality and channel feedback, and with clinic teams on smooth handoffs into consultations
* Run call quality audits, scorecards, and incentive tracking for the team
* Build and refine pitch scripts, objection handling, and follow-up playbooks for no-shows and dormant leads
* Drive CRM discipline and lead routing; work with Product and Tech on improving funnel tools
* Hire and onboard team members ahead of new clinic launches
* Report funnel performance to leadership with clear insights and action plans Compensation & Growth
* Competitive fixed compensation plus performance-linked variable based on funnel outcomes
* Reports to senior leadership
* Clear growth path to Head of Pre-Sales as Dezy scales

title: Director, Technical Program Management
description:
**Job Description**  

As a Technical Project Manager, you will serve as the strategic connective tissue between product strategy and cross\-functional execution. This is a principal\-level, hands\-on leadership role. You are accountable for the delivery of the organization’s most complex, high\-revenue initiatives \- not for reporting on them \- and you carry the dates yourself.


You will guide a team responsible for architecting the Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) framework and providing the operational infrastructure required to scale. You will be responsible for the integrity of the delivery process \- managing the interdependencies between Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial teams. You ensure that the company’s most significant investments are delivered with transparency, alignment, and high impact.


Greenfield initiatives are where this role earns its keep. New programs receive dedicated senior ownership rather than shared program management capacity borrowed across unrelated engineering projects. On these builds you set the plan, hold the commitments, remove blockers directly where you can, and escalate with a recommendation and a recovery path where you cannot.


Your success in this role will be measured by the increased velocity, predictability, and transparency of our most critical product investments.

* Significant increase in the percentage of top initiatives delivered on time and within scope.
* Reduction in the "administrative tax" on Product Managers, as measured by time reclaimed from manual reporting and tool maintenance.
* Improved internal satisfaction scores from Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial leaders regarding the clarity and reliability of the delivery pipeline.
* Greenfield initiatives hitting their committed launch dates, with this role personally accountable for those commitments.


Level, Location, and Scope

* Level. Principal\-level. This is a senior individual leadership role, comparable in scope to an L7 Principal Technical Program Manager at a large technology company.
* Location. Bangalore\-based, most of the engineering, product and data science team are also based in India.
* Dedication. Fully dedicated to Product Operations and the greenfield portfolio. This is not a shared resource split across multiple engineering projects.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Update and maintain a scalable Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) that bridges the gap between high\-level roadmaps and delivery.
* Establish standardized stage\-gates and "Definition of Ready/Done" criteria to ensure Engineering and Data Science receive high\-quality, actionable requirements.
* Conduct quarterly audits of the delivery pipeline to identify friction points, automate manual handoffs, and reduce lead time without over\-engineering the process.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the "Top 20" initiatives \- those involving 3\+ functional teams or multi\-million revenue impact \- from post\-PRD alignment through launch. You hold the timeline and are answerable when it moves.
* Actively unblock the work. Identify and resolve cross\-team resource conflicts and technical dependencies between Product, Tech, Data Science, and Operations, driving each issue to a decision rather than routing it onward.
* Stand up greenfield programs from zero: scope, sequencing, staffing needs, operating cadence, and launch criteria, with no existing process to inherit.
* Engage directly with Engineering and Data Science on architecture, data pipeline, and integration tradeoffs at enough depth to pressure\-test estimates and challenge plans credibly.
* Escalate to executive leadership with a recommendation and a recovery plan attached, not a status color.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for high\-value client steering committees and strategic data vendors (e.g., Netflix, Amazon) to ensure technical integrations stay on schedule.
* Design and own the executive dashboarding strategy, providing a "single source of truth" for product health (adoption, retention) and delivery health (predictability, throughput).
* Ensure Jira and Confluence are configured to provide clean, automated reporting, eliminating the need for Product Managers to manually aggregate status updates.
* Provide quarterly insights to the C\-suite on execution trends, highlighting areas where resource reallocation may be necessary to meet Op Plan goals.
* Oversee the administration and configuration of Jira, Confluence, and associated add\-ons to support a unified workflow across the department.
* Evaluate and implement emerging tools (AI\-assisted productivity, roadmap visualization) that enhance the productivity of the Product and Tech teams.
* Maintain the centralized repository of best practices, templates, and guidelines that standardize how the organization builds and launches products.
* Lead quarterly training sessions to ensure new hires and existing team members are proficient in the PDLC and operational tools, ensuring a consistent culture of execution.

 **Qualifications*** 15\+ years of experience in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, or Product Management, with at least 5 years operating at a principal or director level. For calibration: comparable in scope and seniority to an L7 Principal TPM at a company such as Amazon.
* Proven track record of managing "Top\-Tier" strategic initiatives that require the synchronization of cross\-functional areas (e.g., Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Sales).
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing a Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) in a growth\-stage or enterprise technology environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of greenfield, 0\-to\-1 programs where the plan, process, and cadence did not yet exist and had to be built.
* A track record of unblocking rather than tracking. Be ready to describe specific technical and organizational blockers you personally cleared, and launch dates you were held to.
* Technical fluency sufficient to hold a credible conversation with Engineering and Data Science leaders about architecture, data pipelines, and integration risk.
* Strong ability to translate raw delivery data into executive\-level insights. Experience building automated dashboards that track both business health (KPIs) and delivery health (velocity, lead time).
* Exceptional ability to build consensus and maintain high\-trust partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success and Commercial leadership.
* A passion for process as an enabler, not a hurdle. You should have a reputation for making the teams around you faster and more effective.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* Professional certifications in Program Management (PMP, PgMP) are welcomed but secondary to proven real\-world results.

 **Additional Information**  

Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Production Planning & Control
description:
**Job Title / Designation:** Production Planning \& Control
  

**Experience:** 5 to 6 Years
  

**Qualification:** B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Mechanical, Industrial, or Production Engineering.
  

**Job Location:** Bengaluru  

  

**Role Description**  

  

We are seeking a highly driven Production Planning \& Control (PPC) specialist with 5 to 6 years of core experience in Automobile, Aerospace, or High\-Reliability Electronics Manufacturing. In this role, you will lead end\-to\-end operational planning, from Material Requirement Planning (MRP) and Master Production Scheduling (MPS) down to shop\-floor execution. You will act as the operational nerve center, managing cross\-functional workflows across component sourcing, PCBA manufacturing, box\-build integration, and Environmental Stress Screening (ESS). Furthermore, you will serve as a key liaison aligning top management strategies, sales targets, and customer delivery commitments with real\-time manufacturing capacity.  

  

**Desired Experience:**  

  

* Industry Exposure: 5 to 6 years of hands\-on PPC experience in Aerospace \& Defence, Automotive, or EMS (Electronic Manufacturing Services) operating under AS9100D, IATF 16949, or ISO 9001 quality frameworks.
* Proven track record in managing high\-mix, low\-to\-medium volume manufacturing, PCBA manual assembly, wiring harness, System\-level mechanical integration \& Manufacturing, Supply chain.
* Direct exposure to testing workflows, acceptances, and Environmental Stress Screening (ESS) environments (thermal cycling, ESS, vibration, and functional testing).
* Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in ERP/MRP systems, advanced Excel macros/data analytics, BOM management, clear\-to\-build (CTB) tracking, and capacity planning.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

  

* Master Scheduling \& Shop\-Floor Planning: Develop, maintain, and execute Master Production Schedules (MPS) and Material Requirement Plans (MRP) for SMT/PCBA assembly, mechanical integration, and final testing to ensure 100% On\-Time Delivery (OTD).
* Cross\-Functional Operations Liaison:
* Manufacturing \& Assembly: Coordinate with production and engineering teams to optimize line balancing, eliminate shop\-floor bottlenecks, and track daily output against target routings.
* Supply Chain \& Materials Management: Partner with SCM, stores, and procurement to monitor component lead times, track critical active/passive electronic components, verify CTB readiness, and optimize store kitting processes.
* Testing \& ESS Integration: Plan and route assemblies through functional testing, screening, and ESS labs to prevent testing backlogs and maintain steady WIP throughput.
* Strategic \& Customer Interfacing:
* Top Management Engagement: Prepare daily/weekly progress dashboards, WIP reports, capacity utilization matrices, and delay analysis reports for executive reviews.
* Sales \& Customer Touchpoints: Serve as the primary operational contact for the sales team and clients to provide accurate Lead Time estimates (ATP/CTP), order tracking, and delivery timelines.
* Process \& Inventory Control: Control Work\-in\-Progress (WIP) levels, reduce inventory carrying costs, enforce strict engineering change order (ECO) controls, and drive continuous improvement through Lean and 5S initiatives on the shop floor.

title: SENIOR SALES/BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT (CREATIVE AGENCY )
description:
**Business Development Executive / Senior Business Development Executive (AGENCY SALES)**

**(BDE/Senior BDE) – Hashtag Inc**

**Experience:** 2–8 years ( Must have Agency's creative ecosystem)

**Location:** Bangalore

At Hashtag, the **BDE** is responsible for bringing the next wave of brands into the agency.

You don't just generate leads. You know where the opportunities are, who to speak to, how to open the conversation, and how to turn a business need into a pitch worth winning.

You'll own the new\-business pipeline \- from **prospecting and relationship\-building to discovery, pitching, negotiation and closure**. You'll work closely with our leadership, strategy, creative, content, design, production, web and performance teams to build solutions that make commercial sense and give clients a reason to choose Hashtag.

You understand that selling a creative agency is different from selling a product. You're selling **thinking, ideas, capability, trust and business outcomes**.

And once you build a relationship, you don't disappear after the deal. You help create a strong foundation for the account and look for opportunities to grow the relationship.

If you're someone who can **open doors, create demand, lead conversations and close business**, this is your role.

**What You'll Do**

**Own New Business**

* Own Hashtag's new\-business pipeline across relevant industries and categories.
* Identify high\-value prospects and build a targeted business development plan.
* Research brands, businesses, decision\-makers, marketing activity and competitive landscape.
* Proactively create opportunities rather than relying only on inbound leads.
* Build relationships with Founders, CMOs, Marketing Heads, Brand Heads and other senior decision\-makers.
* Develop a strong network within the brand, marketing and business ecosystem.

**Create Opportunities**

* Generate qualified leads through outbound prospecting, referrals, networking, LinkedIn, events and industry relationships.
* Identify businesses that could benefit from Hashtag's capabilities before a formal requirement comes in.
* Monitor new launches, business expansions, category movements and marketing activity to identify potential opportunities.
* Convert cold conversations into meaningful discovery meetings.
* Qualify opportunities based on business need, scope, budget, timelines and decision\-making structure.

**Lead the Sales Conversation**

* Lead discovery conversations and uncover the real business and marketing challenge behind a requirement.
* Understand where Hashtag can create value across **strategy, campaigns, content, social, film, design, digital, web and performance**.
* Develop the right approach with internal teams rather than simply forwarding a client brief.
* Bring strategic and commercial thinking into pitch opportunities.
* Present Hashtag's capabilities and solutions confidently to senior stakeholders.
* Own the conversation from **"Who are you?" to "Let's work together."**

**Win the Pitch**

* Lead the end\-to\-end business development process from opportunity identification to closure.
* Coordinate with Strategy, Creative, Content, Design, Production, Web and Performance teams for pitches.
* Ensure proposals, presentations and commercials are aligned with the client's business requirement.
* Present and defend the agency's thinking and value proposition.
* Handle commercial discussions, negotiations and objections.
* Build proposals that balance **client value, creative ambition and agency profitability**.
* Maintain momentum and ownership until the deal is closed.

**Build Senior\-Level Relationships**

* Develop long\-term relationships with key decision\-makers.
* Become a trusted point of contact even before an active requirement exists.
* Stay connected with prospects through regular, relevant conversations.
* Build relationships beyond a single opportunity or project.
* Generate referrals and introductions through existing relationships.
* Represent Hashtag at industry events, networking forums and relevant business communities.

**Grow the Business**

* Look beyond individual projects and identify opportunities for larger engagements and retainers.
* Identify cross\-sell opportunities across Hashtag's capabilities.
* Work with the Account Management / Brand Partner team to create a smooth transition after closure.
* Stay connected with key accounts where appropriate to identify future opportunities.
* Contribute ideas that strengthen Hashtag's overall new\-business strategy.

**Own the Numbers**

* Take ownership of business development targets and revenue contribution.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline across different stages of the sales funnel.
* Track leads, meetings, qualified opportunities, pitches, proposals, negotiations and closures.
* Maintain accurate CRM / business development trackers.
* Forecast potential closures and communicate pipeline movement to leadership.
* Analyse what is converting, what isn't and continuously improve the sales approach.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A strong, consistent pipeline of qualified new\-business opportunities.
* Regular conversations with relevant decision\-makers across target brands.
* Consistent conversion of prospects into qualified briefs and pitch opportunities.
* New clients and revenue brought into Hashtag.
* Strong relationships with senior marketing and business stakeholders.
* Successful pitches that demonstrate both creative value and commercial understanding.
* Healthy conversion rates across the sales funnel.
* A predictable pipeline rather than last\-minute dependence on opportunities.
* New relationships that continue beyond the first project.
* Hashtag is increasingly getting into conversations with brands that previously weren't on the agency's radar.

**Who You Are**

* **4–7 years of experience** in Business Development, Sales, Client Acquisition or Agency New Business.
* Strong experience in a **creative, advertising, digital, branding, media or marketing agency** is preferred.
* Proven experience in generating and closing new business.
* Comfortable selling creative and marketing solutions rather than standardised products.
* Strong understanding of brands, marketing and the agency ecosystem.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Comfortable speaking with senior stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Commercially sharp and comfortable discussing budgets, commercials and value.
* Strong relationship\-builder with an active professional network.
* Persistent, proactive and highly self\-driven.
* Able to understand a business problem and translate it into an opportunity for Hashtag.
* Strong follow\-through and excellent pipeline discipline.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven creative environment.

**Nice\-to\-Haves**

* Existing relationships with CMOs, Marketing Heads, Brand Heads, Founders or business owners.

* Predictive \& Trend Analytics: Synthesize disparate datasets from multiple business systems into actionable trend analyses, identifying operational bottlenecks, risks, and efficiency opportunities.

* C\-Suite \& Board Deliverables: Conceptualize, structure, and design polished, executive\-ready PowerPoint slide decks for Board meetings, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and strategic client proposals.

* Presentation Coaching: Partner with practice leaders to refine messaging, narrative flow, and visual alignment prior to major executive and external client briefings.
  

  

3\. Admin Software Governance \& Process Optimization


* Admin Stack Management: Oversee the daily administration, configuration, and user governance of internal enterprise software, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), and project tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Asana, ServiceNow).
* Workflow Automation: Leverage Microsoft 365 tools (Teams, SharePoint, Power Automate, Planner) to automate manual administrative tasks, approval chains, and document repositories.
* Tracking \& Operational Governance: Maintain end\-to\-end tracking systems for strategic practice initiatives, action logs, contract lifecycles, and cross\-team deliverables to ensure 100% accountability.
  

  

4\. Strategic Client Engagement \& Relationship Management


* Client Interface \& Account Governance: Act as a key operational liaison for client engagement activities—managing routine client communications, status reporting, and governance cadence.
* Meeting Orchestration: Lead pre\-meeting preparation, drive client\-facing status calls, document structured Minutes of Meeting (MOM), and rigorously enforce post\-meeting action item closure.

Qualifications \& Skills


Technical Requirements


* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
* Experience: 6 to 9 years of progressive experience as a Business Analyst, Senior Operations Analyst, or Client Engagement BA.
* MS Office Mastery: Expert\-level mastery of MS Excel (data modeling, macros, complex analytics) and MS PowerPoint (executive layout design, advanced formatting, storytelling).
* Software \& Systems Proficiency: Deep hands\-on experience with administrative software, project management/ticketing tools (Jira, ServiceNow, Trello), CRM systems, and MS Productivity Apps (Power Automate, Power BI, SharePoint).
* Data Synthesis \& Reporting: Advanced capability in raw data hygiene, quantitative analysis, process mapping, and executive metric reporting.
  

  

Soft Skills \& Work Environment


* Executive Presence \& Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with demonstrated poise when presenting to C\-suite leaders and key client stakeholders.
* Leadership \& Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to influence cross\-functional teams, manage client expectations under pressure, and mentor junior analysts.

* Adaptability \& Ownership: Proactive self\-starter capable of driving clarity in ambiguous environments and taking end\-to\-end ownership of complex assignments.
  

  

Preferred Certifications (Any of the following are a plus)

* PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI\-PBA) or PMP

title: Solution Engineer Sales
description:
**About Unosecur**


Unosecur is a fast\-growing, Pre\-Series A startup with $5M in funding. We're a B2B security SaaS platform making identity security smarter and simpler for enterprises worldwide, with sales teams across the USA, Europe, and India.


You'll be part of a diverse team working on cybersecurity and AI, with opportunities to solve complex problems and build production\-grade AI capabilities.

**The Role**


We're hiring a Solution Engineer based in Bengaluru to provide technical presales support and drive Proof of Value / Proof of Concept engagements during the sales cycle, including with C\-level stakeholders. You'll partner closely with Account Executives to own the technical win in complex sales cycles.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical win. Partner with Account Executives and GTM to drive complex sales cycles from initial discovery to technical wins.
* Tailor the narrative. Translate complex technical identity risks into business value — explain an IAM policy misconfiguration to a DevOps Engineer, then explain the business impact of that risk to a CISO five minutes later.
* Execute high\-velocity PoVs. Run frictionless Proof of Values. Our technology connects via APIs and shows value in minutes — guide the customer through that data, highlighting critical identity risks (toxic combinations, shadow admins, over\-privileged roles) in their environment.
* Be a trusted advisor. Become a deep subject\-matter expert on Identity Security across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers (Okta, Entra ID), and business apps (Snowflake, GitHub) for clients and partners.
* Represent the voice of the customer. As an early member of the team, your feedback loop to Product and Engineering is critical — translate customer use cases and business requirements into clear feature requests to shape the roadmap.
* Evangelize. Represent Unosecur at industry conferences, webinars, and in technical blog posts.

**What You'll Need**

* 5\+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting within the SaaS or cybersecurity space
* Strong conceptual understanding of the major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) — how companies structure their cloud (organizations, projects, subscriptions) and the common security challenges they face
* Solid foundation in security concepts such as Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity \& Access Governance (IAG), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Least Privilege, Zero Trust, and compliance standards
* Exceptional ability to present technical solutions to non\-technical audiences — can run a demo and handle objections with confidence
* Proven discovery skills: asking the right questions to uncover customer pain points and mapping them to technical solutions
* Startup agility: prior experience in early or growth\-stage startups, with a bias toward action and comfort with ambiguity

**Nice to Have**

* Experience selling or working with identity providers (Okta, Entra ID) and cloud security tools (Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca)
* Able to read and explain scripts as well as REST APIs
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals, or similar

title: Chief of Staff & Executive Assistant to Founder & CEO
description:
**Designation:** **Chief of Staff \& Executive Assistant to Founder \& CEO**
============================================================================

**Location:** Bengaluru, India — Hybrid / primarily office\-based
  

**Reports to:** Founder \& CEO
  

**Experience:** Ideally 6–10 years
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time
  

**Working Hours:** India\-based role with **daily overlap with U.S. business hours,**

**This role is based in Bengaluru but is specifically designed to provide daily overlap with U.S. working hours.**

A typical work schedule is expected to be approximately:


**3:00/4:00 PM IST to 12:00/1:00 AM IST**

**About Organisation:**

We are a fast\-growing healthcare technology company building technology\-enabled virtual care solutions for specialty medical practices in the United States.


Our platform helps specialty practices deliver scalable care outside the clinic through virtual care programs, patient engagement, technology, clinical workflows and AI\-enabled solutions.


As our organisation continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional **Chief of Staff \& Executive Assistant to the Founder \& CEO** , based in Bengaluru.


This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.


The person will work closely with the Founder \& CEO across company strategy, leadership coordination, board preparation, customer initiatives, product priorities, hiring, business analysis and day\-to\-day CEO\-office operations.


The right person will become a trusted extension of the CEO.


**The Role**
============

The primary objective of this position is simple:


**Make the CEO and the organization significantly more effective.**

The role combines two responsibilities:


### **Executive Leverage**

Help the CEO manage time, information, communication, meetings, travel, priorities and follow\-through.


### **Chief of Staff / Business Execution**

Help translate CEO priorities into action across the company, coordinate senior leaders, drive strategic initiatives and prepare the CEO for important decisions.


Becauserimarily operates in the United States, this role will be based in Bengaluru but will operate substantially during overlapping U.S. business hours.


This is an important part of the position.


The person should expect to work with the CEO and U.S. leadership team **every working day** , rather than simply joining occasional evening calls.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1\. Run the CEO Office**
--------------------------

Create a disciplined operating system around the CEO.


Maintain a clear view of:


* · CEO priorities
* · Key decisions
* · Delegated items
* · Follow\-ups
* · Important relationships
* · Upcoming meetings
* · Customer commitments
* · Board commitments
* · Strategic initiatives
* · Recruiting priorities
* · Important deadlines
* Nothing important should get lost.
* Proactively identify what requires the CEO’s attention rather than waiting for instructions.

**2\. Calendar \& Priority Management**
---------------------------------------

* Own and actively manage the CEO’s calendar.
* This is not simply a scheduling function.
* Understand:
* · Why a meeting is required
* · Whether the CEO needs to attend
* · Who else should participate
* · What decision is expected
* · Whether something can be delegated
* · Whether the issue can be handled asynchronously
* Protect the CEO’s time for the highest\-value activities.
* Coordinate meetings across U.S., India and international time zones.

Because this role works daily with the CEO during U.S. hours, the individual should be available to handle real\-time scheduling changes, priorities and issues during the CEO’s working day.


**3\. Daily CEO Coordination**
------------------------------

* Maintain a highly effective daily operating cadence with the CEO.
* This may include:
* · Reviewing priorities for the day
* · Preparing upcoming meetings
* · Identifying decisions required
* · Reviewing outstanding follow\-ups
* · Coordinating with senior executives
* · Tracking delegated actions
* · Surfacing issues requiring CEO intervention
* · Preparing information required for upcoming decisions
* The goal is to develop enough context that the individual increasingly anticipates what the CEO needs before being asked.

**4\. Meeting Preparation**
---------------------------

* Prepare the CEO for important:
* · Leadership meetings
* · Customer meetings
* · Board meetings
* · Investor discussions
* · Candidate interviews
* · Partnership discussions
* · Strategic planning sessions

For significant meetings, prepare concise briefing materials covering:


**Objective**  

Why are we having this meeting?


**Context**  

What does the CEO need to know?


**Decision**  

What decision or outcome is required?


**Issues**  

What are the unresolved questions or risks?


**Recommendation**  

What should we do?


The objective is for the CEO to enter important meetings already prepared.


**5\. Leadership Team Coordination**
------------------------------------

* Work closely with senior leaders across:
* · Product
* · Engineering
* · Finance
* · Sales
* · Operations
* · Clinical
* · Patient Engagement
* · Marketing
* · HR
* Track decisions and commitments made in leadership meetings.
* Follow up with owners.
* Ensure deadlines are met.
* Escalate issues when required.

The candidate must be comfortable following up with senior executives and holding people accountable while maintaining strong working relationships.


**6\. Strategic Projects**
--------------------------

* Take ownership of selected CEO\-led initiatives.
* Examples could include:
* · New product initiatives
* · Market expansion
* · Competitive analysis
* · Pricing strategy
* · Business model analysis
* · Strategic partnerships
* · M\&A opportunities
* · Customer initiatives
* · New business opportunities
* · AI initiatives
* · Organizational projects
* · Executive hiring
* · Operating\-plan initiatives

**8\. Board \& Investor Support**
---------------------------------

Support preparation for board meetings and investor discussions.


Responsibilities may include:


· Coordinating board materials


· Gathering functional updates


· Reviewing presentations


· Preparing CEO talking points


· Tracking board requests


· Managing follow\-ups


· Maintaining important board documentation


The candidate will have access to highly confidential company information and must demonstrate exceptional discretion.


**9\. Executive Communication**
-------------------------------

Help draft and refine communications from the CEO, including:


· Internal emails


· Leadership communications


· Customer communications


· Board communications


· Candidate outreach


· Investor communications


· Meeting summaries


· Presentations


Excellent written and spoken English is essential.


The individual should be able to communicate comfortably with senior U.S.\-based executives, customers, physicians, investors and partners.


**10\. Travel \& Logistics**
----------------------------

Coordinate CEO travel when required, including international travel.


Responsibilities may include:


· Flights


· Hotels


· Ground transportation


· Meeting logistics


· Itineraries


· Schedule coordination


· Last\-minute changes


Travel planning should optimize both business productivity and CEO time.


The individual may occasionally be required to travel within India or internationally.


This allows the individual to:


· Work with the CEO in real time


· Participate in leadership meetings


· Join important customer discussions


· Coordinate directly with U.S. executives


· Respond to issues during the U.S. business day


· Complete follow\-ups while U.S. teams are still online


This is **not an occasional late\-evening\-call requirement** .


Daily U.S. overlap is a normal and fundamental part of the position.


Candidates seeking a conventional 9 AM–6 PM India working schedule should not apply.


At the same time, we expect sustainable working hours. The position should not routinely require both a full Indian workday and a full U.S. workday.


**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**Exceptional Organization**
----------------------------

You can manage dozens of concurrent priorities without losing track of details.


**Strong Business Judgment**
----------------------------

You understand what deserves CEO attention and what does not.


You know when to escalate, when to delegate and when to solve something yourself.


**Intellectual Curiosity**
--------------------------

You can quickly understand unfamiliar industries, technologies, financial concepts and business problems.


**High Ownership**
------------------

You naturally think:


**“How do I get this done?”**

rather than:


**“Whose responsibility is this?”**

**Bias Toward Action**
----------------------

You identify problems before they become urgent and proactively resolve them.


**Strong Analytical Ability**
-----------------------------

You are comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets, business metrics and structured problem solving.


**Excellent Communication**
---------------------------

You can communicate comfortably with:


· Senior executives


· Physicians


· Customers


· Investors


· Board members


· Employees


· External partners


**Persistence**
---------------

You are comfortable following up repeatedly when something needs to get completed.


**Low Ego**
-----------

You are equally comfortable preparing a strategic business analysis and fixing a calendar or travel issue.


Neither feels beneath you.


**Discretion**
--------------

You will have access to highly confidential business and personal information.


Trust and integrity are non\-negotiable.


**Ideal Background**
====================

We are deliberately flexible about exact background.


Strong candidates may come from:


· Chief of Staff roles


· Founder’s Office roles


· CEO Office roles


· Senior Executive Assistant roles


· Strategy and operations


· Management consulting


· Investment banking


· Startup operations


· Business operations


· Program management


We expect the strongest candidates to have approximately **6–10 years of professional experience** , although exceptional candidates outside this range will be considered.


A bachelor’s degree is required.


An MBA is helpful but not required.


Experience working directly with **U.S.\-based executives or customers** is highly desirable.


Experience in healthcare, technology, SaaS, startups or U.S.\-focused businesses is useful but not mandatory.


**Important: This Is a Hybrid Role**
====================================

Candidates should clearly understand the nature of this position.


This is **not a pure strategy Chief of Staff role** .


And it is **not a traditional Executive Assistant role** .


**The ideal candidate enjoys both.**

* You may spend one hour helping analyze a new business opportunity and the next ensuring an important CEO meeting gets rescheduled correctly.
* You may help prepare a board presentation, participate in a leadership meeting, analyze a business issue and coordinate CEO travel within the same week.
* You need to be comfortable operating across the entire spectrum.
* AI \& Technology Orientation
* We are building an increasingly AI\-driven company, and we expect the CEO Office to operate the same way.
* You should be highly comfortable using AI and modern productivity tools for:
* · Research
* · Market analysis
* · Competitive analysis
* · Meeting preparation
* · Meeting summaries
* · Document creation
* · Presentation development
* · Data analysis
* · Email drafting
* · Information organization
* · Workflow automation

title: Account Executive (SMB), Rippling Spend
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

The Spend Management Account Executive (SMB) role at Rippling provides an extremely unique opportunity \- we’re looking for talented and ambitious SMB Account Executives who can both manage a high velocity sales cycle while also implementing newly signed Rippling customers.

  

One fundamental belief at Rippling is that Account Executives should spend 100% of their time between engaging with interested prospects, managing sales cycles to help potential customers evaluate our product, closing revenue from marketing\-generated demos, driving Outbound activities to generate additional pipeline, and working with their customers to ensure a seamless transition to our platform.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Maintain a pipeline of high\-value prospects through salesforce to forecast revenue accurately
* Own the entire sales cycle from initial discovery and demo, to contract signature
* Reach out to prospective customers and create new Spend management Opportunities to Generate Pipeline Via Outbound.
* Consistently attain and overachieve quota on a monthly basis
* Become a product expert across our Spend Management platform and understand our competitor landscape
* Articulate Rippling’s Spend Management value proposition by using the appropriate sales qualification standards
* Work closely with your customers to ensure a smooth transition onto the Rippling platform

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Minimum 2 years of quota\-carrying experience in a full cycle closing role with strong prospecting, qualifying, negotiating, and closing skills
* Minimum 1 year experience selling to SMB/Mid\-market sized businesses
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment. AEs at Rippling close a large volume of deals every month and we require someone who is comfortable with volume and pace
* Proven track record of success (top 10% of sales org)
* Ability to discuss Rippling's value proposition with C\-level executives, finance teams, and decision makers
* Experience with outbound prospecting to our existing customer base and conducting product demonstrations
* High adaptability and understanding of change within the evolution of a startup

 **Please note:**

* This job requires you to work EST/EDT hours. (5:30pm to 2:30am IST)
* This is a hybrid role and will require you to work out our Bangalore office three days (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday) a week.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

**Position:** Senior Real Estate Sales Manager  
**Division:** Office Space Leasing  
**Department:** Sales / Business Development  
**Experience:** 4–5 Years  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Senior Real Estate Sales Manager** to lead and drive business development for our **Office Space Leasing Division**.

The candidate will be responsible for generating new business, managing key client relationships, driving office space leasing transactions, handling negotiations, achieving revenue targets, and managing the sales team. The role requires strong knowledge of the commercial real estate market, particularly **office spaces, managed offices, coworking spaces, and commercial leasing**.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing high\-value client requirements from **lead generation to transaction closure**, while also leading, supporting, and developing the sales team to achieve individual and business targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Development \& Sales**

* Drive new business acquisition for the **Office Space Leasing Division**.
* Identify and develop new corporate, SME, startup, and business accounts requiring office spaces.
* Generate leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, market visits, online platforms, and other business\-development channels.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline and ensure consistent movement of opportunities through the sales funnel.
* Understand client requirements including location, seating capacity, budget, tenure, amenities, and business needs.
* Recommend suitable office spaces, coworking spaces, managed offices, and commercial properties based on client requirements.
* Conduct client meetings, property presentations, and site visits.
* Independently manage the complete sales cycle from **lead generation, requirement understanding, property options, site visits, negotiation, and closure**.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and revenue targets.
* Support team members in generating new business and closing high\-value opportunities.

**Client \& Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, decision\-makers, property owners, landlords, and workspace operators.
* Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts.
* Understand client business requirements and provide customized office space solutions.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups and ensure a high level of client engagement throughout the transaction.
* Develop long\-term relationships to generate repeat business, referrals, and new opportunities.
* Guide team members in managing important client relationships and resolving escalated client concerns.

**Negotiation \& Deal Closure**

* Lead commercial negotiations with clients, landlords, and workspace providers.
* Negotiate rental rates, lease terms, deposits, lock\-in periods, fit\-out requirements, and other commercial terms.
* Prepare and present commercial proposals and property comparisons.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve transaction\-related issues.
* Drive negotiations effectively towards successful closure.
* Ensure proper coordination for documentation, agreements, and transaction completion.
* Review and support team\-led negotiations to improve closure rates and commercial outcomes.

**Team Management \& Sales Leadership**

* Manage, lead, and motivate Business Development Executives, Sales Associates, and other team members within the leasing division.
* Set individual and team sales targets in alignment with business objectives.
* Allocate leads, territories, accounts, and responsibilities among team members.
* Monitor individual and team performance against assigned targets.
* Conduct regular team meetings, pipeline reviews, performance reviews, and sales planning sessions.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and on\-the\-job training to improve team performance.
* Support team members in client meetings, negotiations, site visits, and complex closures where required.
* Review team pipelines and ensure timely follow\-up on all active opportunities.
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans.
* Recruit, onboard, and help develop sales team members as required.
* Establish clear sales processes, reporting standards, and accountability across the team.
* Recognize high performance and maintain a motivated, target\-driven sales culture.
* Ensure the team consistently updates CRM records and follows company sales procedures.
* Take responsibility for both individual sales performance and overall team revenue achievement.

**Market \& Inventory Management**

* Maintain strong knowledge of the Bengaluru commercial real estate market.
* Track rental rates, market trends, new developments, competitor activity, and workspace availability.
* Build and maintain relationships with property owners, landlords, coworking operators, and managed office providers.
* Identify new properties and opportunities that can strengthen the company's office\-space inventory.
* Ensure accurate and updated property information is maintained in the CRM/inventory system.
* Share relevant market insights and inventory updates with the sales team.

**CRM \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, client requirements, property options, site visits, proposals, negotiations, and closures.
* Ensure timely updates of all sales activities in the CRM by the team.
* Prepare regular individual and team sales pipeline and performance reports for management.
* Monitor conversion ratios and identify opportunities to improve sales performance.
* Track team productivity, lead response time, follow\-up quality, and closure performance.
* Provide management with market feedback, sales insights, team updates, and business\-development opportunities.
* Present regular forecasts and action plans to achieve revenue targets.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* 4–5 years of experience in **commercial real estate sales / office space leasing / coworking / managed office sales**.
* Prior experience managing, leading, or supervising a sales or business\-development team.
* Proven track record of achieving individual and team sales and revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of the **Bengaluru commercial real estate market**.

* Strong business development, lead generation, and client acquisition skills.

* Ability to analyze sales data, prepare forecasts, and implement performance\-improvement strategies.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings, market visits, property inspections, and team activities.
