title: VP, Investment Allocations
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1\.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

**Job Summary and Business Unit Overview**


Blackstone Credit \& Insurance (BXCI) was created in September 2023 by combining Blackstone's Credit and Insurance businesses. BXCI offers a broad range of solutions across corporate and asset\-based credit, including investment\-grade and non\-investment\-grade private credit. BXCI invests across the credit markets and manages strategies focused on sectors with strong fundamentals.


We are seeking a highly motivated Vice President to lead the Investment Allocations team within BXCI. The role will oversee the Bengaluru Center of Excellence (CoE) team and partner closely with global Investment Allocations stakeholders. The Vice President will be responsible for allocation governance, operational execution, controls, data quality, team leadership, and strategic transformation. The role requires sound judgment, strong execution discipline, and the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders across Investments, Capital Formation, Insurance, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal and Compliance, and Data teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Bengaluru Investment Allocations CoE and establish clear objectives, service standards, capacity plans, and accountability across the team.
* Partner with global colleagues to run hypothetical allocation scenarios (hypos), evaluate allocation outcomes, and support the timely and accurate finalization of allocations across asset classes, funds, and client mandates.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end allocation process, including data intake, eligibility validation, constraint monitoring, exception management, approvals, booking support, and post\-allocation review.
* Ensure allocations are executed in accordance with approved policies, investment guidelines, client and fund restrictions, conflicts protocols, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish and maintain robust governance, including maker\-checker controls, documented approvals, audit trails, escalation protocols, and periodic control attestations.
* Define, monitor, and report key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), service\-level metrics, and operational trends; drive timely remediation of identified issues.
* Perform and oversee periodic allocation surveillance, portfolio reviews, and management reporting for relevant business and client stakeholders.
* Drive consistent data quality and reconcile allocation inputs and outputs across source systems, models, and downstream records; ensure exceptions are investigated and resolved promptly.
* Act as the senior point of contact across business, Technology, Finance, Operations, Data, Legal and Compliance, Capital Formation, and Insurance teams globally.
* Lead strategic initiatives focused on modernization, workflow digitization, automation, standardization, and operational scalability.
* Assess change impacts, define business requirements, coordinate user acceptance testing, and ensure effective implementation and post\-go\-live stabilization of new processes and systems.
* Create effective handover and follow\-the\-sun operating models between regional teams, supported by clear procedures, business continuity plans, and cross\-training.
* Build, coach, and retain a high\-performing team through structured development plans, timely feedback, succession planning, and an inclusive culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* Prepare concise, executive\-level updates on performance, capacity, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and strategic outcomes.
* Respond to ad hoc requests from Investment, Capital Formation, Insurance, and other stakeholders, providing accurate and timely analysis.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory inquiries, and risk or compliance reviews by maintaining complete and readily retrievable evidence.

LogicMonitor® is the AI\-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on\-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.



Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row!



We are hiring a GTM Engineer to help build the systems that power customer lifecycle reporting and operations for a fast\-scaling AI business. Customer signals span the full journey, from sales handoff through implementation, adoption, and renewal or expansion, and the team needs one trusted way to bring them together.  

This is a builder role for someone who is curious, business\- and data\-fluent, and excited about AI. The right person can take loose requirements and turn them into working prototypes or production\-ready code using SQL, Python, scripts, and AI\-assisted coding tools.  

The role blends business operations, data architecture, and technical build work. It is a strong fit for someone who can translate messy operating needs into practical workflows, reporting, and system logic that help leaders make decisions from data.
**Here's a closer look at this key role:**

  

* Build the canonical customer operating data layer
* Connect Salesforce, Jira, Langfuse, Snowflake, product telemetry, and related sources into one usable customer view.
* Surface customer health and product adoption signals so leaders can quickly see where intervention is needed.
* Build executive\-facing reporting, visualizations, and operating views for accounts, health, adoption, and leadership readouts.
* Translate lifecycle definitions and stage entry / exit criteria into system requirements.
* Build and maintain integrations, reconciliation logic, data recency checks, source\-of\-truth mapping, and history/backfill support.
* Support automation jobs, alerts, backend reliability, and the semantic layer that powers BI and reporting surfaces.
* Support AI summaries and account readouts with structured, attributed, current data.
* Partner with business and technical stakeholders to turn reporting needs into workflows, data structures, and durable code.
* Define requirements for stage movement, time\-to\-value, customer health, and product adoption.
* Maintain the architecture needed for history, freshness, reconciliation, and reporting consistency.
* Work closely with source\-system owners and BI / data partners.
* Help define field hygiene, metric definitions, and data governance for customer lifecycle reporting and operations.
* Data governance mindset: you think in systems, not fixes, building and documenting standards, and hold the line on data quality over time.

**What You'll Need:**
* 6\+ years in customer operations, lifecycle operations, CX operations, RevOps, Sales Ops, BizOps, Product Ops, data engineering, analytics engineering, systems engineering, or GTM engineering.
* Strong business acumen and comfort connecting metrics to operating decisions.
* Hands\-on experience with SQL and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
* Experience integrating SaaS systems and REST APIs and JSON.  

Salesforce data model familiarity.
* Familiarity with Kantata, Jira, Pendo, Langfuse, Snowflake, Power BI, Slack, or BI tools.
* Understanding of data modeling, data architecture, and how source systems feed operational reporting.
* Comfort working with messy source data and reconciliation logic.
* Comfort building working prototypes with AI\-assisted coding tools, SQL, Python, scripts, or lightweight apps.
* Basic familiarity with working on SaaS systems in AWS/Kubernetes
* Strong communication skills and an eye for executive\-level visual storytelling.
* Ability to build quickly without overengineering.
* Comfort analyzing trends, building forecasts, and turning data into operational recommendations.
* Deep curiosity about AI tools, systems, and applied workflows.  

  

Preferred Experience
* Experience with operational data products or customer\-facing internal systems.
* Familiarity with event data, product telemetry, and usage analytics.
* Experience in fast\-moving AI, infrastructure, or SaaS environments.

Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.


**Customer Assurance Prog Mgr**
===============================


Bengaluru, India
**Job category:** Customer Support **Job ID:** 136262\-en\_US **Job Summary**
---------------


The Customer Assurance Program (CAP) Manager serves as NetApp’s highest level of customer advocacy and escalation management, leading the resolution of critical customer situations when standard support channels are no longer sufficient. As a trusted advisor, this role is responsible for restoring and maintaining customer confidence by driving complex issue resolution, influencing cross\-functional teams, and managing executive\-level communications.
Working across global teams, the CAP Manager owns escalations from initiation through resolution, balancing customer needs with business objectives while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. The role also contributes to strategic initiatives that strengthen customer support quality, improve operational processes, and drive organizational change across people, processes, and products.
**Jon Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Customer Escalation \& Advocacy**
* Own and drive the resolution of critical customer escalations with end\-to\-end accountability.
* Conduct comprehensive situation assessments to understand customer concerns, business impact, risks, and resolution requirements.
* Develop and execute resolution plans that balance customer satisfaction, business priorities, timelines, and costs.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for executive stakeholders throughout complex customer engagements.
* Restore and maintain customer trust through effective communication, transparency, and advocacy.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Lead global, cross\-functional virtual teams across multiple geographies, functions, and time zones.
* Influence stakeholders and drive alignment across Engineering, Support, Sales, Product Management, Professional Services, and Leadership teams.
* Facilitate collaboration and remove obstacles to accelerate issue resolution.
* Drive accountability and ownership across all teams involved in customer engagements.

**Executive \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build trusted relationships with executives, customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Provide executive\-level updates, action plans, risk assessments, and recommendations.
* Manage expectations and communicate effectively during high\-pressure situations.
* Facilitate decision\-making by clearly articulating business impacts and potential outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement \& Strategic Initiatives
* Identify recurring trends, root causes, and systemic issues impacting customer experience.
* Drive improvement initiatives focused on enhancing support quality, operational effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead or contribute to strategic projects and transformation initiatives across the business.
* Document lessons learned, best practices, and operational improvements to strengthen organizational capabilities.

**Operational Excellence**
* Manage multiple high\-priority escalations, projects, and initiatives simultaneously.
* Maintain accurate documentation and ensure clear communication throughout engagement lifecycles.
* Monitor progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies.
* Drive measurable outcomes aligned with NetApp’s customer success objectives.
**Job Requirements**
--------------------


**Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience in the technology industry, customer success, escalation management, support operations, program management, or related functions.
* Proven experience leading complex customer escalations and critical business situations.
* Demonstrated success managing globally distributed, cross\-functional teams.
* Experience supporting enterprise and Fortune 500 customers.
* Strong track record of influencing senior leaders and driving successful outcomes.
* Experience restoring and maintaining customer trust during high\-impact situations.

  

**Skills \& Competencies*** Strong customer advocacy and relationship management skills.
* Exceptional leadership, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to influence executives and cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with executive presence.
* Ability to remain calm, decisive, and effective under pressure.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Growth mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across global teams and time zones.

Strong diplomacy, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.  
* 

**Technical Knowledge**
* Fundamental understanding of enterprise storage infrastructure technologies.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and productivity tools.
* Ability to quickly develop knowledge of NetApp products, solutions, and support processes.

**Education**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, certifications, and relevant industry experience.
* Additional certifications or advanced qualifications are considered a plus.
At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.


**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**


At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.


NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. description:

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1742687
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**EY \- GDS Consulting \- AI \& DATA – Sales Support executive (Senior Manager)**

  


**The opportunity**



The Sales Support executive (Senior Manager) is a key contributor to Consulting growth, responsible for supporting sales pursuits, proposal execution, and commercial analysis across priority opportunities. This role works closely with Senior Managers, Partners, Account Leaders, and solution teams to improve pursuit effectiveness, deal quality, and pipeline discipline.

  


**Your key responsibilities**

  


**Sales \& Pursuit Support**


* Support end to end sales pursuits for consulting opportunities, including qualification, proposal development, pricing support, and approvals.
* Partner with pursuit leaders to help shape deal strategy, solution positioning, and client value propositions.
* Maintain strong discipline on pipeline tracking, win probability updates, and pursuit milestones.

  


**Proposal \& RFP Management**


* Manage and coordinate RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and client presentations under guidance of Senior Managers and Partners.
* Work with cross functional teams (solution architects, finance, legal, risk, delivery) to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely submissions.
* Consolidate inputs, track dependencies, and ensure alignment between scope, commercials, and delivery approach.

  


**Commercial \& Financial Analysis**


* Support pricing models, effort estimates, margin analysis, and financial summaries for consulting deals.
* Assist in preparing business cases, deal review materials, and approval documentation.
* Analyse deal economics and highlight commercial risks, assumptions, and improvement opportunities.

  


**Sales Operations \& Governance**


* Ensure compliance with sales governance, review checkpoints, and approval workflows.
* Support maintenance of sales support templates, trackers, and standard documentation.
* Identify process gaps and contribute to continuous improvement of sales support operations.

  


**Stakeholder Management**


* Act as a primary working level contact for account teams and pursuit stakeholders.
* Provide clear, structured updates on pursuit status, risks, and next steps.
* Support leadership in pipeline reviews, forecast updates, and performance reporting.

  


**Team Collaboration \& Capability Building**


* Mentor Senior Consultants and Consultants within the sales support team.
* Share best practices on proposal writing, commercial structuring, and pursuit management.
* Contribute to knowledge assets, playbooks, and reusable pursuit collateral.

  


**Required Skills \& Experience**

  


**Experience**


* 15\+ years of experience in consulting sales support, pursuit management, commercial advisory, or related roles.
* Hands on experience supporting medium to large consulting deals across technology, data, digital, or transformation programs.
* Experience working in a global / matrixed consulting environment is preferred.
* Should have strong AI understanding

  


**Core Competencies**


* Strong understanding of the consulting sales lifecycle and proposal processes.
* Working knowledge of pricing, effort estimation, and commercial constructs.
* Ability to synthesize complex inputs into clear, client ready deliverables.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.

  


**Behavioural \& Leadership Skills**


* Detail oriented with strong execution discipline.
* Comfortable operating in fast paced, deadline driven pursuit environments.
* Collaborative team player with emerging leadership capabilities.
* High standards of quality, compliance, and professionalism.

  


**Education**


* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent is an advantage.

  


**What we look for**


* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment

  


**What working at EY offers**



At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.



You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:


* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

As a Strategic Partner Development Manager, you'll open doors with potential partners, lead exploratory discussions and evaluate/develop business opportunities. You will lead cross\-functional teams, provide thought leadership and serve as a mentor to managers and associates. You are comfortable escalating and presenting business development strategies and key issues to senior management. You'll work closely with Google Product, Engineering, Legal and Sales teams on new product initiatives and key strategic relationships that support our online advertising business.

  


This Strategic Partnerships Development Manager for Knowledge, and Information (K\&I) Partnerships will drive high\-impact initiatives across DeepMind, Google Research, and Tech and Society. Bridging the gap between cutting\-edge AI research and real\-world societal impact, you will lead critical ecosystem engagements to improve foundational models and public data infrastructure for billions of users. From scaling Indic language capabilities and AI accessibility programs to establishing factual public data infrastructure via Data Commons, this role is critical to ensuring our frontier AI models are highly capable, and localized for the APAC region. You will also have exceptional cross\-functional collaboration and operational excellence, managing multiple complex funding streams, data licensing extensions, and Go\-To\-Market strategies simultaneously.


The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product\-enabling partnerships, go\-to\-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.**Responsibilities**

description:
**Role : SME Sales Executive**

**Location :** MG Road, Bangalore (In\-House)  
**Reporting to :** SME Sales Lead (UK) / SME Sales Shift Lead  
**Markets Covered:** US\-Canada  
**Tools Used :** Zendesk (calls, tickets), Calendly, Company Platform

**About the** Company is an online services marketplace connecting customers with professionals across over 1,000 categories. Operating in nine countries including the UK, US, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand, we're transforming how people find trusted service providers for everything from home improvement to professional services.  
Our platform uses cutting\-edge technology to match customers with the right professionals quickly and efficiently. We're currently undergoing an exciting transformation: migrating from a lead generation model to a full marketplace platform with subscription\-based pricing.  
As a profitable, PE backed scale up (EMK Capital), Company offers the best of both worlds: the agility and innovation of a fast\-moving business combined with financial stability and resources for growth. We recently launched our new marketplace model in Australia (Q4 2025\) and are preparing for rollout to the UK and US markets in 2026\. You'll have genuine ownership, responsibility, and the opportunity to shape our commercial strategy during a pivotal transformation phase with the chance to make your own contribution to our journey.

**Role Overview**

The **SME Sales Executive** is a front\-line sales role responsible for engaging small and medium\-sized businesses (SMEs) who have shown interest in Company’s platform. This role combines **outbound cold calling**, **live selling and activation**, and **onboarding conversations** to help sellers start winning work through Company.

Sales Executives will speak to business owners across global English\-speaking markets, build trust quickly, clearly explain Company’s value, and guide sellers toward either booking an onboarding session or activating directly on the call.

This role requires confidence on the phone, strong communication skills, resilience, and the ability to follow structured sales processes while delivering a high\-quality seller experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Outbound Sales \& Cold Calling**

· Make high\-volume outbound calls to sellers using Zendesk

· Engage new and lapsed sellers through structured cold\-calling frameworks

· Confidently explain Company’s value proposition (for both lead\-gen and marketplace model)

· Handle common objections and move conversations forward.

· Determine whether the best next step is:

o Booking an onboarding meeting, or

o Activating and selling on the call

**Meeting Booking \& Scheduling**

· Book onboarding or follow\-up meetings using Calendly.

· Guide sellers through availability using simple, conversational questions:

o “Which day works best for you?”

o “Morning or afternoon?”

· Confirm meeting details clearly and professionally.

· Send follow\-up emails with Calendly links when sellers cannot commit immediately.

**Live Selling \& Seller Activation**

· Activate sellers directly on a call or during pre\-booked activation calls.

· Explain pricing, credits, lead flow, and value clearly and confidently.

· Help sellers select the right categories, locations, and lead settings.

· Ensure sellers understand best practices before purchasing leads.

· Maintain compliance with approved scripts, pricing, and offers.

**Onboarding Calls**

· Conduct onboarding calls with sellers who have already booked meetings.

· Walk sellers through:

o Activation and start pack options (if required)

o Profile setup

o Lead settings and filters

o Buying and responding to leads

o Best practices to maximise conversion

· Answer questions and remove friction during early platform usage.

· Deliver a positive, consultative seller experience.

**Systems, Process \& Data Accuracy**

· Accurately log all call outcomes, notes, and actions in Zendesk.

· Use correct dispositions for unanswered calls, voicemails, callbacks, and meetings booked.

· Follow outbound cadence rules (call attempts, voicemail, email follow\-ups).

· Adhere to compliance, quality, and communication standards.

**Key Skills \& Experience**

· 1–3 years’ experience in outbound sales, inside sales or customer support.

· Comfortable making cold calls to business owners and decision\-makers.

· Clear, neutral, and confident spoken English suitable for global markets.

· Strong objection\-handling and conversational selling skills.

· Ability to follow structured scripts while sounding natural and authentic.

· Comfortable using CRM or ticketing tools (Zendesk experience is a plus).

· Resilient, target\-driven, and comfortable handling rejection.

· Willingness to work aligned to US/UK business hours.

**Working Hours \& Availability**

· If supporting US\-Canada \- Shift 08:00 PM IST to 05:00AM IST

· If supporting UK\-Ireland \- Shift 12:30PM IST to 09:30PM IST

· If supporting Australia\-New Zealand \- Shift 05:00AM IST to 02:00PM IST  
**Perks and Benefits**

· Flexible working policy with India office located in CBD Bangalore

· Insurances \- Family Floater Mediclaim, Employee Personal Accident and Employee Term Life

· Personal annual L\&D Budgets to spend on your development

· **Cult.fit** membership for all employees with access to mental health courses and fitness classes

· Fully stocked snacks in pantry, Quarterly All\-site Socials

· Being at the forefront of an industry with new and exciting problems to solve

**Interview Process**

· Screening with Talent Partner

· 1st Stage \- Interview with Hiring Manager (30 mins)

· 2nd Stage \- Technical Task \& Interview (60 mins

3rd Stage \- Values interview (30 mins)

Pay: ₹580,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and proactive **E\-commerce Dispatch Executive** to manage the end\-to\-end dispatch process for our e\-commerce business. The ideal candidate will ensure timely and accurate dispatch of customer orders, coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams, maintain shipment records, and ensure smooth order fulfillment across all online sales channels.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate the daily dispatch of e\-commerce orders received from various online marketplaces and the brand website.
* Verify picked and packed orders before dispatch to ensure accuracy and quality.
* Generate invoices, shipping labels, manifests, and packing slips.
* Coordinate with the warehouse team to ensure timely order dispatch as per SLA timelines.
* Schedule and coordinate courier pickups with logistics partners.
* Hand over shipments to courier partners and ensure proper documentation is maintained.
* Monitor shipment status and update dispatch details on e\-commerce portals and ERP/WMS systems.
* Ensure all dispatched orders are scanned, manifested, and handed over correctly to avoid shipment discrepancies.
* Coordinate with courier partners regarding shipment delays, failed pickups, and tracking updates.
* Handle dispatch\-related issues including missing shipments, damaged packages, RTOs (Return to Origin), exchanges, and re\-dispatches.
* Maintain accurate dispatch records and shipment documentation.
* Coordinate with the inventory team to ensure stock availability before dispatch and help prevent overselling.
* Prepare daily dispatch reports, pending shipment reports, courier handover reports, and inventory reconciliation reports.
* Work closely with customer support to resolve dispatch and shipment\-related queries.
* Ensure compliance with company SOPs, quality standards, and dispatch processes.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of e\-commerce dispatch operations and warehouse processes.
* Familiarity with marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, Nykaa, etc.
* Basic understanding of inventory management and stock reconciliation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP/WMS software.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work under deadlines.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in e\-commerce dispatch, warehouse dispatch operations, or order fulfillment.
* Experience in the retail, apparel, or e\-commerce industry is preferred.

Preferred Skills

* Experience using Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Unicommerce, and ERP software.
* Knowledge of courier aggregation platforms and shipment manifesting processes.
* Understanding of e\-commerce dispatch SOPs, courier SLAs, and shipment tracking.

description:
**Company:**

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Hardware Engineering
**General Summary:**

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As an **ASIC Design Manager** **(** **Principal** **/ Director\-Le** **vel)** in the **Custom Silicon Group** , you will lead the development and delivery of next\-generation, high\-performance SoCs from concept to tapeout. You will be responsible for driving the complete silicon development lifecycle, spanning architecture, RTL design, integration, physical design, verification, silicon bring\-up, and production readiness. In addition to providing technical and organizational leadership, you will serve as a key customer\-facing engineering leader, partnering with strategic customers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into successful silicon solutions.


You will lead a team of engineers and work closely with cross\-functional groups across geographies \- including RTL design, verification, CAD, and integration teams. Your role will be pivotal in shaping the physical design strategy, ensuring design convergence, and maintaining signoff integrity across timing, power, and area metrics.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 8\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 7\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
**Principal Duties and responsibilities:**

* Demonstrate proven experience in executing responsibilities across multiple sites.
* Lead and manage a team across multiple functions.
* Design closure and tapeout expertise in advanced technology nodes.
* Complete ownership of PnR implementation, including Floor planning, Placement, CTS, and post\-route activities on the cutting\-edge nodes.
* Possess mandatory signoff knowledge, including STA, Power Analysis, FV, Low Power Verification and PV.
* Collaborate effectively to resolve issues related to constraints validation, verification, STA, Physical Design and tapeout
* Understand deep sub\-micron design challenges, including leakage power, signal integrity, and DFM.
* Support pre\-sales and business development activities by evaluating technical feasibility and providing design expertise.
* Provide technical leadership during design reviews and executive\-level customer engagements.
* Drive resolution of customer\-reported issues by coordinating across design, verification, firmware, software, and validation teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering and 17\- 25 years of Hardware/VLSI Engineering specializing in Physical Design and timing signoff for high\-speed SoCs.**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Excellent hands\-on experience on Floor planning, PnR and STA flows
* Good knowledge of Placement/Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS), Low Power/High Performance optimization etc.
* Thorough understanding of signoff domains– LEC/CLP/PDN etc.
* 18\+ years of experience with Physical Design and timing signoff expertise in latest tech nodes (e.g., 2nm/3nm/4nm/5nm)

About the Role

We are looking for a responsible and energetic **Field Operations \& Logistics Executive** to manage day\-to\-day field activities related to corporate gifting orders. The person will coordinate with vendors, collect and move products, ensure proper packing and quality checks, and manage shipments and deliveries.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable travelling locally, coordinating with multiple vendors and delivery partners, and handling products with care.

Key Responsibilities1\. Vendor Coordination

* Coordinate with product and branding vendors for order collection and delivery.
* Follow up with vendors on production status, ready dates, samples and pending items.
* Visit vendors to collect products, samples and finished goods.
* Ensure the correct quantity and product specifications are received.
* Coordinate with the internal team regarding vendor updates and delays.

2\. Packing \& Dispatch

* Manage packing of corporate gifting products and kits.
* Ensure products are packed safely and according to client requirements.
* Check quantities before packing and dispatch.
* Arrange cartons/boxes, tapes, bubble wrap and other packing materials.
* Ensure boxes are properly labelled before dispatch.

3\. Quality Check (QC)

* Conduct basic QC of products received from vendors.
* Check quantity, colour, size, printing/branding, finishing and product damage.
* Identify defective or damaged products and immediately report them to the concerned team.
* Ensure only approved and good\-quality products are packed and dispatched.
* Maintain basic QC records when required.

4\. Porter \& Local Transportation

* Book **Porter / local delivery services** for product movement.
* Coordinate with drivers and delivery partners for pickup and drop.
* Ensure products are safely loaded and delivered.
* Track pickup and delivery status.
* Coordinate multiple pickups from different vendors when required.

5\. Shipping \& Courier Coordination

* Coordinate shipments through courier and logistics partners such as **Blue Dart, DTDC and other shipping companies**.
* Prepare boxes/packages for shipment.
* Ensure shipping labels and delivery details are correct.
* Track shipments and update the internal team.
* Coordinate with the courier team in case of delays, delivery issues or address problems.

6\. Inventory \& Product Handling

* Maintain proper count of products received and dispatched.
* Assist in arranging and organizing stock at the office/warehouse.
* Ensure products are handled carefully to avoid damage.
* Support the team during large\-volume corporate gifting projects and events.

7\. General Field Support

* Travel locally for vendor visits, product collection, deliveries and other operational requirements.
* Support the team during urgent orders and client deliveries.
* Coordinate with the sales and operations team to complete orders within deadlines.
* Take ownership of assigned operational tasks and ensure timely completion.

Required Skills

* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple vendors and delivery partners.
* Basic knowledge of packing and dispatch processes.
* Good attention to detail for QC and quantity checking.
* Ability to work under deadlines and handle urgent requirements.
* Basic knowledge of WhatsApp, Excel/Google Sheets and email.
* Good organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Physically comfortable handling cartons and travelling for vendor visits.
* Should be responsible, punctual and proactive.

Preferred Qualifications

* 1–3 years of experience in **logistics, field operations, warehouse, dispatch, procurement support or corporate gifting**.
* Experience coordinating with vendors and courier/transport partners will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of Bangalore local areas and transportation services is preferred.
* **Two\-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.**

Key Performance Areas (KPI)

* Timely collection of products from vendors.
* Accurate quantity and quality checking.
* On\-time packing and dispatch.
* Proper coordination with Porter/courier partners.
* Minimum damage/loss during product movement.
* Timely updates to the internal team.
* Successful completion of urgent and deadline\-driven orders.

Working Style

This is a **field\-oriented operations role**. The candidate should be comfortable travelling to vendors, handling products, coordinating pickups and deliveries, and supporting the team during high\-volume corporate gifting projects.

title: India Sales Operations Analyst
description:
**Your role at Dynatrace**
--------------------------

The Sales Operations Analyst is a strategic business partner to Sales Leadership, responsible for driving operational excellence, forecast rigor, pipeline health, productivity, and disciplined execution across India region.


Working directly with Regional Vice President of India, Regional Directors, and cross\-functional stakeholders, this role delivers forward\-looking insights, identifies risks and growth opportunities, improves business processes, and supports achievement of revenue objectives. The successful candidate combines strong analytical capability with commercial judgment, executive communication, and independent execution.


**Strategic Business Partnership**

* Act as the primary Sales Operations partner for Sales Leaders in India, supporting strategic planning, operational execution, and business reviews
* Build trusted relationships with RVPs, Regional Directors, sellers, and cross\-functional partners.
* Provide forward\-looking insights and recommendations that improve growth, productivity, and execution discipline
* Influence decisions through clear analysis, commercial judgment, and practical recommendations

**Forecasting and Business Cadence**

* Drive a consistent weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual operating cadence across the region
* Support forecast reviews and proactively identify forecast risk, pipeline gaps, execution challenges, and upside opportunities
* Prepare concise, executive\-ready analyses that help Sales Leadership stay ahead of business issues
* Monitor critical performance indicators and recommend corrective actions where required

**Pipeline and Revenue Analytics**

* Analyze pipeline generation, progression, coverage, conversion, and sales productivity trends
* Translate data into recommendations to improve pipeline quality, velocity, and conversion
* Conduct territory, whitespace, account, and market opportunity analysis
* Support annual planning and go\-to\-market development with accurate, timely, and relevant insights

**Sales Process Excellence**

* Identify operational gaps, process bottlenecks, and performance inconsistencies, and drive resolution
* Promote adherence to sales policies, methodologies, data standards, and operating requirements
* Partner with Finance, Enablement, Marketing, Data, Systems, and other teams to improve seller productivity and business outcomes

**Salesforce, Data, and Systems**

* Independently navigate Salesforce processes, reports, dashboards, and underlying data required for day\-to\-day Sales Operations support
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Sales Operations tools, reporting, and workflows
* Drive data quality, governance, process compliance, and accurate use of sales systems
* Support user adoption and operational training where required

**Operational Ownership and Communication**

* Provide proactive, reliable, and insight\-driven day\-to\-day support with minimal supervision
* Prioritize effectively, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership from issue identification through resolution
* Escalate risks early and appropriately, with clear context, business impact, and recommended action
* Communicate in a clear, timely, and structured manner so Sales Leadership and stakeholders can make informed decisions

**What will help you succeed**
------------------------------

* 6 to 10 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a related function
* Experience supporting enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity, observability, or another high\-growth technology environment
* Strong Salesforce knowledge, including CRM processes, reporting, dashboards, and data quality practices
* Experience with forecasting, pipeline management, territory planning, and sales performance reviews.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capability
* Strong business partnering, problem\-solving, written communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence stakeholders across functions and levels of seniority
* Experience with business intelligence and applying generative AI, automation technologies, and modern productivity tools to support analysis, problem\-solving, and day\-to\-day business operations
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

**Why you will love being a Dynatracer**
----------------------------------------

* Dynatrace is a leader in **unified observability** and **security** .
* We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
* Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
* You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with **Dynatrace Intelligence** —the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
* Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.
**Note to Recruiters and Agencies** : Thank you for your interest in Dynatrace. Please note that **we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes** —do not forward them via our website or directly to Dynatrace employees. Dynatrace will not pay fees for unsolicited resumes, and any resumes received this way will be considered the property of Dynatrace.


**Benefits and work\-life perks**

We offer best\-in\-class core rewards, including paid time off, financial security benefits, retirement savings plans, and health insurance. Beyond that, you’ll get other benefits and work\-life perks designed to make your ride with us even more rewarding.

Our Employee Assistance Program, powered by Telus Health, offers support for you and your family members.

#### **Flexibility**

Our hybrid working model and flexible working hours offer you the flexibility you need.


#### **AI\-driven workflows**

#### **Learn \& develop**

#### **Regular team events**

Our AI\-driven insights cut through the noise, allowing customers to focus on what truly matters by automating manual tasks and resolving issues with pinpoint accuracy. title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**About Hevo**
--------------



DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data\-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc.



We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune\-based company with 2000\+ customers spread across 45\+ countries in e\-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper\-growth!


**Why do we exist?**



At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data\-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.



Hevo Pipeline is a no\-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150\+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.



Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40\+ countries to be more data\-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.


**The Role**
------------



We are growing into mid\-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar \- and the stakes \- are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post\-sale motion to match.



Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart.



As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets.



You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management \- a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


* Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations \- architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior\-level technical engagements.
* Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co\-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
* Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
* Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance \- both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
* Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
* Contribute to internal knowledge \- documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post\-sales team.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------


**Required**


* 6\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role \- Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post\-sale or consulting function.
* Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse\-native transformation (dbt, etc.).
* Demonstrable ability to engage at the architectural level \- not just explain a product, but understand and speak to a customer's data infrastructure.
* Strong communication skills: you can make complex technical ideas clear to both engineers and executives, and you are confident pushing back when a customer's approach is suboptimal.
* Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment with a small team and high autonomy.

**Nice to Have**


* Experience in a pre\-sales or post\-sales SE role at a data infrastructure or SaaS company.
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, compliance, or security requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.

**What You Will Not Be Doing**
------------------------------



This is not a support role, a ticket\-handling role, or a general customer success role. You will not be measured on ticket volume or response SLAs. You will be measured on whether enterprise customers trust Hevo at the technical level \- and whether that trust translates into deeper, longer, larger relationships.


**What We Offer**
-----------------


* Competitive compensation and/or equity.
* Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post\-sale function is built.
* A collaborative, high\-trust environment where technical depth is valued and rewarded.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Enterprise Business Development Manager - APAC
description:
**About Innovatrics**


Innovatrics is a global provider of biometric identity management solutions, delivering fingerprint, face, iris, and multimodal biometric technologies to government and enterprise customers worldwide. The company operates independently with a strong R\&D foundation and a reputation for high NIST\-ranked performance and scalable identity platforms.

**Your Role**


As a Senior Enterprise Business Development Manager for APAC, you will be responsible for building Innovatrics’ enterprise footprint across the region from the ground up.


Unlike mature markets, APAC represents a high\-potential, underpenetrated territory where brand awareness and customer references are still limited. This role is focused on proactive market creation, new logo acquisition, and strategic expansion across key enterprise verticals including financial services, fintech platforms, telecom operators, digital marketplaces, and OEMs.


You will act as a market builder — identifying opportunities, structuring entry strategies, and converting early wins into long\-term regional growth engines.


In a nutshell, you will have to:

* Drive aggressive new business acquisition across APAC.
* Establish anchor enterprise references in priority countries.
* Build structured pipeline from outbound prospecting and ecosystem leverage.
* Develop positioning for identity verification, fraud prevention, and biometric onboarding use cases.
* Develop the region into a scalable revenue contributor over 3–5 years.

  

This is a high\-impact, high\-ownership hunter role — not an account maintenance position.

**Geographic Scope**

* APAC


Travel: 40–60% depending on active programs.

 **Why This Job Is Exciting**


This is a strategic expansion role with full ownership of Innovatrics’ enterprise growth across APAC.


You will lead market creation in a region where digital identity, onboarding, and fraud prevention are accelerating — yet where we are still building our footprint.


Success in this role means transforming a greenfield opportunity into a structured, reference\-backed regional business — with strong executive exposure and long\-term scaling potential.

 **Within one month, you will:**

* Get fully on\-boarded with our Enterprise solutions, platforms, and key tools
* Start building relationships with internal teams—Sales, Solutions, Engineering and Professional Services
* Learn our key customer use cases and industry challenges
* Learn our CRM (Zoho), automation tools, and account segmentation model
* Shadow sales calls and client meetings to understand our approach and customer profiles
* Take ownership of a portfolio of early\-stage enterprise accounts

 **Within three months, you will:**

* Complete a structured market assessment across priority countries (South\-East Asia).
* Define country prioritization and vertical focus (banks, fintech, telcos, digital platforms).
* Map top 30–50 target enterprise accounts.
* Initiate outbound engagement with decision\-makers.
* Align internally with Presales and Product on competitive positioning for LATAM.
* Deliver a 12\-month regional action plan.

 **Within six months, you will:**

* Build a qualified pipeline with clear revenue visibility.
* Conduct executive\-level meetings with key target accounts.
* Advance at least one lighthouse opportunity to late\-stage negotiation.
* Formalize at least one regional ecosystem partnership (SI, fintech integrator, or technology ally).
* Adapt messaging to regional regulatory and fraud landscape specifics.
* Deliver reliable forecast visibility to leadership.

 **Within one year, you will:**

* Secure at least one anchor enterprise customer and build a multi\-quarter pipeline with 3x coverage.
* Establish at least one referenceable customer.
* Demonstrate repeatable outbound motion across at least two priority countries.
* Create structured local case narratives for marketing leverage.
* Build a sustainable pipeline with multi\-quarter coverage.

**About You**


You have repeatedly built enterprise markets from limited brand presence to structured revenue engines. You thrive in greenfield territories where brand awareness is still being built and where success depends on initiative, structure, and persistence.


You understand how to engage C\-level executives, navigate complex enterprise decision cycles, and position high\-impact digital solutions in a way that resonates with business, risk, and technology stakeholders alike.


You are proactive and self\-driven. You do not wait for inbound leads — you create opportunities. You are comfortable building pipeline from scratch, qualifying rigorously, and focusing energy where probability of impact is highest.


You are comfortable competing against well\-established global and regional players and differentiating through technical performance and business value.


You combine strategic thinking with execution discipline. You can define a country entry strategy and, in the same week, lead a negotiation with a priority account.


You operate with autonomy, resilience, and accountability — and you are motivated by building something meaningful, not simply managing an existing book of business.

 **Requirements** **Qualifications**

* University degree in Technology, Engineering, or Business
* 10\+ years of enterprise sales experience in APAC.
* Proven hunter track record in new logo acquisition.
* Experience selling SaaS, identity verification, cybersecurity, or mission\-critical digital solutions.
* Existing network in Identity Industry is desired
* Strong understanding of APAC regulatory and compliance environments.
* Executive presence and negotiation maturity.
* Fluent in English.
* Comfortable working in hybrid/remote setups

  

**Benefits**  

  

Compensation
At Innovatrics, we offer highly competitive salaries because we value top talent focused on creating meaningful impact. Compensation is based on your experience, skills, qualifications, and location.


Compensation will be determined based on your expertise and the value you bring to our network.


This is a high\-impact, high\-ownership role combining market development, partner acquisition, and long\-term revenue growth.


Beyond base pay, we provide an attractive benefits package. You can learn more at https://careers.innovatrics.com/


**Interview Process**
Here is the typical interview process for this role:


Recruiter Screen (30 min)


Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)


Team Interview: Practical Business Case focused on Account Acquisition (60 min)


CARES (30 min)


Reference checks and offer discussion

We are looking for a **Business Development Executive – SFO (Small Fleet Operator) Program** to build and scale our network of small fleet operators in Bangalore.

The role will be responsible for identifying fleet owners and vehicle operators, pitching our vehicle rental/fleet program, negotiating commercials, onboarding vehicles in bulk, and ensuring successful activation and utilization of the fleet.

* Resolve commercial and operational escalations in coordination with internal teams.

* Map the Bangalore fleet ecosystem and maintain a database of fleet owners and operators.
* Track competitor offerings, rental rates, incentives and market practices.
* Identify emerging fleet clusters and new demand pockets.
* Build referral and channel relationships with vehicle dealers, financiers, OEMs, logistics companies and fleet ecosystem partners.

* Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and daily activity tracker.

* New SFOs acquired

* Fleet utilization
* Revenue contribution
* Conversion rate
* Operator retention

* Candidates from other **EV, fleet rental, 3PL, transportation, logistics or commercial vehicle businesses** with similar experience are also encouraged to apply.

**Build Adira Beyond Digital**

Adira is on a mission to make better innerwear accessible to women across every stage of life. From girls and teenagers to mothers, plus\-size women, and seniors, we design products around real\-life needs that are often ignored by the mainstream market.

As a pioneer in women's intimate wear innovation, Adira holds a patent for its period panty and has built a strong customer base through D2C and marketplaces. We are now entering an exciting next phase: taking Adira beyond online channels and building a strong offline and institutional presence across India and international markets.

This role is for someone who wants to build a new business channel from the ground up—not simply manage an existing sales territory.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Offline Expansion \& Institutional Sales Manager to build Adira's offline distribution, institutional sales, B2B, and international B2B markets

You will be responsible for identifying and opening new opportunities across hospitals, schools, colleges, old\-age homes, NGOs, corporates, institutions, specialty retailers, distributors, and other relevant organizations, while also exploring international order opportunities through structured outbound sales.

A major part of this role will involve cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting, networking, business development, and relationship building to create a strong pipeline and convert opportunities into recurring business.

**What You'll Own:**

* Build and execute Adira's offline expansion and institutional sales strategy.
* Identify and develop new B2B and institutional opportunities across India and selected international markets.
* Generate leads through cold calling, cold emailing, LinkedIn outreach, networking, referrals, databases, exhibitions, and industry contacts.
* Develop institutional relationships with hospitals, schools, colleges, old\-age homes, NGOs, corporates, healthcare organizations, and other relevant institutions.
* Identify opportunities for Large\-Volume procurement of Adira products for institutional and organizational requirements.
* Develop relationships with retail outlets, specialty stores, distributors, and regional retail partners.
* Identify and onboard suitable offline distribution and retail partners.
* Build international B2B opportunities and generate Large\-Volume order enquiries from global markets.
* Own the complete sales cycle—from prospecting and first contact to negotiation, order closure, fulfilment coordination, and repeat business.
* Prepare proposals, quotations, presentations, product introductions, and commercial offers for institutional and B2B customers.
* Understand customer requirements and work with internal teams to recommend the right products, sizes, quantities, pricing, and commercial structures.
* Build a strong pipeline and maintain accurate records of prospects, opportunities, follow\-ups, and closures.
* Develop long\-term relationships with key accounts and identify opportunities for recurring orders.
* Track market feedback and identify new categories, customer segments, and geographic opportunities for Adira.
* Represent Adira at exhibitions, trade events, industry forums, and relevant business networking platforms.
* Work closely with Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Customer Experience teams to ensure smooth execution of institutional and offline orders.

**What We're Looking For:**

We're looking for someone who is hungry to build, confident in approaching strangers, persistent with follow\-ups, and comfortable creating opportunities rather than waiting for them.

**You should have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in B2B Sales, Institutional Sales, Business Development, Offline Expansion, Distribution, or Key Account Management.
* Strong experience in cold calling, cold emailing, outbound prospecting, and lead generation.
* Proven experience opening new accounts and building business from a cold pipeline.
* Experience selling to institutions, hospitals, schools, NGOs, corporates, retailers, distributors, or similar organizations.
* Experience handling Large\-Volume orders and commercial negotiations.
* International B2B sales or export business development experience is a strong advantage.
* Strong understanding of CRM, sales pipelines, lead tracking, and follow\-up processes.
* Excellent negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship\-building skills.
* High resilience, ownership, and ability to work independently.
* A strong commercial mindset with a clear focus on revenue generation.

**Why This Role Is Exciting:**

This is an opportunity to be one of the people building Adira's next growth engine.

You won't be inheriting a mature offline business. You'll be creating it.

You'll have the opportunity to take an Indian women's intimate wear brand into institutions, retail networks, communities, and international markets, while helping solve real problems for women who are often underserved by traditional retail.

For someone who loves sales, networking, deal\-making, opening doors, and building something from zero to one, this role offers enormous ownership and visibility.

**Key Success Measures:**

* New Institutional Accounts Acquired
* New Retail/Distribution Partners Onboarded
* Monthly B2B / Institutional Revenue
* Offline Revenue Growth
* International Order Revenue
* Qualified Leads Generated

* Average Order Value

* New Markets / Geographies Opened

We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

You’ll play a key role in solving real\-world challenges. You’ll apply your skills to deliver results that matter whether that’s through engineering, planning or customer support. You’ll work with purpose, learn every day and help shape a more sustainable future.

**What you’ll do**

* Sales Leadership: Drive capital equipment sales within the assigned region, focusing on Enduron High Pressure Grinding Rolls, Enduron Optimil, and integrated future\-ready flowsheet solutions. Lead marketing, sales, and strategic initiatives to expand market presence.
* Customer Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong multi\-level relationships with customers, engineering firms, consultants, contractors, and asset owners in the mining and minerals processing sectors. Act as the primary interface between customers and commercial teams locally and overseas.
* Market Analysis \& Business Development: Analyze market trends to identify new business opportunities and support quotation processes in collaboration with technical teams. Translate customer inquiries into viable technology solutions.
* Sales Cycle \& Contract Negotiations: Manage the sales cycle end\-to\-end, including contract negotiations, ensuring successful deal closures and market share growth.
* Collaboration \& Reporting: Work closely with Weir Minerals India management and sales network. Maintain accurate reporting through CRM updates, call reports, market plans, and personal business plans.
* Travel: Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory to customer sites.
**What you’ll bring**

**Must\-haves:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Mineral Processing.
* Minimum 5 years of sales experience, preferably in capital equipment or mining industry.
* Strong communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
* Proven ability to build customer relationships and secure deals with a goal\-oriented, persistent, and professional approach.
**Nice\-to\-haves:**  

* Background in mining or mineral processing industry.
* Experience with CRM and ERP systems.
* Ability to mentor and develop sales skills in a growing team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze market trends and identify new business opportunities.
**Why join Weir?**  

We live our values — we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.  

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world\-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end\-to\-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.  

We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

**Benefits**  

* Career development and learning support
* Access to global inclusion networks
* Regional and team\-specific benefits
* Sharebuilder scheme
* Wellness support for you and your family

FIXED SALARY ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month

Performance incentives are paid over and above the fixed salary

What sets us apart: AI workflows are core to how we deliver from automated audits and reporting to AI\-driven creative testing and predictive budget allocation — not an afterthought.**The Role**
============


This is a leadership role for someone who can own the paid media and ABM motion end\-to\-end — strategy, execution quality, client relationships and outcomes. You'll be the strategic lead on a book of high\-value SaaS accounts, orchestrating full\-funnel LinkedIn and ABM programs alongside search and paid social, while raising the delivery bar for the specialists around you.**This is not a run\-the\-playbook role.** You'll build the playbook, improve it with AI, and own pipeline and retention across your accounts.**What You'll Own**
===================

**Strategy \& ABM Orchestration**
---------------------------------

* **Full\-funnel strategy:** own the paid media \+ ABM plan for each account — channel mix across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Bing, and emerging channels, mapped to pipeline and revenue goals.
* **ABM motions:** build and validate ICP account lists (Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo, intent signals) and design 1:1, 1:Few and 1:Many programs tied to funnel stage and sales handover criteria.
* **Warm\-then\-outreach:** coordinate paid media with outbound / SDR sequences so target accounts are engaged before sales touches them; define multi\-touch attribution across paid and outbound.

**Paid Media Execution \& Quality**
-----------------------------------

* **Channel depth:** set the bar on Google (Search, PMax, YouTube, Demand Gen), LinkedIn (all ad formats \+ ABM targeting), Meta and Bing — bidding strategy, audience signals, conversion tracking and creative testing.
* **Pipeline\-first optimization:** think in CPL, CP\-SQL, CP\-Opportunity, ROAS and pipeline efficiency — connect ad platform data to CRM/revenue data and reallocate budget on what actually drives outcomes.
* **Pacing \& forecasting:** own monthly pacing, spend forecasting and budget allocation across your book with no surprise over\- or under\-spend.

**Client Leadership \& Retention**
----------------------------------

* **Strategic lead:** run weekly client calls and monthly/quarterly reviews with data\-backed insight and clear next steps; be the trusted advisor stakeholders lean on.
* **Retain \& expand:** drive 12\+ month retention through results and stakeholder trust, and surface expansion / cross\-sell opportunities within accounts.
* **Executive reporting:** deliver CFO\-ready reporting that ties spend to pipeline and revenue influenced.

**AI\-Driven Workflows**
------------------------

* **Daily AI use:** use Claude and other AI tools daily for ad copy, SQR analysis, keyword and audience research, competitor intelligence and data interpretation.
* **Build the system:** contribute to and improve TDD's AI workflow playbooks, prompt libraries and internal tooling (audits, anomaly alerts, creative\-fatigue detection, ABM reporting).
* **Prove efficiency:** automate repetitive operations and show measurable time savings across the pod.

**Team Enablement**
-------------------

* **Raise the craft:** mentor and QA the work of paid media specialists in the pod — campaign structure, experimentation discipline and reporting accuracy.
* **Operational rigour:** keep ClickUp hygiene, experiment documentation and escalation discipline tight; speed and rigour coexist.

**Who You Are — Non\-Negotiables**
==================================

* **5–8 years** of hands\-on B2B SaaS paid media experience with real budget responsibility.
* **Deep LinkedIn \+ ABM experience** — account list building, intent/firmographic targeting, and full\-funnel LinkedIn programs — plus strong Google Ads depth.
* **Pipeline\-first thinking** — you've worked where leads don't matter, pipeline and revenue do, and you can trace a click to a closed deal.
* **HubSpot and/or Salesforce fluency** for CRM, funnel tracking and attribution.
* **Active daily AI use** (Claude, ChatGPT or equivalent) for real work — not curiosity, application.
* **Strong English communication** — you'll lead calls with US/EU/APAC SaaS teams — and comfort with fast pace, ambiguity and high ownership.

**Strong Plusses**
------------------

* ABM platform experience (6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) and intent tooling (G2, Bombora, Clearbit, ZoomInfo).
* Experience coordinating paid media with outbound/SDR sequences (Apollo, Outreach).
* Prior pod\-lead / team\-lead experience, or a clear track record of mentoring.
* Exposure to building AI agents or prompt engineering for PPC/ABM workflows.

**Why Join Us**
===============

* **AI at the core.** You'll work with and help build an AI\-native paid media stack: automated audits, anomaly alerts, creative\-fatigue detection and ABM reporting\- not manual grunt work.
* **Global SaaS as your canvas.** Work with fast\-moving SaaS brands scaling to $100M\+ ARR across the US, EU and APAC.
* **Real ownership.** You own strategy, clients and outcomes — not a slice of someone else's playbook.
* **Partner\-grade credibility.** Google Premier, HubSpot Platinum and LinkedIn Corporate Partner status behind you.
* **Clear growth path.** A leadership role with a visible trajectory toward pod and department leadership.
* **Performance\-first culture.** Transparent, high\-ownership, experiment\-driven — speed and rigour coexist.
